You sit down at their table wearing the one who didn't come home, his face, his voice, the way he held his cup, and they cry with joy and fuss over you and tell you everything you want to know while you smile his smile.
[Trait: Polymorph Mimic]

abilities.name: Aurora Veil
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap your allies in a veil of shifting light; foes struggle to see or target them for a few turns.

Your wings throw out the colours of the northern lights, rippling green and violet, and you sweep them over your friends and the colours cling, wrapping them in curtains of shifting light, and when the enemy looks for them all they can see is a glow that slides away from their eyes no matter how hard they stare.
[Trait: Pixie Aurora]

abilities.name: Bad Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: your hits poison; a poisoned foe takes poison damage each turn and gets weaker for the rest of the fight.
There's a sour taste in your mouth before every blow now and your sweat smells wrong, and wherever you hit them the skin goes dark and tight round the mark and spreads in thin lines along the veins, and they feel it, the heaviness in the arms, the shake in the knees, the fight draining out of them one beat of their heart at a time.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Bad Blood]

abilities.name: Bad Luck Charms
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every charm and ward against curses; you can break one curse on an ally, or see straight through a ward.

You pick up the little charm they've been wearing to keep you away and laugh, and turn it over, and you know every trick in it, who made it, what it's for, and how to undo it, and you undo it, and the curse they've been carrying falls off them.
[Trait: Hollow Hill Hexqueen]

abilities.name: Bait and Switch
abilities.info:
What it does: draw a foe's attack onto something else, a decoy, an ally of theirs or the scenery; the hit meant for you lands there instead.

You make a show of being right there for them and at the last second you're not, and what they swing at is the post you were standing in front of, or their own friend, or a pile of rocks that comes down on them, and you're laughing from somewhere else.
[Trait: Trained Trick IV]

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.info:
What it does: throw a crackling ball of lightning that drifts toward foes for three turns, shocking each one it touches.
You cup your hands and it grows there, a ball of crackling light that hums and spits, and you let it go and it drifts out across the fight, slow and wandering, and everywhere it touches someone it bangs and they go stiff and fall.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Ball Lightning]

abilities.name: Bar the Doors
abilities.info:
What it does: your howl means death; foes who hear it are frightened, fight badly and may flee for a few turns.

You howl from somewhere they can't see and they all know what it means, the old stories come back to them all at once, and their hands shake and their eyes keep going to the dark, and the weak ones break and run for any door they can bar.
[Trait: Barghest]

abilities.name: Barbed Soul
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight, whatever hits you up close takes a wound back; the harder it hits, the worse it gets.

Your soul bristles, you feel it push up under your skin in rows of hidden points, and the first thing to touch you in anger screams, its own blow tearing back into it, claws and knuckles and teeth coming away bloody from a body that looks no different, and the harder it swings the deeper it bites.
[Trait: Thorn Soul]

abilities.name: Bare Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: go without breath, food, water or sleep for a long time without weakening; you can't drown, starve or suffocate for days.

Your chest stops moving and you don't notice, your belly stops asking and you don't notice, and you just keep going, through the smoke, under the water, through the night and the next one, the cold blue spark in your eyes never dimming, while everybody else lies down in the dirt and begs for a rest.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Bare Bones]

abilities.name: Bark an Order
abilities.info:
What it does: give one ally a clear order: they act on it at once and do it better.

You snap it out short and loud over everything, one word with the full weight of your chest behind it, and they move before they've had time to think about it, exactly where you meant, exactly when, and it works.
[Trait: Trained Command I]

abilities.name: Bark Shell
abilities.info:
What it does: you curl behind a shell of bark; blows glance off you for a turn or two while you can't attack.

You drop and curl in on yourself and the bark on your shoulders spreads with a long creak, thick ridged plates sliding over your back and head and closing tight, and their blows thud off your bark, jarring their arms to the elbow, while you sit inside your shell breathing slow and waiting for them to tire.
[Trait: Barkhide Bear]

abilities.name: Bark Skin
abilities.info:
What it does: harden your skin to bark when a blow comes in: that hit is turned aside.

Your skin creaks and goes rough and dark and furrowed, ridges of bark closing over each other where the hit's about to land, and it thunks into wood, splinters flying, and you just look down at the scar and back up at them, slow, the way a tree looks at anything that thinks it's in a hurry.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Bark Skin]

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.info:
What it does: throw up a barricade across a passage or gap: foes must break it down before they can get through.

Everything not fixed down goes into it, and some things that were, piled and wedged and lashed together with whatever rope there is, and you're still jamming the last bits in when they arrive and find a wall where the way through used to be.
[Trait: Trained Build III]

abilities.name: Basilisk Gaze
abilities.info:
Lock eyes with a foe and turn their limbs heavy and grey.
[Trait: Soul of the Basilisk]

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a wall your allies shelter behind; attacks can't reach them past you this turn.

You plant yourself in the breach and lock your stone wings out wide, and you are the wall, and everything they throw breaks on you, rocks and fire and charging bodies, and behind you your friends catch their breath in perfect shelter.
[Trait: Gargoyle Bastion]

abilities.name: Battle Plan
abilities.info:
What it does: set out a plan before a fight: for the whole fight your allies know their places and act together.

You crouch and draw it in the dirt with a claw while they all lean in, who goes where, who goes first, where to fall back to when it goes bad, and they nod, every one of them, and when the fight starts nobody stops to ask anybody anything.
[Trait: Trained Command V]

abilities.name: Bearkin Maul
abilities.info:
A crushing swipe that knocks a foe flat.
[Trait: Soul of the Bearkin]

abilities.name: Become Nothing
abilities.info:
What it does: for a while nothing can notice you as long as you don't attack: you walk among foes, past guards and through camps unseen.

You let yourself go flat and grey and empty, nothing worth looking at, and you walk right through the middle of them, past the guards, past the fire, close enough to touch, and their eyes go over you like you're the floor.
[Trait: Trained Stalk V]

abilities.name: Become the Power
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns your body turns into your power itself: blows pass through or burn on you, and everything you touch takes your power.

You stop holding it in and let it take you, and your skin goes, and your hair, and you're made of it now, all of you, and they hit you and their hands go into it.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VII]

abilities.name: Become What I Ate
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the form and power of something you digested for a while.

You reach down into your glowing core and pick one, a troll you ate three summers ago, and pull it up into yourself, and your jelly body bulges and stretches and hardens into its shape, green skin, long arms, wounds closing as they open, a dead thing's body and power wrapped around your own.
[Trait: Soul Slime]

abilities.name: Before the Monsters
abilities.info:
What it does: you remember the world before the dungeon opened; you know the true history of one place, ruin or thing.

You close your eyes and go back, slow, past every age, to before any of them came up out of the ground, and you tell it as it was, what this place really was and who built it and why, in a voice like wind through old leaves.
[Trait: Deep Wood Elder]

abilities.name: Before They Ask
abilities.info:
What it does: you answer a creature's question before they ask it; they're unsettled and believe whatever you say next.

They open their mouth and you answer before they've said a word, exactly what they were going to ask, and they shut their mouth again and stare at you, and after that whatever you tell them they believe, because how could you possibly be wrong.
[Trait: Gazer Oracle]

abilities.name: Bells All Night
abilities.info:
What it does: bells and noise can't save them; foes who try to drown out your crow find it louder.

They ring their bells and beat their drums and scream at the sky to drown you out, and you just crow louder, and it comes straight through all their noise like it isn't there, and the ringing stops one bell at a time.
[Trait: Last Dawn Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Belly Up
abilities.info:
What it does: you taste water and know what poisoned it, where it came from and how to cure it, or how to poison it worse.

You dip one of your heads down and taste it and you know, the whole story of it, what died in it upstream and what was put in it and by whom, and how to make it clean again, and how to make it much, much worse.
[Trait: Plague Hydra]

abilities.name: Bend the Knee
abilities.info:
What it does: one weaker monster, or a mob of them, backs down, flees or obeys one short order for the scene; anything as strong as you or stronger shrugs it off and takes it as a challenge.

You let it out quietly, your soul rolling off you heavy and slow until the air is thick enough to choke on, and the small things in front of you go quiet, ears flat, tails down, eyes sliding away from yours as their knees buckle and their arms sag, and the bravest of them lasts the longest, shaking, before it bows its head with the rest.
[Trait: Crown Soul]

abilities.name: Big Swing
abilities.info:
You swing anything heavy through a crowd.
[Trait: Ogre]

abilities.name: Big Talk
abilities.info:
What it does: talk yourself up so a group of creatures takes you far more seriously than they should.

You tell them who you are and everything you've done, every word of it bigger than the truth, every scar you've got coming with a story twice its size, and they look at each other and decide not to find out if you're lying.
[Trait: Trained Talk IV]

abilities.name: Binding Contract
abilities.info:
What it does: you make a promise binding on both sides; whoever breaks it suffers for it.

You both sign in blood, yours and theirs, and the ink glows red on the paper and then on their palm, a little brand, and it binds them, and if they ever break it they'll find out what the burning is for.
[Trait: Imp Dealmaker]

abilities.name: Binding Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing one foe into stillness; they can't act while the song holds.

You sing and they stop, mid-step, mid-swing, mid-word, their face slackening, dreamy and still, and they just stand there listening with their eyes half closed, swaying a little, while you walk up to them and do whatever you like.
[Trait: Siren Charmer]

abilities.name: Binding Stare
abilities.info:
What it does: you catch a weak foe's eye; they do as you say for a short while.

You rise up on your coils until you're looking down on them, and you hold their eyes, and you don't blink, not once, and something in them gives way, and when you tell them to put down what they're holding they do it, and when you tell them to kneel they do that too, smiling, their eyes empty as a well.
[Trait: Lamia Charmer]

abilities.name: Bird on a Branch
abilities.info:
What it does: you go so still that nothing notices you, not even animals; you're mistaken for part of the land until you move.

You settle and go still, stiller than still, and a bird lands on your arm and preens, and a beast walks right past you sniffing, and the scouts walk past you too, and none of them ever know you were there.
[Trait: Mantid Grand Abbot]

abilities.name: Bite Down
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns pain doesn't slow you: wounds don't weaken your attacks or your checks until the fight ends.

You grind your teeth together until your jaw aches and lock all of it away somewhere deep, the cuts, the burns, the bone grinding in your side, and you fight on like none of it happened.
[Trait: Trained Endure V]

abilities.name: Black Clouds
abilities.info:
What it does: the black clouds that mean you're singing gather; foes who see them are frightened and look for shelter instead of fighting.

The clouds come up black on the horizon and every sailor alive knows what they mean, and they stop fighting and start looking for shore, for shelter, for anything, because they know who's singing and what she does.
[Trait: Black Squall Siren]

abilities.name: Black Death
abilities.info:
What it does: you bring a plague down on a whole place; it spreads from body to body and weakens or kills those who catch it unless it is cured.

You walk in among them in daylight with your rags trailing and nobody needs touching, it's enough to walk past them, the fleas spilling off your hem behind you, and by nightfall the first ones are burning with fever, by the second day the black swellings come up under their arms and the screaming starts behind every closed door, families dragging their own sick out into the open and barring the way back in, mothers begging at the gates, the carts of dead stacked higher every morning, until the bells stop ringing because there's nobody left to ring them.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-King]

abilities.name: Black Fen
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn the land around you into poisoned bog; foes in it sink, sicken and are poisoned for the rest of the fight.

You rise up out of your bog and the bog comes with you, spreading across the solid ground, grass rotting black in an instant, earth turning to sucking poisoned mud, and they're trapped in it up to the knees and sinking, the venom soaking through their boots and into their skin, begging the ones behind them to pull them out as they watch their own legs blister and blacken.
[Trait: Black Fen Hydra]

abilities.name: Black Fever
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe is poisoned so deep it takes heavy poison damage each turn for four turns, and if it dies of it the fever passes to the nearest foe.
It doesn't look like much at first, a touch, a breath, nothing, then the sweat comes, then the shivers, then their gums go dark and their nails lift and they're clawing at their own skin begging somebody to make it stop, and when they finally drop the fever is already in the next one, burning behind their eyes, the poison itself choosing who's next.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Black Fever]

abilities.name: Black Squall
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a killing storm; everything on the water or in the open is battered, drowned and struck down.

You sing the black squall and the sky goes dark as midnight in the middle of the day, the wind rising to a scream, the sea standing up in black walls taller than any mast, and it falls on the fleet, and the fleet is gone, every ship, every sail, every sailor, swallowed by the sea while your song goes on above the storm.
[Trait: Black Squall Siren]

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.info:
What it does: you dance through a group of foes, striking each one you pass, and come out the far side unharmed.

You spin onto your toes and move to music only you can hear, a turn, a duck, a leap over a low sweep, claws long as daggers flashing out on every beat, and you pass through them, never stopping, never quite where they swing, and when you finally step out the other side and turn to face them, they're all still standing there for a moment before the lines on them open up.
[Trait: Catfolk Bladedancer]

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a storm of wind-cuts over a whole field; every foe in it is cut again and again for a few turns.

You rise up over the field and the wind rises with you, black clouds piling up and churning, and then the storm breaks and it doesn't rain water, it rains cuts, a howling downpour of wind slicing over everything below again and again, and there's no cover from it, nowhere to crawl, just the wind and the cutting.
[Trait: Tempest Mantid]

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.info:
What it does: bless your allies for three turns: they hit a little harder and the dark can't frighten them.
You speak a few quiet words and the light settles over them like a warm cloak, and they stand a little straighter, and the fear that was crawling up their backs just stops.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Blessing]

abilities.name: Blight Touch
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread rot through what you touch; one foe or object rots, weakening and hurting them each turn for a while.

You lay a black-barked hand on them, gently, and nothing happens, and they laugh, and the next morning there's a bruise there, and the morning after the bruise is soft, and by the third day they can push a thumb right into it and it doesn't hurt at all, and it stinks of rot.
[Trait: Blightwood]

abilities.name: Blinding Speed
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you move twice as fast as anyone around you: you act first, cover twice the ground and are much harder to hit.

Everything slows down around you, the swings coming at you like they're moving through water, the shouts drawn out long and low, and you go between them with all the time in the world, here, there, gone, while they turn their heads after you a beat too late every time.
[Trait: Trained Strike IV]

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a blizzard over the area; foes are blinded, slowed and frozen for a few turns.

The air turns bitter around you and you breathe out long and hard, and the breath becomes a wind, and the wind becomes a howling white blizzard swallowing everything you can see, snow driving sideways so thick they can't see their own feet, fingers freezing to their gear, and you walk through it untouched, the only thing in the storm that knows where everyone is.
[Trait: Frost Ogre]

abilities.name: Blood Feast
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain several foes at once; each is hurt and you heal from all of them.

You open your arms and the blood comes out of them, pulled through the skin of every foe near you in fine red threads, all of it streaming into you, and you swell and swell, red and gorged, while they grey and wither and drop to their knees.
[Trait: Blood Fiend]

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.info:
What it does: you grow faster as you drink; each foe you bite this fight makes you quicker and stronger.

The first bite tastes of copper and fire and you feel it, faster, stronger, and the second bite you're even quicker, and by the third you're a red blur moving through them so fast they can't even see you, just feel the teeth, and each one you drain feeds the next.
[Trait: Vampire Slayer-Fiend]

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe and hang on; your bite grows stronger the more they bleed.

You smell it before you see it, a cut on their arm, a bloody nose, and the shark in your blood wakes up hungry, your heavy jaw dropping open on row after row of new teeth, and you lunge and clamp down and start shaking, and every drop that hits your tongue makes you bite harder and shake harder until you're not even thinking anymore, just tearing.
[Trait: Crocodile-Blooded]

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.info:
What it does: while you are hurt, every hit you land grows harder the more you bleed and pain stops slowing you until the fight ends; when it ends, every wound comes due at once.

The first cut barely registers, the second makes you laugh, and by the third the blood's running down into your eyes and the world's gone narrow and red and simple, just the next one in front of you and the next, your arms swinging heavier every time something tears you open, and you don't feel any of it, not one wound, right up until there's nobody left standing and every single one of them arrives at once.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Blood Fury]

abilities.name: Blood in the Water
abilities.info:
What it does: you frenzy; every bite lands harder while blood is in the water, for the rest of the fight.

One cut opens on someone somewhere and you smell it from a long way off, and the frenzy takes you, your eyes rolling back white, your jaws snapping at anything, faster and faster and harder, every bite tearing bigger chunks, deaf to everything but the next mouthful of blood.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Sea-Wolf]

abilities.name: Blood Lunge
abilities.info:
What it does: you lunge and bite one foe; they're hurt and you heal a little from their blood.

You're perfectly still in a patch of shadow and then you're not, a blur through the gloom faster than an eye can follow, and your fangs are in their neck before they've finished turning round, and you drink, a long hot swallow, and feel the strength flood into you.
[Trait: Vampire Hunter-Fiend]

abilities.name: Blood on the Wind
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day you know where every wounded creature within a long way is, and how badly it's hurt.

The wind brings it to you all day, every hurt thing for miles, the deer with the broken leg, the scout dragging a torn leg, the beast licking its side, all of them shining in your head.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VI]

abilities.name: Blood Pack
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a pack of blood-wolves; they come and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You give one long rising howl, and out of the dark woods come the red eyes, a dozen pairs, twenty, more, great grey wolves with blood on their muzzles, and they circle round you snarling, and when you lunge they lunge with you.
[Trait: Blood Wolf Lord]

abilities.name: Blood Pool
abilities.info:
What it does: you pool darkness on the ground that drains everyone standing in it; they weaken each turn while you heal.

You spread out across the floor in a pool of red-black darkness, and they're standing in it before they notice, and then they notice, the cold coming up through their boots, the blood starting to bead on their skin and drip down into the pool, and they can't step out of it, their feet stuck fast.
[Trait: Blood Night Shade]

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.info:
What it does: the more you're hurt the harder you hit; for the rest of the fight your wounds feed your strength and pain stops slowing you.

The first cut opens across your arm and you look down at it and laugh, and something red comes up behind your eyes, the veins in your neck standing out thick and purple, foam on your tusks, and every wound after that only makes it worse, every hit you take poured straight back into the next swing, until you're a howling, bleeding thing that won't stop and can't feel and has forgotten it ever knew how to be afraid.
[Trait: Orc Berserker]

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.info:
What it does: while blood is flowing near you, you grow faster and stronger every turn and bite deeper, until the fight ends.

The first blood hits the water and something in you snaps and you go mad with it, rolling your eyes back white, biting at everything in reach, quicker every time you taste more of it, harder, wilder, your jaws working in a frenzy that doesn't care what it's biting as long as it bleeds.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Blood Rush]

abilities.name: Blood Scent
abilities.info:
You smell blood across a bay.
[Trait: Sharkfolk]

abilities.name: Blood Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: smell blood from far off, in water or air, and follow it to its source; you always know who is bleeding nearby.

One drop and you've got it, your head snapping round, nostrils flaring, the whole world narrowing down to that thread of copper hanging in the water, and you're already moving, cutting through it with your eyes going flat and black, and they never know how you found them so fast.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Blood Sense]

abilities.name: Blood Sip
abilities.info:
What it does: you sip blood from a foe to mend your own wounds.

You dart in on your little wings and latch on to their neck with your long fangs and suck, quick greedy gulps, and they're swatting at you and you're already gone, licking your lips, your own cuts closing over pink while they clap a hand to the bleeding holes.
[Trait: Blood Imp]

abilities.name: Blood Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain several foes in a red whirl; each is hurt and you heal from them all.

You go through them in a red blur, from one throat to the next to the next, a bite, a drink, gone, and they're falling behind you clutching at their necks, and you come out the other side flushed and glowing with your mouth dripping and your wounds all closed.
[Trait: Vampire Blood-Reaver]

abilities.name: Blood Taste
abilities.info:
What it does: draw strength from fresh blood: biting or drinking blood heals you and makes you stronger for a while.

The smell of it hits you first, warm and copper and alive, and your teeth ache, and when you get it in your mouth it's like the first sip of something strong, the warmth running down into your chest and out into your arms, your wounds knitting, your eyes going bright, and you have to make yourself stop.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Blood Taste]

abilities.name: Blood Wing Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike and drink in one pass; one foe is hurt and you heal from them.

You dive on them on red wings and rake them open as you pass, and your mouth is on the wound before you're gone, a long hot swallow, and you climb back into the air flushed and fat and stronger while they stagger below with a hole in them.
[Trait: Blood Devil]

abilities.name: Bloody but Standing
abilities.info:
What it does: when a blow would drop you, you stay on your feet with a sliver of health left; once a fight.

It should have put you down and everybody knows it, the crack, the blood, your knees going, and then they don't go, you lock them and straighten up, swaying, bleeding, and look at whoever did it and smile with red teeth.
[Trait: Trained Endure IV]

abilities.name: Blot Out the Stars
abilities.info:
What it does: you climb up into the night and vanish against it; you can't be seen while you're above them in the dark.

You climb and climb until you're up among the stars and you spread yourself out across them, and they go out one by one behind you, and down below they look up and see nothing but a patch of sky with no stars in it, and don't know they're looking at you.
[Trait: Night-Weaver]

abilities.name: Blot Out the Sun
abilities.info:
What it does: swallow all the light in a wide area for three turns: foes in it are blinded, frightened and drained a little each turn.
The light goes out of the world, all of it, not slow but at once, like a hand closing over the sun, and in the dark the only sound is them panicking, and the dark itself presses in on them, cold and heavy, taking a little more of them every breath.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Blot Out the Sun]

abilities.name: Blur
abilities.info:
What it does: blur from where you stand to anywhere close by in an instant, and strike as you arrive.

One moment you're over there and the next there's just a smear in the air where you were and you're beside them already, too fast for the eye to follow the bit in between, and the hit lands before they've worked out which way to look.
[Trait: Trained Strike VI]

abilities.name: Boarding Raid
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a raid onto a ship or shore; you and your crew board it and strike hard together.

Your ship slides up alongside theirs in the fog and the grappling lines go over, and your crew pours across the rail with their teeth bared, and you're at the front of them, the first onto the deck, snarling, and the crew of the other ship falls back before your reavers.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Corsair]

abilities.name: Boarfolk Gore
abilities.info:
Charge and drive tusks into a foe.
[Trait: Soul of the Boarfolk]

abilities.name: Bog Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you rise out of a bog or marsh to strike a foe who never knew you were there; your first strike lands hard.

There's nothing in that bog but black water and bubbles and the stink of rot, they'd swear to it, and they stroll past the mossy hump at the edge of the path, and the hump opens its eyes, and you surge up out of the muck in a spray of filth and slime with your claws already swinging.
[Trait: Bog Troll]

abilities.name: Boiling Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: you come up from below and the ground boils for a few turns; foes standing on it are burned each turn.

You rise up toward the surface and the ground above you boils, steam and mud and heat bubbling up out of it for a mile around, and anything standing on it hops and screams with its feet burning.
[Trait: Deep Fire Wyrm]

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.info:
What it does: throw a quick blast of your power at one foe at range: a light hit of your power's kind.

You snap your arm out and it leaves your hand in a quick hard bolt that crosses the space between you and hits them in the middle and knocks them back a step.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke I]

abilities.name: Bone Armour
abilities.info:
What it does: the bone over your skull and shoulders takes every hit for a few turns; blows to your front do almost nothing.

You tuck your head down and the thick bone over your skull and shoulders takes all of it, the blows, the bites, the blasts, everything thumping off it like rain on a roof, and you just keep your head down and push forward.
[Trait: Boarfolk Juggernaut]

abilities.name: Bone Bolt
abilities.info:
What it does: you fling a shard of bone at one foe; it strikes hard and splinters in the wound.

You point your bone staff and a rib pulls itself out of the nearest corpse with a crack and floats up glowing green, and you flick your fingers and it flies, spinning, and punches into them and splinters inside, and they go down clutching at a wound full of sharp bone fragments.
[Trait: Bone Mage]

abilities.name: Bone Breaker
abilities.info:
What it does: a heavy blow aimed at a limb: on a good hit the limb is broken and that foe fights badly with it for the rest of the fight.

You watch for the arm they lean on and the moment it's out you bring everything down on it, and there's a crack that everybody hears, and the limb bends somewhere it never should, and their scream turns into a whimper as they try to hold it still.
[Trait: Trained Fight III]

abilities.name: Bone Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a cloud of grave-dust and embers; foes in it are burned and choked.

Your drake-skull jaws creak open and you exhale, and what comes out is dry and grey and full of sparks, grave-dust and old ash and glowing embers in a choking cloud, and they're coughing and burning at once, eyes streaming, throats raw, spitting black.
[Trait: Draconic Bones]

abilities.name: Bone Cast
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw the bones and read one danger before it arrives, where it will come from and roughly when.

The knucklebones rattle in your fist, you blow on them and throw them in the dirt, and for a heartbeat the noise around you falls away and they lie there in a shape only you can read, an ambush in the gully, a knife at the next fire, close enough now that you can almost smell it coming.
[Trait: Gnoll Bone-Seer]

abilities.name: Bone Reading
abilities.info:
Read a skeleton's bones and know how it died and roughly when; the next lore action about the dead is stronger.
[Trait: The Quiet Council: Bone Clerk]

abilities.name: Bone Wings
abilities.info:
What it does: you fly on bone wings, carrying you over obstacles and out of reach.

Your bone wings creak open with no skin on them at all and somehow they catch the air, and you lift off rattling and clattering into the sky, wind whistling through your ribs, and you fly over the heads of the living with your empty skull grinning down at them.
[Trait: Bone Drake]

abilities.name: Bone-Calling
abilities.info:
Throw the bones and read where the weak ones are; the next instinct action to find easy prey is stronger.
[Trait: The Laughing Pack: Bone-Caller]

abilities.name: Bones and Dust
abilities.info:
What it does: your warband strips a beaten camp or field bare in moments; you and your allies recover health and take whatever was worth taking.

You give the nod and the warband falls on what's left like locusts, laughing, tearing, carrying off everything that isn't nailed down and everything that is, and by the time you've finished your meal there's nothing left on the ground but bones and dust.
[Trait: Gnoll Warmaster]

abilities.name: Book of Skin
abilities.info:
What it does: you look up a name in your book; you learn what that creature owes, to whom, and its weaknesses.

You open the book of skin and run your claw down the names until you find it, and there it all is, written in your own hand, what they owe, who else they owe, what they promised, and what they're most afraid of losing.
[Trait: Contract Devil]

abilities.name: Bore
abilities.info:
You grind a tunnel through soft rock.
[Trait: Rockworm]

abilities.name: Borrowed Face
abilities.info:
What it does: you take another's face, voice and look for a while; others believe you are them.

You look at them for a long moment, memorising, then pass a hand down over your own face and your features smear away under your palm, and when your hand drops it's their face looking back at them, every scar, every freckle, and you smile their smile and walk away to go and live their life for an afternoon.
[Trait: Fox Deceiver]

abilities.name: Borrowed Instinct
abilities.info:
What it does: for one action you call up a kept soul's instinct, its senses, its tricks, its fear, and act as if you were born that race.

You reach into the crowd of souls in you and pick one, and your body answers before your head does, nostrils flaring to read the air, weight dropping low to the ground, eyes reading the room through someone else's fear, and for that one breath you move as if you were born to it, and then it's gone and you're yourself again, mostly.
[Trait: Mirror Soul]

abilities.name: Boss's Word
abilities.info:
Speak as a boss of Delvers' Rest: monsters of the town do what you say for a scene unless it gets them killed.
[Trait: The Big Table: Boss]

abilities.name: Bottled Souls
abilities.info:
What it does: you open a soul bottle from your shelf; you spend a stored soul for a favour, a secret or a burst of power.

You take one of the little glass bottles down off the shelf and hold it up to the light and pop the stopper, and the soul inside comes out in a curl of glowing smoke, and you spend it, on whatever you need, while it screams very quietly.
[Trait: Devil Broker]

abilities.name: Boulder Hurl
abilities.info:
What it does: you rip up a boulder and hurl it; the foe it hits is crushed and those near them knocked down.

You dig your fingers into the hillside and pull, and a boulder the size of a cart rips out of the earth with roots and dirt raining off it, and you lift it over your head, grunting, and heave it, and it sails over their heads turning lazily in the air while they stand there gawping up at it until it lands.
[Trait: Mountain Troll]

abilities.name: Boulder Toss
abilities.info:
What it does: rip up a boulder, a log or a body and hurl it: whatever it lands on is flattened and anyone near the impact is knocked off their feet.

You squat and get your fingers under it and heave, veins standing out across your neck, the ground cracking as it comes loose with clods of dirt still raining off it, and you lift the whole thing over your head and grunt and let it fly, and the ones it's coming for look up in time to see the shadow and no more, and the ground bucks under everyone else's feet.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Boulder Toss]

abilities.name: Branch Slam
abilities.info:
What it does: you slam a heavy branch-arm down on one foe; they're crushed and knocked flat.

Your great oak arm creaks as it lifts, acorns rattling down out of your crown, and squirrels bolt off your shoulders as you raise it high, and then it comes down, a crack of wood on bone, and they're driven into the ground so hard the leaves jump.
[Trait: Oak Treant]

abilities.name: Brand
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes holy damage; the undead and shadow-things take double.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy Magic]

abilities.name: Break the Guard
abilities.info:
What it does: smash through whatever a foe is hiding behind: their cover, shell or guard is broken and your next hits land easier for a few turns.

You go at their guard instead of them, again and again, the same spot every time, shell, wood, hide or bone, until it splits with a crack and comes apart, and then there's nothing between you and them but a lot of very surprised flesh.
[Trait: Trained Fight VI]

abilities.name: Break Them
abilities.info:
What it does: words that crush a foe's will: a weaker creature gives up the fight, a stronger one fights badly for a while.

You find the thing they're most afraid is true about themselves, and you say it out loud, calm and certain, like everyone already knows, and you watch something go out of their eyes that doesn't come back.
[Trait: Trained Talk VII]

abilities.name: Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: breathe your power out in a short cone in front of you: every foe in it takes a hit of your power's kind.

You fill your chest and let it out and it comes out of you as your power, a short rush of it rolling out over everyone in front of you, and they reel back out of it.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke II]

abilities.name: Breathing Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: you move through stone as if it were soil; you open tunnels, close them behind you, or bring a ceiling down on foes.

You lean into the rock and it gives for you like warm earth, and you swim through it with the walls breathing around you, and behind you the passage closes up again, and if you want it to it closes up on whoever's following.
[Trait: Earth Dragon]

abilities.name: Brew
abilities.info:
What it does: you brew a potion from your own leaves; it heals, harms or does something stranger, as you choose.

You pluck three leaves and a root-hair and drop them in a pot with a splash of water and stir with one finger, muttering, and the pot bubbles and changes colour, green, then gold, then a nasty purple, and you sniff it and nod, and it'll either heal a broken leg or stop a heart, and only you know which.
[Trait: Mandrake Apothecary]

abilities.name: Bright Eye
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight your eyes shine with holy light; you see anything hidden or invisible, and the undead and shadow-things that meet your stare take holy damage.
A warmth fills your head, steady and calm, the light gathers behind your eyes until it shines out of them, and everything that was hiding is suddenly just there in plain sight, and the dead things flinch from your look and burn wherever it lands on them.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Bright Eye]

abilities.name: Brown Grass Walk
abilities.info:
What it does: everything green you walk past dies; for a few turns foes standing near you weaken and their wounds won't heal.

You walk slow and the grass goes brown under your feet and the brown spreads out from you in a ring, leaves curling, flowers dropping, and whoever's standing there feels it too, their strength going out of them like water out of a cracked pot.
[Trait: Gnoll Elder Witch]

abilities.name: Built to Last
abilities.info:
What it does: anything you build from now on is twice as sturdy and needs half the repair.

Your work changes, slower, more careful, every joint locked tight, every stone set square and tested twice, and the things you build stop falling down when they're hit, they just stand there taking it, year after year.
[Trait: Trained Build VII]

abilities.name: Bulk Deal
abilities.info:
What it does: trade in quantity: on a large trade you get noticeably better terms than one piece at a time.

You don't ask for one, you ask for forty, and you watch the trader's eyes go wide and their lips start moving doing the sums, and while they're still counting up the size of it you name a price per piece that would've got you laughed out of the place an hour ago.
[Trait: Trained Barter IV]

abilities.name: Bull Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through water or shallows; whatever is in your path is smashed aside and hurt.

You come through the water, a massive grey body pushing a wave in front of it, and you hit them in the shallows head first and keep going, anything floating capsizing, anyone wading flung aside, everything in your path smashed aside.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Bull]

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.info:
What it does: lower your head and charge in a straight line: whatever stands in the way, a door, a barricade or a line of foes, is smashed through or thrown aside and knocked down.

Your horns come down and your breath comes out in hot snorts and a hoof scrapes the floor once, twice, and then you go, every step heavier and faster than the one before, the floor shaking under you, and whatever they've put between you and them, a door, a wall of bodies, all of it, comes apart against your horns and goes flying in pieces while you keep running straight through.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Bull Rush]

abilities.name: Bull Through
abilities.info:
What it does: force your way through a line or a crowd of foes: everyone in your path is shoved aside and you come out the other side where you wanted to be.

You put your head down and go, shoving, elbowing, stamping, bodies bouncing off you to either side, somebody's grabbing at your back and somebody's under your feet, and you just keep driving your legs until there's nothing left in front of you but open ground.
[Trait: Trained Fight III]

abilities.name: Bull-King's Roar
abilities.info:
What it does: you roar and every herd and herder nearby goes quiet; weaker creatures obey you, and foes hesitate for a turn.

You roar, and it rolls down from the high pastures and through every valley, and every animal stops chewing and every herder stops talking and they all turn to face you and wait, and in the fight in front of you nobody moves for a long breath.
[Trait: Minotaur King]

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a living wall; allies behind you are shielded from attacks for a few turns.

You plant yourself in front of the others and spread your arms and your belly and your huge stone-hard bulk wide, a fortress of an ogre, and everything aimed at them hits you instead, rocks, fire, charging beasts, all of it crashing into your front and stopping dead, while behind you your friends get their breath back.
[Trait: Fortress Ogre]

abilities.name: Burn the Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: the dead around you rise sick; for a few turns fallen foes stagger up and spread your plague to anyone they touch.

You walk among the fallen and touch each one, gently, and they twitch, and then they get up, grey and coughing and weeping from the eyes, and they stagger toward the living with their arms out, carrying your sickness to anyone they reach.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-King]

abilities.name: Burn the Fences
abilities.info:
What it does: your herd tears down and burns a camp's walls and fences in one pass; it's left defenceless.

You ride round it once at a canter, looking, and then you give the word and the herd goes in, ropes over the posts, hooves on the rails, torches in the thatch, and when you ride out the other side there isn't a fence left standing on the plain.
[Trait: Centaur High Khan]

abilities.name: Burn Through
abilities.info:
What it does: your hits eat through armour; each hit adds acid damage and weakens the foe's armour for the rest of the fight.
Your skin runs wet and steaming when you're angry now and the ground fumes where you drip, and whatever they've got between you and them, hide, scale or plate, pits and sags where you hit it, eaten through in seconds, so the next blow goes right into what's underneath.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Burn Through]

abilities.name: Burning Body
abilities.info:
What it does: your skin blazes: for a few turns anyone who hits you, grabs you or stands against you is scorched.

Your skin splits along the lines of your scales and fire pushes through the cracks, little flames at first, then whole sheets of it rolling off your shoulders and back, and the one who grabbed you lets go shrieking with their palms blistered, and the next one who swings at you jerks back with their arm smoking, and you just stand there burning, waiting for someone else to try.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Burning Body]

abilities.name: Burning Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: the ground round you catches fire for three turns; every foe in it burns each turn, and the fire spreads a step further out every turn.
You drive your heel down once and the heat runs out of you into whatever's under your feet, it blackens and splits in a ring round you, then flame comes up out of every split at once in a rush, and you stand in the middle of it breathing it in while it rolls outward hunting for anything that will burn.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Burning Ground]

abilities.name: Burning Hunt
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a hunt of fire across a whole field; every foe in it is chased and burned for the rest of the battle.

You bay and the hunt begins, every hellhound in the dungeon pouring up out of the vents behind you, and the hunt pours over the land, setting the grass alight, running down everything that flees, and the field behind you is a sea of fire and running shapes.
[Trait: Hellhound Huntmaster]

abilities.name: Burning Pack
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead the pack in a burning hunt; your hounds chase down the foe you choose and burn whatever they bite.

You bay once and the pack pours out of the dark behind you, a river of black bodies and burning eyes and smoking jaws, and you run at the front of it, and every one of them catches fire as they run, and the hunt goes across the land, a grass fire with teeth.
[Trait: Hellhound Packmaster]

abilities.name: Burning Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe with fire; they're burned from the inside for a few turns.

Your tail glows red-hot from the base to the barb, heat shimmering off it, and you whip it down into them and they scream, not from the sting but from what comes after, the fire spreading through them from the wound, their blood boiling under the skin around it, steam coming out of the hole.
[Trait: Ember Scorpid]

abilities.name: Burrow Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: tunnel through rock and earth and burst up beneath a foe: they are thrown down and badly hurt, and you are clear of whatever was between you.

You dive head first into the ground and it just takes you, rock grinding apart around you, and up on the surface they feel it, a rumble under their feet getting louder and closer, and they look down in time to see the ground bulge and split and you come erupting up out of it right under them, jaws first, in a fountain of stone.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Burrow Strike]

abilities.name: Burrowing Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through earth and stone, bursting out under or beside a foe and slamming into them.

You lower your ram's horns and hit the hillside at a run, and instead of stopping you go in, earth and rock splitting in front of your horns, the ground humming under their feet as you tunnel toward them, and then the dirt beside them bursts open and you come out of it horns first in a shower of stones.
[Trait: Earth Drake]

abilities.name: Burst
abilities.info:
What it does: release your power all around you at once: every foe close by takes a solid hit of your power's kind.

You let go of everything you've been holding in and it goes out of you in every direction at once in one big push, and everybody standing close is thrown back off their feet.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke IV]

abilities.name: Cackle Order
abilities.info:
What it does: you show yourself and give the pack's hunting signal; while the foe watches you, every ally who hears it comes at them from the sides they aren't watching and strikes harder this turn.

It comes out of the dark quiet at first, a giggle, then a laugh, and eventually they see you, those bright yellow eyes staring at them through the fog, and they stare back unsure what to do, run or attack, but before they can make a move they hear it, the sound of claws and teeth from both sides.
[Trait: Gnoll Packleader]

abilities.name: Cackling Chase
abilities.info:
You run prey ragged; it tires before you do.
[Trait: Gnoll]

abilities.name: Call Lightning
abilities.info:
What it does: you call down a bolt of lightning on one foe.

You point one finger at the sky and the sky darkens over them, a single black cloud boiling up out of nowhere, and you bring your finger down, and the lightning comes with it, a white bolt cracking down onto their head with a boom that knocks them flat and leaves the air stinking of burnt hair.
[Trait: Sylph Stormcaller]

abilities.name: Call of the Wild
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and every wolf and wild dog in the area answers and fights beside you; a foe's own hounds may slip their leashes and join you.

You climb the highest rock and howl just once, long and low and old, and for a moment everything goes silent, then it answers, wolves on every ridge, wild dogs in the gullies, and among your enemies their own hunting hounds start whining and pulling at their chains, and by the time the howling stops half of them have slipped their collars and are running to you.
[Trait: Wolfkin King]

abilities.name: Call the Deep
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the sea's peoples to war; merfolk, sea-beasts and things of the deep fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You blow a great conch shell and the sound rolls out through the water for miles, and the sea answers, merfolk rising out of the drowned cities in their thousands, sea serpents uncoiling from the reefs, giant crabs scuttling up out of the deep, and the water boils with the army of the sea.
[Trait: Merfolk Sea-King]

abilities.name: Call the Warrens
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every goblin within earshot; they pour out of the ground and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You bang your fists on the iron crown and let out a shriek that carries down every hole and tunnel for a mile, and the ground boils, goblins spilling out of burrows and cracks and rabbit holes and drainage ditches, hundreds of them, shrieking, waving rusty scraps and sharpened spoons, a green flood pouring down the slope toward whatever their king is pointing at.
[Trait: Goblin King]

abilities.name: Calm at the Centre
abilities.info:
What it does: you sit in the calm eye of a storm you've raised; for a few turns nothing can reach you through the winds around you.

You fly down into the middle of the storm where it's still and quiet and warm, and you circle there lazily while the winds roar round you in a wall, and everything thrown at you gets caught in that wall and flung away.
[Trait: Tempest Wyvern]

abilities.name: Camped on You
abilities.info:
What it does: you let foes camp on you and then wake; they're thrown into the sea or stranded far out on the water.

You lie still and let them land their boats on your little beach and light their fire on your back and sleep, and in the middle of the night you get up and walk out to sea with them on you, and they wake up a long way from anywhere.
[Trait: Island Crab]

abilities.name: Can't Be Stopped
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight you can't be knocked down, held or stunned; blows still hurt, but nothing stops you acting.

Something shuts in your head and the pain becomes something that happens to somebody else, and they hit you and you're still there, they grab you and you shrug them off, they knock your head sideways and you turn it back and look at them, and they understand they're going to have to kill you, and they're not sure they can.
[Trait: Trained Fight VII]

abilities.name: Can't Close Your Eyes
abilities.info:
What it does: you never sleep and can't be surprised; you see every attack coming for the rest of the fight.

You've never closed your eyes, not once, not on anything, and nothing gets past them, and every attack they try you watched coming before they knew they were going to make it.
[Trait: All-Seeing Gazer]

abilities.name: Candle Shrink
abilities.info:
What it does: you pad into a room and every light shrinks; you move through it unseen and can't be found until you strike.

You pad in through the door and the candles shrink down to sparks and the lamps gutter and the shadows swell up out of the corners to meet you, and you walk right through the middle of the room in the dark while everyone in it holds their breath.
[Trait: Void Panther]

abilities.name: Candles in Every Window
abilities.info:
What it does: you know who in an area is close to death and how long they have.

You drift over the village at night and you can feel it, the ones whose time is close, little flickering lights going dim, and you know each one, who and how long, and you could go and wail outside their window if you wanted to.
[Trait: Banshee Queen]

abilities.name: Careful Questions
abilities.info:
What it does: scholars and the curious bring you questions; you answer any one about something you've digested, or what it knew.

They come to you nervously and ask, standing well back, and you think about it, sifting through everything you've ever eaten, every book and every scholar, and the answer bubbles up out of the middle of you, slow and precise.
[Trait: Sage Slime]

abilities.name: Carrion Bloom
abilities.info:
What it does: the dead and dying around you rot in moments and burst; living foes close by are sickened and weakened for a few turns, and you're untouched.

You let the rot out of you and it goes into the bodies first, the fallen around you darkening and swelling as grey fuzz races over them, then the bloom bursts in a wet sigh of spores, and the ones still standing cough and gag, eyes streaming, skin going blotched and soft wherever it touched them as they stagger back from the stink of their own flesh going bad.
[Trait: Rot Bloom]

abilities.name: Carrion Feast
abilities.info:
You eat carrion and mend a little.
[Trait: Ghoul]

abilities.name: Carrion Nose
abilities.info:
What it does: smell blood and fear on the wind from far off; you always know which foe in a group is hurt or most afraid.

Your head comes up and your nostrils flare and the wind brings it all to you in a rush, sweat, piss, old blood under fresh bandages, the sharp sour stink that comes off something that knows it's being hunted, and out of a whole crowd your eyes go straight to the one who's limping a little and trying to hide it, and you giggle.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Carrion Nose]

abilities.name: Carry Ten
abilities.info:
You lift and haul far beyond your size.
[Trait: Antfolk]

abilities.name: Cat's Luck
abilities.info:
What it does: once in a while, at exactly the right moment, the thing that should have got you misses or goes wrong instead.

The floor gives way, the rope snaps, the blow is coming straight at your throat, and somehow, the way it always somehow does, you twist in mid-air and land on your feet in a crouch, the blow whistling past where your head just was, and you look up with your ears perked and your whiskers twitching as if you'd meant to do that all along.
[Trait: Catfolk Wanderer]

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.info:
What it does: unleash everything at once: a huge blast of your power that hits every foe you can see, very hard.

Everything you have comes up at once and you can't hold it and you don't try, it goes out of you in one great roaring wave that rolls over everything you can see, and when it's gone the ground is changed.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VIII]

abilities.name: Catfolk Rake
abilities.info:
Spring from cover and rake with every claw.
[Trait: Soul of the Catfolk]

abilities.name: Caustic Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight your skin is acid: anything that touches you is burned, and grabs on you fail.
Your skin goes slick and wet and smoking, and anything that lays a hand or a tooth on you jerks back screaming with the skin coming away, and nobody wants to grab you again.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Caustic Hide]

abilities.name: Cave-In
abilities.info:
What it does: you bring a tunnel roof or rock face down on your foes; they're buried, hurt and cut off.

You tap the rock with one claw and listen, then tap again a little further over, and there, right there, that's the stone that holds the rest up, and you smack it once with the pick-end of your claw and dive backwards as the ceiling groans and lets go, a roaring avalanche of rock and dust swallowing the tunnel and everyone in it.
[Trait: Tunnel Boss]

abilities.name: Ceiling Drop
abilities.info:
What it does: you drop from the ceiling on a silk line onto a foe below and strike before they can react.

You've been up there the whole time, flattened into the dark between the beams with your extra eyes glittering, and they walk right underneath you, and you let go, sliding down a silk line without a sound, upside down, your face level with theirs for one awful moment as they turn, and then the knife is in and you're already zipping back up into the black.
[Trait: Webcrawler]

abilities.name: Centaur Volley
abilities.info:
Strike from range while on the move.
[Trait: Soul of the Centaur]

abilities.name: Chain Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: a bolt hits one foe and then jumps to up to three more close by; each takes lightning damage and is stunned for a moment.
You point and the world flashes for a heartbeat, the bolt hits the first one with a bang that rattles your teeth, and before the sound has even finished it's already leapt to the next and the next, one after another, each of them locked rigid and jerking where they stand, and the thunder keeps rolling long after they've hit the ground.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Chain Strike]

abilities.name: Charged Hit
abilities.info:
What it does: fill your next blow with your power: it hits as both a blow and a burst of your power's kind.

You make a fist and pour your power down your arm into it until it hums, and when the hit lands all of it goes in together.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke III]

abilities.name: Charming Word
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak a soft word to one foe; a weak mind goes slack and agreeable, and they won't attack you for a turn or two.

You lean down close, scales whispering on stone, and say it softly in their ear, just one word, warm as a hand on the back of the neck, and it slides into their head and settles there, and their shoulders drop and their hands go loose and they smile at you, very, very pleased to see you.
[Trait: Lamia Enchantress]

abilities.name: Chief's Call
abilities.info:
Call the herds and a herd comes, running, from wherever it's grazing.
[Trait: The Horn Moot: Herd Chief]

abilities.name: Chill Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: breathe out a short cold blast: one foe is chilled and slowed for a turn, or water in front of you freezes.
You breathe out slow and it comes out of you as a long cold plume that frosts the air, and the puddle in front of you creaks and goes solid, and the one in the way flinches back with frost in their eyebrows.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Chill Breath]

abilities.name: Chill Touch
abilities.info:
What it does: your touch drains warmth and strength out of what you grab: the foe weakens and slows, and you heal a little.

Your hand closes on their arm and they go rigid, frost spreading out from under your fingers, their skin going blue and then ashen, their breath smoking, and you feel it come up into you, their heat, their life, sweet and warm, while they shake and their knees buckle and their teeth chatter so hard you can hear them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Chill Touch]

abilities.name: Chilling Keen
abilities.info:
What it does: you keen and the foes near you freeze in fear; they can't act for a turn.

You keen, high and thin and endless, a note that never takes a breath, and it gets into their blood, cold, and their blood stops moving, their hearts stuttering, and they're frozen where they stand with their eyes wide and their mouths open and their hands locked.
[Trait: Keening Wraith]

abilities.name: Chitin Plates
abilities.info:
What it does: armour plates grow over you hard enough to turn claws and edges; for a while you take much less damage from cutting and stabbing.

It clicks and crackles out of your skin, plate after plate sliding up over your shoulders and back and chest, sealing together at the edges with a crackle, and the following hit skids right off you with a screech and a spray of sparks.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Chitin Plates]

abilities.name: Choking Mist
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a mist that blinds and chokes; foes in it can't see, struggle to breathe and are weakened for a few turns.

The mist that follows you everywhere spreads out from your feet, grey and wet and heavy, rolling over them in a soft blanket, and at first it's only cold, then it's thick, then it's in their throats, a damp rotten taste of swamp water, and they're coughing and gasping and stumbling around blind while you walk through it seeing everything.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Mist-Priest]

abilities.name: Cinder Wings
abilities.info:
What it does: you take wing on flames for a short flight, carrying you over obstacles or away from a fight.

Your back splits with heat and wings of pure flame roar open from your shoulders, scattering cinders everywhere, and you leap and they catch the air, carrying you up over walls and gaps and the heads of your enemies, trailing smoke and sparks behind you.
[Trait: Cinder Salamander]

abilities.name: City Breathes
abilities.info:
What it does: you rest in your city and it heals you; you and anyone resting inside your walls recover fully.

You settle down at the centre of it and breathe, and the city breathes with you, in, out, every road and every tunnel, and the strength flows back into you along all of them, and everyone resting inside the walls feels it too.
[Trait: Antfolk City-Mother]

abilities.name: City Guardian
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every gargoyle of a city to defend it; they wake and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You stand up on the cathedral roof and spread your wings over the city and call, a grinding roar of stone, and every gargoyle on every rooftop and gutter and archway opens its stone eyes, and the skyline of the city comes alive and takes to the air.
[Trait: Gargoyle Cathedral-Lord]

abilities.name: City Overnight
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a walled city in a single night.

You plant yourself on open ground at sunset and the colony goes to work around you, and by dawn there's a city there, walls and towers and roads and markets all of packed earth, and the traders coming over the hill in the morning stop their carts and stare at a city that wasn't there yesterday.
[Trait: Antfolk City-Mother]

abilities.name: Clean Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: you roll over one fallen foe and strip it to the bone; you heal a lot and take its soul if it's fresh.

You roll over it and it's gone inside you, and you can feel it going, the skin, the meat, all of it, and when you roll on there's nothing left on the ground but a neat white skeleton, picked perfectly clean, and you feel warm and full.
[Trait: Ooze Mountain]

abilities.name: Clean Track
abilities.info:
What it does: you roll over a fallen foe and dissolve it; you heal and leave nothing behind but a scar on the ground.

You roll over the body and it's gone, dissolving into you with a hiss, and you keep rolling, and behind you on the ground there's only a smooth bare track scoured down to the stone, and you're warmer for it.
[Trait: Devouring Slime]

abilities.name: Clear the Floor
abilities.info:
Shove a brawl apart and keep it apart; the next command or fight action to stop a fight hits harder.
[Trait: The Big Table: Runner]

abilities.name: Cliff Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you drop from a cliff or height onto one foe; your strike lands hard and the wound stiffens.

You've been waiting on the cliff ledge for hours, and they pass below, and you just let go, dropping with your wings tucked, and you land on them beak first, and they go down with your talons on their back and grey spreading out from the peck in their shoulder.
[Trait: Cliff Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Cliff-Top Shrines
abilities.info:
What it does: the harpies who worship you come when you call; a flock of harpies fights for you for the rest of the fight.

You call out with the voice of the storm and from every cliff top they come, harpies, a screaming cloud of them, the ones who built their shrines to you, diving down on whatever you're looking at, all claws.
[Trait: Thunderbird Wyvern]

abilities.name: Clockwork Guardian
abilities.info:
What it does: you wind up a clockwork guardian you built; it fights beside you for the rest of the battle.

You pull the canvas off it with a flourish, a heap of brass taller than an orc and iron and copper pots with a dragon's skull for a head, and you crank the big key in its back, turn after turn, until something inside it goes tick, tick, tick, and its eyes light up, and it lurches forward on clanking legs to stand between you and the enemy with steam hissing out of its joints.
[Trait: Kobold Artificer]

abilities.name: Cloud Herd
abilities.info:
What it does: your winged herd flies with you; for the rest of the fight they dive on your foes from above, striking anywhere you point.

You call and they come down out of the clouds behind you, the whole flying herd, and you point and they peel off one after another and dive, hooves first, out of the sky onto whatever you pointed at.
[Trait: Sky Khan]

abilities.name: Cloud of Crows
abilities.info:
What it does: the crows that follow you attack; for a few turns a black cloud of crows tears at your foes.

You lift one hand and the cloud of crows that's always following you comes down out of the sky, screaming, and goes for their eyes and their faces and their hands, a black storm of beaks and wings that won't let up.
[Trait: Ghoul Rot-King]

abilities.name: Cloud Stalk
abilities.info:
What it does: you hide in cloud and strike from it; your first strike lands hard on a foe below.

You rise up into the clouds and sit there in the grey, invisible, waiting, and when they pass underneath you drop out of the cloud in silence, a grey stone shape falling out of the grey sky, and they never see you until you're on them.
[Trait: Gargoyle Skystalker]

abilities.name: Coast Towns Empty
abilities.info:
What it does: your fleet comes over the horizon; a coastal town or camp empties in panic, and you take what's left.

Your ships come over the edge of the sea in a long line and the coast town sees them and runs, all of it, out the back gate and up the hills, leaving the doors open and the tables set and everything they own for you to take at your leisure.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Reaver-King]

abilities.name: Coastline Sings
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing and the cliffs sing back; your voice carries for miles along the coast, and everyone on it hears your words.

You open your mouth and the cliffs pick up the note and pass it along, cliff to cliff, cove to cove, until the whole coastline is singing with you, and every soul on it hears every word as if you were standing right beside them.
[Trait: Siren Sky-Queen]

abilities.name: Coax Green
abilities.info:
You make plants grow, bend or part.
[Trait: Dryad]

abilities.name: Cockatrice Peck
abilities.info:
A peck that stiffens the flesh toward stone.
[Trait: Soul of the Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap one foe in silk so tight they can barely breathe, holding them helpless until they're cut free.

Your eight hairy legs carry you over them before they can scramble away and you go to work, spinning them round and round and round with silk pouring off you in thick white ropes, arms pinned, legs pinned, their muffled screaming getting weaker as the layers close over their face, until all that's left is a twitching white bundle hanging from your web, saved for later.
[Trait: Spider Goblin]

abilities.name: Coil
abilities.info:
You wrap a foe in the tail and hold them.
[Trait: Lamia]

abilities.name: Coil and Crush
abilities.info:
What it does: wrap a foe in your coils and squeeze: they are held fast, can barely act, and take more damage every turn they stay caught.

You go round them once before they see it coming, then twice, the heavy coils sliding over each other with a dry hiss, and then you pull tight, and every time they let a breath out there's a little less room to take the next one, their kicking going feeble, their eyes bulging, ribs creaking, while you just hold them there and watch.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Coil and Crush]

abilities.name: Coils of the World
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap a whole battlefield in your coils; nobody can leave it, and those caught against your body are crushed for the rest of the fight.

You're so vast that your coils look like a range of hills, and you move, a scaled wall rising up out of the sand all around the field and closing into a ring, then another ring inside it, then another, so the enemy is caught inside a maze of your body with no way out, and every time you shift the coils tighten and someone else gets ground between them.
[Trait: Great Lamia]

abilities.name: Cold Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: hold your breath for a very long time underwater and keep a cold, steady head when anything comes at you; fear and surprise barely touch you for a while.

Your heart slows down to a lazy thud, thud, and your eyes go flat and patient, and you slip under and just stay there with the cold water pressing on you, not a bubble, not a twitch, and when the thing in the dark lunges at you everybody else would jump and you just watch it come, blinking slow.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Cold Blood]

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.info:
What it does: the cold drops suddenly over a wide area: every foe in it is slowed for three turns and takes cold damage each turn.
The air goes still and then it goes cold, not winter cold, deeper, the kind that cracks stone, and everyone in it freezes mid step with their breath hanging in front of them, their joints locking, moving slower and slower like their blood's turning to slush.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Cold Snap]

abilities.name: Cold Touch
abilities.info:
A touch that chills and weakens.
[Trait: Wraith]

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.info:
What it does: bring down a tunnel, roof or wall you know well: everything under it is buried.

You know exactly which stone is holding it all up because you're the one who put it there, and you walk up to it and pull it out, and the whole thing comes down at once with a roar and a wall of dust on whoever was standing underneath.
[Trait: Trained Build VI]

abilities.name: Collect the Debt
abilities.info:
What it does: you call in a debt; the one who owes you must pay, in whatever form you demand, or suffer for it.

You open your book and run one claw down the page until you find the name, and you read it aloud, and wherever they are, whatever they're doing, they feel it, the brand on their palm burning white-hot, and they know the bill has come due and there's nowhere in the world to hide from it.
[Trait: Contract Devil]

abilities.name: Colony Will
abilities.info:
What it does: you move the whole colony like one body; your allies act together and strike harder for a few turns.

You lift your cap and the countless mushrooms of your colony turn toward you, and then they're not a thousand anymore, they're one, every cap and every kin moving in perfect silence as one body, flanking and striking and closing in all at once with no orders given, because there's no gap between your will and theirs.
[Trait: Myconid King]

abilities.name: Colossal Step
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush everything beneath your step; foes under or near your feet are crushed and thrown down.

You lift one foot the size of a house and they see the shadow of it falling over them, and they run, and some of them don't run fast enough, and it comes down with a boom that rattles teeth for a mile, and the ground jumps under everybody, and the ones who were under it are part of the ground now.
[Trait: Colossus]

abilities.name: Colossus Stride
abilities.info:
What it does: you stride across the battlefield; anything under your feet is crushed and you cross huge distances in a few steps.

You're so big now that the battle is something happening around your ankles, and you simply walk through it, each step covering a field, each footfall crushing whatever was unlucky enough to be standing there, carts, walls, fighters, flattened into the mud while the ones further off watch the colossus come and understand there's nothing they own that can stop it.
[Trait: Ogre Colossus]

abilities.name: Colour of Old Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: your shadow touches a foe and they see their own death in it; they're frightened and weakened for a few turns.

Your shadow slides across the floor to them, the colour of old blood, and when it touches their feet they look down into it and see themselves, dead, drained, and they can't look away, and the strength goes out of their legs.
[Trait: Crimson Abyss]

abilities.name: Constellation
abilities.info:
What it does: you draw a constellation in the sky; allies beneath it fight harder and are harder to hit for a few turns.

You walk a slow circle and every hoofprint you leave burns silver in the grass, and as the circle closes the prints lift off the ground and rise, climbing into the dark to hang there as new stars in a shape no sky has ever held, a great stag with its antlers lowered, and its light settles on your allies' shoulders, steadying their hands and turning aside every blow aimed at them as if the heavens themselves had reached down.
[Trait: Centaur Astromancer]

abilities.name: Cook an Egg
abilities.info:
What it does: the heat that comes off your shell hurts anything that gets close; for a few turns foes who strike you are burned.

The heat comes off your back in waves so hot the air ripples and steam hisses up off the ground under your feet, and the ones who get close enough to hit you pull back with their skin blistered and their fur singed.
[Trait: Volcanic Scorpid]

abilities.name: Coordinated Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: point your allies at one foe: every ally that attacks it this turn hits much harder.

You point one claw at it and say nothing else, and they all go at once from every side, left, right, high, low, and the thing in the middle spins one way and then the other trying to face all of them and can't face any of them.
[Trait: Trained Command III]

abilities.name: Copy Body
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the shape of something you ate; you look and move like it for a while.

You think back to the last thing you swallowed, a wolf, and your jelly stirs and bulges and hardens, legs pushing out, a snout stretching forward, fur colouring over you, until a wolf stands where the jelly was, a little too glossy in the torchlight, sniffing the air.
[Trait: Gel Mimic]

abilities.name: Coral Guard
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a wall of coral that shelters allies from attacks for a few turns.

You lay your palms on the reef and sing to it, low and patient, and the coral answers, branching and climbing and spreading faster than it has any right to, pink and white and hard as stone, until a wall of it stands between your people and whatever's coming, and the blows break on it.
[Trait: Merfolk Reef-Warden]

abilities.name: Corner the Supply
abilities.info:
What it does: buy up or lock down one kind of goods in a place: for a while others have to come to you for it.

You buy up every bit of it you can find, quiet, a little here and a little there, through three different hands so nobody sees the shape of it, and by the time anyone notices there's none to be had anywhere except in your store, at your price.
