[Trait: Trained Barter VI]

abilities.name: Corner to Corner
abilities.info:
What it does: you step into one dark corner and out of another you know, anywhere within a mile.

You back into the shadow where the wall meets the floor and you're gone, and a mile away in another dark corner something shifts and you step out of it, brushing a thread of nothing off your legs.
[Trait: Void Spinner]

abilities.name: Corpse Feed
abilities.info:
What it does: you root into a corpse and draw strength from it; you heal and grow stronger for a while.

You kneel by the body and push your pale roots down into it, through the skin and into the meat, and you drink, and they watch it shrink and grey and wither, while the colour comes back into your own grave-dirt skin and your wounds knit closed.
[Trait: Graveroot]

abilities.name: Corpse Pack
abilities.info:
What it does: your corpse-hyenas swarm one downed or wounded foe; they're bitten all over and pinned.

You whistle through your rotten teeth and the pack that's always been trailing behind you comes slinking in, giggling, grey, hungry, and they find the one who's down and pile onto it, a heap of snapping, tugging, feeding things.
[Trait: Ghoul Hyena-Lord]

abilities.name: Corrode
abilities.info:
What it does: you dissolve one foe's armour; their protection is ruined and they're easier to hurt.

You ooze up over their legs and they hack at you, and you let them, and you spread up over their armour, and it gives way, plates going soft and runny, mail dripping away in molten links, leather peeling away in strips, until they stagger back out of you wearing nothing but smoking rags.
[Trait: Corrosive Slime]

abilities.name: Council of Clans
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a council of the bearkin clans; every clan that comes fights beside you for the rest of the battle.

You go up to the old stone on the hill and beat on it with both fists, a booming that shakes the hill, and it rolls across the northern forests from valley to valley, and they come, out of caves and dens and river camps, grizzled elders and young bulls and furious mothers, until the council of the clans stands around you in a ring of fur and teeth, waiting for their grandfather to tell them who to tear apart.
[Trait: Bearkin Grandfather]

abilities.name: Council's Silence
abilities.info:
Call the council's silence on a room; the dead in it stop and listen, and the living feel cold and quiet.
[Trait: The Quiet Council: Councillor]

abilities.name: Count the Sounder
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every boar in your sounders and everything they've seen; you learn what's happened in the oak wood in the last day.

You stand at the edge of the wood and grunt, and the sounder answers, a hundred voices, a thousand, and in every grunt there's a little news, who passed, what's rotting, where the hunters are, and you know your wood like the back of your trotter.
[Trait: Boarfolk Queen]

abilities.name: Court of Foxes
abilities.info:
What it does: your court of lesser foxes runs your errands; they fetch, spy, carry messages or trick someone for you.

You flick one tail and the little foxes come trotting out of the shadows, bowing, and you give them their jobs, fetch this, watch him, tell her that, lead those ones astray, and off they go giggling, and by morning it's all done.
[Trait: Six-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Court of Night
abilities.info:
What it does: you call your court's vampires to you; they come and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You raise your hand and the shadows in the room stir, and out of them they step, one after another, pale and beautiful and terrible in their finery, the vampires of your court, and they smile at your enemies with the tips of their teeth showing and wait for you to tell them who to eat.
[Trait: Vampire Lord]

abilities.name: Court of the Eaten
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the scavengers of the field to fight for you; vultures, rats and wild dogs swarm your foes for the rest of the fight.

You sit back on a heap of the fallen like a throne and raise one hand, and the court comes, out of the sky, out of the grass, out of the holes in the ground, every scavenger on the plains, and they fall on the living as readily as the dead.
[Trait: Carrion King]

abilities.name: Crabfolk Crush
abilities.info:
Seize and crush with a great claw.
[Trait: Soul of the Crabfolk]

abilities.name: Cracking Roots
abilities.info:
What it does: you drive your roots through the ground under foes; it heaves and cracks, throwing them down and holding them.

You plant your feet and your roots go down and spread out under them, and the ground lifts and cracks and splits open in long lines, and they fall into the cracks and the roots close around their legs and hold them there.
[Trait: Rot Colossus]

abilities.name: Creeping Stone
abilities.info:
What it does: a peck that spreads stone slowly through flesh: the foe stiffens more each turn, and if it isn't stopped a weak foe turns fully to stone.

Just one peck and you hop back and wait, and they see it before they feel it, the flesh at the mark turning grey and hard, cracking, spreading, a little more every time they breathe, and they're clawing at it, trying to scrape it off with their nails, sobbing, begging, while it crawls up over their shoulder and into their neck and the begging goes slower and slower.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Creeping Stone]

abilities.name: Crimson Rain
abilities.info:
What it does: you rain blood that you drink back; every foe in an area is hurt as their blood is drawn out, and you heal from all of it.

You rise over the field and spread your red wings and the clouds turn red with you, and it rains, warm and red and sticky, and it's their own blood falling on them, pulled out of their bodies into the sky and pouring back down, and it trickles back to you in a hundred little red streams.
[Trait: Crimson Archfiend]

abilities.name: Crimson Tide
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain everything around you; every foe nearby is badly hurt as their blood is pulled out of them, and you heal from all of it.

You spread your arms in the middle of them and the blood comes to you, pulled out through their skin in a red mist, out of their eyes, their noses, their mouths, swirling up around you in a crimson tide, and they slump down grey and shrivelling while you stand in the middle of it drinking the whole field.
[Trait: Crimson Vampire]

abilities.name: Crippling Venom
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe and their limbs go weak; they're slowed and can barely fight for a few turns.

Your venom can drop an ox, and when your tail drives into their thigh they feel exactly what that means, the leg going numb, then the other one, then their arms getting heavy and floppy, their hands unable to keep their grip, until they're on their knees with their head swaying, too weak to even crawl away.
[Trait: Wyvern Venomlord]

abilities.name: Crowd Roar
abilities.info:
What it does: you roar like a whole arena; allies who hear it strike harder and shake off fear for a few turns, and weak foes may falter.

You lift your arms over your head with blood running down your horns and roar, a roar that shakes the dust off the ground, and your allies feel it in their chests, backs straightening, weapons rising, the fear burned clean out of them, and over on their side a few of their own soldiers catch themselves stamping and cheering before they realise whose name they're shouting.
[Trait: Minotaur Gladiator]

abilities.name: Crowd Speech
abilities.info:
What it does: speak to a whole crowd: they're moved to cheer, to calm down, to riot or to follow you.

You climb up where they can all see you and talk, and the crowd goes quiet, then quieter, and then you've got them in your hand, and they cheer when you want them to cheer and fall silent when you need them silent.
[Trait: Trained Talk VI]

abilities.name: Crown of Scars
abilities.info:
What it does: every scar you carry reminds your body how to survive; for the rest of the fight you heal a little every turn and wounds bleed less.

Your old scars itch and then they burn and then the burning spreads, and every new wound they put in you closes up faster than it should, like your body's done all this before and remembers exactly how it went.
[Trait: Wolfkin King]

abilities.name: Crown Tax
abilities.info:
What it does: you demand tribute from a camp, warren or caravan of weaker creatures; they pay in goods or fight a whole warband for it.

You sit back on whatever's nearest like it's a throne and name your price, slow, while behind you the warband grins and sharpens things, and the ones you're talking to look at the numbers and look at each other and start piling up whatever you asked for.
[Trait: Goblin King]

abilities.name: Crowned in Lightning
abilities.info:
What it does: the lightning around your head shocks anything that strikes you; for a few turns foes that hit you are stunned.

The crown of lightning on your head crackles and spits, and when they hit you it jumps to them with a crack and they're thrown back stiff and smoking, and the next one thinks very hard before trying.
[Trait: Storm-King Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Crowned in Rust
abilities.info:
What it does: your rusted crown commands the dead; any undead nearby obeys you, and weaker ones won't attack you.

You lift your head and the rusted gold catches what light there is, and every dead thing near you knows that crown, and the skeletons lower their weapons, and the ghouls back away, and the restless ones lower their heads and wait.
[Trait: Bone King]

abilities.name: Crushing Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: your claw cracks armour, bone and stone: grab a foe and crush, breaking whatever protects them and badly hurting them.

Your claw swells up huge and heavy, the shell thick and ridged, and you snap it shut on whatever's in front of you, an arm, a leg, a head, and you squeeze, and you keep squeezing, the creaking building and building until it gives with a crack you hear across the whole fight.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Crushing Claw]

abilities.name: Crushing Coil
abilities.info:
What it does: you coil around one foe and squeeze; they're hurt and held until they break free.

Your tail comes round behind them and loops over their shoulders before they've noticed it moving, then again around their waist, then their legs, and you settle into it, and squeeze, slow and patient, every breath they let out you take up the slack, until they can't draw the next one at all.
[Trait: Lamia Constrictor]

abilities.name: Crushing Coils
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush one foe in your tentacles; they're badly hurt and held.

Your tentacles wrap round them, one after another, legs, arms, chest, throat, until there's nothing of them showing but their face, and you squeeze, every sucker biting, every coil tightening, and they feel their ribs bend and their breath leave them in a thin wheeze.
[Trait: Kraken-Spawn]

abilities.name: Crushing Grip
abilities.info:
What it does: you grab one foe and crush them in your grip; they're badly hurt and held until they break free.

You reach out with a hand the size of a door and close it around them, and they're held, arms pinned, and you squeeze slowly, watching their face as you do it, the crack of a rib, then another, their struggling getting smaller and weaker, while you breathe your swamp-stinking breath right in their face.
[Trait: Cave Troll]

abilities.name: Crushing Hold
abilities.info:
What it does: squeeze a held foe: they take damage every turn you keep holding, and a weaker foe can't act at all.

You wrap them up in both arms and lock your hands and squeeze, a little more with every breath they let out, their ribs creaking, their struggling going wild and then weak, their face going dark, while you breathe slow and steady in their ear.
[Trait: Trained Fight IV]

abilities.name: Crushing Hug
abilities.info:
What it does: you grab one foe in a bear hug and crush them; they're badly hurt and held until they break free.

You come in close and fast for something so huge and wrap both arms around them before they can step back, pulling them into your fur so all they can smell is musk and blood, and then you squeeze, slow and steady and terrible, their ribs bending and creaking and cracking one by one, breath squeezed out in a thin wheeze, their struggling getting weaker and weaker against a grip that just keeps tightening.
[Trait: Great Bear]

abilities.name: Crushing Room
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush the room you are; everyone inside is crushed and badly hurt.

The room they're standing in gets smaller, they don't notice at first, and then they notice, the ceiling a little closer, the walls a little nearer, and then it goes fast, stone grinding on stone, the walls rushing in from both sides, and they're sobbing and shoving at walls that keep coming, nails tearing on the stone.
[Trait: Room Mimic]

abilities.name: Crypt Gate
abilities.info:
What it does: you open a crypt passage to anywhere in the necropolis; you and allies can travel through it.

You knock three times on a tomb lid and it slides open, and inside it isn't a coffin but stairs, going down into the dark, and you lead them down and along and through the cold dead tunnels under the city, and come up out of another tomb at the other end of the necropolis an hour later.
[Trait: Ghoul Crypt-Lord]

abilities.name: Crypt Lock
abilities.info:
Seal a crypt or a door so the dead inside stay in and the living outside stay out.
[Trait: The Quiet Council: Crypt Warden]

abilities.name: Crypt Lore
abilities.info:
What it does: you know the dead buried in a place, who they were and what was buried with them.

You press your grey face to the cold ground and breathe in, a long deep sniff, and the dead tell you everything through the stone, which ones were rich and which were poor, which went into the ground with rings on their fingers and which with nothing, where every one of them lies and what's still clutched in their hands.
[Trait: Ghoul Cryptkeeper]

abilities.name: Crystal Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: you harden into crystal against blows; they do you little harm for a few turns.

The crystals on your back spread over the rest of you with a crackle, clear and hard and glittering, and when they hit you their weapons glance off with bright ringing chimes and shower sparks of light, and you lie there glittering.
[Trait: Crystal Worm]

abilities.name: Cure All
abilities.info:
What it does: you cure every wound and sickness on one ally.

You press your forehead to theirs and breathe out, and every leaf on your crown turns gold at once, and the gold flows out of you and into them, through their veins and bones, chasing out fever and poison and rot, closing every cut and mending every break, and they sit up whole and clean and blinking.
[Trait: Mandrake Cure-Root]

abilities.name: Curse Ray
abilities.info:
What it does: you fire a cursing ray at one foe; they're weakened, slowed or burned, as you choose, for a few turns.

One of your stalks turns toward them and the eye on the end of it glows sickly green, then brighter, then fires, a thin humming beam that hits them in the chest, and they feel the curse land, their strength draining out of them.
[Trait: Gazer Curse-Eye]

abilities.name: Cut of Everything
abilities.info:
Know what a deal is worth to the Table and push for its share; the next barter action leans your way.
[Trait: The Big Table: Hand]

abilities.name: Cut Off the Escape
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns no foe can run from the fight; you're always in the way of the path they try.

Every time one of them breaks and runs you're already there in the gap, turning them back, and they try another way and you're there too, and after a while they stop trying and just stand there panting.
[Trait: Trained Hunt III]

abilities.name: Cut the Rain
abilities.info:
What it does: your movements are so precise for a few turns that you parry every blow aimed at you and strike back each time.

Everything around you slows to the speed of falling rain and you move through it, every blow that comes at you turned aside with the smallest flick, and each turn of your wrist ends with a cut back on whoever threw it.
[Trait: Catfolk Grand Duelist]

abilities.name: Cyclone Cut
abilities.info:
What it does: you spin a cyclone of wind-cuts around you; every foe near you is cut and thrown about.

You spread your scythes and spin on the spot, quicker with every turn, until you're a blur in the middle of a whirlwind, a howling cyclone of wind and cuts with you in its eye, and it tears through their line sucking them in, slicing them up and spitting them out in pieces.
[Trait: Storm Mantid]

abilities.name: Dance of Madness
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a dance that grabs a crowd and won't let them stop; foes caught in it dance helplessly for a few turns, exhausted and unable to fight.

The first notes are almost a joke, a silly little jig, and they laugh, and then they notice their feet tapping and can't make them stop, then their hips are swinging, then they're whirling and stamping and leaping across the field in a frenzy, sobbing and begging you to stop, blistered and gasping and dancing on bleeding feet with their arms flung out, and you just smile and play the next verse faster.
[Trait: Satyr Muse]

abilities.name: Danger Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day you are never caught off guard: traps, ambushes and sneak attacks are spotted just before they happen.

There's a little voice at the back of your skull that's been there since before you could talk and today it won't shut up, stop, not there, look up, wait, and every time you listen it's right.
[Trait: Trained Instinct IV]

abilities.name: Dark Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike from total darkness at a foe who can't see you; your first strike lands hard.

They brought torches, and the torches gutter and fail one after another as they go deeper, until they're standing in black so thick they can hear their own hearts, and you've been beside them the whole time, blind eyes huge and white, feeling every breath they take, and when you strike it comes out of nowhere at all.
[Trait: Deep Basilisk]

abilities.name: Dark Drain
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain one foe in darkness; they weaken badly while you heal.

You swallow them, the darkness closing over them, and inside it they can't see, can't hear, can only feel the cold mouth pressed against every inch of their skin, drinking, and when you spit them back out into the light they're grey and shaking and half empty.
[Trait: Crimson Shade]

abilities.name: Dark Sight
abilities.info:
What it does: see perfectly in total darkness, as clearly as in daylight.

Your pupils swell until there's no white left, two black pools, and the darkness just lets go of everything it was holding, the room coming up out of it sharp and grey, every face, every crack, every hand reaching for something sharp, while the others are still feeling along the wall for the way out.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Dark Sight]

abilities.name: Dark Silk
abilities.info:
What it does: you spin silk nobody can see; webs, lines and snares you make are invisible until something touches them.

The silk comes out of you black and thin as a whisper and you string it across the way ahead, between anything that stands still, and the moment it leaves your fingers it's gone, swallowed by the gloom, and they walk straight into it without ever seeing a thing until it's stuck across their faces.
[Trait: Shadow Weaver]

abilities.name: Dark Veil
abilities.info:
What it does: you veil an area in darkness; foes in it can't see, while you and those you choose can.

You shrug and darkness pours off your shoulders, flooding out in every direction, swallowing the torches, the walls, the floor, until they're standing in black so thick they can't see their own feet, and you can see every one of them.
[Trait: Shade Weaver]

abilities.name: Darkened Sky
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every harpy on the coast; they blot out the sun and strike your foes for the rest of the battle.

You scream from the highest cliff and every colony on the coast answers, and they rise, thousands of them, a black screeching cloud that rolls in off the sea and blots out the sun, and the day goes dark as dusk under them, and out of that dark they drop, raking and shrieking and tearing.
[Trait: Harpy Queen]

abilities.name: Darkness Falls
abilities.info:
What it does: darkness pours off you and puts out every light nearby; foes are blinded in it while you see perfectly.

You open your jaws and darkness spills out of you in a black smoke, spilling over the boards and up the walls, and every lamp and torch in the room shrinks to a spark and goes out, and in that perfect black they hear the soft pad of paws circling them, closer, and see nothing at all except, now and then, a pair of eyes that aren't where they were a moment ago.
[Trait: Void Panther]

abilities.name: Dawn Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow and the foes near you stiffen toward stone; they're slowed more each turn for a few turns.

You wait until the sun comes up over the galleries and then you crow, the dawn call, and the stiffness rolls out through them, fingers locking, joints grinding, and they wake up with their arms gone grey and heavy and their legs refusing to move, and the panic goes through them as they all realise it at once.
[Trait: Cockatrice Herald]

abilities.name: Day and a Night
abilities.info:
What it does: you stand in a breach without moving; for as long as you hold it nothing gets past, though you can't attack.

You step into the gap and settle and set, stone on stone, and you don't move, not for blows, not for fire, not for anything, and the hours go by and the fight breaks on you over and over, and you're still standing there in the morning.
[Trait: Gargoyle Bastion]

abilities.name: Days Inside You
abilities.info:
What it does: you know everything that happens on your floor; where every creature is and what it's doing.

They've been walking around inside you for days and you've felt every step, every rest, every whisper, every hand trailed along a wall, and you know exactly where every one of them is right now and how tired they are.
[Trait: Dungeon Mimic]

abilities.name: Daze Cloud
abilities.info:
What it does: you release a cloud of spores that leaves everyone in it dazed for a turn or two.

You squeeze your swollen cap and it puffs out a cloud of grey dust that rolls over them soft as fog, and they breathe it in before they can stop themselves, and the world goes slow and swimmy, colours too bright, sounds too far away, and they stand there blinking at nothing with their mouths hanging open.
[Trait: Myconid Sporer]

abilities.name: Dead Blade
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike with a fighting arm that never tires; you can keep attacking without weakening for the rest of the fight.

You come at them with no breath and no pulse, swinging, and swinging, and swinging, the same strike over and over with no rest and no change, and they block and block and block until their arms are shaking and their lungs are burning, and you're still swinging exactly as hard as the first time.
[Trait: Skeleton Knight]

abilities.name: Dead Forest
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn the land around you into rot that feeds you; foes in it sicken each turn while you heal from it.

You take one step and the grass around your feet goes grey, then the trees drop their leaves and blacken, and the living caught in it start to notice small things first, a gum that bleeds when they bite, a toenail that lifts away inside the boot, a handful of hair left on the hand when they wipe the sweat away, while their strength drains down into the ground and up into your roots.
[Trait: Blight King]

abilities.name: Dead Grass Nest
abilities.info:
What it does: the poison in your body protects you; for a few turns anything that bites, grabs or hits you is poisoned by it.

Your body runs so thick with venom now that it seeps out of your skin and drips from your scales, and anything that touches you comes away sick, their skin blistering, their mouths foaming, and they stagger back from you already dying.
[Trait: Wyvern Plaguewing]

abilities.name: Dead Legion
abilities.info:
What it does: you march a legion of skeletons; a great host of undead fights for you for the rest of the battle.

You ride out at the head of your legion on a horse made of bones, and behind you they march in perfect rows, thousands of skeletons in rusted armour, their feet hitting the ground together in one dry rattle, and they don't need to eat or sleep or rest, they just keep coming.
[Trait: Grave Lord]

abilities.name: Deadening Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow and the foes near you go numb; their limbs are weak and clumsy for a few turns.

You puff up your swollen comb and crane up and crow, a shrill, cracked, ugly sound, and it crawls into their muscles, their hands going dead and tingling, their legs going heavy, until they're dropping what they're holding and swaying on numb feet.
[Trait: Cockatrice Crower]

abilities.name: Deadly Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe with killing venom; they're badly poisoned and may die if not treated.

Your tail rises up over your back slow and curved with the barb glistening black, and you hold it there just long enough for them to see it, and then it strikes, and the venom goes in hot and spreads cold, and they're on their knees in the sand clawing at their chest while their heart stutters and their lips turn blue.
[Trait: Scorpid Deathstalker]

abilities.name: Death Bolt
abilities.info:
What it does: you hurl a bolt of death at one foe; they're badly hurt and their wounds won't heal naturally for a while.

You point one bony finger and a bolt of black-green light streaks out and hits them in the chest, and they look down at the hole, and it isn't bleeding, it's grey and dry and cracking at the edges, and it's getting bigger.
[Trait: Lich]

abilities.name: Death by Cuts
abilities.info:
What it does: a long string of quick shallow hits on one foe: each one small, but the foe bleeds every turn after until they are tended.

You stay on them like a fly, never stopping, never committing, a flick across the arm, the cheek, the ribs, the back of the hand, dozens of them, and none of them matter, and all of them bleed, and after a while they're swaying where they stand in a puddle of their own making.
[Trait: Trained Strike VI]

abilities.name: Death Command
abilities.info:
What it does: you order lesser dead to attack; undead around you strike at your command and fight harder for a few turns.

You raise your black gauntlet and speak one word in a voice from the bottom of a grave, and every skeleton and corpse and shambling thing in the field turns toward you, then toward where you're pointing, and they march, and they hit harder and faster than dead things should, because their general is watching.
[Trait: Death Knight]

abilities.name: Death from the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: one hit from hiding on an unaware foe: a weaker foe dies outright, a stronger one is badly wounded.

There's no warning at all, not a sound, not a shadow, not a smell, just the dark and then you in it and the one strike that was everything you had, and it's over before it started.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VIII]

abilities.name: Death Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and weak foes' souls slip loose; weak foes may die outright, and the rest are shaken and weakened.

You stand on the hill above them in the mist and howl, long and low and hollow, and the ones who hear it feel something come loose inside them, a cold tugging, and the frail simply stop, their souls sliding out of their mouths in a pale breath, their bodies dropping, and the rest clutch their chests and feel their own souls straining to follow.
[Trait: Barghest]

abilities.name: Death Shriek
abilities.info:
What it does: you shriek and the weak fall; weak foes may die outright, and the rest are badly hurt and shaken.

You draw breath through your root-mouth for a long time, a terrible rasping pull, and the ones who know what you are start running, and then you let it out, a shriek so piercing it bursts their eardrums and stops hearts, and the weak drop where they stand with blood running from their ears and noses, and the strong crawl away whimpering with their hands clamped over their heads.
[Trait: Mandrake Banshee-Root]

abilities.name: Death Spin
abilities.info:
What it does: you seize a foe in water or mud and spin; they're torn, dizzied and held under until they break free.

You come up out of the water with your crocodile jaws open and close them on whatever you hit first, an arm, a leg, a shoulder, and you drag them down and roll, over and over and over, the water churning white and red around you, until up and down mean nothing and their screams turn into bubbles and the limb in your mouth comes away in pieces.
[Trait: Swamp Reaver]

abilities.name: Death Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe and their heart falters; they're poisoned badly and may collapse.

Your tail comes down once and it's barely a prick, a pinpoint of blood on their neck, and they laugh, and then the laugh catches in their throat as their heart stumbles, beats too fast, then too slow, then hard enough to shake them, their hands going to their chest and their face going grey, and they look up at you begging with their eyes as their legs give out.
[Trait: Wyvern Death-Queen]

abilities.name: Death Wail
abilities.info:
What it does: you wail and the weak drop; weak foes collapse, near death, and the rest are shaken.

You rise up over the field with your hair streaming in a wind that isn't there and you wail, and the sound tears through them, and the weak ones just drop, eyes rolled back, blood running from their ears and noses, and the strong ones fall to their knees clutching their heads begging for it to stop.
[Trait: Banshee Queen]

abilities.name: Death Web
abilities.info:
What it does: you trap a group in venom-soaked webs; they're held and poisoned each turn until they break free.

You throw your webs wide and they come down over the group dripping, every strand soaked in your venom, and wherever it touches skin it burns, and the more they struggle the more of it they rub in, and soon the screaming turns to choking as their throats swell and their muscles lock and they hang there twitching in a web that's killing them slowly.
[Trait: Black Widow]

abilities.name: Deep Freeze
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe freezes solid for two turns and can't act; a hit while it's frozen does heavy cold damage and breaks the ice.
You breathe out slow and the frost goes across the gap to them like it knows the way, it climbs their legs, their chest, their throat, they try to cry out and it freezes in their open mouth, and then it's a shape of solid ice standing exactly where it stood, every hair and every tooth held perfectly still, the deep cold itself holding it there for you.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Deep Freeze]

abilities.name: Deep Wood Wrath
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the whole forest down on your foes; roots, branches and every creature of the wood strike them for a few turns.

You remember before monsters, before anything, and you've seen a lot of fools come into this wood with fire, and you're tired of them, and the forest knows it, and it comes down on them all at once, roots, branches, falling trunks, wolves and bears and stinging things pouring out of the green from every side.
[Trait: Deep Wood Elder]

abilities.name: Demand Submission
abilities.info:
What it does: order a beaten or frightened foe to yield: weaker ones surrender and obey you.

You stand over it with your weight on its chest and your face close to its face and tell it to yield, once, and it looks up at you a long time and then it goes limp, belly up, throat bare, whining, and it's yours.
[Trait: Trained Command IV]

abilities.name: Desert Court
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every desert serpent to your side; snakes, lamia and sand-crawlers fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You lift your arms over the oasis and sing one long note that carries out across the dunes, and the sand moves, rippling, hissing, and out of it they rise, vipers and sand-snakes and great desert serpents and your own lamia sisters in their bronze and gold, until the desert at your back is a sea of scales and forked tongues waiting for their queen to point.
[Trait: Lamia Queen]

abilities.name: Desert's Wrath
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a sandstorm and strike from inside it; foes are blinded and battered while you hit them from the storm for a few turns.

You raise both claws to the sky and click them together, and the wind answers, the dunes lifting into the air in a howling brown wall that rolls over them and blots out the sun, sand scouring skin raw, and somewhere in it something enormous is moving, and every now and then a claw comes out of the storm and takes someone back into it.
[Trait: Scorpid Desert-King]

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.info:
What it does: consume the soul of a beaten foe outright as it dies: a big heal, and you shake off any effect on you.

You take the last of them in one long breath, all of it, and it goes down into you like a hot meal after a winter, and every hurt you had fades and every hold on you lets go.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VII]

abilities.name: Devour the Fallen
abilities.info:
What it does: you eat from a fresh kill; its soul comes into you faster and you mend a few of your wounds.

You drop onto the kill before it's cold, jaw unhinging wider than it should, and you tear in, hot blood and the crack of small bones, and with every mouthful you feel the soul sliding down with the meat, warm and thick, your own torn skin knitting shut as the hunger quiets for a moment, just a moment.
[Trait: Hungering Maw]

abilities.name: Devour the Field
abilities.info:
What it does: you flood across the field and devour it; foes caught under you are engulfed and dissolved, and you heal from everything you eat.

You spread, a mountain of ooze sliding out across the battlefield, and it covers everything, grass, bodies, stones, carts, and whoever is trapped under the edge of you scream and kick as you pull them in, dissolving as they go, and with every one you eat you swell bigger and hungrier and the tide comes on faster.
[Trait: Ooze Mountain]

abilities.name: Diamond Body
abilities.info:
What it does: you become unbreakable for a few breaths; nothing can hurt you until it ends.

Your crystal body goes clear and hard as the hardest thing in the world, a diamond the size of a river, and they throw everything at you, claws and fire and stone and spells, and all of it just skids off you in showers of sparks while you lie there glittering.
[Trait: Diamond Wyrm]

abilities.name: Dig In
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw up a wall, cover, a trap or a shelter fast out of whatever's lying around, and it holds for the night or the fight. Rolls build.

Claws, rocks and deadwood go flying into place while everyone else is still arguing about it, and when you finally sit back there's a wall where there wasn't one and a pit of sharpened sticks right where they'll come running.
[Trait: Den-Builder]

abilities.name: Digest Knowledge
abilities.info:
What it does: you learn a skill from a foe you digested; you can use it for the rest of the day.

You pulse slowly around the last of what you ate and let it settle into your core, and the knowledge goes with it, how they held a weapon, how they picked a lock, how they spoke to beasts, and when you move again your body moves the way theirs used to, a dead fighter's tricks wobbling to life in jelly.
[Trait: Sage Slime]

abilities.name: Digesting Touch
abilities.info:
What it does: you digest whatever you touch; one foe or object you grab is burned by acid and starts dissolving.

You lay one soft jelly hand on their arm, almost kindly, and it sticks, and you don't squeeze and you don't hurry, you just wait while they tug and then pull and then beg, and under your palm their skin wrinkles and slides loose, and you drink what's beneath it with the calm of something that has eaten a thousand of them.
[Trait: Ooze-Cap]

abilities.name: Dim
abilities.info:
What it does: draw the light out of a small area: it goes dark around you, and you're hard to see in it.
You close your hand slowly and the light near you drains into it, the torches dimming, the shadows creeping in from the corners, until you're standing in a pool of dark that nobody else can see into.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Dim]

abilities.name: Dire Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you lunge and bite through a foe's guard; whatever they block with breaks and the limb behind it is badly hurt.

The snarl tears up out of your chest, drool roping off your jaws and spattering the dirt, and you hit them with all your weight behind your teeth, no feint, no circling, just fury, biting straight through whatever they put between you, splintering and shrieking as it gives, and you don't let go, you shake them until the limb behind it snaps and they're flung into the mud with the hot stink of your breath still on their face.
[Trait: Dire Wolfkin]

abilities.name: Dirt in the Eyes
abilities.info:
What it does: throw dirt, sand or spit in one foe's eyes: they are blinded for a turn and fight badly.

You scoop up a handful while they're busy looking at your other hand and fling it straight in their face, and they rear back clawing at their eyes and swinging blind, and you step round behind them while they're still blinking.
[Trait: Trained Trick I]

abilities.name: Dirty Trick
abilities.info:
You throw grit, trip a leg or stab low; the next blow lands on an off-balance foe.
[Trait: Goblin]

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.info:
What it does: you fire a ray that unmakes what it hits; one foe or object is badly hurt or destroyed outright.

Your central eye narrows and goes black, then white, then something that isn't a colour at all, and the beam it fires doesn't burn or freeze, it unmakes, and whatever it touches comes apart, flaking away into grey dust from the edges inward, armour, flesh, bone, while they scream and watch their own arm fall away into nothing.
[Trait: Gazer Tyrant-Eye]

abilities.name: Dissolve
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe's flesh dissolves where you touch them: heavy acid damage, and the wound won't heal for the rest of the fight.
You grab them and hold on and the acid goes into them, and you can feel them coming apart under your fingers, the skin first, then what's under it, and they're screaming and pulling away and leaving part of themselves in your hand.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Dissolve]

abilities.name: Dive Volley
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive out of the sky loosing shot after shot at the foes below, then pull up out of their reach.

You fold your wings and drop out of the clouds, wind howling in your ears and the ground rushing up, and on the way down you loose and loose and loose again, every shot whistling ahead of you into the faces turned up to see what's howling down at them, and at the last instant you snap your wings open and climb back into the storm, leaving them pinned and bleeding with nothing left to shoot back at.
[Trait: Storm Pegataur]

abilities.name: Don't Dig Me Up
abilities.info:
What it does: the stories about you keep foes away; anyone who knows them won't come near you, and weaker ones flee.

They know what you are, everyone does, and when they see you rooted there with that mouth of yours shut tight they go very quiet and very careful, and the ones who aren't sure of themselves back away and keep backing away until they're out of earshot.
[Trait: Last Scream Mandrake]

abilities.name: Doors That Won't Open
abilities.info:
What it does: you seal a building or room you're in; nobody can leave it without your word for a few turns.

You flick your tail and the doors swing shut, all of them, one after another, with a sound like a sigh, and they won't open, not for pushing, not for pulling, not for hammering, and your guests turn round slowly to face you.
[Trait: Lamia Temple-Queen]

abilities.name: Double Maul
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite with both heads at once; one foe takes two savage bites, or two foes take one each.

Both your heads lunge together from both sides, one going high, one going low, jaws smoking, and they close on them at the same time, and there's no right way to twist, because there's nowhere to go that isn't teeth.
[Trait: Two-Headed Hellhound]

abilities.name: Drag to the Deep
abilities.info:
What it does: you drag a group into the deep; they're held, pulled under and drowning until they break free.

The sea around them boils and the tentacles come up, hundreds of them, wrapping everyone near the water, and they all go under together, and down in the green they climb over each other for a surface that keeps getting further away, friends kicking friends in the face to get one more arm's length closer to the light.
[Trait: Elder Kraken]

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.info:
What it does: you seize a foe near water and drag them under; they're held and drowning until they break free.

The water by the bank barely ripples, then a long, mossy arm shoots up out of it and closes on their ankle, and they get one shriek out before you yank and they're gone, under the black water, kicking and clawing at your arm as you pull them down into the cold and the dark and hold them there, waiting, patient as only a troll can be.
[Trait: River Troll]

abilities.name: Dragged to the Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: you stand in front of your allies like a siege engine; for a few turns missiles and blasts at them hit you instead and barely scratch you.

You plant yourself at the front like they've dragged you up to the walls again, and everything the defenders throw comes at you, rocks and fire and bolts, and it bounces off you and piles up at your feet while the ones behind you walk forward untouched.
[Trait: War Golem]

abilities.name: Dragon Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a long blast of dragonfire; everything in a long line is burned badly.

You're a dragon now and your fire knows it, roaring up out of your belly, and you stretch your neck out and pour it over them in a river of red and gold that goes on and on, melting stone, boiling puddles, and the ones caught in it don't even have time to scream before they're ash on the wind.
[Trait: Young Dragon]

abilities.name: Dragon's Fury
abilities.info:
What it does: you unleash a dragon's fury; fire floods the area in front of you and everything in it is burned.

Every kobold who ever lit a candle at a dragon shrine was praying for this, the day one of them would grow into the real thing, and you rear up over them and roar, and the roar turns into fire, a dragon's fury flooding out over the enemy in a wave of heat so fierce the stone glows, and the kobolds behind you scream in worship as the enemy burns.
[Trait: Kobold Dragon]

abilities.name: Dragon's Wrath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a firestorm over a whole field; everything in it is burned.

Kings send gold to your mountain so they never have to see this, and you climb into the sky over them and fill it with your wings, and you breathe, not a jet but a storm, fire rolling out across the land in a boiling wall that swallows armies, forests, villages, and when it finally passes there's nothing but black earth and smoke and a silence that lasts for years.
[Trait: Elder Dragon]

abilities.name: Drain
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes shadow damage and you heal a little of it back.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow Magic]

abilities.name: Drake Breath
abilities.info:
Breathe fire across a group of foes.
[Trait: Soul of the Drake]

abilities.name: Drake Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: breathe a great gout of fire over a whole group in front of you; everything it touches catches and burns for several turns.

Your belly heaves and the scales of your throat light up, orange, then yellow, then white, the heat coming off you so hard the air ripples, and you rear back and empty the whole furnace out in one roaring rush that rolls across them and over them and past them, setting everything in its path burning at once, the screams starting a moment later.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Drake Fire]

abilities.name: Drakeling Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a long jet of dragonfire that burns everything in a line.

Your little wings snap out wide and your chest swells, scales glowing red from the inside, and you rear back on your hind legs and let go, a roaring river of dragonfire pouring out of your jaws, and it's so much bigger than anything that should come out of something your size that they're still staring when it hits them.
[Trait: Drakeling]

abilities.name: Draw the Warmth
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns, every hit you land on a foe saps a little of their strength and gives you a little health.

Every time you touch them something comes away with it, a little thread of warmth pulled out of them and into you, and they get greyer and slower with every hit while you get warmer.
[Trait: Trained Absorb III]

abilities.name: Dread Wings
abilities.info:
What it does: you darken the sky and breathe grave-fire over a whole field; everything in it is burned and the dead rise.

Your vast bone wings spread across the sky and the sun goes grey behind them, and you sweep low over the field breathing a storm of green grave-fire, and it covers everything, the living and the dead, and when you circle back round the dead you've made are standing up to join you.
[Trait: Elder Dracolich]

abilities.name: Dream Prison
abilities.info:
What it does: you trap one foe in a dream; they're helpless and asleep, living it, until something breaks it.

You kiss them on the forehead and they fall into it, a dream so lovely they never want to leave, home, warm bread, everyone they ever lost alive and laughing, and they lie smiling under your trees while the moss grows over them and their body wastes, and if they ever claw their way to waking they'll weep for what they had to leave behind.
[Trait: Dream Dryad]

abilities.name: Drink the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain everything in your darkness; every foe inside it is badly hurt each turn while you heal.

You spread out over the field in a red-black fog, and everything inside you empties, the blood coming out of them through their skin in a fine red mist that you breathe in, every soldier, every horse, every bird that flies into you, until the darkness is full and red and the ground under it is covered in pale husks.
[Trait: Crimson Abyss]

abilities.name: Drive the Prey
abilities.info:
What it does: herd one creature or a group the way you want them to go, toward a trap, your allies or a dead end.

You don't go straight at it, you come from the side and the wrong side, showing yourself, hiding, showing yourself again, and every time it veers away from you it's going exactly where you wanted it.
[Trait: Trained Hunt II]

abilities.name: Drop by Drop
abilities.info:
What it does: you sell a little of your venom; poisoners and traders pay you a fortune for it, or trade you secrets.

You let one drop fall into the little glass vial and hold it up to the light, and the poisoner across from you licks their lips, and starts pushing gold across the table, more and more, and then starts telling you secrets too.
[Trait: Scorpid Venom-King]

abilities.name: Drown in Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: you drag one foe into black water; they're held and drowning in darkness until they break free.

Something takes their ankle, cold and strong, and they're going down, the light shrinking to a pinprick above them, and they hold their breath, and hold it, and hold it, nails tearing off on your scales, until their body breathes in without asking them, a lungful of black water, and the last thing they ever see is your lantern eyes blinking open in front of their face.
[Trait: Trench Lord]

abilities.name: Drowned Host
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise the drowned dead from the marsh; they drag foes under and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You stand at the edge of the fen and sing a low wet song, and the water starts to bubble, and they come up out of it, everyone who ever drowned in your marsh, bloated and grey with weed in their teeth and their eyes gone milky, and they wade out toward the living with their soft swollen hands reaching, and whoever they catch is pulled down into the mud, kicking, and held there under a pile of the dead until the kicking stops.
[Trait: Fen Witch]

abilities.name: Drowning Path
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead your party through any marsh safely, and lure foes who follow you onto the paths that drown people.

You know which tussock holds and which one doesn't, and you walk across them light and easy, humming, and the ones following you try to step where you stepped and get it wrong, and the marsh takes them down slow, bubbling, while you keep walking.
[Trait: Fen Hag]

abilities.name: Drowning Song
abilities.info:
What it does: sing a song that holds a whole group still and dreaming for several turns; anyone shaken awake is dazed after.

The song comes out of you rising and falling with the tide and it gets into all of them, and they stop, the nearest first, hands sagging, mouths falling open, eyes going glassy and wet, standing there swaying in the water while it creeps up around them, so lost in the dream you've put in their heads they'll smile all the way under.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Drowning Song]

abilities.name: Dryad Roots
abilities.info:
Call roots from the ground to seize and hold.
[Trait: Soul of the Dryad]

abilities.name: Duck and Weave
abilities.info:
What it does: for a turn the next attack aimed at you is far likelier to miss as you slip out of its way.

You see it coming and drop your head and roll your shoulders and it goes past you close enough to feel the wind of it, and you come up the other side of it grinning while they stumble after their own swing.
[Trait: Trained Strike I]

abilities.name: Dune Sleep
abilities.info:
What it does: you lie still and pass for the land itself; foes camp, walk or fight right on top of you without knowing.

You stretch out and settle and go still, and the sand drifts over you, and you're a ridge, a line of dunes, the land, and they make camp on your tail and light their fires and argue and sleep, and you lie there under them waiting.
[Trait: Great Lamia]

abilities.name: Dungeon Lore
abilities.info:
What it does: know the ways of the Great Dungeon around you: which floors are deadly, what lives there and how to get through.

You know this floor and the one below it, what hunts here and what hides, where the water runs and which halls nobody ever walks back out of, and you lead them round the worst of it one quiet turn at a time.
[Trait: Trained Lore III]

abilities.name: Dungeon's Arteries
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every tunnel of the dungeon as part of your own track; you find any place below or the way to it.

The tunnels are your old tracks, every one of them, and you know them the way you know your own body, every bend, every branch, and wherever they want to go down there, you know the way, and the shortest way, and the way nobody else knows.
[Trait: World Worm]

abilities.name: Dust on the Horizon
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a dust cloud with your riders that can be seen for days; foes who see it are frightened and fight badly when you arrive.

You send the herd running in circles and the dust goes up into the sky in a great brown column you can see from three days away, and everyone who sees it knows what's coming, and by the time you arrive half of them have already made their minds up to run.
[Trait: Centaur Warchief]

abilities.name: Early Night, Late Dawn
abilities.info:
What it does: you hold back the dawn; night lasts as long as you want it in one place, and shadow-born there stay strong.

The sun is supposed to rise and it doesn't, you've asked the night to stay, and it does, the dark hanging over the place long into the morning, and everything that lives in the dark keeps hunting.
[Trait: Shade Night-Lord]

abilities.name: Earth-Eater
abilities.info:
What it does: you collapse the ground under an army; foes in the area fall, are buried and badly hurt.

You've been tunnelling under them for days without them knowing, loop after loop, hollowing the ground out, and when you're done you turn and come up through the middle of it all, and the ground under them drops, fighters and beasts and wagons falling into the earth in one great roaring collapse.
[Trait: World Worm]

abilities.name: Earthquake Stomp
abilities.info:
What it does: you stomp hard enough to shake the earth; every foe nearby is thrown down and buildings may crack.

You lift one tree-trunk leg as high as your belly lets you and bring it down, and the earth goes with it, a deep boom you feel in your guts, the ground rippling outward, walls cracking, roofs sliding, and every foe for fifty paces thrown off their feet and bounced across the shaking ground.
[Trait: Ogre Titan]

abilities.name: Earthshaker
abilities.info:
What it does: bring both fists, or your whole weight, down on the ground: every foe close around you is knocked off their feet.

You lift your arms high over your head and bring them down together and the ground jumps, a crack running out from under you in every direction, and everybody close by goes over, arms flailing, landing hard in the dirt around you.
[Trait: Trained Fight IV]

abilities.name: Earthwork
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a wall of packed earth in moments; it blocks a path or shelters allies.

You dig in with all your broad limbs at once and the dirt flies, but it doesn't fly anywhere, you're catching it, packing it, slapping it into place, spitting on it to bind it, and in a few breaths there's a wall of hard-packed earth taller than you standing between your friends and the enemy.
[Trait: Antfolk Builder]

abilities.name: Eat an Army
abilities.info:
What it does: you eat anything or anyone you've beaten during the fight; each mouthful heals you a lot.

You pick one of them up off the ground by the leg, still kicking, and you just eat it, right there in the middle of the fight, crunch, gulp, and you can feel it go into you, and you wipe your mouth and look around for the next one while the rest of them scream.
[Trait: Ogre King]

abilities.name: Eat Away
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes acid damage and its armour is weakened for the rest of the fight.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid Magic]

abilities.name: Eat Through
abilities.info:
What it does: touch one object and the acid eats into it: a lock, a chain, a hinge, a strap weakens and breaks.
You press your palm to it and it hisses, and the smell comes up sharp and sour, and when you pull your hand away the metal under it is pitted and soft and comes apart when you twist it.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Eat Through]

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.info:
What it does: you darken the sky over a field; it falls dark for the rest of the scene, and the dead and the shadow-born grow stronger in it.

You rise up into the noon sky and spread yourself across it, and the sun goes dim, then dark, a black hole where the sun should be with a thin ring of fire around it, and the land below goes cold and dim, and in the gloom everything dead and everything of shadow stirs and wakes and grows strong.
[Trait: Eclipse Wraith]

abilities.name: Eight-Legged Scuttle
abilities.info:
What it does: you scuttle up walls and across ceilings at speed; for a few turns you can strike from above and be gone before anyone looks up.

Your eight legs go all at once in a horrible quick ripple and you're up the wall and across the ceiling before they've turned, upside down and grinning, and the first they know of it is the drop and the bite and the skitter back up into the dark.
[Trait: Spider Goblin]

abilities.name: Elder Dominion
abilities.info:
What it does: you dominate a strong mind; even a powerful foe obeys you for a while unless they break free.

They're strong, stronger than most, and they meet your eyes thinking they can take it, and you just look at them, and the weight of three thousand years comes down on their mind, and they crumple, and when they look up again their eyes are yours.
[Trait: Vampire Elder]

abilities.name: Elder's Word
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak with an elder's weight; even angry foes stop to listen, and a fight may pause or a bargain open while you talk.

You don't raise your voice, you lower it, a slow deep rumble, and somehow it carries over every shout and clash, and they turn, a few at a time, to look at the grey-muzzled bear standing there with honey on its breath and a hundred winters in its eyes, weapons sinking, because when an elder of the north speaks even fools know to shut up and hear it.
[Trait: Bearkin Elder]

abilities.name: Ember Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a short gout of fire that burns one foe.

Your frill flares open bright as a sunset and your throat swells, and the little wing-buds on your back flicker with flame, and you cough out a burst of glowing embers and fire that splashes over them, sparks catching in their hair and clothes and leaving them stamping and slapping at a dozen little fires.
[Trait: Ember Salamander]

abilities.name: Empty Sockets
abilities.info:
What it does: the grave-fire in your eyes holds one foe's stare; they're paralysed with dread for a turn.

You lower your skull to their level and the green fire in your empty eyes flares up, and they look into it and can't look away, and something in them freezes solid with a fear older than they are.
[Trait: Dracolich]

abilities.name: End of the Road
abilities.info:
What it does: you sit at the end of a foe's road; they see you there and know they're marked, and fight badly for the rest of the fight.

You don't attack, you just sit at the end of their road where they can see you, still, black, waiting, and they see you, and they know what it means, and from then on every swing they make has death in the back of it.
[Trait: Grim Hound]

abilities.name: End the Siege
abilities.info:
What it does: you look along the top of a wall or a battle line; the foes standing on it turn slow and stiff, and the weakest are stone.

You lift your great head and let your eyes travel slowly along the top of the wall, one end to the other, and wherever they pass the defenders stiffen and grey and stop, and you hear them screaming from the far end as they watch it coming toward them.
[Trait: Basilisk King]

abilities.name: Endless Halls
abilities.info:
What it does: in your maze you make the halls run on without end around a foe; they can't reach an exit or their allies until you let them.

You breathe out slow and the labyrinth breathes with you, and the hall in front of them stretches, torch after torch after torch, the same cracked flagstone, the same dripping arch, their own footsteps coming back at them from up ahead a heartbeat early, and they walk and run and finally crawl down a corridor that has no end, because you are the lord of these halls and you haven't decided where it stops.
[Trait: Labyrinth Lord]

abilities.name: Endless Heads
abilities.info:
What it does: no single wound can stop you; every head fights on by itself, and you can only be brought down by destroying them all.

They hack and hack, and every head they take off is replaced, and the ones they burn are still snapping, and you fill the sump with necks and jaws and eyes until they're fighting a forest of you, and every time one of them thinks they've found the heart of you there's another head behind them hissing in their ear.
[Trait: Hundred-Headed Hydra]

abilities.name: Endless Night
abilities.info:
What it does: you drop a night so deep over the area that no light works in it; only you can see, and foes caught in it are hunted blind for the rest of the fight.

You stretch, slow and long, and the stars wink out above you, then the moon, then the torches, and the dark that comes down is thicker than any night they have ever known, so black they can't see their own hands in front of their faces, and somewhere in it something big is purring, close enough to feel the rumble, and the endless night has no dawn until you decide it's had enough to eat.
[Trait: Night Panther]

abilities.name: Endless Pack
abilities.info:
What it does: you call and allied gnolls keep coming out of the grass in waves for the rest of the fight, more for every one that falls.

You don't even get up, you just sit back on your pile of bones and laugh, and the grass laughs back, first from the left, then the right, then from behind them, and they kill one and two more come over the rise, kill those and there's ten, until they finally understand there was never a pack out there at all, the whole plain is gnolls and it has all night.
[Trait: Gnoll Khan]

abilities.name: Endless Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you trap a group in your song; they stand helpless while it lasts, and it lasts until something breaks it.

You sing and you don't stop, ever, and the ones who hear it stop where they are and listen, and they're still listening at nightfall, and still listening the next day, not eating, not drinking, not moving, just smiling and listening while their bodies waste away around the sound.
[Trait: Endless Song Siren]

abilities.name: Endless Sounder
abilities.info:
What it does: you call your sounders and they keep charging out of the trees in waves for the rest of the fight.

You stand at the edge of the oak wood and lift your snout to the wind and call, and the forest floor shakes, then breaks open in bristles, sounder after sounder after sounder pouring out from between the trunks, mothers and boars and half-grown young all squealing and charging, and every time they think the last of them has come out another hundred push through the bracken.
[Trait: Boarfolk Queen]

abilities.name: Endless Well
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight your power never runs dry: your power moves cost nothing and come back twice as fast.

You reach down for it and there's no bottom, it just keeps coming, more and more, from somewhere deeper than you knew you went, and you stop counting and throw it at them.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VIII]

abilities.name: Endless Winter
abilities.info:
What it does: you bring an endless winter down over the area; it stays frozen, slowing and freezing every foe in it, for the rest of the fight.

You press your frozen hand to the ground and the frost spreads out from your fingers in a white ring that never stops growing, grass snapping, water freezing solid, birds dropping out of the sky, and the cold sinks into everything, into the walls and the bones and the blood, a winter with no spring at the end of it that holds them until you choose to release them.
[Trait: Winter Ogre]

abilities.name: Enforcer's Weight
abilities.info:
Lean on someone with the whole Table behind you; the next fight or command action against a lawbreaker hits harder.
[Trait: The Big Table: Enforcer]

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.info:
What it does: swallow a smaller foe whole: they are trapped inside you and dissolve a little each turn until they break free or are gone, and you heal as they go.

You rise up over them and come down and they're inside you, all of them, pounding at you from the inside with their muffled screams bubbling up through you, and you can feel them going, the hair first, then the skin, then the pounding going feeble as you settle down over them and digest, warm and patient and full.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Engulf]

abilities.name: Engulf Corpse
abilities.info:
What it does: you engulf a body and grow from it; you heal and grow stronger for a while.

You slide over the body and it sinks into you, and they watch it happen through the clear wobble of your flesh, skin melting, then muscle, then the bones blurring pale and vanishing, and as it goes you swell and brighten and your wounds close up, fat and full and ready for the next one.
[Trait: Jelly-Cap]

abilities.name: Engulf Many
abilities.info:
What it does: you engulf several foes at once; they're held and dissolving until they break free, and you heal from them.

You rear up and come down over the whole group at once, and they're inside you, three, four of them, floating, kicking, their mouths open in silent screams as the acid goes to work, and you feel them dissolving into you and you swell bigger with every one.
[Trait: Devouring Slime]

abilities.name: Engulfing Grasp
abilities.info:
What it does: you engulf one foe in your jelly body; they're held and dissolving until they break free, and you heal as you digest them.

You fall on them, a wave of warm jelly, and they're inside you, palms flat against the walls of you, a scream coming out of their mouth as a cloud of silver bubbles, and their hair lifts loose and drifts away from their scalp in one soft clump while they watch it go, still kicking as you feed.
[Trait: Jelly Troll]

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.info:
What it does: you erupt, raining fire and molten rock over a whole field; everything in it is burned and battered.

The ground under your feet bulges and splits and starts to glow, and you rear up, a salamander-dragon the size of a mountain's heart, and you erupt, fire and smoke and molten rock blasting out of your mouth and back and every crack in your scales, high into the sky, and then it comes down on them, burning stones raining out of the black clouds.
[Trait: Volcano Salamander]

abilities.name: Eternal Ice
abilities.info:
What it does: freeze everything in a wide area solid for two turns: every foe in it is trapped in ice and takes heavy cold damage when it breaks.
You open your hands and the cold just goes out of you all at once, silent, and everything in front of you stops, the foes, the dust in the air, the water in mid splash, all of it held perfectly still in ice, the deep cold itself, and then the crack when it finally lets go.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Eternal Ice]

abilities.name: Even Vampires Fear
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare down another undead or blood-drinker; it backs off, won't attack you, and may obey you.

You look at it, the vampire, the wraith, the thing that thinks it's the worst thing in the graveyard, and it looks back at you, and it backs away first, because even the worst things in the dark know what the king of the hungry dead does to things that annoy it.
[Trait: Ghoul King]

abilities.name: Every Ant Knows
abilities.info:
What it does: every ant in your city knows your scent and reports to you; you know anything that happens in your mound or near it.

You let your scent out into the tunnels and it spreads to every ant in the city, and back along the same trails comes everything they've seen, who's come in, who's gone out, who's where, all of it reaching you as a smell.
[Trait: Antfolk Mound-Lord]

abilities.name: Every Rat
abilities.info:
What it does: you ask the rats and learn what they've seen and heard across the region: who went where, who said what, and where things are hidden.

You sit back in the dark and listen, and they come to you, a thousand tiny visitors pressing their whiskers to your ear, the rat under the warlord's table, the rat in the tavern wall, the rat in the guardhouse grain, and every one of them whispers what it saw, every secret, every coin hidden under every floorboard across ten towns, until there's nothing anybody has done in the dark that you don't know.
[Trait: Rat King]

abilities.name: Every Road Bows
abilities.info:
What it does: every fox spirit on the roads answers you; foxes nearby come to fight, spy or lead travellers astray for you.

You walk the road with your nine tails behind you like a sunrise, and from every hedge and every hollow they come out and lower their heads, and you tell them what you want, and they scatter to do it.
[Trait: Nine-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Every Satyr Running
abilities.info:
What it does: you blow your horn and every satyr within a day's walk comes running; they fight, feast or wreck whatever you point at.

You put the great horn to your lips and blow, and the sound goes out over the hills and doesn't stop, and over every ridge they come, satyrs, dozens, hundreds, laughing and stamping and ready for whatever you've got.
[Trait: Satyr King]

abilities.name: Every Web Shivers
abilities.info:
What it does: every spider in the canyon comes when you move; a swarm of spiders fights for you for the rest of the fight.

You shift your weight and every web in the canyon shivers with you, and out of every crack and every shadow they come pouring, spiders, thousands of them, all legs, down the walls toward whatever's annoyed you.
[Trait: Black Widow]

abilities.name: Every Wreck
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every wreck on your coast; where it lies, what it carried and how to get to it.

You were singing for every one of them, so you know them all, where they went down, what was in their holds, who was on them, and how to get into each one now where it's lying in the dark on the bottom.
[Trait: Siren Storm-Queen]

abilities.name: Everything Catches
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns everything you touch catches fire; any foe you hit or grab burns each turn.

You stop holding it in and the fire runs down your arms and over your hands and every single thing you touch catches, the rope, the wood, the hide, the ones who grab you, all of it blazing up where your fingers were.
[Trait: Salamander Flamelord]

abilities.name: Everything Owes You
abilities.info:
What it does: you call in an old debt; any creature that's ever bargained in the wild owes you a favour, and must pay it.

You crook one long finger and they come, from every corner of the wild, every creature that ever made a deal under the hills, and they stand in front of you and you remind them, very politely, what they owe, and they pay.
[Trait: Fae King]

abilities.name: Everything's a Weapon
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you fight with whatever is to hand, a stool, a pot, a handful of coals, a tail: each hit is unpredictable and hard to defend against.

You stop reaching for anything in particular and grab everything, a pot round the head, a handful of coals down the neck, a chair leg, a bucket, a rock, a fistful of their own hair, and they can't guard against any of it because there's no telling what's coming next.
[Trait: Trained Trick VII]

abilities.name: Evil Eye
abilities.info:
What it does: fire a beam from your eye at one foe: it weakens, slows or burns them (you choose which) for several turns.

Your eye rolls round to find them and swells and goes bright, a thin hum rising behind it, and then the light comes out of you in a straight burning line, and where it lands they go weak at the knees, or slow like they're walking through mud, or just start smoking, whichever you wanted.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Evil Eye]

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike a killing cut at a wounded foe; a badly hurt foe may die outright.

You walk over to them slowly while they crawl backwards through their own blood holding up one shaking hand, and you look down at them with your calm green eyes and say nothing at all, and you raise one scythe and bring it down once, clean, and their head rolls into the grass with the mouth still trying to finish the word please.
[Trait: Mantid Executioner]

abilities.name: Eye for Value
abilities.info:
What it does: size up one thing or one load of goods: you know roughly what it's worth in ingots and who would want it.

You turn it over in your hands and heft it and sniff it and bite the corner of it, eyes half shut, and the number comes to you the way a smell does, and right behind it the name of the one trader in three days' walk who'd pay double for it.
[Trait: Trained Barter I]

abilities.name: Eye of the Dungeon
abilities.info:
What it does: you see anywhere in the dungeon you have been, as if you were there.

You close your central eye and open every other one, and through each of them you see a different room, a different hall, a different floor, the dungeon spread out in front of you with every living thing moving through it, and you can watch anyone you like, anywhere you've ever been.
[Trait: All-Seeing Gazer]

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you stand calm in a storm that tears your foes apart; everything around you is battered while you and allies near you are safe.

The storm you call is the worst the coast has ever seen, and you stand in the very middle of it in perfect stillness with your hair barely stirring, the sailors' goddess smiling at the sky, while all around you the wind rips trees out of the ground and hurls your enemies away.
[Trait: Sylph Storm-Queen]

abilities.name: Eyes Command
abilities.info:
What it does: the lesser gazers of your hall fight for you; their rays strike your foes for the rest of the fight.

You turn and every lesser gazer in the hall turns with you, and you look at the one you want gone, and every one of them looks too, and the rays come from everywhere at once.
[Trait: Gazer Tyrant-Eye]

abilities.name: Eyes in the Shadow
abilities.info:
What it does: you let the little green eyes out of your shadow to spy; for a day you see whatever they see across a whole area.

Your shadow stretches and the little eyes in it blink and crawl out of it and scatter in every direction, into cracks, under doors, up into the rafters, and you close your own eyes and see through all of theirs at once, every whisper and every secret, giggling to yourself.
[Trait: Hag Mother]

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.info:
What it does: fade for a moment: pass through walls, doors and bodies and slip through shadow; nothing can hit you while you are faded.

You loosen your hold on yourself and the world turns thin and cold, sounds coming from far away, and you drift forward into the wall and it gives like fog, and the blow swung at you goes straight through you and out the other side, and then you're gone through the stone and the only thing left is a chill in the air and frost on the wall.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Fade]

abilities.name: Fae Bargain
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike a binding fae bargain; both sides must keep it, and the one who breaks it pays a price the fae choose.

You hold out a hand with too many joints in the fingers and smile, and tell them what you want and what you'll give, and the moment they shake on it they feel it settle in their bones, a bargain the hills themselves will hold them to, and every word of it is fair, and every word of it means something slightly different from what they thought.
[Trait: Fae King]

abilities.name: Fae Court
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the fae of the woods to help you; pixies, sprites and wild spirits fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You clap your hands once and the grove lights up, little lights blinking on in every leaf, every flower, every knothole, and out they come, pixies and sprites and things with antlers and moth-wing ears, the fae court pouring out of the trees chattering and giggling with their tiny cruel teeth already bared.
[Trait: Fae Grove-Queen]

abilities.name: Fae Light
abilities.info:
What it does: you conjure dazzling fae lights; foes are dazzled and distracted for a turn or two.

Your leaf-veined wings shimmer and a dozen little lights pop into the air around you, blue and pink and gold, darting and spinning and giggling, and they swarm around their heads, flashing in their eyes, zipping behind them, and they're swatting at the air and spinning on the spot, unable to see you for the glitter.
[Trait: Fae Dryad]

abilities.name: Falling Sky
abilities.info:
What it does: you pull a star out of the sky and drop it on your foes; everything where it lands is blasted and burned.

You reach up and close your fingers around a star and the night darkens around the hole it leaves, and they look up and watch it come, a white point swelling into a burning eye, the night turning to noon, their shadows shrinking under their feet as they understand far too late there's nowhere to run from something that big, and then it lands, and the ground where they stood is a glowing crater ringing for a mile.
[Trait: Star Khan]

abilities.name: False Door
abilities.info:
What it does: you pass as a door until someone touches you; then you grab them.

You're a door, a perfectly ordinary heavy oak door with an iron ring for a handle, and they reach for the ring, and the ring is warm, and soft, and it closes round their fingers, and the wood around it splits into a grin full of splinters, and the door pulls them in.
[Trait: Door Mimic]

abilities.name: Famine
abilities.info:
What it does: you curse a camp or village with famine; its food and water spoil and every foe in it is weakened for as long as they stay in the cursed ground.

You walk once around their camp at dusk, slow, trailing one claw through the dirt and laughing to yourself, and by morning the grass has died in a perfect ring around their tents, the horses lie dead where they stood and the grain sacks hold nothing but dust and little white teeth, and whichever way they march to get out of it, the dead grass marches with them.
[Trait: Gnoll Elder Witch]

abilities.name: Fast Bore
abilities.info:
What it does: you bore through rock at a run; you can travel through stone as fast as a person runs on open ground.

You put your ringed mouth to the rock and grind, rings of teeth grinding against each other, and the stone just goes, ground to gravel and spat out behind you, and you slide forward into the hole you've made almost as fast as you made it, leaving a smooth round tunnel behind you.
[Trait: Rockworm Borer]

abilities.name: Fear Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: you scream and weak foes flee in terror for a few turns; stronger ones are shaken.
