Your scream isn't a bird's anymore, it's every terrible thing at once, a mother finding her child dead, a house burning with the family inside, wolves at the door, and it goes straight into the back of their skulls, and the faint-hearted drop everything and run blind and sobbing, and even the hard ones find their hands shaking.
[Trait: Harpy Banshee]

abilities.name: Fear Shade
abilities.info:
What it does: fill one foe's mind with shadow: they are frightened for two turns and fight badly or flee.
You look at them and let the dark into their head, and suddenly every shadow around them is moving, reaching, whispering, and they back away from nothing, swinging at the dark, and then they turn and run.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Fear Shade]

abilities.name: Feast for All
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a feast in your hall; everyone who eats there heals fully, and the tribes who came owe you a favour.

You set out the long table and the fire roars and the food keeps coming, meat and honey and fish and bread, and everyone eats until they can't move, and the old wounds close and the old grudges cool, and they all leave owing you something.
[Trait: Bearkin Hearth-Elder]

abilities.name: Feast of Kings
abilities.info:
What it does: after a fight, every scavenger on the field comes to feed on the fallen and every mouthful they take heals you and your allies.

When the fighting's done you walk out among the dead with your crown of finger bones rattling, and everything that eats the dead comes to you, crows dropping out of the sky, rats pouring out of the ground, hyenas crawling in on their bellies, and every mouthful any one of them swallows mends you as if you'd taken it yourself, so the whole field feeds its king.
[Trait: Carrion King]

abilities.name: Feast of the Fallen
abilities.info:
What it does: you feed on every corpse around you; you heal fully and grow stronger for the rest of the fight.

You're as old as the oldest war, and the battlefield you grow on is still giving up bones, and now every body on it withers at once, shrinking and greying and crumbling to dust as your roots drink them dry, and you grow, swelling up out of the earth huge and green and terrible, fat on every fallen body for a mile.
[Trait: Grave-King Mandrake]

abilities.name: Feast on Fear
abilities.info:
What it does: a frightened foe near you feeds you: for a few turns each frightened foe heals you a little every turn.

Their fear comes off them in waves, sour and sharp in the air, and you open yourself up and breathe it in, and it goes down into you warm, and the more they shake and back away and whimper the stronger and steadier you feel.
[Trait: Trained Absorb IV]

abilities.name: Feather Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike from the air with your talons; one foe is raked and knocked down.

You rise up on feathered arms with your raptor's eyes fixed on them, hovering, and then you drop, talon-feet first, raking down their face and chest as you land on them, and you're up and gone again on the next gust before they can even swing back.
[Trait: Stormfeather Sylph]

abilities.name: Feeding Frenzy
abilities.info:
What it does: you set your pack on one foe; ghouls swarm them and tear at them for a few turns.

You point at them and grin with every tooth you've got, and your pack comes out of the dark, grey and long-limbed and hungry, a dozen of them, and they swarm the one you pointed at, dragging them down by the arms and legs and burying them under a heaving pile of claws and teeth.
[Trait: Ghoul Lord]

abilities.name: Feel Like Falling
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe who looks at you too long feels like they're falling; they stagger, lose their footing and can't act for a turn.

They look at you, into the nothing that you are, and they can't look away, and the ground goes out from under them in their head, and they're falling, falling, clawing at the air with their stomach in their throat, standing perfectly still on solid ground.
[Trait: Void Wraith]

abilities.name: Feel the Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: feel through the ground what's moving near you: footsteps, digging, anything big coming.

You put your palms flat on the ground and wait, and it comes up through your hands, the thump of feet, the scrape of digging, something big and slow a long way off and getting closer.
[Trait: Trained Instinct II]

abilities.name: Feel the Heat
abilities.info:
What it does: the forge in your chest burns hotter for a few turns; you heal each turn and foes who strike you are scorched.

The forge in your chest roars up and the heat of it comes out through every seam of you, and the cracks in you glow and close as the heat welds them, and the ones who hit you pull back with their skin blistered from touching you.
[Trait: Forge-Titan]

abilities.name: Feel the Turn
abilities.info:
What it does: sense when a fight is about to go wrong or right: you know the moment to strike or flee, and your next move lands perfectly.

There's always a moment in a fight where it tips one way or the other and you feel this one coming, a change in the air, a breath everybody takes at once, and you're already moving into it, striking or running, while everyone else is still catching up.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VII]

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.info:
What it does: pretend to attack one way and hit another: your next hit on that foe is much harder to stop.

You twitch left like you mean it, your eyes going that way, your shoulder going that way, and they buy it and go to meet it, and you come in from the right into the space they just left wide open.
[Trait: Trained Trick I]

abilities.name: Fen Story
abilities.info:
What it does: the stories about you do the work; any foe who knows your name is frightened, and weaker ones won't come near.

They've all heard the stories, every one of them grew up on them, and when they see you rise out of the bog with your many heads dripping they know exactly who you are, and the stories come back to them, every awful one, and their nerve goes.
[Trait: Black Fen Hydra]

abilities.name: Field of Graves
abilities.info:
What it does: the dead feed your roots; for the rest of the fight you heal each turn for every corpse nearby.

Your roots are down among the fallen already, drinking, and every body on the field is feeding you, and you feel it coming up through you, steady and warm, closing every wound almost as soon as it's opened.
[Trait: Battlefield Mandrake]

abilities.name: Field of Power
abilities.info:
What it does: fill the ground around you with your power for a few turns: foes who stand in it are hurt every turn.

You press your hands to the ground and push it down and out, and the ground all around you fills with it, and anything that steps in there hurts every second it stays.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VI]

abilities.name: Field of Statues
abilities.info:
What it does: you sweep your stare across the whole field; every foe who meets it begins turning to stone, the weakest at once.

You lift your enormous head and the grinding of it carries over the battlefield, and then you look, one slow sweep from left to right, and the screaming starts all at once, hundreds of voices, everyone who met your eyes clawing and stumbling and trying to turn away too late, and then it stops, one voice at a time, until the only sound on the field is the wind moving between a thousand grey figures frozen mid-run, mid-scream, mid-prayer, every one of them still able to watch you walk away.
[Trait: Granite Bull]

abilities.name: Fight Dirty
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns every hit you land carries a dirty trick with it: a bite, a gouge, a stamp, a twist, each one hurting more than it should.

You stop pretending there are any rules, a thumb in the eye, a knee in the gut, teeth in the ear, a stamp on the foot, every hit coming with something extra and nasty on the side, and they don't know what to guard because everything is getting hurt.
[Trait: Trained Trick V]

abilities.name: Filth Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: a filthy bite that leaves its target sick: shaking, feverish and weaker each hour until they rest and get it treated.

You get your teeth in and hold on and worry at it, a quick dirty bite and you're gone again, nothing much, a little puncture, but over the next hour it swells and goes hot and dark around the edges and the sweats come, then the shakes, and they're scratching at it and coughing and their grip won't close right anymore and they keep asking why it's so cold.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Filth Bite]

abilities.name: Final Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe and they die, or nearly so; only the strongest survive it, badly poisoned.

Whoever crossed you finds you waiting in the middle of the road, and you don't hurry, you walk right up to the one at the front, and the barb drops once, and they're dead before they hit the sand, their face black and swollen and their eyes still open, and the rest of them suddenly remember what they owe.
[Trait: Scorpid Death-King]

abilities.name: Find the Way
abilities.info:
What it does: know which way to go: the way out, the way to water, the way to a place or creature you have smelled before.

You stop and turn slowly on the spot with your eyes shut, and something in your chest pulls, faint and steady, and you follow the pull without arguing, left at the split, down the slope, through the gap you never would have tried, and there it is.
[Trait: Trained Instinct V]

abilities.name: Find the Weakness
abilities.info:
What it does: study one strong foe during a fight: for the rest of it everyone in your party hits it harder.

You hang back and watch it fight for a few breaths, the way it guards, the side it won't turn, the gap in its hide where the old scar is, and you shout it to the others, and suddenly everyone's hitting the same place and it's bleeding.
[Trait: Trained Lore V]

abilities.name: Finger Bone Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you snap a finger bone off your necklace at one foe; they're cursed with bad luck for the rest of the fight and every check they make goes worse.

You tug one bone off the necklace with a little click and point it at them and mutter, and the other bones rattle on their own like they're laughing, and then you snap it in half, and somewhere in them something snaps too, and nothing goes right for them after that.
[Trait: Witch-Hag]

abilities.name: Fingertip Spark
abilities.info:
You flick a spark of fire.
[Trait: Imp]

abilities.name: Fire Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: your jaws burn as they bite: the hit sears deep, the foe catches fire and keeps burning for a few turns.

Smoke curls out between your teeth and the inside of your mouth turns orange and you lunge and bite and the jaws close with a hiss and a stink of scorched meat, and they're screaming and beating at the wound and it won't go out, the fire running out from it across them, and you hold on and growl through it.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Fire Bite]

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a cone of fire; foes in front of you are burned.

You plant your paws and your chest heaves and the glow in your throat climbs up into your mouth, and you open your jaws wide and roar, and the roar is fire, a wide cone of it pouring out over them, setting grass and clothes and fur alight.
[Trait: Hellhound Firebreather]

abilities.name: Fire Fist
abilities.info:
What it does: one heavy hit that lands as a burst of fire: fire damage on top of the blow, and the foe is thrown back burning.
You pull your arm back and the fire runs down into your fist and packs itself in there tight and roaring, and when you hit them it all goes off at once, a bang and a blast of heat that lifts them off their feet and throws them back with their front alight.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Fire Fist]

abilities.name: Fire Hooves
abilities.info:
What it does: you run on burning hooves; everything you trample catches fire and the ground behind you burns for a while.

Your hooves go red, then orange, then white as you build up speed, and every step leaves a print burned black into the ground that keeps smouldering, grass catching, leaves curling, and you run right over the top of them, the ones you trample howling as their clothes go up, a line of burning hoofprints stretching out behind you across the field.
[Trait: Cinder Boar]

abilities.name: Fire Lash
abilities.info:
What it does: you lash one foe with a whip of fire; they're burned and knocked back.

Flames ripple up your spine and gather in your hand, and you draw them out long and thin, a whip of living fire hissing and snapping at the end of your arm, and you crack it at them, and it wraps around their arm and bites, leaving a black burned line and the smell of singed hair as they reel back clutching the welt and wailing.
[Trait: Salamander Firecaller]

abilities.name: Fire Spit
abilities.info:
What it does: you spit fire from every head; one foe or a few close together are burned.

Every one of your throats glows and your heads rear back together, and they spit, fat gobs of sticky flame flying out in every direction, splashing over them and sticking and burning, so they're slapping at fire on their arm while another lot lands on their back.
[Trait: Fire Hydra]

abilities.name: Fire Sweep
abilities.info:
What it does: you sweep fire across a group in front of you; all of them are burned.

Fire bends toward you when you call it, and you call it now, drawing in a long breath that makes your scales glow, and then you turn your head in a slow arc from left to right with your jaws open, and a sheet of flame sweeps over all of them, and they go down burning in a line.
[Trait: Flame Drake]

abilities.name: Fire Volley
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe fire from every head at once; foes in front of you are caught in a wall of flame.

Your heads take turns breathing fire, and now they stop taking turns, all of them rearing up together and opening their glowing throats at the same moment, and the fire comes out of you in a roaring wall, every jet joining into one blaze, and there's no gap anywhere to run through.
[Trait: Flame Hydra]

abilities.name: Fire Wyrm Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe fire from the deep earth; everything in front of you is burned badly.

You rear up out of the ground in a spray of glowing slag and your throat glows with the heat of the world's heart, and you breathe, and what comes out isn't fire like a dragon's, it's older and hotter, a blast from the deep places that turns sand to glass and stone to soup and leaves nothing behind it but smoke.
[Trait: Deep Fire Wyrm]

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.info:
What it does: you hurl a ball of fire that bursts on impact; the foe it hits and those near them are burned.

You cup your hands together and fire pours into the space between them, swirling, growing, roaring, until you're holding a ball of flame the size of a melon that lights up the room, and you wind up and throw it, and it bursts against them in a great orange flower that blows them off their feet.
[Trait: Salamander Pyromancer]

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.info:
What it does: a huge eruption of fire around you: every foe in a wide area takes heavy fire damage and burns for three turns.
It builds and builds in your chest until your skin glows with it and you can't hold it any more, and you throw your arms out and let all of it go at once, and for a heartbeat there's nothing in the world but fire, rolling out in every direction, swallowing everything, pure fire.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Firestorm]

abilities.name: Firestorm Heads
abilities.info:
What it does: you rain fire down from every head; everything around you burns.

The air shimmers as you rise up out of it with every head blazing, and you tip them all back and roar fire into the sky, and it comes down again as burning rain, a storm of flame pouring over everything around you, the reeds catching, the water boiling, anyone under it running and burning.
[Trait: Inferno Hydra]

abilities.name: First Light Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow at first light; every foe that hears it is stiffened and slow for the rest of the morning's fight.

You puff up your chest and crow, and it rings out over the field just as the light comes up, and everything that hears it stiffens, joints creaking, legs heavy, and they have to fight you all morning moving like old stone.
[Trait: Stone Rooster]

abilities.name: Flame Gout
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe a gout of fire that burns one foe.

Smoke has been curling out of your nostrils all day, and now your red throat glows bright as a forge as you draw in a breath, and you thrust your head forward and let it go, a fat gout of flame slapping into them and setting them alight from head to boots, and you watch them burn with your head cocked, pleased with yourself.
[Trait: Fire Drake]

abilities.name: Flame Wall
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a wall of fire that blocks a passage or splits a fight; anything crossing it is badly burned.

You drag one burning claw across the ground in a long line, and the line catches, then roars up into a wall of fire taller than an ogre, so hot the air ripples and the ground cracks, and on the far side of it your enemies stand and stare and know that anything that tries to come through will come out the other side as a running torch.
[Trait: Salamander Flamelord]

abilities.name: Flank Them
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you and your allies flank as one: any foe you and an ally both attack is hit much harder.

You catch an ally's eye and jerk your head, you on that side, me on this one, and you split and circle wide around it, and every time it turns to face one of you the other's already on its back, teeth in, until it doesn't know which way to look.
[Trait: Trained Hunt V]

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes fire damage and keeps burning for two turns.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire Magic]

abilities.name: Flash Cut
abilities.info:
What it does: you cut before a foe can move; your strike lands first and hard, no matter how fast they are.

They're fast, they've always been the fastest, and they go for their weapon, and their hand never gets there, because you've already moved, already cut, already folded your arms back into stillness, and they look down at the line opening across their wrist and don't understand how.
[Trait: Mantid Swordmaster]

abilities.name: Flatten the Village
abilities.info:
What it does: you party through a camp or village; walls fall, tents collapse and anyone in the way is knocked flat.

You come stomping into the middle of it with a song on your lips and a drink in your hand, dancing, kicking, swinging your arms, and by the time the music stops half the buildings are down and everybody in them is groaning.
[Trait: Satyr Rampager]

abilities.name: Fleet Lure
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a whole crew, or a whole group, into your power; they come to you and do as you say until the song breaks.

You sing from the reef at dusk and every ship within earshot turns, their sails filling with no wind, their crews lining the rails with tears running down their faces, and they sail right up onto the rocks around you and climb down into the waves and swim to you, smiling, holding out their arms, waiting to hear what their queen wants.
[Trait: Siren-Harpy Queen]

abilities.name: Fleet of Wrecks
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a fleet of salvaged ships; they sail and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You click your great claw once and the sea gives back what it took, wrecks rising dripping out of the bay, masts patched with coral, hulls sealed with barnacles, crewed by crabfolk clacking at the rails, and your fleet of the drowned sails out to meet the enemy.
[Trait: Crabfolk Wreck-King]

abilities.name: Flit
abilities.info:
You dart out of reach in a blink.
[Trait: Pixie]

abilities.name: Flock Raid
abilities.info:
What it does: you send the flock down in a diving raid; every foe in an area is raked and robbed by diving harpies.

You scream once and the flock behind you explodes into wings, a hundred harpies pouring off their ledges in a shrieking spiral, and they come down on them, raking and snatching and pecking, dragging off anything that shines, and when the flock lifts away again the ground is covered in feathers and blood and empty belts.
[Trait: Harpy Matriarch]

abilities.name: Flock Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing the flock into a raid; your siren and harpy allies swoop and strike together for a few turns.

You sing a war song from on high and your flock lifts off its ledges singing it back, and they come down on your enemies in a shrieking, singing storm of wings and talons, every one of them striking on the beat of your song.
[Trait: Siren Harpy-Queen]

abilities.name: Flood of Slime
abilities.info:
What it does: you flood an area and dissolve everything in it; buildings collapse and foes caught in you are dissolved for the rest of the fight.

You pour over everything, green and steaming, and the ones on the rooftops watch their neighbours go under, and can still see them in there, floating, perfectly clear, their faces slowly melting smooth, while the green keeps rising up the walls toward them.
[Trait: Town-Eater Slime]

abilities.name: Flowers on the Steps
abilities.info:
What it does: the people of a city you guard come to your aid; townsfolk and guards bring help, food or warnings.

You call down from your perch and the people who left flowers on your steps come running, with food, with news, with whatever they can carry to help, because you've watched over them every night of their lives.
[Trait: Gargoyle Cathedral-Lord]

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.info:
What it does: a burst of quick hits on one foe: several light hits in one turn that add up fast.

Your arms go and keep going, hit, hit, hit, hit, a blur of small fast blows from every side that they can't possibly cover, each one nothing on its own, and by the time you step back they're cut and bruised all over and gasping.
[Trait: Trained Strike II]

abilities.name: Fog Cloak
abilities.info:
What it does: the mist wraps around you and your allies; you travel unseen through any village or camp, and the fog follows you in.

You walk forward and the mist walks with you, thick and grey and patient, wrapping round your shoulders like a cloak, and you lead the others right down the middle of the village while the people in it rub at their eyes and see nothing but fog.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Mist-Priest]

abilities.name: Footstep Wood
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk a path and a wood grows behind you; within a day it hides the way you came and blocks anyone following.

Everywhere you step a sapling pushes up out of the ground, and by the time you've crossed the field there's a line of young trees behind you, and by nightfall it's a wood, thick and dark and full of thorns, and the trail you left is gone.
[Trait: Grove Mother]

abilities.name: Foresight
abilities.info:
What it does: you see a foe's next move and warn allies; your side acts first and avoids that attack this turn.

Your central eye goes cloudy, then clear, and you see it, the next few breaths of the fight playing out ahead of time, and you hiss a warning, left, now, duck, and your friends move before the blow comes and it hits nothing but air.
[Trait: Gazer Oracle]

abilities.name: Forest Wrath
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the forest's anger down on whoever hurt it; trees lash, roots seize and branches fall on those foes for a few turns.

Birds burst out of your shoulders in a shrieking cloud and the forest goes dead quiet, not a leaf moving, then it remembers every cut and every fire and it comes for them, branches whipping down, roots ripping up out of the earth to grab ankles and drag, whole trees groaning and toppling across the paths behind them, the wood itself screaming its wrath through a voice of a thousand creaking trunks.
[Trait: Treebear]

abilities.name: Forge of Legends
abilities.info:
What it does: you forge a legendary weapon from metal and a soul; it carries a power of that soul's race.

You take the metal and the soul together, one glowing in your left hand, one burning in your right, and press them into each other, and the forge-city falls silent as the heat comes off you in waves, and you work through the night, and in the morning there's a weapon on your anvil that hums when it's held and whispers in a voice that used to belong to something else.
[Trait: Salamander Forge-King]

abilities.name: Forgetting Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a foe into forgetting why they came; they lose their purpose and may wander off or stop fighting.

You sing them a little song while you walk around them, soft and pretty, and with every verse their face goes a bit more blank, and they look down at what's in their hand as if they've never seen it before, and they look around at the grove and smile, and they can't for the life of them remember what they were so angry about.
[Trait: Dryad Enchantress]

abilities.name: Forgotten More
abilities.info:
What it does: you know blood; from one taste you learn a creature's race, health, sickness, fears and where it's been.

You touch a drop of it to your tongue and close your eyes and you know them, everything, what they are, how strong, what sickness they carry, what they're afraid of, where they slept last night, all of it there in one drop.
[Trait: Vampire Elder]

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn a place into a fortress overnight; walls, trenches and towers protect allies there.

You arrive at dusk trailing the entire colony, and all night long they work, and in the morning the enemy wakes up to find a fortress where there was an empty hill, walls of packed earth, trenches, towers, gates, and ten thousand soldiers on the battlements clicking their mandibles.
[Trait: Antfolk Mound-Lord]

abilities.name: Four Winds
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn every wind against your foes; they're battered from every side, can't move where they want and missiles fly wide for a few turns.

You call the north wind and it comes cold and cruel, you call the south and it comes hot and choking, the east and west after, and you set all four on them at once, howling in from every side, shoving and spinning and lifting them off their feet, until they can't tell which way is up or where they were going.
[Trait: Four Winds Sylph]

abilities.name: Fox Glamour
abilities.info:
What it does: throw a small illusion: a noise behind someone, a face that isn't there, a movement in the corner of the eye; good for one distraction.

You flick your fingers and grin, and somewhere off to their left a branch snaps, or a voice they know says their name, or somebody steps out from behind a wall who couldn't possibly be there, and their head whips around, and in the half a second they're looking you've already done whatever you came to do.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Fox Glamour]

abilities.name: Fox Illusion
abilities.info:
Weave a convincing illusion to fool the eye and ear.
[Trait: Soul of the Fox Spirit]

abilities.name: Fox Trick
abilities.info:
A small illusion of sound or sight.
[Trait: Fox Spirit]

abilities.name: Foxfire
abilities.info:
What it does: call ghostly foxfire: it lights the dark around you, and the flames burn a foe's spirit, sapping their will and strength rather than their skin, and they cannot be put out with water.

Little lights wink on around you, one, then three, then a dozen, pale and blue and bobbing like will-o'-the-wisps, giggling, swirling, and they dance over to the one you point at and sink in through the skin without a mark, and the poor thing starts screaming and slapping at itself, burning from the inside where nothing can reach, its fight and its nerve going up in cold blue smoke.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Foxfire]

abilities.name: Foxfire Ring
abilities.info:
What it does: you circle a foe in a ring of foxfire; they're trapped inside it and burned in spirit if they cross it.

Your four burning tails fan out and sweep in a circle around them, leaving a ring of blue fire that hisses up out of the ground as high as their waist, and they're inside it, and every time they try to step through, the cold flame bites at their soul and they jerk back gasping and shaking.
[Trait: Four-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Foxfire Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you rain foxfire down on a group; every foe under it is burned in spirit and shaken.

Your six tails fan up behind you, every one blazing blue, and you shake them, and the fire comes loose in a hundred little flames that drift up into the air and then fall over them, and wherever they land the light goes out of someone's eyes for a moment.
[Trait: Six-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Foxfire Tune
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a tune that sends blue foxfire dancing out over your foes; it burns their spirit instead of their skin and leaves them shaken.

Blue flames bloom in the holes of your pipes as you play, little flickering ghost-lights that dance out on every note and drift toward them in a bobbing line, pretty as fireflies, and where they touch nothing burns at all, but the ones they kiss go pale and shaky and hollow-eyed, as something warm is licked clean out of them.
[Trait: Foxhorn Satyr]

abilities.name: Friendly Face
abilities.info:
What it does: put one creature at ease: they're willing to talk to you rather than fight or run.

You hold your hands out open and show your teeth in a smile instead of a snarl, and you talk slow and easy about nothing much, the weather, the road, and bit by bit they lower whatever they were about to throw at you.
[Trait: Trained Talk I]

abilities.name: From Behind
abilities.info:
What it does: an attack from hiding or from out of sight lands hard, and the foe doesn't see where it came from. Rolls stalk.

They never hear you, not the step and not the breath, just the weight landing on their back and the hit going in, and when they finally spin round there's nobody there.
[Trait: Stalker]

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe out a blast of freezing air; foes in front of you are chilled, slowed and stiff for a few turns.

Your breath starts steaming in the air even on a warm day, frost spreading across your lips and over your teeth, and you lean in and blow, and a howling white gale of ice pours out over them, coating them in rime, freezing their fingers stiff and their eyelashes together, their breath coming out in crackling puffs as they try to move legs that won't bend.
[Trait: Ogre Magus]

abilities.name: Frost Grip
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe you hit or grab freezes where you struck; that part of it stays stiff and slow for three turns, and a second hit there shatters the frost for extra cold damage.
Your breath fogs even when the air is warm, frost feathers out over your fingers, and when you take hold of them the cold sinks straight in, the skin under your grip goes grey and hard and they feel it creep, joint by joint, until whatever you held won't bend for them any more.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Frost Grip]

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes cold damage and is slowed for two turns.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold Magic]

abilities.name: Frozen Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: freeze the ground round you for three turns: foes on it slip, fall and move at half speed; you don't.
You set your foot down and the frost spreads out from it in a fast crackle, across the ground in every direction, and they go sliding and sprawling and grabbing at each other while you walk across it like it's dry rock.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Frozen Ground]

abilities.name: Frozen River Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe on water or ground and freeze it solid; a frozen bridge, a frozen wall, or foes frozen in place for two turns.

You fill your huge chest and breathe out slow, and the cold pours out of you in a white cloud, and the river under it stops, just stops, solid all the way across, and anyone standing in it is stuck there up to their knees in ice.
[Trait: Winter Ogre]

abilities.name: Frozen Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: your garden of statues frightens anyone who sees it; foes at your perch fight badly and want to flee.

They come up to your perch and see the garden below it, all those statues looking up, all with the same scream frozen on their faces, and they understand what happened to every one of them, and their legs go weak.
[Trait: Petrifying Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Full Copy
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a perfect copy of a creature you ate, with its body, voice and abilities, for a while.

You reach down into everything you've ever swallowed and pull one of them up, and your jelly stretches and colours and hardens into its shape, its face, its voice, the way it limped, the little habits it never knew it had, until even the ones who knew it best would walk straight up to you smiling.
[Trait: Polymorph Mimic]

abilities.name: Full Moon
abilities.info:
What it does: you call down the full moon's light over the fight; your allies heal where it touches them and your foes are blinded for a few turns.

You raise your head and howl and the moon answers by growing, swelling fat and white over the treetops until it fills half the sky, and its light pours down thick as milk, your pack's wounds sealing silver wherever it touches them as your enemies scream, the sheer white light burning their very eyes pale and white like they have just been made blind by the pure radiance of moonlight itself.
[Trait: Moon Wolf]

abilities.name: Furnace Blast
abilities.info:
What it does: you vent a blast of furnace fire; foes in front of you are badly burned.

The iron door in your chest swings open with a clang and the roar comes out first, then the heat, then the fire, a blast of white-hot flame pouring out of you, and everything in front of you blackens and blisters and burns.
[Trait: Furnace Golem]

abilities.name: Furnace Heart
abilities.info:
What it does: you heat metal to working temperature by touch, to mend, shape, weld or melt it.

You lay your clay hand on the iron and the furnace in your chest roars, heat pouring down your arm and through your palm, and the metal goes dull red, then cherry, then bright, soft enough to bend or weld or pour, and you hold it there humming while the smith gets to work.
[Trait: Forge Golem]

abilities.name: Gale
abilities.info:
What it does: throw a blast of wind that hurls foes in front of you back and off their feet, scattering anything loose; small foes are thrown a long way.

You draw your arms back and the wind goes with them, sucking in from all sides, leaves and dust and grit all rushing to you, and then you push it all out at once in one roaring shove that picks them right up off the ground and throws them tumbling end over end through the air while everything around them goes flying with them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Gale]

abilities.name: Gale Blades
abilities.info:
What it does: you send a flurry of wind-cuts across an area; every foe in it is cut.

You rise up humming into the air and spin, scythes slashing again and again, and every slash throws off another crescent of wind, a flurry of them hissing out across the clearing in every direction, cutting grass and branches and cloth and skin, and anyone in it is covered in a hundred fine lines.
[Trait: Gale Mantid]

abilities.name: Gale Push
abilities.info:
What it does: you push foes back with a gale; they're thrown back and knocked down.

Clouds gather when you frown and you frown now, and throw both hands forward, and a gale tears out of your palms with a howl, flattening the grass, ripping cloaks and hats away, and hurling them backwards head over heels through the dirt.
[Trait: Sylph Galecaller]

abilities.name: Gale Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing up a gust that throws foes back and rocks ships.

You face the sea and sing a harsh rising note and the wind comes with it, a gust howling up off the sea, and it slams into them and throws them back off their feet and sends their boat heeling over until the rail goes under.
[Trait: Siren Wreck-Witch]

abilities.name: Gallop
abilities.info:
You cover open ground at a horse's speed.
[Trait: Centaur]

abilities.name: Gambler's Grin
abilities.info:
What it does: you gamble with someone, dice, cards, a bet on anything; you almost always win, and they pay up.

You flash that grin and throw the dice without even looking, and they come up exactly what you needed, again, and again, and the one across the table goes from laughing to quiet to sweating, and pushes the pile across to you.
[Trait: Catfolk Lucky Star]

abilities.name: Garden Keeper
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk among your statues and learn from them; each was a seeker, and they tell you what they were looking for and who sent them.

You slide between the statues touching each one, and they tell you, the look on their face, the thing in their hand, the way they're standing, what they came for and who sent them and what they thought they'd find, and you keep their secrets with them.
[Trait: Petrifier]

abilities.name: Garden of Stone
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn every foe who meets your eyes to stone, and the fear of your gaze makes the rest shut their eyes and fight blind.

You unwind your veil and the field goes silent, then the nearest meet your eyes and freeze, grey in a breath, then the next, and the panic spreads faster than the stone does, warriors clawing at their own eyes, dropping to their knees with their hands over their faces, begging, stumbling blind into each other, and you glide among the fresh statues of your garden trailing one finger over the faces, still warm, feeling the last sob caught in their stone throats.
[Trait: Gorgon Queen]

abilities.name: Garden Sprawl
abilities.info:
What it does: you flood a cave floor with hungry growth; foes standing in it are held, burned and slowly digested.

You spread across the cave floor in a heaving carpet of slime and fungus and anything standing on it sinks in to the ankles and sticks, and it's warm, almost pleasant, right up to the knee, and then the one nearest you looks down and pulls a foot free and there are no toes on it anymore, just a soft pink stump that stinks of rot.
[Trait: Living Ooze-Garden]

abilities.name: Gargoyle Stone
abilities.info:
Turn to stone for a moment, shrugging off harm.
[Trait: Soul of the Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Gatekeeper
abilities.info:
What it does: you hold a gate or passage; nothing passes while you stand there, and anything that tries is mauled.

You plant yourself across the gate with all three heads lowered and snarling, smoke pouring from three mouths, and they come at you, and one head catches them and the second shakes them and the third throws them back, and the gate behind you stays shut.
[Trait: Three-Headed Hellhound]

abilities.name: Gaze of Ages
abilities.info:
What it does: you stone everything in front of you that meets your eyes; whole lines of foes are turned to stone or crippled.

They've been waiting for you to show yourself, and then you do, and the army waiting outside turns to look, because how could they not, and a ripple of grey rolls across them, rank after rank hardening in the act of raising their weapons, and the screams start at the back of the army where the ones who didn't look are watching it happen to everyone in front of them.
[Trait: Basilisk King]

abilities.name: Gazer Ray
abilities.info:
Fire a cursing beam from the eye.
[Trait: Soul of the Gazer]

abilities.name: Gel Shape
abilities.info:
What it does: you flow into a new shape to fit a gap, copy an object or slip free of a hold.

You go loose and soft all over, your body sagging and spreading, and then you flow, under the door, through the bars, out of the grip of the hands that were holding you, and pour yourself up again on the other side into whatever shape you like.
[Trait: Ooze Mimic]

abilities.name: Gem Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: you sense ore and gems in rock nearby, knowing what they are and how much.

You press your blind head to the wall and taste the rock with your skin, and you can feel them in there, the cold tingle of silver, the warm buzz of gold, the sharp sweet sting of a ruby the size of a fist three feet into the stone, and your belly growls.
[Trait: Rockworm Gem-Eater]

abilities.name: General's Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead the charge from the front; every ally charging behind you hits harder for it.

You pull the iron crown down hard on your head and roar, and the warband roars back, every scrawny throat howling your name, and you're off down the hill at the front of them with your weapon over your head, and seeing that big ugly brute out in front gives every little biter behind you a courage they've never had in their lives, so they hit the line for real.
[Trait: Goblin General]

abilities.name: Get Away Clean
abilities.info:
What it does: escape from a fight or a chase: you get out of sight and nobody can follow your trail for a while.

You break off and go, through the gap, over the wall, down the hole, and by the time they've come round the corner after you there's no sign of you at all, not a print, not a sound.
[Trait: Trained Stalk IV]

abilities.name: Get Them Talking
abilities.info:
What it does: draw one creature into talking: they let slip something they meant to keep to themselves.

You ask about them, and you keep asking, and you laugh in the right places and nod in the right places, and they warm up and lean in, and halfway through a story about something else entirely they tell you the thing they never meant to.
[Trait: Trained Talk II]

abilities.name: Ghost Pale
abilities.info:
What it does: in any dim light you go pale and still and are mistaken for a ghost or a trick of the light; foes don't see you until you strike.

You stand still at the edge of the light and your pale fur takes it and holds it, and you look like nothing, like moonlight on a stone, like a ghost nobody wants to look at too long, and they look straight past you right up until you move.
[Trait: Moon-Touched Wolfkin]

abilities.name: Ghost Step
abilities.info:
What it does: you pass straight through a wall, door or foe.

Your edges go pale and see-through and your foxfire burns blue, and you walk at the wall, and for you it isn't, you slide through the stone, a cold shiver passing over anyone on the other side as a ghost-pale fox comes out of the bricks beside them.
[Trait: Ghost Fox]

abilities.name: Ghoul Claw
abilities.info:
A paralysing rake of the claws.
[Trait: Soul of the Ghoul]

abilities.name: Ghoul Feast
abilities.info:
What it does: you eat a fallen foe and rise at full strength, healed of your wounds.

You drop to your knees over one of the fallen and tear into it, and with every mouthful your wounds close, your back straightens, your strength comes surging back, until you stand up from what's left of them with your chin dripping red and not a scratch on you.
[Trait: Ghoul King]

abilities.name: Giant's Wrath
abilities.info:
What it does: you unleash a giant's wrath on one foe; a series of crushing blows leaves them broken.

They made you angry, and an ogre king angry is a thing the songs warn children about, and you grab them up in one fist and hammer them with the other, then slam them into the ground, then pick them up and do it again, and again, roaring without pause, until you finally drop what's left and stand over it with your chest heaving.
[Trait: Ogre King]

abilities.name: Gills
abilities.info:
What it does: breathe water as easily as air for as long as you like, and swim fast and comfortably at any depth.

Slits open up along your neck and the first breath of water is cold and strange and then it's just breathing, easy and deep, and you let yourself sink down into the green dark with your hair floating out around you, perfectly happy, while the bubbles from the last one who tried to follow you trickle up past your face.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Gills]

abilities.name: Giving Up Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: the bones of the old war rise from your field to fight for you for the rest of the fight.

You stir and the ground you're rooted in heaves, and up out of it come the old dead, bones and rusted scraps, soldiers of a war nobody remembers, and they stand up in their ranks and turn to face whatever you're facing.
[Trait: Grave-King Mandrake]

abilities.name: Glamour Jest
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a little glamour, a face, a noise, a coin that isn't there, and a foe falls for it and loses their next action.

Your fox tail swishes and your grin goes sly and a gold coin appears glinting in the dirt at their feet, or their captain's voice calls their name from the bushes, or their own mother waves from the treeline, and they always look, they always do, and by the time they understand there was nothing there you're behind them giggling into your sleeve.
[Trait: Trickster Satyr]

abilities.name: Glamour Swarm
abilities.info:
What it does: fill the air with dazzling lights and laughter: everyone in a wide area is confused for several turns, stumbling, hitting the wrong target and losing their way.

The air fills up with lights, hundreds of them, flashing and spinning and shooting off in every direction, and with them comes the laughing, bright tinkling laughter from everywhere at once, and everybody in it starts tripping over their own feet, spinning around, swinging at shadows, walking straight into each other and getting angrier and angrier while the laughing gets louder.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Glamour Swarm]

abilities.name: Glide
abilities.info:
You glide down from any height.
[Trait: Wyvern]

abilities.name: Glow
abilities.info:
What it does: give off a steady holy light for a while: it lights the dark, and the dead and the dark shy away from it.
You open yourself up a little and the light comes out through your skin, soft and steady, and the shadows pull back from you, and the things that live in them back away hissing.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Glow]

abilities.name: Glowing Floor
abilities.info:
What it does: the stone you walk on cracks and glows; for a few turns the ground near you burns any foe that stands on it.

Your paws come down and the stone cracks and glows under them, and the glow spreads out from your tracks, and anything standing near you finds the ground under it red-hot and has to keep hopping or burn.
[Trait: Hellhound Inferno]

abilities.name: Gnawing Teeth
abilities.info:
What it does: chew through rope, wood, leather or soft metal given half a minute unwatched; bonds, bars and locks of soft stuff stop being a problem.

Your teeth find the knot and get to work, tiny fast bites, chk chk chk chk, the fibres popping a strand at a time while your eyes never stop flicking to the door, and by the time anyone thinks to check on you there's a gnawed stub of rope on the floor and a rat-shaped hole where you used to be.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Gnawing Teeth]

abilities.name: Gnoll Rend
abilities.info:
Lock jaws and tear; the bite worsens with every turn it holds.
[Trait: Soul of the Gnoll]

abilities.name: Go for the Throat
abilities.info:
What it does: a hit aimed at a vital spot on a foe you've been chasing or circling: it hurts far more than a normal hit.

You've been watching how it moves, where it's weak, where it covers, and when the gap opens you don't hesitate, you go in fast and straight at the one place that matters.
[Trait: Trained Hunt IV]

abilities.name: Goblin Ambush
abilities.info:
Strike first from a prepared hiding place; the next stalk or fight action against an unaware foe hits harder.
[Trait: Soul of the Goblin]

abilities.name: Gold Bait
abilities.info:
What it does: you lure greedy foes with fake treasure; those who reach for it are caught and bitten.

You heap yourself up where they'll see you in a glittering pile, gold coins and silver plates and a jewelled cup on top, and they can't help it, nobody ever can, they drop to their knees and plunge their hands in up to the elbows, and the coins close round their arms, because they are a mouth.
[Trait: Hoard Mimic]

abilities.name: Gold Lure
abilities.info:
What it does: you lure foes with treasure that is really you; those who come close are caught and engulfed.

You lie in the middle of the dark room heaped up glittering, gold coins, rubies, a crown on top, catching the torchlight, and they can't help themselves, they never can, they kneel down and reach in with both hands, and the gold closes over their wrists, warm and wet, and pulls.
[Trait: Treasure Slime]

abilities.name: Gold Scales
abilities.info:
What it does: your gold scales harden to armour for a few turns; blows and blasts do far less, and fire does nothing at all.

You puff yourself up and the scales across your body lift and lock together, gleaming, hard as the metal they look like, and the hits come in and ring off you like hammers on a bell, and you look down at them along your snout and smile with all your teeth.
[Trait: Kobold Dragon]

abilities.name: Golem Fist
abilities.info:
A blow of rune-driven strength that breaks armour and walls.
[Trait: Soul of the Golem]

abilities.name: Gone
abilities.info:
What it does: you dart in, hit and are out of reach before they answer, and their next attack on you is at a disadvantage. Rolls strike.

One breath you're across the fight and the next you're inside their guard, three hits landing where they thought you'd be, and by the time they swing back you're already somewhere else watching them turn the wrong way.
[Trait: Swift]

abilities.name: Gone in the Dust
abilities.info:
What it does: in a fight, slip out of sight for a turn: foes lose you and can't attack you until you strike again.

In the noise and the dust you drop low and slip sideways and you're gone, and they spin around looking for you, and you're behind them, waiting for one of them to stop looking.
[Trait: Trained Stalk III]

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.info:
What it does: charge and drive your tusks in deep enough to lift a foe off their feet and throw them; the foe is badly wounded and flung down.

You squeal and tuck your chin and drive forward with your whole weight behind your tusks, and they go in low and deep, and you keep pushing, legs churning, and lift them right off the ground on the end of your face with their arms flailing, and toss them over your shoulder and keep going looking for the next one.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Gore]

abilities.name: Gore and Toss
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge one foe, gore them on your horns and throw them, leaving them hurt and down on the ground behind you.

You paw the ground twice, snorting, brass rings rattling on your horns, then you come in head down at a dead run and the horns go in under the ribs with a crunch, and you don't stop, you heave with that thick neck and toss them up and over your shoulder, already turning to the crowd before they hit the ground behind you.
[Trait: Minotaur Champion]

abilities.name: Grand Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you lay a curse that a whole camp suffers; sickness, ruin or madness, for days.

You float over their camp at midnight and the hollow hill court floats behind you, and you speak the curse in a giggling voice, and it settles over them, and in the morning the milk is blood, the dogs are dead, the children won't stop crying and every one of them knows they did something to deserve it.
[Trait: Hollow Hill Hexqueen]

abilities.name: Grandfather's Word
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak and every bearkin listens; disputes are settled, and even foes of the clans hear you out before they act.

You clear your throat and the whole hall goes quiet, the young bears stop wrestling and the old ones stop arguing, and you say a few slow words, and that's the end of the argument, because nobody in the north has ever disobeyed their grandfather twice.
[Trait: Bearkin Grandfather]

abilities.name: Granite Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: your granite half spreads over the rest of you for a few turns; blows do almost nothing, but you move slower.

The grey creeps over the rest of you with a grinding sound, stone taking flesh, until the whole of you is rock, and they hit you and their hands break, and you take one slow, heavy step toward them and the ground cracks under it.
[Trait: Petrifying Bull]

abilities.name: Grassland Laughter
abilities.info:
What it does: the whole grassland laughs with you; every foe within earshot is frightened for a few turns and fights badly.

You lift your muzzle and laugh, and the grass laughs with you, thousands of voices out in the dark, all around, getting closer, coming from everywhere at once, and every one of them out there that isn't yours goes cold right down to the bone.
[Trait: Gnoll Khan]

abilities.name: Grave Feast
abilities.info:
What it does: you eat from a corpse within reach and your wounds close as you feed; it needs a body.

Out come the arms and hands, but no longer are there weapons, but knives and forks, as you tear into the corpse savouring every tiny piece like it's made of butter and dipped in honey wine.
[Trait: Gravegnoll]

abilities.name: Grave Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe green grave-fire; everything in a long line is burned and the dead it kills may rise.

Your bone jaws open and the green fire roars out, a river of it that burns cold, and the ones it hits shrivel where they stand, skin tightening to grey leather over the skull, and they fall, and they lie still for one long breath, and then their fingers twitch, and they sit up with green fire where their eyes were and turn to look at the friend kneeling over them.
[Trait: Dracolich]

abilities.name: Grave Garden
abilities.info:
What it does: you grow roots through a whole field and feed on the fallen; you heal from every corpse, and foes on the ground are held.

You plant yourself in the middle of the battlefield and your roots go out in every direction, through the earth, through the dead, through the wounded lying moaning in the mud, and the field becomes your garden, and everything in it feeds you, and the ones still alive feel the roots wrap round their arms and legs and hold them down.
[Trait: Battlefield Mandrake]

abilities.name: Grave Hunger
abilities.info:
What it does: eat carrion and rotten meat without sickness, healing a little from every mouthful.

You crouch over it and tear in with both hands, cold and grey and stinking, and you eat like you're starving, and the rot doesn't touch you, it goes down and turns to strength, your cuts closing a little with every bite, and when you look up with your mouth smeared everyone else has gone pale and quiet.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Grave Hunger]

abilities.name: Grave Rats
abilities.info:
What it does: you send grave-rats to swarm one foe; they're bitten, sickened and harried for a few turns.

You squeal once and the grave-rats pour out of your rags and the cracks in the floor, fat grey rats with dead eyes, and they swarm over them, biting, clawing, crawling inside clothes, and every bite is full of grave filth that festers before the swarm even pulls back.
[Trait: Rat-Ghoul]

abilities.name: Graveyard Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: your howl brings the ghouls of any nearby graveyard crawling; they fight for you for the rest of the fight.

You howl, long and wet, and from every grave nearby the soil heaves, and up they come, crawling, grey hands first, every ghoul in the graveyard, and they come scrambling to your side hungry.
[Trait: Ghoul Lord]

abilities.name: Great Hex
abilities.info:
What it does: you lay a curse over a whole camp; sickness, bad luck or blind terror, your pick, sticks to everyone in it for days.

You float a hand off the ground at the edge of their camp at midnight with the little green eyes in your shadow all opening at once, and you whisper, and the whisper crawls into every tent, and in the morning half of them can't get out of bed for the fever and the other half are jumping at shadows and tripping over their own feet, and none of them can work out what they did to deserve it.
[Trait: Hag Mother]

abilities.name: Green Hand
abilities.info:
What it does: make plants grow, bend, part or close with a touch: open a path through brush, hide a door, or ripen something to eat.

You lay your palm against the bark and hum and something answers you, a creak, a rustle, and the branches lift and fold back out of your way, the brambles pull in their thorns, a flower opens up in your hand, and when you walk through, the green closes up behind you and leaves no trail at all.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Green Hand]

abilities.name: Grey and Soft
abilities.info:
What it does: everything you walk over turns to rot; for a few turns any foe who stands where you've been sickens, and you heal from it.

You walk and the ground goes grey and soft and wet under you, the grass rotting, the stones crumbling, and it spreads out behind you in a trail, and anything that walks on it sinks in and sickens, and feeds you.
[Trait: Blight King]

abilities.name: Grey Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow a group toward stone; every foe near you is stiffened and slowed more each turn until they escape the sound.

You throw out your chest and crow, long and harsh, and they can see it happen to each other, the grey spreading over faces and hands, eyes going dull, and they're shouting at each other to cover their ears, and some of them are clawing at their own skin trying to scrape the stone off.
[Trait: Cockatrice Doom-Crier]

abilities.name: Grey for Years
abilities.info:
What it does: your shadow drains the land; for a few turns everything your shadow touches weakens and you heal.

You fly over and your shadow slides across them, and everything it touches goes grey, the grass, the ground, the ones standing on it, the life draining up out of them into the dark of your shadow and into you.
[Trait: Elder Dracolich]

abilities.name: Grey Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare at one foe and their limbs go heavy and slow for a few turns.

You look down at them from your perch with those yellow eyes in your stone face, and they look up, and the weight hits them, their arms dragging, their feet sticking to the cobbles, their joints grinding as their bones set to granite along with you.
[Trait: Basilisk Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Grey Prints
abilities.info:
What it does: your stone footprints confuse anyone tracking you; you leave false trails and can't be followed.

You run in circles and loops and doubles, and every step leaves a little grey print, hundreds of them, every way at once, and the ones tracking you stand there staring at a field of stone footprints going everywhere and nowhere.
[Trait: Cockatrice Stonerunner]

abilities.name: Grey Valley
abilities.info:
What it does: everything green in a wide area goes grey and brittle around you; foes in it are slowed and their footing turns to crumbling stone.

You call out and the valley turns grey, the grass first, then the trees, then the ground itself, colour draining out of it all, everything gone stiff and brittle and crunching under the feet of the ones trying to run.
[Trait: Cockatrice King]

abilities.name: Grit Your Teeth
abilities.info:
What it does: shrug off one hit's pain: the next wound you take this turn hurts you less.

You see it coming and you don't flinch, you set your jaw so hard your teeth creak and let it land square, and the pain goes off in you bright and white and you swallow it whole and stay right where you were, staring at them over the top of it.
[Trait: Trained Endure I]

abilities.name: Ground and Pound
abilities.info:
What it does: pin one downed foe under your weight and beat them: they can't get up and take very heavy damage every turn you stay on them.

You drop onto them with your knees on their chest and your weight pinning them flat, and you start swinging, left, right, left, every blow driving their head back into the dirt, their hands coming up to stop it and getting knocked away, and you don't stop until they stop moving.
[Trait: Trained Fight VIII]

abilities.name: Ground Pound
abilities.info:
What it does: you slam the ground so hard that foes around you are knocked off their feet.

You raise both fists over your head, each one the size of a barrel, and bring them down together on the ground with a grunt, and the earth jumps, a shockwave rippling out from the crater you just made, and everyone standing near you is thrown off their feet in a ring of flying dirt and broken stones.
[Trait: Ogre Brute]

abilities.name: Grove Growth
abilities.info:
What it does: plants around you grow thick and fast at your call, healing allies who rest in them or tangling and holding foes.

You press your mossy paws to the earth and green spills out from under them, shoots and creepers boiling up through the soil, flowers opening in your footprints, and the growth wraps your hurt friends in soft leaf and draws the pain out of them while it goes for your enemies' ankles in coils of thorny bramble, dragging them down into a hedge that keeps on growing.
[Trait: Grove Bear]

abilities.name: Gust Wing
abilities.info:
What it does: you beat a gust of wind that hurls foes back off their feet.

Your wings crackle with static as you spread them, little blue sparks running along their edges, and you beat them once, hard, and a wall of wind slams out from under you with a thunderclap, flattening the grass, tearing the hats off their heads and hurling them back off their feet in a tumbling heap.
[Trait: Storm Wyvern]

abilities.name: Gutter King
abilities.info:
What it does: a dirty finishing move on a foe who is already hurt or down: if it lands, a weaker foe is finished and a strong one badly beaten.

You wait until they're bent over or sprawled or blinking blood, and you don't give them the dignity of a fair hit, you come in from where they can't see with something filthy and final, and when you step back there's nothing left in them that wants to fight.
[Trait: Trained Trick VIII]

abilities.name: Hackles Up
abilities.info:
What it does: sense danger a moment before it strikes: you can't be caught by surprise this turn.

The fur on the back of your neck stands up before your eyes have found anything at all, a cold prickle running down your spine, and you're already turning, already low, when it comes lunging out of the dark at the place you just were.
[Trait: Trained Instinct I]

abilities.name: Haggle
abilities.info:
What it does: push one deal your way: the price moves a little in your favour.

You shake your head slow and suck your teeth and sigh like they've just asked you for your own skin, and you look at the door, and you look back at them with a sad little smile, and the price comes down a bit, and then a bit more.
[Trait: Trained Barter I]

abilities.name: Half-Stone Galleries
abilities.info:
What it does: you read the half-stone creatures around your nest; they tell you what passed, and when.

You walk among the half-stone rats and frozen birds in your galleries and read them, the way each one was turned mid-run, which way they were looking, how grey they've gone, and you know what came through and when and from which way.
[Trait: Cockatrice Doom-Crier]

abilities.name: Hammer Ram
abilities.info:
What it does: you ram one foe with your skull; they're knocked down and dazed.

You dip your wide head and swim at them, your wide skull cutting through the water, and you ram them with it, a crack, and they're sent flying backwards with their head ringing and stars swimming in front of their eyes.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Hammerhead]

abilities.name: Hammerblow
abilities.info:
What it does: one huge overhead blow that hits harder than anything else you can do; a foe who takes it full is flattened.

You raise up as high as you go with your whole body coiled behind it and bring it down in one straight line, no aim, no craft, just weight, and whatever's under it buckles and folds and goes down into the ground with a sound like a dropped boulder.
[Trait: Trained Fight V]

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.info:
What it does: a quick cut or bite at the back of the leg: the foe is slowed for the rest of the fight and can't chase or flee well.

You go low and past them and flick at the back of their leg on the way, quick as you like, and they take one more step and the leg folds under them, and they're down on one knee with their face screwed up wondering why it won't hold them.
[Trait: Trained Strike IV]

abilities.name: Hard to Kill
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight you heal a little every turn and your wounds bleed less.

Your body just refuses, the bleeding slowing to a trickle, the cuts drying and crusting while you fight, your breath coming back even after every hit, and they keep hitting you and you keep being there.
[Trait: Trained Endure V]

abilities.name: Harpy Dive
abilities.info:
Drop on a foe from above, talons first.
[Trait: Soul of the Harpy]

abilities.name: Headbutt
abilities.info:
What it does: you butt one foe with your horns hard enough to daze them for a turn.

You're still laughing when you do it, wine slopping out of the cup in your hand, a little skip on your goat legs to get the bounce right, then your head snaps forward and your horns crack into their forehead with a hollow crack, and they sit down hard in the mud with their eyes crossed and their ears full of bells.
[Trait: Satyr Reveller]

abilities.name: Healer's Knowledge
abilities.info:
What it does: treat a wound, poison or sickness with what you know: one creature is helped and recovers faster.

You know which leaf to chew and which root to boil and which moss to pack into the wound, and how to clean it first and bind it after, and your hands work while you talk them through it, and by morning the fever's broken.
[Trait: Trained Lore III]

abilities.name: Healing Leaf
abilities.info:
What it does: you pluck a healing leaf from your crown and give it to an ally; eaten, it mends a wound and eases pain.

You run your knobbly fingers through the leaves on your head picking through them, muttering, until you find the right one, and pluck it with a little wince, and press it into their hand, and when they chew it the bitterness spreads warm through their body and the wound starts pulling closed.
[Trait: Mandrake Herbalist]

abilities.name: Healing Light
abilities.info:
What it does: touch one ally and the light heals a little of their wounds.
You lay your hand on the wound and let the light run down into it, warm and gentle, and the bleeding slows and the edges pull together and they let out a long breath they didn't know they were holding.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Healing Light]

abilities.name: Heart of Winter
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight foes who touch you or stand close are frozen a little every turn; a foe frozen three times can't move.
Something in your chest goes still and cold and stays that way, and the cold spreads out of you into the air and the ground, and everything near you starts to slow and stiffen, frost climbing up their legs every time they come close.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Heart of Winter]

abilities.name: Heartbeat in the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: your huge eyes see heartbeats in the dark; nothing alive can hide from you in darkness or deep water.

Your great eyes open wide in the black and there they are, every heartbeat around you, little throbbing glows in the dark, behind rocks, under sand, holding still, and every one of them is easy to find.
[Trait: Abyss Hunter]

abilities.name: Heartbeat in the Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: foes inside you hear a heartbeat in the walls; they panic, fight badly and turn on each other for a turn.

Let them stand quiet long enough and they hear it, thump, thump, thump, coming out of the walls, out of the floor, all around them, slow and patient, and they understand where they are, and they start screaming and shoving and trampling each other.
[Trait: Room Mimic]

abilities.name: Hearth Peace
abilities.info:
What it does: you call peace at your fire; nobody can raise a weapon in your hall while it lasts, foe or friend, and those who sat in it may talk.

You throw a log on the fire and the sparks fly up and the hall goes quiet, and you sit down heavy beside the flames and say it once, peace at this hearth, and they feel it settle over them, warm and heavy and absolute, every hand that reaches for a weapon suddenly too tired to close, every shout dying in the throat, until all anyone can do is sit by your fire and listen.
[Trait: Bearkin Hearth-Elder]

abilities.name: Heartstop Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: a sting with venom strong enough to stop a heart: the foe is badly poisoned, losing health every turn and weakening; a weak or wounded foe may die of it.

Your tail arches high over your back and holds there, trembling, a bead of venom on the tip, and you wait for the gap and drive it down in one stab, and they gasp and clutch at it and their face goes white, then grey, sweat pouring off them, and you can hear their heart racing, racing, and then stumbling, and catching, and stumbling again.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Heartstop Sting]

abilities.name: Heat Haze
abilities.info:
What it does: for three turns the air round you shimmers with heat; foes trying to hit you from range miss far more often.
The heat rolls off you in waves until the air itself bends and wobbles, and through it you look like you're standing three places at once, and everything thrown at you sails into the place you aren't.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Heat Haze]

abilities.name: Heavy Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you hold a foe's stare and their limbs turn heavy; they move and strike slowly for a few turns.

Your eyes go flat and dull yellow, the colour of old lamplight down a mine, and your eyes never blink as they hold the stare, and the weight comes on them slow, arms first, then the legs, their bones filling with lead, every swing a struggle and every step a drag, until they're standing in front of you heavy as a statue and not quite one yet.
[Trait: Basilisk Bull]

abilities.name: Heavy Stare
abilities.info:
A stare that slows one foe's limbs.
[Trait: Basilisk]

abilities.name: Hellfire Lash
abilities.info:
What it does: you lash one foe with hellfire; they're burned and the fire clings for a few turns.

Your forked tail catches fire end to end and you swing it, and it cracks across them and the hellfire sticks, burning a line across their body that won't go out no matter how they roll, eating slowly at them while you hover above on burning wings.
[Trait: Fire Devil]

abilities.name: Hellfire Rampage
abilities.info:
What it does: you go on a burning rampage; everything around you burns, and foes caught in it are scorched for the rest of the fight.

The dungeon's furnace opens up inside your chest and you let it out, a boar of living hellfire tearing through the field in a frenzy, goring, trampling, rolling, every bristle a spitting jet of flame, and the heat comes off you in waves so fierce the air shimmers and the ground cracks and smokes, until there's nothing standing anywhere near you and the earth itself is still burning long after you've gone.
[Trait: Hellfire Boar]

abilities.name: Hellfire Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe and fire spreads through their body; they burn from the inside for the rest of the fight unless cured.

Your tail is pure hellfire now and when it strikes it doesn't just go in, it lights them, fire racing through their veins from the wound, glowing orange lines spreading under their skin, and they're gurgling and thrashing as smoke starts coming out of their mouth and nose, burning from the inside out.
[Trait: Infernal Scorpid]

abilities.name: Hellhound Bite
abilities.info:
Bite with burning jaws.
[Trait: Soul of the Hellhound]

abilities.name: Herd Wall
abilities.info:
Plant your feet with your herd at your side so nothing gets through; the next fight action to hold ground is stronger.
[Trait: The Horn Moot: Herd Hand]

abilities.name: Hex Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you spit a curse onto one foe and it catches as sickly green fire that burns them for a few turns.

You hawk up something foul from the back of your throat and spit it at them, a gob of black ash and muttered words, and where it lands it catches, a sickly green flame that crawls over their clothes and their skin, cold where it should be hot, and it won't go out no matter how they slap and roll, it just keeps nibbling away at them while you cackle.
[Trait: Goblin Shaman]

abilities.name: Hibernal Hide
abilities.info:
You shrug off cold and a glancing blow.
[Trait: Bearkin]

abilities.name: Hidden Edge
abilities.info:
What it does: a hit from somewhere a foe never thought to watch: a concealed point, a hidden claw, a second hand; it lands almost for sure.

You keep one hand busy and in plain sight and the other one quiet and forgotten, and when they're watching the busy one the quiet one comes up out of nowhere and finds the gap, and they look down at it, stunned, like it grew there.
[Trait: Trained Trick V]

abilities.name: Hidden Life
abilities.info:
What it does: your life is hidden somewhere else; once a day, when you would die, your bones pull back together and you rise.

They smash you to pieces and stand over the bones breathing hard, and then the green fire flickers in the empty skull, and the bones twitch, and roll, and click back together, and you stand up laughing, because they'll never find where you hid it.
[Trait: Lich]

abilities.name: High Winds
abilities.info:
What it does: you climb into the high winds and ride them; you travel far and fast, and you can see everything for miles below.

You beat your wings and climb and climb until the air goes thin and cold and fast, and you catch the high wind and let it take you, the land rolling away under you, every camp and road and moving thing laid out down there like a map.
[Trait: Storm Pegataur]

abilities.name: Hill Fall
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw your whole hill-sized body down on a group of foes; everyone under you is crushed and pinned.

You stop and look down at them and just fall on them, the whole mountain of you, on purpose, and the ground shakes, and there's a lot of screaming coming from underneath you, and you lie there a moment, comfortable, before you start getting up.
[Trait: Troll Brute]

abilities.name: Hill-Splitter
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge hard enough to split the ground open in front of you; foes in the crack fall or are thrown aside.

The boarfolk tell it like a joke, but they stop laughing when you lower your head, because the first step cracks the earth under you and the second widens it, and you run straight down the line of the crack as it races ahead of you, tearing the hill open, the ground falling away under their feet so they tumble shrieking into the gap or get thrown sprawling off its edges.
[Trait: Boar King]

abilities.name: Hired Gate
abilities.info:
What it does: you hold a gate or passage like a living door; nothing gets past you for a few turns.

You back into the gate and settle there with your shell filling it from side to side, and you tuck your legs in and pull your claws up, and they can hit you all they like, nothing is getting past, not while you're a door.
[Trait: Crabfolk Siege-Shell]

abilities.name: Hit and Hold
abilities.info:
What it does: you hit a foe and keep driving them back, so they can't get away or reach anyone behind you this turn. Rolls fight.

You hit them and keep coming, shoulder in their chest before they've finished flinching, and drive them back step after step until something stops them, and then you hit them again.
[Trait: Skirmisher]

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.info:
What it does: dart in, hit one foe and dart back out of reach in the same turn; they can't hit back before you're gone.

You go in quick and low, one hit, and you're already gone again before they've turned around, dancing back out of reach on light feet while they swing at the space where you used to be.
[Trait: Trained Strike II]

abilities.name: Hive Calm
abilities.info:
What it does: you calm a frenzied group; allies shake off fear and rage, and foes driven by fury lose it for a few turns.

You step into the middle of the chaos and click once, a soft dry sound, and you hold so still that it spreads, the shouting dying, the wild eyes settling, fists unclenching, until the room is breathing slow with you and nobody remembers why they were so angry.
[Trait: Mantid Abbot]

abilities.name: Hive Mind
abilities.info:
What it does: you link every ally's mind together for one battle; they share sight and thought and none of them can be caught by surprise.

You reach out through the roots under the dungeon and touch every one of them at once, and their minds open, and suddenly each of them sees through every other's eyes, hears every other's ears, feels the blow coming at the one beside them before it lands, and they fight as one creature with a hundred bodies and no blind side.
[Trait: Myconid Mind-King]

abilities.name: Hive Strength
abilities.info:
What it does: lift and carry far more than your size should allow; heavy loads don't slow you and you can move objects several times your weight.

You get your arms around it and grip and lift, and it comes up off the ground like it's hollow, a boulder, a beam, a whole cart if you want it, and you set it on your back and walk off with it, steady and tireless, while the ones who were straining at it together stand there gaping.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Hive Strength]

abilities.name: Hive Swarm
abilities.info:
