What it does: you call the hive to swarm a field; antfolk pour out of the ground and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You send one scent out on the wind and the ground for a mile around moves, ants pouring up out of every crack and hole in their thousands, soldiers and workers and young, a black flood surging over the grass, climbing over each other, and they bury your enemies.
[Trait: Antfolk Queen]

abilities.name: Hoard Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: you smell gold and treasure through solid stone, and know roughly how much and where.

You lift your snout and draw in a deep breath through your nose and there it is, faint and sweet and warm, the smell of gold, metal sleeping in the dark, and the gems grown into your scales tingle, and you follow it, sniffing at walls and floors, until you put one claw on a plain grey flagstone and grin with every tooth you have.
[Trait: Hoard Drake]

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.info:
You stay under water long enough to ambush.
[Trait: Lizardfolk]

abilities.name: Hold Fast
abilities.info:
What it does: grab hold of one foe and don't let go: while you hold them they can't pull away or run, and you both fight close.

Your hand finds a fistful of whatever they've got, hide, hair, a limb, and closes, and they pull and twist and kick at you and it does nothing, your grip only sets harder, and you drag them back in close where you want them.
[Trait: Trained Fight I]

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.info:
What it does: you bark one order and your allies stop running and stand; they hold and fight together for the rest of the turn.

The mob is breaking, goblins dropping everything and bolting, and you plant yourself in their way with your stolen armour clanking and roar one word so loud it stops them dead, and they look at you, at the scars, at the dead knight's breastplate, and decide you're scarier than whatever is chasing them, so they turn back around and start stabbing, all at once.
[Trait: Goblin Captain]

abilities.name: Hold the Soul
abilities.info:
What it does: keep a dying creature's soul from leaving for a while after death, long enough to absorb it later.

It dies and you're there before it can go, closing your hand round something that isn't there, and it stays, trapped in the cooling body, tugging at your grip like a fish on a line, waiting for you.
[Trait: Trained Absorb III]

abilities.name: Hold Your Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: go perfectly still and silent: while you don't move, you can't be heard or noticed nearby.

You stop breathing and stop moving and stop thinking about anything at all, and the footsteps come closer and closer and stop right beside you, close enough to smell their sweat, and stand there, and stand there, and go on.
[Trait: Trained Stalk II]

abilities.name: Hollow
abilities.info:
What it does: you pull the shadow out of one foe; it takes heavy shadow damage, you heal by part of it, and for three turns it has no shadow and takes extra damage from everything.
You reach out without hurrying and close your hand, and their shadow peels up off the ground and comes to you, they feel it go like a tooth pulled from somewhere deep, the strength in them goes with it, and they're left standing in full light with nothing under them, grey and empty and trembling, while you breathe in the dark that used to be theirs.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Hollow]

abilities.name: Hollow Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you puff spores out of your hollows; foes nearby are dazed and coughing for a turn or two.

The fungus shelves on your bark swell, and the dark knotholes in your trunk breathe, puffing out yellow-brown clouds with a soft sigh, and the spores roll over them thick and sour and choking, and they stagger back coughing with their eyes streaming and their heads spinning.
[Trait: Rotwood Treant]

abilities.name: Hollow Them
abilities.info:
What it does: drain a weakened foe until they're an empty shell: they collapse, alive but empty, and won't fight again today.

You put your hand over their heart and pull and keep pulling, slow, until their eyes go dull and their mouth goes slack and there's nobody behind their face anymore, just meat that breathes.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VII]

abilities.name: Honey Mead
abilities.info:
What it does: you pour out horns of honey-mead; allies who drink mend minor hurts and shake off fear and weariness.

The smell reaches them first, warm honey and old summer, then you're pressing a dripping horn into each pair of hands with a slow grandfather's grin, and the mead goes down thick and sweet and burning, and as it settles the aches loosen, the shaking stops, cuts close to pink lines and the cold in their bones turns to a fire in their bellies that makes them want to stand up and go again.
[Trait: Bearkin Brewer-Sage]

abilities.name: Horde
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the horde; every orc warband within reach joins you, and the field fills with orcs for the rest of the battle.

You climb up onto the biggest rock in the valley and lift your weapon high, and down below a hundred war drums start beating together, warband after warband marching in from every road and hill and pass, banners of hide and bone, tusks and scars and iron as far as anyone can see, and every warrior in it is looking at you, the one they all bent the knee to, waiting for the swing.
[Trait: Orc Warlord]

abilities.name: Horde Tactics
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw your horde at the foe in waves; they get no rest and can't press any one attacker this turn, while your hurt allies fall back and fresh ones take their place.

You never fight at the front, you sit on your stolen throne under your crown of tails and spend your rats freely, a squeak and a wave sends twenty in, a whistle pulls back the bleeding and throws twenty fresh, wave after wave after wave, none of them caring which of their brothers died to clear the way, until the enemy's arms are shaking and panic sets in as they understand the horde will never run out before they do.
[Trait: Ratfolk Warlord]

abilities.name: Horn Oath
abilities.info:
Swear on the horn stone; anyone of the herds who hears it knows you'll keep it.
[Trait: The Horn Moot: Horn Bearer]

abilities.name: Horn Toss
abilities.info:
You hook a foe on the horns and throw them.
[Trait: Minotaur]

abilities.name: Horn-Shaped Dents
abilities.info:
What it does: you ram a gate, wall or door with your horns; it breaks or buckles, and whoever's behind it is flung back.

You lower your head and walk up to it, not even running, and set your horns against it and push, and keep pushing, the wood groaning and the iron bending, until the whole thing caves in with two horn-shaped dents right in the middle.
[Trait: Minotaur Warlord]

abilities.name: Horns of the King
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge at the head of every horned ally on the field; together your charge hits hardest of all and breaks a battle line.

You lower your great crowned head and every horned thing on the field lowers its own, bulls, rams, minotaurs down to the last calf-horned runt, and when you charge they charge with you, a wall of horns behind the king's, the ground thundering under all of it, and yours hit first and hardest of all, the line in front of you not so much broken as erased.
[Trait: Minotaur King]

abilities.name: Host of Ancestors
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise the host of the ancestors; an army of spirit warriors fights for you for the rest of the battle.

You drive your staff into the earth and the ground splits along a line a mile long, and out of it they climb, row on row of grey tusked ghosts in the war-paint of a hundred generations, every orc who ever fell in battle answering their king's call, and the host of ancestors stands up behind you in silence before it charges with a roar that comes from every age at once.
[Trait: Spirit King]

abilities.name: Host of the Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the restless dead to fight; ghosts rise around you and attack your foes for the rest of the battle.

You raise your hand over the battlefield and the dead hear you, every soldier who ever fell on this ground, and they rise up out of the earth pale and grey with their death wounds still open, and they turn their empty eyes on the living and drift forward in their hundreds, reaching.
[Trait: Wraith Lord]

abilities.name: Host Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you infect one foe; mushrooms sprout in them, weakening them each turn, and if they die the colony grows from them.

You breathe one pale spore onto them and for a while nothing happens, and then they start to itch, then cough, and then little white threads push out through the skin of their arms, their neck, their cheeks, and caps open up along their jaw while they claw at their own face screaming, tearing them off only for more to sprout, until they can feel the roots moving behind their eyes.
[Trait: Myconid Plague-Cap]

abilities.name: Hot Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: run hot: warm a room, dry clothes, light a fire or a pipe with your fingertip, or keep a whole party from freezing.

You breathe slow and let it come up through you, a warmth that starts in your belly and spreads out to your fingers and toes, steam rising off you, frost melting off the rocks around you, and you press a fingertip to the wick and it lights and everyone shuffles a little closer to you without meaning to.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Hot Blood]

abilities.name: Hot Forge
abilities.info:
What it does: you forge or reshape metal with your bare hands; you can mend gear, bend bars or make a simple tool or weapon in moments.

You pick up the bent iron and squeeze, and heat climbs through your iron-dark scales and into the metal, which glows dull red, then cherry, then bright orange, and you work it in your fingers, pinching and smoothing and folding, and in a few breaths you're handing it back straighter and sharper than it ever was, hissing as it cools.
[Trait: Salamander Smith]

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight every hit you land sets the foe burning, and a burning foe takes fire damage each turn until it's put out.
The heat comes up your arms first, a deep ache right in the bones, then the skin across your knuckles opens and the glow comes through the gaps, and the first thing you get hold of smokes and catches before it can pull away, burning where you held it and burning where you let it go.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Hot Hands]

abilities.name: Hounds of Sand
abilities.info:
What it does: the sandstorms that follow you hunt for you; for a few turns a sandstorm sweeps the area, blinding and battering foes.

You whistle and the sandstorm that's been following you across the dunes comes running like a hound, howling, and you send it at them, and it hits them in a wall of grit and wind that tears at their skin and fills their eyes.
[Trait: Scorpid Desert-King]

abilities.name: Howling Jungle
abilities.info:
What it does: you fly over the jungle and the wind howls with you; foes below are thrown about and lose their footing for a turn.

You fly and the jungle bends and howls under you, every tree bowing, every leaf tearing loose, and the wind that follows you comes down on the ones below and bowls them over and tosses them about like dry leaves.
[Trait: Tempest Mantid]

abilities.name: Hull Shudder
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap a ship, boat or building in your arms and shake it; everyone on it is thrown about, and many fall off.

Your tentacles come up out of the water and wrap round it, over the rails, round the mast, and you shake it, and the whole thing shudders and groans and tips, and the ones on it go flying off into the sea where you're waiting.
[Trait: Kraken]

abilities.name: Human Craft
abilities.info:
Use and make human tools and weapons as a skilled human would.
[Trait: Soul of the Human]

abilities.name: Human Tongue
abilities.info:
What it does: speak and read the old human language as if born to it: read human writing, understand human speech, and pass for one in a conversation.

The words come up out of you in somebody else's accent, smooth and natural, the old language rolling off your tongue like you were born to it, and the ruined books stop being scratches and start talking to you, and anyone left who still speaks it hears one of their own.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Human Tongue]

abilities.name: Hundred Deaths
abilities.info:
What it does: you remember how you died before; for the rest of the fight you know every trick a foe tries and see it coming.

You've been killed every way there is, burned and drowned and stabbed and crushed, and you remember every one, so when they try it on you again you just shift your weight and let it go past, bored, because you already know how this one ends.
[Trait: Troll King]

abilities.name: Hundred Nests
abilities.info:
What it does: every harpy of your colony watches for you; for a day you know of anything that moves within sight of your cliffs.

You perch at the top of the cliff and screech once, and from a hundred nests a hundred heads turn out toward the land and the sea, and nothing moves out there for the rest of the day that one of them doesn't see and come screaming back to tell you.
[Trait: Harpy Matriarch]

abilities.name: Hunger Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you plant a gnawing hunger in one foe for a few turns; it saps their strength and they may turn on their own allies as food.

They feel it hard and deep inside, something has changed, they start to drool, their eyes go wild, and they stare at what were once their friends, now no more than food to sate the hunger you have planted deep inside them.
[Trait: Gnoll Prophet]

abilities.name: Hungry Grip
abilities.info:
What it does: a grab that pulls at the soul: the foe you hold is weakened and you recover a little health.

Your fingers sink in and you pull, not at the flesh but at what's under it, and they gasp and go pale and sag, and a little of the warmth that was theirs comes up your arm into you.
[Trait: Trained Absorb II]

abilities.name: Hunt of Kings
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a great hunt with every wolf and wolf-rider at your call; your chosen prey is run down and torn apart wherever it runs.

You point once at the one you want and every wolf in the hills knows it, and the hunt of kings begins, wolves and riders streaming out over the hills in a great howling net, cutting off every road, every river crossing, every cave, closing tighter and tighter around one terrified prey until there's nowhere left to go and you ride up at your leisure to finish it.
[Trait: Wolf King]

abilities.name: Hunter's Patience
abilities.info:
What it does: wait unseen for prey to come to you: when it does, your first hit lands with far more force.

You settle in and wait, an hour, half a day, without fidgeting, without a sound, and when it finally comes walking right past you it doesn't know a thing until you're on it.
[Trait: Trained Hunt V]

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.info:
What it does: you scream a hurricane into being; everything in the area is battered, hurled and torn apart for a few turns.

You hang over the coast and scream until your throat bleeds, and the wind turns, round and round, gathering speed, until a hurricane is spinning over the land with you in its eye, roofs tearing off and spinning away, trees ripped out by the roots, and anything caught in it hurled into the sky and smashed down again.
[Trait: Harpy Tempest-Witch]

abilities.name: Hydra Bites
abilities.info:
Strike with a flurry of snapping bites.
[Trait: Soul of the Hydra]

abilities.name: Hydra Flurry
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike with every head you have; foes near you are hit again and again.

Nine heads, nine sets of jaws, nine snaking necks, and they all strike at once in every direction, a blur of scales and teeth filling the space around you, and anything near you gets bitten, and bitten, and bitten again, from the front and the sides and above, faster than any arm can block.
[Trait: Nine-Headed Hydra]

abilities.name: I Know That One
abilities.info:
What it does: recognise one creature, plant, ruin or thing: you know what it is and one useful fact about it.

You've heard about these, or seen one once from a long way off, or been told by somebody who saw one up close and lived, and it all comes back to you in a rush right when you need it, the one thing about it that matters most.
[Trait: Trained Lore I]

abilities.name: I've Heard of This
abilities.info:
What it does: you recall something true and useful about the creature, ruin, place or soul in front of you: a weakness, a danger or a way through. Rolls lore.

Something about the carving tugs at you, half a song, a story some old one told by the fire, and it comes back all at once with the part nobody else remembers, the part about what happened to the last ones who tried.
[Trait: Lorekeeper]

abilities.name: Ice Crown
abilities.info:
What it does: your crown of ice spreads over your whole body for a few turns; blows do less, and anyone who hits you is frozen a little.

The ice on your head creaks and spreads, down your face, over your shoulders, across your chest, until you're wearing it like armour, and every hit that lands on it cracks and sends a numbing cold up the arm that threw it.
[Trait: Frost Ogre]

abilities.name: Ice Skin
abilities.info:
What it does: for three turns a layer of ice armours your skin: blows do less, and anything that hits you is chilled.
The cold comes up through your skin and sets there in a thin hard shell that creaks when you move, and the next hit lands on ice instead of you, and the one who threw it pulls back shaking a numb hand.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Ice Skin]

abilities.name: Ice Spike
abilities.info:
What it does: drive a spike of ice up from the ground or out of your hand into one foe: heavy cold damage and the foe is pinned for a turn.
You make a fist and the cold gathers into a point, and you drive it forward and the ground under them splits and a spike of ice comes up out of it fast and hard and pins them there, gasping, frozen to the spot.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: Ice Spike]

abilities.name: Ill Omen
abilities.info:
What it does: you laugh a curse onto one foe; their luck turns bad for a few turns, blows miss, footing slips and gear fails.

One little laugh is all it takes and from then on everything goes wrong for them, straps snap, the foot finds the one loose stone, the blow meant for you lands on their friend, and every time it happens they hear you laughing somewhere close.
[Trait: Gnoll Omen-Witch]

abilities.name: Imp Flame
abilities.info:
What it does: you hurl a ball of fire that bursts on one foe; they're burned.

You cackle and roll a ball of fire between your palms, bigger and bigger and hotter, flames licking up your arms, and then you wind up and throw it with a flick of your tail, and it bursts on them in a shower of sparks and set-alight clothes.
[Trait: Imp Firebrand]

abilities.name: Imp Hex
abilities.info:
Lay a curse of bad luck on a foe.
[Trait: Soul of the Imp]

abilities.name: Imp Spark
abilities.info:
What it does: flick a spark of fire off your fingertip: light something, startle someone, or singe one target.

You snap your fingers with a nasty little grin and a spark jumps off the end and lands exactly where you meant it to, in the hay, on the fuse, on the back of somebody's neck, and they yelp and spin round and you're looking the other way, whistling.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Imp Spark]

abilities.name: Imp's Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: lay a petty curse on one creature for a day: bad luck, an itch they can't reach, fumbling hands, a voice that cracks when it matters; every check they make goes a little worse.

You point at them and mutter something nasty under your breath and wiggle your fingers, and for a moment it's nothing, and then it's everything, their bootlace snaps, their nose itches right in the middle of their best swing, they drop the thing they're holding, they trip on nothing, and every time it goes wrong you can't help giggling.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Imp's Curse]

abilities.name: Incense on the Cliffs
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a few notes to one listener; they'll do one thing for you, even something they'd never do, and smile.

You sing to them softly, just them, and their face goes slack and happy, and you ask them for something in the middle of the song, and they do it, smiling the whole time, even if it's the last thing they'll ever do.
[Trait: Siren Enchantress]

abilities.name: Infernal Gate
abilities.info:
What it does: you open a gate of hellfire; fire pours through it over an area and devils come through to fight for you.

You draw a circle in the air with one burning claw and the air splits along it, and behind it is the furnace at the bottom of the world, and the fire pours out through the gate, and out of the fire come the devils, laughing, with their tails swinging.
[Trait: Vent Archdevil]

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.info:
What it does: you become an inferno; everything near you burns for a few turns, and foes who come close are badly burned.

You stop holding the fire in and let it out all at once, flesh going to flame, and you're not a salamander anymore but a pillar of white-hot fire with a face somewhere in the middle of it, roaring, and the walls around you sag and drip, and anything that comes near goes up in flames.
[Trait: Living Flame]

abilities.name: Inferno Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge as a fireball; the foe you hit and everything near them is set burning.

The smoke on your back catches with a whump and suddenly you're not a boar anymore but a ball of flame with tusks, roaring fire trailing behind you, and you hit them dead centre and burst, fire splashing out in every direction, everything around them going up at once, and you trot out of the inferno with your bristles still burning, looking for the next one.
[Trait: Infernal Boar]

abilities.name: Inferno Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and fire spreads across the area; everything around you is burned.

You bay up at the sky with your burning jaws, and the howl comes out as fire, and the fire spreads out from you in a ring, racing over the stones, climbing the walls, catching everything it touches, until everything is burning and you're standing in the middle of it howling.
[Trait: Hellhound Inferno]

abilities.name: Information Trade
abilities.info:
What it does: trade knowledge instead of goods: a rumour, a secret or a way through pays as well as ingots would.

You lean in across the table and lower your voice and tell them where the caravans won't be guarded on the next new moon, slow, watching their face, and you can see it land, and it's worth more to them than anything in your pack and they pay like it.
[Trait: Trained Barter VI]

abilities.name: Inspiring Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a song that puts fire in your allies; they fight harder and shake off fear for a few turns.

You leap up onto a rock or a barrel or somebody's shoulders and sing, loud and rough and joyful, a marching tune half of them already know the words to, and it catches, feet stamping, voices joining, until your allies go into the fight bellowing the chorus with their chests puffed out, afraid of nothing.
[Trait: Satyr Bard]

abilities.name: Into the Shadows
abilities.info:
What it does: duck out of sight into cover or shadow: unless someone was watching you, they lose track of you.

You take one step sideways out of the light and let the dark close over you, and you go still inside it, breath slowed, eyes half shut so they don't shine, and they look straight at the spot where you're standing and their eyes slide right off it.
[Trait: Trained Stalk I]

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike one foe with an iron fist; they're badly hurt and knocked back.

Your rune flickers once and your arm swings back on grinding joints, slow, deliberate, the way it has swung a thousand times for a thousand years, and it comes forward, and the iron fist lands with a clang and a crunch and they're thrown across the room into the wall.
[Trait: Iron Golem]

abilities.name: Iron Fortress
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a fortress your allies shelter behind; while you stand, they can't be reached.

You plant your iron legs and lower your great plated body, and the runes all over you flare and lock, and your friends crowd in under you and behind you, and the enemy throws everything they have at the fortress you've become, and it all rings off your plates and falls harmless to the ground.
[Trait: Iron Hive-Titan]

abilities.name: Iron Gut
abilities.info:
What it does: eat or drink something poisoned, rotten or foul without harm, and shake off a poison already in you.

It goes down foul and your gut clenches round it like a fist, heaves once, twice, sweat breaking out on your lip, and then it holds and the cramp lets go and the cold sweat dries, and you belch long and loud and wipe your mouth and feel fine.
[Trait: Trained Endure II]

abilities.name: Iron Plates
abilities.info:
What it does: you brace on your metal plates against blows; they do you little harm for a few turns.

You hunker down and the rune on your head flares, and the metal plates along your body slide together and lock, and when they hit you there's a clang that jars their arms to the shoulder, and you stand there under the blows not even rocking.
[Trait: Iron Ant]

abilities.name: Iron Swipe
abilities.info:
What it does: you swipe with iron-hard claws that tear through armour and hide alike, leaving deep wounds.

Your lips peel back with a roar that blasts spit and leaf-litter into their face and you rise up on your back legs, huge and swaying, then bring one paw down and across with all of you behind it, claws hard as forged iron shrieking through plate and leather and meat in one long rake, and they spin away clutching at four ragged furrows that go right down to the bone.
[Trait: Bearkin Ironpaw]

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.info:
What it does: your will holds your allies together: for the rest of the fight none of them can be frightened, charmed or turned.

Something hard that's been forged in you over every fight you've ever survived goes out into all of them at once, and when the fear comes for them and the whispers start and the spells reach into their heads, every bit of it breaks on you.
[Trait: Trained Command VII]

abilities.name: Ironbark
abilities.info:
What it does: you harden your bark against cutting and stabbing; such blows do you little harm for a few turns.

Your bark darkens and tightens with a creak, going hard as hammered iron from your roots to your crown, and when they hack at you their edges ring and skid and chip, and they shake their stinging arms and stare at a tree that won't even take a scratch.
[Trait: Ironwood Treant]

abilities.name: Island Shell
abilities.info:
What it does: you become an island allies can stand on; they're safe from the sea and protected while you hold still.

You rise up out of the sea and settle, and your back is an island, trees and rocks and a little beach, and your friends wade ashore onto you, safe from the waves, safe from the deep, and the only sign it's not a real island is the soft clicking that comes up through the ground at night.
[Trait: Island Crab]

abilities.name: Jelly Wall
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread your jelly body into a wall; for a few turns allies behind you are shielded, and anything that hits you sticks.

You let yourself go wide and flat and tall, a wobbling wall of jelly across the path, and everything thrown at you sinks into you and stops, and the ones who swing at you find their arms stuck in you up to the elbow, wriggling.
[Trait: Ooze Colossus]

abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.info:
What it does: a column of holy light falls on one foe: very heavy damage, and against the dead and the dark it's usually the end of them.
You point up at the sky and then down at them, and the light comes down out of nowhere in a single column, blinding, roaring, pure light itself, and when it lifts there's nothing left where the dark thing was but ash and a scorched circle.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Judgement]

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns nothing stops your advance: blows don't knock you back, grabs don't hold you, and you walk through anything in your way.

You start walking and you don't stop, they hit you and you keep walking, they grab you and you drag them along, they stand in your way and you walk through them, every step heavy and even, and the ones at the back start backing up long before you reach them.
[Trait: Trained Fight V]

abilities.name: Jungle Silence
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk out to fight and everything goes silent; foes are frightened and fight badly for a few turns.

You step out of the trees and the jungle goes quiet, every bird, every bug, every frog, all at once, and in that silence your foes can hear their own hearts pounding and the soft click of your arms unfolding.
[Trait: Mantid Executioner]

abilities.name: Keen Ears
abilities.info:
What it does: hear what others miss: footsteps, breathing, whispers or movement behind walls and in cover nearby.

You hold still and let the noise of the world sort itself out, wind, water, your own heart, and under all of it the little sounds start standing out, a twig shifting, a breath held too long, a heartbeat behind the wall.
[Trait: Trained Hunt II]

abilities.name: Keen Eyes
abilities.info:
What it does: from up high spot movement no one else could: a scout in the trees, prey in the grass, an ambush before it springs.

You go still on your perch with your head cocked and the whole world spreads out under you sharp and close, every stalk of grass, every leaf, and there it is, one little twitch that doesn't belong, the shine of an eye in the scrub, and you screech it out before anybody down there has the faintest idea they've been seen.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Keen Eyes]

abilities.name: Keen Nose
abilities.info:
What it does: follow a scent through rain, over rock and across days; anyone you have smelled once is hard to lose.

You put your nose to the ground and breathe slow, and under the rain and the mud it's still there, thin as a thread, the same smell you caught days back, a boot heel scuffing stone, a hand dragged along a wall, and you follow it with your ears flat and your whole body pulled toward it.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Keen Nose]

abilities.name: Keep Them in Line
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day your followers obey you without question: no squabbling, no stealing, no slacking.

You walk through the middle of them slow and look at each one in turn, and the squabble stops halfway through a shove, and the stolen thing gets quietly put back where it came from, and the lazy one gets up off the ground, and nobody tries it again all day.
[Trait: Trained Command III]

abilities.name: Kick the Gate
abilities.info:
What it does: you kick through a gate, wall or door in one blow; anyone behind it is buried under the wreck.

You walk up to it, take one look, and kick, and the gate doesn't so much break as explode, splinters and stone and iron flying, and the ones who were holding it from the other side are under it now and you step over the lot of them.
[Trait: Ogre Colossus]

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.info:
What it does: set one thing alight with a touch: kindling, a rope, a door, a foe's fur or clothes; it burns for two turns.
You press a fingertip to it and hold it there, patient, and it smokes, then it curls, then it catches with a soft little whump and climbs, and you blow on it gently like you're coaxing a campfire and it roars up.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Kindle]

abilities.name: Kindling Snap
abilities.info:
What it does: you grab whatever a foe is holding or hiding behind in your jaws and bite clean through it; they're left with nothing in their hands.

You lunge at the thing they're holding instead of them and your jaws close on it with a crack, and you shake your head once and it comes apart like kindling, and they're left standing there with a stump of something in their hand and your face very close to theirs.
[Trait: Dire Wolfkin]

abilities.name: King's Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and every wolf for miles knows where you are; wolves nearby come to fight for you, and weaker beasts flee the area.

You throw it up into the sky, long and low and huge, and it rolls out over the land, and far away one wolf answers, then ten, then a hundred, coming, and everything else with teeth that heard it decides it's time to be somewhere else.
[Trait: Wolf King]

abilities.name: King's Word
abilities.info:
What it does: speak with the authority of a ruler: weaker creatures obey your commands, and even strong ones hesitate to defy you.

You speak and it's not a voice anymore, it's a law, and the weak ones obey halfway through hearing it, and the strong ones open their mouths to argue and close them again.
[Trait: Trained Command VIII]

abilities.name: Kingdom Builder
abilities.info:
What it does: for a week your home or holding grows twice as fast: rooms, walls, works and people all come quicker.

You throw yourself into it from the first light to the last, and everybody follows you, digging, hauling, building, and the place grows faster in a week than it did in a month.
[Trait: Trained Build VIII]

abilities.name: Kingdom of Gold
abilities.info:
What it does: you sleep on your hoard; resting heals you fully and you can't be woken by anything weaker than you.

You curl down into the gold and it shifts and clinks around you, warm and comfortable, and you sleep like the mountain sleeps, deep, untroubled, and when you wake every wound you had has gone and the town built on your back never even felt you breathe.
[Trait: Mountain Dragon]

abilities.name: Knit Flesh
abilities.info:
You close a fresh wound in a few breaths.
[Trait: Troll]

abilities.name: Know the Land
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day the land itself tells you its secrets: hidden paths, dens, water, dangers and the best ground to fight on.

You walk out into it and it opens up to you, the hidden trail, the den under the roots, the soft ground that will swallow a heavy foot, the high rock where nothing can come at you from behind.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VII]

abilities.name: Know the Market
abilities.info:
What it does: in any town or camp, learn what's short, what's cheap and who's buying, so your next trade there pays better.

You walk the stalls once, slow, with your ears open and your mouth shut, listening to who's shouting and who's not, what's piled up and rotting and what's gone by noon, and by the end of it you know who's desperate, who's flush, and what you should have brought.
[Trait: Trained Barter III]

abilities.name: Know Their Ways
abilities.info:
What it does: know how one race lives: what they value, what insults them, how they trade and fight. Your next dealings with them go better.

You know what they eat and what they bury, what they'll fight to the death over and what makes them laugh, how they greet a stranger and how they insult one, and when you speak to them you speak like someone who's sat at their fire.
[Trait: Trained Lore IV]

abilities.name: Know Your Prey
abilities.info:
What it does: study one kind of creature: you learn its weak spots and habits, and hit it harder for the rest of the day.

You watch it move and eat and fight and sleep, and you learn it, the leg it favours, the soft spot under the jaw, the way it looks left before it lunges, and after that every move it makes you've already seen.
[Trait: Trained Hunt VI]

abilities.name: Kobold Burrow
abilities.info:
Dig in or dig through: open a passage, a pit or a bolt-hole in moments.
[Trait: Soul of the Kobold]

abilities.name: Kobold Flame
abilities.info:
What it does: you spit a gout of drake-fire that sets one foe burning.

Your throat starts to glow orange through the shiny scales and your little crest flares up, and you lean back, puffing your cheeks out, and then spit, and out comes a fat jet of drake-fire that splashes all over them and sets their clothes going, and you dance on the spot yipping with joy because the dragon in your blood just showed itself.
[Trait: Dragonscale Kobold]

abilities.name: Lamia Constrict
abilities.info:
Coil around a foe and crush; they struggle to act while held.
[Trait: Soul of the Lamia]

abilities.name: Lamp Eyes
abilities.info:
What it does: your stone eyes light the deep dark; you see everything in it, and anything hiding there is found.

Your eyes open and they glow, pale and stony, two lamps in the dark, and the deep places open up in front of you, every crack and every shadow and every creature holding its breath behind a rock, and none of them can hide from those eyes.
[Trait: Basilisk Deep-King]

abilities.name: Lamp of Passage
abilities.info:
Carry a council lamp; the dead of the Barrow Hills let its bearer pass.
[Trait: The Quiet Council: Lamplighter]

abilities.name: Lance
abilities.info:
What it does: a long straight beam of your power that hits every foe in a line.

You lean back and push both hands forward and it goes out of you in one long straight line, through the first, and the one behind it, and the one behind that.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke V]

abilities.name: Lance Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge one foe at full gallop with your point lowered and run straight through them, knocking them off their feet and leaving them badly hurt.

The ground starts shaking before you've even moved, hooves pawing, your chest swelling as you drop your point level, and then you're running, the gallop building to a thunder that rattles teeth, the world narrowing to the one foe in front of you, and you hit them at full tilt and keep going straight through, the shock of it ringing up your arm as they're torn off their feet and left behind in your dust.
[Trait: Centaur Lancer]

abilities.name: Last Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: take a little of what leaves a creature as it dies close to you: you heal a little.

It breathes its last right in front of you and something goes out of it with the breath, warm, faint, and you breathe it in before it can drift away and feel it settle in your chest.
[Trait: Trained Absorb I]

abilities.name: Last Dawn
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow at dawn and a whole field turns to stone; everyone who hears it begins to petrify, the weakest at once.

The sun comes over the hills and you crow, and it's the last thing anyone in earshot ever hears, the grey running over them faster than they can run from it, some caught reaching for each other, some caught covering their ears, some caught halfway out of their beds, until everywhere your crow carried stands silent and grey in the morning light.
[Trait: Last Dawn Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Last Flash
abilities.info:
What it does: you hide in the storm until you strike; foes can't see you coming, and your first hit from the sky lands with full force.

You circle up in the black of the storm where nothing can see you, waiting, waiting, and when the next flash comes it's you, coming down out of it, and that flash is the last thing they see.
[Trait: Thunderhawk Sylph]

abilities.name: Last Light
abilities.info:
What it does: a pillar of holy light comes down on one foe for heavy holy damage; undead and shadow-things it hits are destroyed outright, unless they're bosses.
Everything goes quiet, even the wind, then a single note rings out clear and high and the sky above them opens, a column of light comes straight down on them so bright nobody can look at it, and when it's gone there's nothing left of the dead thing but a scorch on the ground and the warmth of holy light itself still hanging in the air.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Last Light]

abilities.name: Last One Standing
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns the more you are hurt, the harder your blows land and the less the next wound hurts.

You're hurt bad and something wakes up in you because of it, the blood loss making you light and cold and calm, every wound making the next one matter less, and you go forward into them like you've got nothing left to lose.
[Trait: Trained Endure VI]

abilities.name: Laughing Dream
abilities.info:
What it does: you sleep and laugh; when you wake you know one thing that's going to happen soon, a danger, a death or a chance.

You curl up and close your eyes and start giggling in your sleep, then laughing, then howling with it, the whole camp lying awake listening, and when you wake you know, and you say it out loud, and by morning it comes true.
[Trait: Gnoll Prophet]

abilities.name: Lava Heads
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe lava from every head; everything in front of you is burned and buried in molten rock.

Your heads glow orange from the inside and open together, and out comes lava, thick glowing rivers of it pouring from every jaw, splashing over the floor and climbing over itself, and it rolls over them, slow and unstoppable, burning and swallowing, and hardens into black rock with their shapes inside it.
[Trait: Volcanic Hydra]

abilities.name: Lava Spray
abilities.info:
What it does: you spray molten rock over the foes in front of you; they're burned and pinned as it cools.

Your tail curls up and shudders and you spit a stream of molten rock out of the barb in a glowing arc, splashing over them, and it burns, and it keeps burning, and then it cools around their legs and arms into black stone with them still struggling inside it.
[Trait: Volcanic Scorpid]

abilities.name: Lava Trail
abilities.info:
What it does: you leave a trail of lava; foes who cross it or are caught in it are badly burned.

You burst up out of the floor and slide away in a great glowing curve, and behind you the ground runs liquid, a river of lava spilling out of your wake, and anyone caught on the wrong side of it has to choose between burning and staying where they are.
[Trait: Magma Worm]

abilities.name: Law Under Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: your word is law in any tunnel or warren: weaker underground creatures obey you, and none of them will fight you down there.

You walk down into the tunnels and they all go quiet, every scratch and whisper and footstep, and you say what you want, once, and the dark does it, because down here under the ground nobody's ever said no to you and lived.
[Trait: Warren King]

abilities.name: Leaf That Cures
abilities.info:
What it does: you give one leaf that cures any one sickness or poison anywhere, even one nothing else can touch.

You pull one leaf off yourself, carefully, and fold it into their hand, and tell them how to take it, and they go home and do as you said, and the sickness that nothing else could touch just goes, overnight, like it was never there.
[Trait: Mandrake Cure-Root]

abilities.name: Leaves Wilt
abilities.info:
What it does: when you're hurt the forest takes some of it; for a few turns the trees around you take your wounds and you heal instead.

The blow lands and you gasp, and all around you for a mile the leaves curl and brown and drop, the forest taking the wound for you, and you stand up straight again whole while the trees shake their bare branches above you.
[Trait: Forest Dryad]

abilities.name: Legion
abilities.info:
What it does: call on every soul you hold at once: for a few turns you are far stronger, faster and harder to hurt.

You open the door inside you and every soul you ever took comes up at once, goblin, wolf, wraith, all of them, and they pour into your arms and legs and eyes until there's an army inside one body.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VIII]

abilities.name: Legion March
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a legion in perfect order; allies move and strike together and can't be broken for a few turns.

You march at the head of them and every step you take a thousand feet take with you, a single sound, ranks turning together, wheeling, charging, never a gap, never a soldier out of place, and the enemy realises too late that they're not fighting an army, they're fighting one creature with a thousand bodies.
[Trait: Antfolk War-Marshal]

abilities.name: Leviathan Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite through anything; one foe takes a massive bite that ignores their armour and protection.

You come up out of the black with jaws that have been biting for a thousand years, and they don't care what anyone wears, they close, and there's a crunch, and the top half of whatever you bit is still swimming for the surface for a moment before it understands.
[Trait: Abyssal Megalodon]

abilities.name: Lid Snap
abilities.info:
What it does: when someone opens or reaches into you, you snap shut on them; they're badly hurt and held.

You sit in the corner of the empty room with your brass lock catching the torchlight, so still and so clean and so very convenient, and they kneel down and lift your lid with a grin, and see the teeth a moment too late, and the lid comes down on their arms with a crunch and a wet sound and doesn't come back up.
[Trait: Chest Mimic]

abilities.name: Lie in Wait
abilities.info:
You pass for an object until someone comes close.
[Trait: Mimic]

abilities.name: Light Step
abilities.info:
What it does: land any fall softly and move across any floor in total silence; jumps and drops don't hurt you or give you away.

You drop off the ledge and twist in the air without thinking, tail swinging round to set you right, and you land on four soft pads with no more sound than a leaf, then you're padding across the loose boards where everyone else creaks, your weight spread out so light that the sleeping thing in the corner never even twitches an ear.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Light Step]

abilities.name: Lightburst
abilities.info:
What it does: you flash a burst of light that dazzles; foes near you are blinded for a turn.

Your wings start glowing, softly at first, shifting colours, then brighter and brighter, and then they flash, a burst of light right in their faces, and they reel back with their hands over their eyes and green spots blotting out everything.
[Trait: Pixie Lightweaver]

abilities.name: Lightning Crawls
abilities.info:
What it does: the lightning crawling over you strikes anything that touches you; for a few turns foes that hit you are shocked.

You come down out of the cloud with the lightning still crawling over your stone, little blue snakes of it running along your wings, and anything that lays a hand on you gets bitten by it and thrown back twitching.
[Trait: Gargoyle Storm-Wing]

abilities.name: Lightning Cry
abilities.info:
What it does: you cry out and lightning strikes one foe.

Lightning dances along your wingtips as you rear up and scream at the sky, and the sky screams back, a jagged white bolt cracking down out of nowhere and hitting them dead on, and when the flash fades they're on their backs with their hair standing up and smoke coming off their boots.
[Trait: Thunder Wyvern]

abilities.name: Lightning Edges
abilities.info:
What it does: lightning runs along your scythes for a few turns; every cut you land also shocks the foe.

You raise your scythes and the lightning runs up them, crackling along the edges, and every cut you make after that comes with a snap and a flash, and the ones you hit jerk and twitch and fall.
[Trait: Storm Mantid]

abilities.name: Lightning Lunge
abilities.info:
What it does: you lunge as a lightning strike out of your own storm, hitting one foe before they can react and passing straight through their guard.

The tempest around you drops dead still, the eye of the storm settling over them, the hair standing up on their arms and the air smelling burnt, then there's a flash so white they see their own bones through their eyelids and you're already through them and out the other side, and only then does the thunder come rolling in after you, late to its own fight.
[Trait: Tempest Wolf]

abilities.name: Lightning on the Cliffs
abilities.info:
What it does: wherever you land lightning strikes nearby; for a few turns bolts hit foes near you each turn.

You land and the lightning lands with you, cracking down on the rocks all around, and it keeps coming, every turn, bang, bang, bang, finding whoever's standing closest to you.
[Trait: Storm Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Lilting Tune
abilities.info:
A few notes that soothe or stir one listener.
[Trait: Satyr]

abilities.name: Line Work
abilities.info:
Work in a line with others so the load moves twice as fast; the next build action with helpers is stronger.
[Trait: The Hive: Hauler]

abilities.name: Lingering Power
abilities.info:
What it does: your power clings to one foe for a few turns, hurting them a little each turn.

It hits them and doesn't stop, it stays, soaking in, clinging, eating at them every time they breathe, and they can't brush it off.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke III]

abilities.name: Listening Mushrooms
abilities.info:
What it does: every mushroom in the dark listens for you; you hear anything said anywhere near fungus in the dungeon.

You sink into the threads under the roots and listen through every mushroom in the dark, every cap in every crack, and somewhere far away someone is whispering plans next to a little patch of fungus and you hear every word.
[Trait: Myconid Mind-King]

abilities.name: Little Lights
abilities.info:
What it does: the little lights of your grove spread out and watch for you; you know of anything that enters your grove or the woods near it.

You open your hands and the little lights drift out of the grove in every direction, between the trees, into the brush, and every one of them is an eye, and when anything with heavy feet comes into the wood you see it before it's taken ten steps.
[Trait: Fae Grove-Queen]

abilities.name: Little Spark
abilities.info:
What it does: call up a little of your power: light, heat, a chill, a crackle, a stink, whatever your power is; enough to light, scare or startle.

You open your hand and it comes up out of your palm, small and flickering and yours, and you hold it up to see by, or toss it at something that needs scaring.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke I]

abilities.name: Live Off Scraps
abilities.info:
What it does: you find food, water and a safe place to sleep wherever you are, and can go a day without either without slowing down. Rolls endure.

Your nose is down before the pack is, turning stones, pulling roots, sniffing out the trickle under the moss, and by dark there's something cooking and a hollow nobody else would have found, dry and out of the wind.
[Trait: Scavenger]

abilities.name: Live Wire
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight lightning jumps from you to anything that hits or grabs you; each time, it takes lightning damage and loses its hold.
Your hair lifts first, every strand standing on end, then the air round you snaps and ticks with tiny jumps of light, and the moment anything lays a hand or a hit on you the lightning leaps the gap with a bang, flings it back off you twitching, and the air smells scorched after.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Live Wire]

abilities.name: Living Crown
abilities.info:
What it does: the stars circling your brow fly out and blind every foe close to you for a turn, then return.

You lower your head and the little stars that circle it break orbit and shoot out in every direction, blazing, and everyone close catches one full in the face and reels away clutching at their eyes, and the stars come drifting back to settle round your head.
[Trait: Star Khan]

abilities.name: Living Dungeon
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a maze and trap foes inside; the walls move, close and digest them for the rest of the fight.

They think they're in a dungeon and they are, it's you, and the first sign is small, the walls warm to the touch, then the floor giving a little underfoot, then a drip from the ceiling that sizzles on someone's shoulder, and by the time they understand the halls are shrinking and sweating and the only way out is further in, they're already being digested.
[Trait: Labyrinth Slime]

abilities.name: Living Floor
abilities.info:
What it does: you reshape the floor you are; walls move, pits open and passages close for the rest of the fight.

You've let them explore for three days, you know every step they've taken, and now you're hungry, and the floor shifts, corridors swinging shut behind them, pits opening under their feet, stairs folding into walls, every way out sealing itself, and they're lost in a dungeon that is digesting them.
[Trait: Dungeon Mimic]

abilities.name: Living Library
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day you can answer any question about the world's races, places and old powers that someone, somewhere, ever knew.

You've heard everything and read everything and eaten the souls of things that knew everything, and today it's all right there at the front of your head, and whatever they ask you, you know, and you know who told you.
[Trait: Trained Lore VIII]

abilities.name: Living Maze
abilities.info:
What it does: you wake your whole maze; its walls, floors and doors fight for you, crushing, dropping and sealing foes for the rest of the fight.

You press your palm flat to the wall and feel the pulse in the stone, slow and huge and yours, and then the maze wakes, walls lurching in to grind together, floors dropping away into black pits, doors slamming shut on reaching hands, every corridor twisting and swallowing until your enemies understand they were never fighting you down here, they were fighting the maze, and the maze had been hungry for years.
[Trait: Labyrinth King]

abilities.name: Lizardfolk Death Roll
abilities.info:
Seize a foe and roll, in water or out, tearing and drowning.
[Trait: Soul of the Lizardfolk]

abilities.name: Long Sleep
abilities.info:
What it does: you put a whole group into a deep sleep; they won't wake for a long time unless shaken hard.

You hum one note and the grove goes still, birds stopping mid-song, and a heavy golden drowsiness rolls out over them, and they yawn and sit and lie down among the roots, and the moss starts creeping over their boots by the time the first one snores, and they'll wake a year from now with grey in their hair.
[Trait: Dryad Dreamweaver]

abilities.name: Loose a Splinter
abilities.info:
What it does: you let one kept soul out as a pale half-shape that fights or scouts for you for a few turns, then it fades back into you.

You crack something loose inside, a sharp little break like a bone snapping, and a pale piece of something you killed claws its way up out of your chest, half a shape, a jaw and a pair of arms and a smear of light where the rest should be, and it goes where you point, snarling with a voice it lost years back.
[Trait: Splinter Soul]

abilities.name: Lord of Tunnels
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every tunnel in the deep places and who walks it; nobody can hide from you or lose you down there.

You lie in the deepest hall with your stone-lamp eyes half closed and every tunnel in the dark is a thread running to you, every footstep a twitch on the line, and you know who came in through the old mine three days ago and where they're sleeping tonight and which turn they'll take tomorrow when they think they've found the way out.
[Trait: Basilisk Deep-King]

abilities.name: Lords Come to Ask
abilities.info:
What it does: the dungeon's lords seek your help; you can trade a favour with any powerful creature below for one in return.

They come to your hall, the great ones, the lords of the deep floors, and they wait for you to look at them, and they ask, politely, and you name your price, and they pay it, because there's nobody else down there who sees what you see.
[Trait: Gazer Overlord]

abilities.name: Lost Ones
abilities.info:
What it does: the lost things wandering your maze come when you call; a few creatures that found their way into your halls fight for you.

You stamp and bellow down the long halls and out of the dark they come shuffling, the lost ones, the ones who wandered in and never found the way out, wild-eyed, half starved, and they know who feeds them now.
[Trait: Labyrinth Lord]

abilities.name: Low Blow
abilities.info:
What it does: hit one foe somewhere that really hurts: they double over and lose their next action.

You go for the soft spot nobody's guarding, below the belt, behind the knee, the bit under the arm, and they fold up around it with a noise like a kicked dog and forget they were ever fighting.
[Trait: Trained Trick III]

abilities.name: Low Spires
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive into a tower, wall or high place and break it; anyone on top is thrown down.

You come down out of the storm right at the top of the tower and hit it with your whole weight, and the top of it explodes into falling stone, and everyone who was up there comes tumbling down with it.
[Trait: Gargoyle Thunderhead]

abilities.name: Lure
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing one listener toward you, step by step, unless they break the song.

You perch on the wreck-rock and sing, soft and sweet, just for one of them, and they hear it as if you were singing in their ear, and they start walking toward you with a soft smile, step after step toward you, while their friends shout their name and they don't even hear.
[Trait: Siren Lurer]

abilities.name: Lure Cry
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a song that draws one listener toward you, step by step, unless they shake it off.

You perch on a rock above the water and sing low and sweet, a voice that rolls over the waves, and their feet start moving before they've decided anything, one step, then another, toward the water, toward you, with a soft smile on their face and their eyes gone dreamy and far away.
[Trait: Sea Harpy]

abilities.name: Lure Light
abilities.info:
What it does: you lure a foe with a glow; they're drawn toward you, lost in the light, until they shake it off.

You hang still in the lightless deep and let the lights along your body pulse, slow and soft and blue, and they can't look away, they drift toward it with their eyes wide and dreaming, closer and closer, right up into your arms.
[Trait: Abyssal Merfolk]

abilities.name: Lure Song
abilities.info:
What it does: sing a few notes to one listener: they are drawn toward you step by step, and feel kindly toward you, while you keep singing.

You hum it at first, soft, just for them, and their head turns, and then you let the words come and they take one step toward you without deciding to, and another, smiling a soft faraway smile, wading in up to their knees, their waist, with their eyes on you the whole way.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Lure Song]

abilities.name: Magma Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe molten rock; it burns everything in its path and hardens around foes it hits, holding them.

Your throat glows lava-orange and you lean forward and vomit out a torrent of molten rock, thick and glowing and slow, pouring over them, and it burns where it touches and then it cools, black crust forming over their legs and arms, sealing them where they stand in a shell of stone that's still hot inside.
[Trait: Magma Salamander]

abilities.name: Magma Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike with a molten claw; one foe is crushed and burned.

Your great claw glows orange through the cracks in its plates and lava dribbles off the tips of it, and you grab them with it, and they shriek as it closes, the heat searing through anything they've got on, the smell of burning filling the air as your claw squeezes and cooks at the same time.
[Trait: Magma Scorpid]

abilities.name: Make Do
abilities.info:
What it does: build a rough tool, piece of gear or crude weapon out of scrap in moments; it works but won't last long.

You look at the heap of junk and see the thing it could be, and your hands start putting it together while your head's still working it out, bent, bound, sharpened, balanced, and what you're holding at the end is crude and lopsided and it works.
[Trait: Trained Build III]

abilities.name: Make Stone Weep
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a song so moving that one creature or crowd is overcome; they're easy to talk round for a while.

You play something slow and aching and it gets into them, into the cracks in them, and they're weeping before they know it, stone-faced guards and hard old warriors alike, and when you stop and ask them for something they can't say no.
[Trait: Satyr Muse]

abilities.name: Make Their Peace
abilities.info:
What it does: the living who see you are frightened; for a few turns weaker foes fight badly or flee, praying.

You drift toward them and they see what you are, and the weak ones drop to their knees and start praying to whatever they've got, and the strong ones fight with their hands shaking, all of them thinking about the end.
[Trait: Wraith Reaper]

abilities.name: Make Them Believe
abilities.info:
What it does: tell one big lie well enough that even a suspicious creature believes it.

It's a huge lie, the kind that gets people killed when it comes apart, and you tell it like it's the most boring truth in the world, yawning halfway through, and they believe every single word.
[Trait: Trained Talk VI]

abilities.name: Make Them Need It
abilities.info:
What it does: talk up something you have until a buyer wants it badly: they pay far more than it's worth.

You don't sell it, you tell its story, where it came from and who died for it and who else has been asking after it and how few of these there are left, slow and sad, and by the end they're leaning in, desperate, pushing ingots at you to take it off your hands.
[Trait: Trained Barter VII]

abilities.name: Make Way
abilities.info:
What it does: the oaks part for you; you and your party travel through any forest at speed, and the way closes behind you.

You grunt and the trees lean aside, branches lifting, roots shifting, opening a path right through the thickest of the wood, and you trot down it with your party behind you, and the forest closes up again at your heels.
[Trait: Boarfolk Oak-Mother]

abilities.name: Mandible Crush
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush one foe in your mandibles; they're badly hurt and held.

You come at them with your head down, those huge mandibles spread wide, and you clamp them shut on their middle with a crunch, and lift them right off their feet, and squeeze while they hammer at your plates with their fists.
[Trait: Antfolk Soldier]

abilities.name: Mandrake Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: let out a shriek that stuns and deafens everything nearby for a turn or two; weak creatures that hear it may drop senseless.

You pull your head back like you're being dragged up out of the dirt, and what tears out of you is the scream of every root ever torn from the ground, and everyone within earshot drops whatever they're holding and grabs their skull, and the weakest drop where they stand, twitching and don't get back up.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Mandrake Scream]

abilities.name: Mandrake Shriek
abilities.info:
Scream to stun everyone nearby.
[Trait: Soul of the Mandrake]

abilities.name: Mantid Scythe
abilities.info:
Unfold and slash faster than the eye follows.
[Trait: Soul of the Mantid]

abilities.name: Map in Your Head
abilities.info:
What it does: never get lost: you always know where you are, the way back and the shortest way to anywhere you know.

Every place you've ever been is drawn in your head with every way between them, every shortcut and every dead end, and you take the shortest way without thinking about it while the others are still arguing about which way is north.
[Trait: Trained Lore VI]

abilities.name: Map of Tombs
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every tomb on the continent; you know the way to any grave, crypt or burial and what's in it.

You put your palm on the soil and the dead whisper up through it, from every tomb on the continent, and the map of them spreads out in your head, every crypt and every grave, and you know exactly where to dig.
[Trait: Ghoul Grave-Elder]

abilities.name: Maps Are Wrong
abilities.info:
What it does: you move the trees of a wood around so that anyone using a map or memory of it gets lost; you and yours never do.

You walk through the wood at night tapping trunks, and they shuffle and shift behind you, and by morning nothing is where it was, and the ones following their maps walk in circles for days while you stroll straight through to where you meant to be.
[Trait: Treant Shepherd]

abilities.name: Market Silk
abilities.info:
What it does: you sell silk or anything else to the canyon markets at your price; every trader knows the silk passes through your hands.

You lay the bolt on the table and the trader runs their fingers along it and goes quiet, because they know whose loom it came off, and there's no point haggling with the one whose hands every thread in the canyon passes through.
[Trait: Arachne High Weaver]

abilities.name: Marsh Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you curse an area of ground into marsh; foes caught in it sink, slow and sicken for a few turns.

You crouch and dip one long finger into the dirt and stir it slowly and whisper the fen's name, and the ground goes soft under their feet, then wet, then black and sucking, swallowing them to the shins, the knees, the waist, the smell of rot rising up around them as leeches and biting things crawl up out of the mud to find them.
[Trait: Fen Hag]

abilities.name: Marsh Hunter
abilities.info:
What it does: move through water without a ripple and burst out of it onto a foe who didn't see you, grabbing and dragging them into the water.

Just your eyes and the ridge of your snout above the surface, drifting, the water lying flat and calm around you like you're a log, closer, closer, and they lean down to drink and the water explodes white and you've got them, jaws locked, rolling, dragging them backwards into the deep while their hands scrabble at the mud and find nothing.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Marsh Hunter]

abilities.name: Masquerade
abilities.info:
What it does: you make a crowd see you as someone else; each sees who they trust most.

You walk into the middle of them and every one of them sees someone different, a mother, a lover, an old friend, their captain, a child they lost years ago, and they all reach out to you smiling, and nobody wonders why the others are smiling at a stranger, and you let them lead you right to the thing you came for.
[Trait: Fox Face-Thief]

abilities.name: Mass Glamour
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a glamour over everyone around you; foes can't tell friend from foe and may strike each other for a few turns.

You blow a long breath out across them and a shimmer rolls over the crowd, and when it passes every face has changed, friends wearing enemies' faces, enemies wearing friends', the captain looking like a stranger and the stranger looking like their brother, and the fight turns into a mess of shouting and swinging where nobody knows who is who anymore.
[Trait: Glamour Satyr]

abilities.name: Master Crafter
abilities.info:
What it does: make one fine piece of gear from good materials: it's better than anything bought.

You take your time over this one, picking the best of everything, working every part twice, and what you hand over at the end is better than anything any trader could sell.
[Trait: Trained Build VI]

abilities.name: Masterwork
abilities.info:
What it does: you forge a weapon or piece of armour of rare quality, far better than common gear.

You take the ingots in both hands and close your eyes, and the heat that pours out of you makes the forge-hall shimmer, and you work for hours without stopping, folding, hammering with your fists, quenching in your own breath, until at last you hold it up to the light and the other smiths go quiet, because they know they'll never make anything like it as long as they live.
[Trait: Salamander Forgemaster]

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.info:
What it does: a crushing swipe and bite that throws a foe flat; a foe on the ground under you is pinned and badly hurt.

You come up on your back legs and you're suddenly twice their size, a roar coming out of you that they feel in their teeth, and then you drop on them with all of it, one huge paw knocking them flat and the other pinning them there while your jaws close on the shoulder and shake, and they find out what it means when a bear decides you're not getting up.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Maul]

abilities.name: Maze Mind
abilities.info:
What it does: never lose your way in tunnels, halls or mazes: every turn you have taken stays clear in your mind and you can always find the way back or the way through.

Every turn you've taken settles into your head and stays put, left, left, down the stair, past the stone with the scratch on it, the whole twisting place laying itself out behind your eyes like you're standing over it looking down, and when the others stop dead and argue about which way, you're already walking.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Maze Mind]

abilities.name: Maze Trap
abilities.info:
What it does: in a maze or halls you know, you lure a foe after you into a section you set up earlier and shut it behind them, cutting them off from their allies.

You let them chase you, never too far ahead, a glimpse of horn at the next turn, the clop of hooves round the next corner, left, left, right, down the stair, and they never notice the keys grown into your hide counting every turn, not until you step through a door and they follow and hear it, one small click behind them, and the hall they came in by is a blank stone wall.
[Trait: Labyrinth Keeper]

abilities.name: Melt
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe you hit or grab takes heavy acid damage and keeps dissolving for three turns; its armour is gone for the fight.
You take hold and hold on, and the hiss gets louder and louder until it's a roar, they shriek and pull and can't get loose, their face runs and twists as the acid works in, their armour slides off them in hot grey sludge, and when you finally let go there's less of them than there was, and the acid isn't finished yet.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Melt]

abilities.name: Melt Armour
abilities.info:
What it does: your acid eats one foe's armour, hide or shell: it protects them far less for the rest of the fight.
You get your hands on the hard part of them, the shell, the hide, the plate, and it sizzles and runs, softening, sagging, sliding off them in wet lumps, and under it there's nothing but soft skin.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Acid: Melt Armour]

abilities.name: Melt Rock
abilities.info:
What it does: you melt through stone, leaving a glowing tunnel; anything in your path is burned.

Your mouth glows white-hot and you push it against the rock and the rock gives up, glowing red and slumping, dripping away from your face, and you slide forward through it with a hiss of steam, leaving a tunnel behind you with glowing walls that slowly cool to black glass.
[Trait: Lava Worm]

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.info:
What it does: you heal a grievous wound on one ally, even one that should have killed them.

You kneel by them and pull a handful of your own roots loose with a grunt and press them into the wound, and they wriggle, and burrow, and knit, sewing torn flesh back together from the inside, and the bleeding stops and the colour comes back and they gasp a breath they shouldn't have been able to take.
[Trait: Mandrake Elder-Healer]

abilities.name: Mending Flesh
abilities.info:
What it does: small cuts, bites and scrapes on you close within moments, healing a little each turn for a short while.

There's an itch under the skin where they cut you and then you watch it happen, the edges of the wound crawling back toward each other, pink and wet and knitting shut while the blood's still running, and the one who cut you stares at the clean skin and back at their own hands.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Mending Flesh]

abilities.name: Merchant Prince
abilities.info:
What it does: your name carries weight with traders everywhere: anywhere you go, merchants offer you their best terms first.

Word goes ahead of you down every road you walk, and by the time you come into a market the traders have already heard, and they're smoothing out their best cloths and setting out their best goods and putting on their best smiles, all for you.
[Trait: Trained Barter VIII]

abilities.name: Merfolk Tide
abilities.info:
Call a current to drag a foe or lift an ally.
[Trait: Soul of the Merfolk]

abilities.name: Mesmer
abilities.info:
What it does: hold someone's gaze and bend a weak or willing mind: they obey simple commands for a while and forget it after.

You lean in close and look at them and keep looking until your eyes are all there is, deep and red and patient, and your voice is soft and they can't stop listening to it, and whatever you tell them to do they do with a dreamy little smile, and when it's over they won't remember a thing except a feeling that someone was very kind to them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Mesmer]

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.info:
What it does: a vast poison fog rolls out over the whole area for three turns: every foe in it takes heavy poison damage each turn and is weakened.
It comes out of every part of you at once and keeps coming, a fog of poison that rolls out over everything you can see, into every lung, every eye, every cut, and the sound of the whole fight changes to coughing and retching and then to quiet.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Miasma]

abilities.name: Mimic Ambush
abilities.info:
Pass as an object, then strike the unaware.
[Trait: Soul of the Mimic]

abilities.name: Mimic Voice
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak in anyone's voice you've heard; others believe it is really them.

You clear your throat and when you speak it's their captain talking, every gruff word perfect, the little cough at the end, and they snap to it and march off in the wrong direction, and you watch them go with that sly grin that never leaves your face.
[Trait: Fox Trickster]

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.info:
What it does: take the shape and texture of an object worth reaching for and wait: the first one to touch you is grabbed and bitten before they can react.

You make yourself into the thing they want, a chest with a good lock, a bag that clinks, and you sit there gleaming and patient, and the greedy one comes over smiling and reaches out and the lid comes open into teeth and a long wet tongue that wraps their wrist and pulls them in up to the elbow while the others just stand there screaming.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Mimicry]

abilities.name: Mind Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread spores that make foes obey; those who breathe them follow your commands for a few turns.

You breathe out a cloud of fine grey spores that drifts over them, and they breathe it, and it goes up into their heads, and there's a moment where they feel it, something else in there with them, and then their faces go slack and their eyes cloud over and they stand up straight and wait for you to tell them what to do.
[Trait: Mind-Spore Gazer]

abilities.name: Minotaur Charge
abilities.info:
Lower the horns and run; whatever stands in the way breaks or flies.
[Trait: Soul of the Minotaur]

abilities.name: Mirage
abilities.info:
What it does: you conjure a convincing mirage; foes see whatever false thing you show them until they touch it.

You wave your hands and the light bends and folds and paints the air, and there's a bridge where there's no bridge, a door in a blank wall, a whole army coming over the hill, so real they can smell it, and they march toward it or flee from it, and either way they're doing exactly what you wanted.
[Trait: Pixie Glimmer]

abilities.name: Mischief Night
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a whole army into chaos for one night; they're lost, robbed, confused and fighting each other till dawn.

You wait until their camp is asleep, and then you and your court get busy, every pixie in the meadow, and by morning the horses are loose and braided, the tents are on fire, the food is full of beetles, the officers are tied to trees, and half the camp is fighting the other half over who did it.
[Trait: Pixie King]

abilities.name: Mist Roll
abilities.info:
What it does: a thick marsh mist rolls in on your word for a few turns; foes in it are lost and blinded, while you and your allies see fine.

You say one word into the air and the mist comes rolling in off the water, thick and grey and cold, and in a breath the whole fight disappears in it, and they're calling out to each other, lost, while you walk through it like it's your own house.
[Trait: Fen Witch]

abilities.name: Molten Armour
abilities.info:
What it does: you coat your allies in armour forged on the spot; blows against them lose much of their force for a few turns.

You slap your glowing palms onto your friends' shoulders one after another, and molten metal pours out of your hands and over them, flowing, hardening as it goes into shining plates that fit them perfectly, hot to the touch and hissing in the cold air, and when the next blow lands it rings off the armour and skids away.
[Trait: Salamander Anvil-Lord]

abilities.name: Molten Slam
abilities.info:
What it does: you slam the ground and lava spills out around you; nearby foes are badly burned.
