You raise both molten fists over your head and bring them down on the floor, and the floor splits and lava comes bubbling up out of the cracks, spreading out around your feet in a glowing pool, and anyone standing close goes up howling as it rolls over their boots.
[Trait: Magma Golem]

abilities.name: Moon Change
abilities.info:
What it does: you let the wolf take more of you for the rest of the fight; you heal a little every turn and your bites hit harder.

You arch your back and the change goes through you with a crack of bones, your jaw pushing out, your fur thickening, your eyes going yellow, and the wounds on you close over as the wolf takes them, and you come back down on all fours with a grin full of fangs.
[Trait: Moonhowler]

abilities.name: Moon Goes Red
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn the moon red; for the rest of the night every wolf and blood-drinker is stronger and every foe is afraid.

You howl up at it and the moon blushes, then darkens, then goes the deep red of old blood, and everything with fangs howls back, and everything without them looks up and shivers.
[Trait: Moonblood King]

abilities.name: Moon Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl under the moon; every wolf and wolf-rider ally hears it and fights harder, and lone wolves nearby come to join you.

You tip your head back and howl at the moon, a wolf's howl out of an orc's throat, and the wolves of the tribe lift their heads and answer you, then the wild wolves in the hills, then wolves far off you'll never see, until the night is one long chorus and every wolf on your side of the field has fire in its eyes and blood in its mouth.
[Trait: Moonhowler]

abilities.name: Moon Hunger
abilities.info:
What it does: under the moon you rend one foe with claws and fangs; they're badly hurt and you heal from it.

The moon comes out from behind the clouds and you feel it in your bones, the change, fur and fangs and claws tearing out of you, and you howl and fall on them, rending and tearing in a frenzy of wolf and blood, and every bite heals you while it kills them.
[Trait: Werewolf Vampire]

abilities.name: Moon Mending
abilities.info:
What it does: standing in open moonlight you heal over a few breaths, cuts and bites closing up; it does nothing by day or under a roof.

The cold of it touches you first, silver light settling on your fur, then the itch starts deep in every cut and bite as the flesh crawls back together and the pain bleeds out of you into the night.
[Trait: Lunar Wolfkin]

abilities.name: Moonsight
abilities.info:
What it does: under moonlight you see as clear as noon; hidden or sneaking foes in the open dark are spotted.

Your eyes tinge white as they become deep dark pools of black, then suddenly a ring of white as the moon is reflected within your very sight, the night like day, every shadow thin as smoke, every crouched shape behind every tree lit silver, and the one holding their breath in the bushes thinking they're safe looks up to find you already looking right at them.
[Trait: Moonfang]

abilities.name: Moonstep
abilities.info:
What it does: in moonlight you blink from patch to patch of it, closing on a foe or slipping out of reach in a few heartbeats.

You step into the moonlight and there's a sound like chimes, you're there one minute and gone the next, and with each chime you appear closer and closer, threading through the light, until the last chime rings right behind them and your breath fogs on the back of their neck.
[Trait: Moon-Touched Wolfkin]

abilities.name: More Soldiers
abilities.info:
What it does: every foe that falls in this fight rises as your soldier; for the rest of it the dead fight for you.

One of them falls and you point at it without looking and it gets back up, its eyes gone dark, and turns to face its own friends, and the next one that falls does the same, and by the end of the fight you've got more soldiers than you started with.
[Trait: Grave Lord]

abilities.name: Morning Caps
abilities.info:
What it does: you read the mushrooms sprouting from the dead; they tell you who died, how and what they knew.

You crouch by the caps that came up overnight out of the fallen and touch them, and they tell you in their slow way, who this was, how they died, what they were carrying, what they last saw, all of it fed up into the fungus with everything else.
[Trait: Myconid Plague-Cap]

abilities.name: Mountain
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns blows barely hurt you at all, nothing moves you, and every foe that hits you is jarred by it.

You settle your weight down into your feet and down through them into the ground and you become part of it, and they hit you and their arms ring, and they shove you and their feet slide, and you stand there like the land itself.
[Trait: Trained Endure VIII]

abilities.name: Mountain Rumbles
abilities.info:
What it does: you stir and the ground rumbles; foes across a wide area are knocked down and the ground splits under them.

You shift in your sleep and the whole mountain rumbles with you, and the ground under them jumps and cracks, glowing lines opening in it, and they're thrown down and scrambling away from the heat coming up out of the cracks.
[Trait: Volcano Salamander]

abilities.name: Mountain Shudder
abilities.info:
What it does: you thrash and the mountain shudders; every foe in the area is knocked down and rocks fall on them.

You thrash once inside the mountain and the whole thing shudders like it's caught a chill, and up on the surface the ground jumps and rocks come tumbling down the slopes onto everyone standing on them.
[Trait: Rockworm Leviathan]

abilities.name: Mountain's Weight
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush everything beneath your bulk; foes under or near you are pinned and crushed.

Fighting them is beneath you, so you roll over, and you do, a dragon as big as a hill shifting in its sleep, and all that bulk comes down on everything beside you, carts and walls and warriors pressed flat into the earth beneath a ridge of gold-crusted scales.
[Trait: Mountain Dragon]

abilities.name: Moves When You Think
abilities.info:
What it does: you see and hear through every infected creature in your cave; nothing happens there that you don't know about.

You think and the whole cave thinks with you, every rat, every bat, every poor soul with your spores in their lungs, and through all their eyes and ears at once you see everything, every corner, every whisper.
[Trait: Spore Mind-Lord]

abilities.name: Multi-Ray
abilities.info:
What it does: you fire rays from several stalks at once; several foes are each hit by a different curse.

Your stalks all turn at once, each one finding a different target, and each one glows a different colour, green and violet and red and grey, and they fire together, a web of humming beams strung through the air, and one foe weakens and one burns and one goes slow and one goes blind.
[Trait: Gazer Hexeye]

abilities.name: Myconid Spores
abilities.info:
Release a cloud of spores that dazes and sickens foes.
[Trait: Soul of the Myconid]

abilities.name: Name as a Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak your own name to one foe; they fall into a cursed sleep and are badly weakened when they wake.

You tell them your name, quietly, and they hear it, and their eyes go heavy, and they lie down right where they are, and they dream terrible things, and when they wake up, if they wake up, they're weaker than they've ever been.
[Trait: Archlich]

abilities.name: Name for Children
abilities.info:
What it does: your name frightens anyone from the coast; foes who know it are frightened and fight badly for a few turns.

You tell them your name and you see it land, they heard it when they were small, from their mothers, at bedtime, and it comes back to them now, all those nights of not sleeping, and their hands shake.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Sea-Wolf]

abilities.name: Nasty Little Bastard
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight every dirty trick you know works better: foes can't read your feints and fall for every one.

You stop being something they can read, you laugh when you should be scared and go limp when you should be angry and come in when you should be running, and they keep guessing wrong, and every time they guess wrong it costs them.
[Trait: Trained Trick VIII]

abilities.name: Necropolis Secrets
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every tomb and its secret in your necropolis; you know what's buried where and who put it there.

You walk the halls of the dead and every tomb tells you its secret, what's in it, who's in it, who buried them and who they were hiding from, and you know all of it, and none of it is going anywhere unless you say so.
[Trait: Ghoul Crypt-Lord]

abilities.name: Nest in the Cracks
abilities.info:
What it does: the birds nesting in your shoulders keep watch; you can't be surprised, and they warn you of anything coming.

The birds in the cracks of your shoulders lift off all at once in a clatter of wings, and you turn your great stone head slowly to where they're looking, because they've never once been wrong about something coming.
[Trait: Colossus]

abilities.name: Nest of Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: the things that live in your sump rise to fight for you; a swarm of sump creatures attacks your foes for the rest of the fight.

You stir in your nest and the bones shift and rattle, and everything that lives down there in the dark water with you comes up, crawling, swimming, slithering, and goes for whoever came down into your sump without asking.
[Trait: Hundred-Headed Hydra]

abilities.name: Nesting Birds
abilities.info:
What it does: the birds nesting in you keep watch; you can't be surprised, and they warn you of anything coming from far off.

The birds in your shoulders go quiet all at once, then one chirps sharp and they all take off in a flurry, and you know before you've even looked up that something's coming, and from which way, and how big.
[Trait: Treebear]

abilities.name: Never Lose the Trail
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day nothing can hide its trail from you: tricks, water, magic or time; you always find the prey.

They doubled back and crossed the river and cast something to hide it and waited three days, and none of it matters, the trail's still there to you, faint but there, and you follow it all the way to their door.
[Trait: Trained Hunt VII]

abilities.name: Never Lost
abilities.info:
What it does: you study a fight before it starts; for the whole fight your side moves with cold patience and never falls for a trick or a feint.

You lie on the warm rock and watch them for a long time without moving, a very long time, until you know them better than they know themselves, and when it starts nothing they do surprises you, and nothing you do is in a hurry.
[Trait: Lizard King]

abilities.name: Never Scratched
abilities.info:
What it does: your diamond body cuts anything that hits it; for a few turns foes that strike you are cut and their gear is ruined.

They hit you and their hits skid off diamond, and the edges of you are sharper than anything they've got, and every blow they throw comes back to them with the skin of their knuckles left on you and their gear notched and broken.
[Trait: Diamond Wyrm]

abilities.name: Never Stop Hammering
abilities.info:
What it does: you repair broken gear and armour for your whole party in the middle of a fight; it's as good as new.

You pull your hammer out of the air where you keep it and start working, right there in the middle of everything, clang, clang, clang, the sparks flying, bending things back, fusing things together, and you hand it all back hot and whole.
[Trait: Salamander Anvil-Lord]

abilities.name: Never the Same Face
abilities.info:
What it does: you change how one creature sees you: a friend, a stranger, a child, a monster; they believe it until you break it.

You catch their eye and grin and in their head you become something else, an old friend, a lost child, a goat, a terror, whatever works, and they treat you exactly like that thing until you decide to stop pretending.
[Trait: Glamour Satyr]

abilities.name: Never Touched
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns attacks aimed at you almost always miss; only the strongest foes land a hit at all.

Every swing, every lunge, every grab they throw, and you're never there, a twist, a lean, a half step, a hop, every swing and bite and grab going through empty air, and you don't even seem to be trying, and the longer it goes on the wilder they get.
[Trait: Trained Strike VIII]

abilities.name: New Stone
abilities.info:
What it does: the magma you leave behind cools into stone at your word; you raise walls, bridges or barricades from it.

You walk and the molten rock runs off your scales and pools behind you, and you shape it with your feet and your tail as it cools, a wall here, a bridge there, and in a few breaths it's hard new stone standing where there was nothing.
[Trait: Magma Salamander]

abilities.name: Night Cloak
abilities.info:
What it does: for three turns darkness covers the area: you and your allies are hidden in it and strike from it, and foes can't see.
You pull the dark around all of you like a blanket and it holds, thick and cold, and inside it your side can see each other fine while the other side flails around blind, calling for torches that won't light.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Night Cloak]

abilities.name: Night Eyes
abilities.info:
What it does: for a while you see in darkness as if it were dusk.

Your eyes drink in what little light there is, and the dark thins out around you to grey, shapes coming up out of it one after another, the wall, the path, the thing crouched in the corner, and you walk on through the black like it's evening.
[Trait: Trained Instinct III]

abilities.name: Night Fall
abilities.info:
What it does: you call night on a place; it falls dark there for the rest of the scene, and shadow-born grow strong in it.

You look up at the noon sky and close your hand, and the light goes out of the day all at once, dusk then night then the deep black of midnight in the space of a few breaths, and in that sudden dark everything that lives in shadow wakes up and moves.
[Trait: Shade Night-Lord]

abilities.name: Night Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting a foe who doesn't know you're there; the strike lands with full force and their poison works fast.

You slip in after dark with your plates wrapped in cloth so they won't click, past the dozing guard, under the flap, and you stand over the sleeper listening to them breathe, and the sting falls once, quiet as a dropped feather, and the breathing changes, and slows, and they never open their eyes.
[Trait: Scorpid Assassin]

abilities.name: Nine Flames
abilities.info:
What it does: you loose all nine tails of foxfire at once; everything in front of you is burned in spirit.

Your nine tails spread behind you, each one a column of blue and white flame, and every fox on every road lowers its head as you swing them forward together, and nine rivers of foxfire pour out across them, burning nothing and everything, every soul it touches flickering and dimming.
[Trait: Nine-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Nine Ways at Once
abilities.info:
What it does: with nine heads watching, nothing gets behind you; for the rest of the fight you can't be flanked or surprised.

Your nine heads turn on their long necks, each looking a different way, front, back, up, down, and nothing that happens anywhere around you goes unseen, and the ones creeping round behind you find a head already waiting there for them.
[Trait: Nine-Headed Hydra]

abilities.name: No Light Burns Long
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day no light lasts near you; fires, torches and magic lights die, and your allies see in the dark.

You decide to go somewhere and the lights there know it, the torches shrinking, the fires dying down to embers, the magic lamps flickering out one after another, and you walk through the dark you've made with your friends seeing fine beside you.
[Trait: Shade Dark-Lord]

abilities.name: Noble Charm
abilities.info:
What it does: you charm a weak mind into service; one weak foe obeys you for a while.

You take their hand, slow and polite, and look into their eyes, and smile, just enough to show the tips of your teeth, and something in them goes soft and loose and willing, and when you tell them to fetch you something, or stand guard, or fight for you, they do it with a dreamy smile on their face.
[Trait: Vampire Noble]

abilities.name: Nobody Came Back
abilities.info:
What it does: you are part of a floor of the dungeon; you can move unseen through any room, wall or object of it.

You slide through the walls of the floor the way blood moves through a body, into a chest, out of a door, along the ceiling, through the floor, and you can be anywhere in it, behind anyone, and nobody ever knows which part of the room is you.
[Trait: Mimic King]

abilities.name: Northern Lights
abilities.info:
What it does: you light up the night sky; allies under it can see in the dark, and foes are dazzled and distracted.

You open your wings wide and the colours pour off them and up into the sky, rippling, curtaining, and the whole night is lit up in swaying light, and your friends can see by it, and your foes can't stop staring up at it with their mouths open.
[Trait: Pixie Aurora]

abilities.name: Not a Scratch
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns attacks on you almost always miss as you slip and twist away; the one that misses you is left open.

They swing and you're not there, you lean, you turn, you step half a pace, and every hit sails past close enough to stir your fur, and each time it does they're left reaching and off balance, and that's when you smile.
[Trait: Catfolk Swordmaster]

abilities.name: Nothing Is Real
abilities.info:
What it does: you make a whole place false; walls, doors, floors and treasure around foes are you, and you turn on them.

Nothing in the room is what it seems, and they don't find that out until you decide, and then the floor bites, and the door eats an arm, and the chest crawls toward them on legs, and the walls have eyes and the torches have mouths, and every single thing in the place they thought was safe turns out to have been you all along.
[Trait: Mimic King]

abilities.name: Nothing Moves
abilities.info:
What it does: you hear about everything that happens under the town; you know who went where below the streets in the last day.

You crouch at the edge of a grate and listen, and the tunnels talk to you, the scrape of a boot, the splash of a body, the squeak of a rat that saw it all, and by the time you stand up you know exactly who's been moving under your streets and where they went.
[Trait: Ratfolk Under-King]

abilities.name: Numbing Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow and every foe near you goes numb; their limbs are weak and clumsy for a few turns.

You puff out your scaled and feathered chest and stretch your neck and crow, a horrible cracked sound, and it gets into their bones, their fingers tingling, their arms going dead and floppy, their legs folding under them, until they're fumbling at their gear with hands that won't close.
[Trait: Basilisk-Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Numbing Peck
abilities.info:
A peck that numbs a limb.
[Trait: Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Numbing Rake
abilities.info:
What it does: you rake a foe with filthy claws; the limb you open goes numb and useless for a few turns as the wound festers.

You walk with your head lolling from side to side as you giggle, your hand dragging through the muck and the mud as you cleave at their body, and before they know it they can't use that limb, infected and rotting as it goes numb and slack.
[Trait: Ghoul-Gnoll]

abilities.name: Oak Call
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the oaks and they fight for you, dropping acorns like stones and swinging their branches at your foes.

You grunt up at the canopy, and the oak wood grunts back, a creaking groan running through every trunk, then the acorns start coming down, not falling but pelting, hard as sling stones, bruising and cracking skulls, while the low branches swing down and sweep the legs out from under anyone running for the trees.
[Trait: Boarfolk Oak-Mother]

abilities.name: Oasis Toll
abilities.info:
What it does: every caravan and traveller in the desert pays you; you get the best of any trade in the dry lands.

You don't even have to be there, the caravan masters set aside your share before they ever reach your water, and when you do turn up at a trade they fall over themselves to give you the best terms in the whole desert, smiling, sweating.
[Trait: Lamia Queen]

abilities.name: Object Mimic
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the shape and look of an object; you pass as it until you move or are touched.

You slide into the corner and go still, and your skin changes, hardening, colouring, grain spreading over you, corners forming, until you're a small wooden chest with iron bands and a brass lock sitting in the corner of the room, so perfect even the rats walk past.
[Trait: Mimic Slime]

abilities.name: Object Shape
abilities.info:
What it does: go still enough to pass for furniture, a crate or a lump of rock; while you don't move no one takes you for a creature.

You fold in on yourself, legs tucking, edges squaring off, your skin going dull and grained and flat, and you settle into the corner with all the others like you've been there for years gathering dust, and they walk past, and one of them sits down on you, and you wait.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Object Shape]

abilities.name: Off the Cliff
abilities.info:
What it does: you order one reckless charge; your allies throw themselves at the foe without fear, hitting very hard but taking more damage for a turn.

You point at the biggest, nastiest thing in the fight and roar one word, and the warband doesn't think, doesn't hesitate, doesn't care, they just go, all of them at once, screaming, straight into it like it's the only thing they ever wanted to do.
[Trait: Orc Warchief]

abilities.name: Offering Stones
abilities.info:
What it does: at a place where the forest tribes have left offerings, you learn what they pray for and what they fear, and they treat you as sacred.

You stop at the stones where they've left their gifts and sniff each one, the bread, the bone, the knotted cord, and every one tells you a story, what they hoped for and what they're afraid of, and when they come back and see you there they kneel.
[Trait: Moon Wolf]

abilities.name: Offerings at the Prow
abilities.info:
What it does: sailors pay you for good weather; you get the best of any trade on the coast or the water.

They leave you offerings at the prow and they bring you the best of everything when they put in, because they know what happens to the ships whose captains forget to pay the storm-queen, and you take your share with a smile and a breeze.
[Trait: Sylph Storm-Queen]

abilities.name: Offerings of Rot
abilities.info:
What it does: your ratfolk worshippers come with offerings; a horde of ratfolk fights for you for the rest of the fight.

You stir in your cavern and the chanting starts somewhere in the dark, and then they come, ratfolk, hundreds of them, carrying their offerings of rot up to you, and when you look at your foes they drop their offerings and go for them instead.
[Trait: Fungus Rat Queen]

abilities.name: Ogre Slam
abilities.info:
Bring the whole bulk down on a foe or a wall; staggers and breaks.
[Trait: Soul of the Ogre]

abilities.name: Ogre's Gut
abilities.info:
What it does: eat something no one else could keep down, rotten, raw or still moving, and recover a little health and strength from it instead of getting sick.

No sniffing it, no checking it, in it goes and you crunch, bones and gristle and whatever was crawling on it, your jaw grinding away while the rest of the party turns away gagging, and down in your huge gut it all turns to heat and the heat spreads out into your arms and you feel better than you have all day.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Ogre's Gut]

abilities.name: Old Friend Price
abilities.info:
What it does: a trader you have dealt with fairly before gives you their best terms and holds goods back for you.

They see you coming across the market and their face splits into a grin and they wave you round the back of the stall where they keep the good stuff, and you both haggle loud for the look of it while they quietly hand you the best they've got.
[Trait: Trained Barter V]

abilities.name: Old Memory
abilities.info:
What it does: you remember what happened in this place long ago, events, people and secrets the land witnessed.

You stand very still and let your roots sink into the ground, and the moss on your beard stirs though there's no wind, and the place starts telling you its story, a battle fought here three hundred years ago, a treasure buried under that stone, a traveller who walked this path last spring and never came back out, all of it rising up slow and green through your roots.
[Trait: Elder Treant]

abilities.name: Old Road Ghosts
abilities.info:
What it does: on a dark night you ask the ghosts of the old roads what they saw; they tell you who passed and what happened there.

You walk the old road on the dark of the moon and they come out to walk beside you, the ones who died on it, and you ask, and they tell you, slow and sad, who came this way and what they did, every one of them a witness.
[Trait: Dead Moon Fox]

abilities.name: Old Stories
abilities.info:
What it does: remember a story about this place or creature: it hints at a danger, a treasure or a way through.

Something about it stirs a story you were told by the fire when you were small, and you start telling it out loud without meaning to, and halfway through you all go quiet because you're standing in the middle of it and it's true.
[Trait: Trained Lore I]

abilities.name: Old Stories Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge, and every boarfolk who's heard the stories charges with you; your allies hit with you for one turn as one.

You squeal and lower your head and every boarfolk who ever heard the story of the hill you split drops their head with you, and when you go they all go, and the charge hits the line all at once like a falling hill.
[Trait: Boar King]

abilities.name: Older Than Trees
abilities.info:
What it does: you root yourself and the forest feeds you; for a few turns you heal a lot each turn but can't move.

You sink your claws into the ground and they go down like roots, and the whole forest pours its strength up into you, the sap, the earth, the old slow life of it, and your wounds close one after another while you stand there still as an oak.
[Trait: Forest Bear]

abilities.name: Omen of Death
abilities.info:
What it does: you mark one foe; their strength drains away a little more every turn until the mark is broken.

No attack comes, only a black shape sitting at the edge of the light, a black dog with burning eyes, and stare at one of them, and they see you, and they know what you are, and from then on they can feel themselves fading, their hands weaker, their breath shorter, their heart slower, every time they look up you're still sitting there, waiting.
[Trait: Grim Hound]

abilities.name: On Me
abilities.info:
What it does: your tribe or followers do one thing at once on your word, no arguing, even scared. Rolls command.

One bark and every head in camp snaps round, and whatever they were afraid of a breath ago they're running the way you pointed, because you said so and nobody wants to be the one who didn't.
[Trait: Pack Leader]

abilities.name: One Soldier
abilities.info:
What it does: your legion moves so tightly foes can't tell how many there are; they misjudge you and attack in the wrong place.

Your soldiers move so close and so together that from a distance they're one long shape, and the enemy can't count them, can't tell where the line ends, and throws everything at the wrong end of it while you hit the other.
[Trait: Antfolk War-Marshal]

abilities.name: One Swarm
abilities.info:
What it does: your allies move with you as one swarm for several turns: every one of them strikes at the right moment, covers each other and closes every gap.

You click your mandibles and a smell comes off you, sharp and sour, and every one of your allies catches it, and suddenly they all know exactly where to stand and when to move, pouring in from every side at once over a dropped crust, no gaps, no hesitation, every strike landing together, until whatever you all set on is just buried.
[Trait: Soul Gift: One Swarm]

abilities.name: Ooze
abilities.info:
You flow through a crack or around a blade.
[Trait: Slime]

abilities.name: Orange in the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: your glowing heads fool foes in the dark; they strike at the wrong head and leave themselves open.

Your heads glow in the dark and you move them, slow, weaving, crossing over and back, a dozen lights swaying, and they can't tell which one's real, and when they swing at one there's another right behind them with its jaws already open.
[Trait: Volcanic Hydra]

abilities.name: Orange Sky
abilities.info:
What it does: your burning pack runs with you; a pack of hellhounds fights for you for the rest of the fight.

You howl and the sky glows orange behind you and they come, your pack, hounds of fire running across the land toward you, and they fall in beside you and go where you go and bite what you bite.
[Trait: Hellhound Huntmaster]

abilities.name: Orc Cleave
abilities.info:
A brutal two-handed blow that can carry through to a second foe.
[Trait: Soul of the Orc]

abilities.name: Orc Roar
abilities.info:
A war-roar that steadies allies and shakes the weak.
[Trait: Orc]

abilities.name: Orders Nobody Else Can Give
abilities.info:
What it does: the golems of the dungeon follow you; nearby constructs and made things obey your orders for the rest of the fight.

You speak in the rune-tongue they were made with, the one their makers lost, and every made thing in earshot turns its head to you, every golem, every construct, every thing of stone and iron, waiting for the order only you can give.
[Trait: Rune King]

abilities.name: Ore Sense
abilities.info:
Smell ore in rock; the next build or instinct action to find metal is stronger.
[Trait: The Hive: Guest]

abilities.name: Others Scatter
abilities.info:
What it does: other sea creatures fear you; sharks and sea beasts won't fight you, and weaker ones flee your waters.

You rise and the other sharks scatter, the beasts of the deep turn tail, the whole sea emptying around you in a widening ring, because every hunter in the water knows what the oldest one does to anything that gets in its way.
[Trait: Abyssal Megalodon]

abilities.name: Out of the Way
abilities.info:
What it does: every flying creature makes way for you; for a day you and your allies travel through the sky freely, and nothing in the air attacks you.

You take to the sky and the sky clears for you, the birds peeling off, the harpies diving for their cliffs, the other wyverns lowering their heads, and you fly wherever you like with nothing in the whole sky daring to come close.
[Trait: Wyvern Sky-King]

abilities.name: Oven Air
abilities.info:
What it does: the air around you becomes an oven; foes close to you are burned a little every turn for a few turns.

The air around you ripples and goes hot, then hotter, then like the inside of an oven, and everyone standing close sweats, then cooks, their skin going red and tight, and they have to back off or burn.
[Trait: Infernal Scorpid]

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns all your power moves hit much harder, but each one costs you a little health.

You open yourself up wider than is safe and it floods out of you, too much, too fast, burning you on the way out, and everything you throw lands like a hammer.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke V]

abilities.name: Overgrowth
abilities.info:
What it does: you make a forest grow over a place in minutes; paths vanish, walls are pulled down and foes are tangled and slowed.

You walk among them and every footstep blooms, shoots bursting up out of the dirt, saplings stretching into trees while they watch, ivy pouring up walls and pulling them apart stone by stone, until the road they came down is a forest and the camp they built is buried under green and they're standing there tangled to the waist in it.
[Trait: Grove Mother]

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.info:
What it does: pour lightning into one foe until it overloads: heavy damage, and the foe is stunned for two turns.
You grab hold of them and don't let go, and you pour it in, more and more, their whole body lit up and jerking, the smell of scorching hair, until something in them gives with a pop and they drop smoking.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Overload]

abilities.name: Pack Call
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the wolves you ride with; they come running and fight beside you for the rest of the battle.

You put two fingers in your mouth and whistle a long rising note that the wolves of the tribe know from their first day out of the den, and from out of the hills they come running, big shaggy war-wolves with scarred muzzles and yellow eyes, and they fall in around you snarling, waiting for their rider to tell them whose throat to rip out.
[Trait: Wolf Rider]

abilities.name: Pack Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: a howl that calls your allies to you; for a few turns everyone who heard it moves and strikes together as one pack, flanking and covering each other.

You lift your muzzle to the sky and howl, long and rising and cold, and it rolls out over everything and the others answer it without thinking, turning toward you, falling in at your sides, and after that nobody has to say a word, one goes low when you go high, one cuts left when you feint right, every one of you moving with the same breath, one big animal with too many teeth.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Pack Howl]

abilities.name: Pack Laugh
abilities.info:
Laugh with the pack until the prey panics; the next fight action against a frightened foe hits harder.
[Trait: The Laughing Pack: Hanger-On]

abilities.name: Pack Run
abilities.info:
What it does: run prey down without tiring for hours, herding it where you want; a foe that flees you can't get away and arrives wherever you drove it worn out.

You go down on all fours and lope after them easy and loose, tongue lolling, no hurry at all, and every time they look back you're there, a little closer, laughing, cutting off the way they wanted to go so they veer the way you wanted them to, mile after mile until their legs give and their chests heave and they stumble out right where the rest of the pack is already waiting.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Pack Run]

abilities.name: Pack Snarl
abilities.info:
What it does: you snarl and the pack attacks; your hound allies strike at your target together and harder this turn.

You drop your head and snarl, a low grinding snarl, smoke curling from your jaws, and every hound in the pack knows that sound, and they're moving before it ends, a rush of black bodies and burning eyes all coming at the one you're staring at.
[Trait: Hellhound Alpha]

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.info:
What it does: you direct your allies' fight; each strikes harder against a foe another ally is already engaging this turn.

You don't even join in, you stand back on the rise with your ears flicking, a jerk of your chin here, a short bark there, and the pack moves as one, one hamstrings, one goes for the throat, one cuts off the retreat, and the fight plays out exactly the way you saw it before it started, right down to which of them falls first.
[Trait: Wolfkin Packlord]

abilities.name: Painful to Look At
abilities.info:
What it does: you shine so bright foes can't look straight at you; for a few turns attacks on you miss far more.

You turn your light up until you're a little sun hanging in the air, too bright to look at, and they try, squinting, shading their eyes, swinging at the glare, and they can't see where you are inside it.
[Trait: Pixie Sun-Sprite]

abilities.name: Pale and Dry
abilities.info:
What it does: you drink one foe dry; a weaker foe is left lifeless and pale, a stronger one is badly drained and you heal a lot.

You take hold of them and drink, and keep drinking, long after they've stopped struggling, until there's nothing left in them, pale, dry, light as paper, and you drop what's left and lick your lips and turn around for another.
[Trait: Crimson Archfiend]

abilities.name: Pale Crops
abilities.info:
What it does: you pass over a place and drain the life out of it; every foe there weakens and you heal.

You drift over the field and the sun dims, and everything under you goes pale and limp, the crops, the grass, whoever's caught under you, their colour draining out of them and into you while they stagger and sag.
[Trait: Eclipse Wraith]

abilities.name: Panic in the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: pick off foes unseen until fear breaks them: for a few turns foes near you are frightened, fight badly and may flee.

You take one and it's gone, just gone, a gurgle in the dark and nothing, and then another, and the rest of them start shouting each other's names and backing into each other with their eyes huge, waiting to be next.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VI]

abilities.name: Paralysing Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite a foe and the muscle around the bite locks stiff, holding them in place for a turn or two.

You come in low and slow with the corpse-hyenas fanning out around you, jaws hanging open and dripping, then snap forward and sink your teeth in, and the muscle round the bite locks up hard as wood, the stiffness spreading through them until they're standing there frozen and wide-eyed while the hyenas close in.
[Trait: Ghoul Hyena-Lord]

abilities.name: Paralysing Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: your claw scratch locks a foe's muscles: they are paralysed where they stand for a turn or two, then stiff and slow after.

Your nails are long and black and filthy and you rake them across whatever you can reach, just a scratch, nothing, and then their arm stops, and their leg stops, and their face stops halfway into a snarl, frozen, eyes rolling in a body that won't answer them anymore, while you lick your nails and take your time choosing where to start.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Paralysing Claw]

abilities.name: Part of Me
abilities.info:
What it does: anything that falls in your cave becomes yours; one fallen foe rises as part of your body and fights for you.

One of them falls and you flow over it, and it doesn't come apart the way the others do, it softens and swells and stands up again, grey and wet and full of you, and it turns round and goes for its own friends with your hunger.
[Trait: Ooze-Fungus Mother]

abilities.name: Peacemaker
abilities.info:
What it does: talk two sides out of a fight that's about to start: they back down and agree to talk.

You walk right into the middle of it with your hands held up high and start talking, to both of them at once, and you don't stop talking until both sides have lowered their claws and are listening to you instead.
[Trait: Trained Talk VII]

abilities.name: Peak Tyrant
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike out of the sun so foes never see you coming; your first strike lands hard and they're knocked down.

Nothing in the high country flies in daylight while you hunt, and the ones on the ground learn why when they look up into nothing but sun, blinding white, and then the sun gets a shadow in it, and the shadow gets bigger, and they're still squinting when your talons hit them.
[Trait: Wyvern Sky-Tyrant]

abilities.name: Perch Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn one foe to stone from your perch.

They're looking for you, sweeping the high places with their eyes, and they find you, and that's the end of it, because the moment their eyes meet yours they feel it slam down through them, stone from the eyes outward, their scream catching in a throat that's turning to granite, and they join the garden below your perch.
[Trait: Petrifying Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Perfect Cut
abilities.info:
What it does: you make one perfect strike that nothing can block or turn aside.

You close your eyes and breathe out, the world going quiet around you, rain hanging in the air, a leaf frozen halfway to the ground, and you open them and move just once, one clean stroke, and the leaf falls in two halves, and the rain behind them falls in two halves, and so does whatever they held up to stop it.
[Trait: Catfolk Grand Duelist]

abilities.name: Perfect Stillness
abilities.info:
What it does: you stop time around you for a breath; you act freely while everything else is frozen.

You let out one slow breath, and the world stops, rain hanging in the air in glittering beads, a leaf frozen mid-fall, a weapon stopped a finger's width from your face, and in that perfect silence you move, unhurried, through a world of statues, and then you breathe in and it all starts again.
[Trait: Mantid Elder]

abilities.name: Persuade
abilities.info:
What it does: convince one creature to do something they're unsure about.

You lay it out for them plain and simple so it's easy to see, every reason, every gain, every way it goes wrong if they don't, and you watch their face as they turn it over and come round to it one step at a time.
[Trait: Trained Talk IV]

abilities.name: Pestilence Censer
abilities.info:
What it does: you swing a chained censer of green plague smoke over every foe near you; whoever breathes it is sickened, weakened and confused for a few turns.

The sound comes first, a swing and jangle of chain echoing through the world, then the smell, they can't quite place it until it's too late, and the ground seems to writhe with smoke as the last of their minds split apart.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-Priest]

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn one foe to stone with a look.

They make the mistake of looking up, just once, just for a moment, and your eyes are waiting for theirs, and there's no slow creep, no time to scream, it happens in a single breath, a crack like ice forming on a pond and they're grey from head to foot, mouth still open in the middle of a word they'll never finish.
[Trait: Gorgon]

abilities.name: Petrifying Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow and every foe near you begins stiffening toward stone, slowing more each turn.

At dawn you climb up onto the highest rubble heap in the gallery and crow, and the call spills down over them, and they feel it in their skin, a crackling, a tightening, grey spreading over their faces and down their arms as they run, and the ones who are slowest end up running nowhere at all, frozen mid-stride, the crow still echoing in the stone around them.
[Trait: Stone Rooster]

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: lock eyes with one foe: their limbs stiffen toward stone, slowing them badly for several turns; held long enough a weak foe is frozen solid.

You find their eyes and you hold them, and they try to look away and they can't, and the grey starts at their fingertips and creeps up, their hands going stiff and heavy, and they're screaming now, trying to shake it off, slapping at their own arms with hands that won't bend anymore while it climbs up their neck and the scream goes thin and stops at the throat, and their eyes are still moving.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Petrifying Gaze]

abilities.name: Phantom
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you move through a fight like a ghost: you are almost impossible to hit, and every hit you land from the shadows lands hard.

You stop being a thing that stands in places, you're here, you're not, you're behind them, you're gone, your shape only ever caught as a flicker at the corner of their eye, and every flicker leaves somebody bleeding.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VIII]

abilities.name: Phantom Run
abilities.info:
What it does: you run through walls, doors and foes as if they weren't there.

Your body goes thin and dark and blue-eyed and you just run, straight at the wall, and through it, a cold ripple passing through the stone, and through the next one, and the one after, and the ones you're hunting hear your claws on the floor behind a wall that should've stopped you.
[Trait: Ghost Hound]

abilities.name: Phase Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike through armour as if it wasn't there; one foe is hurt and their armour doesn't help.

You drift up behind them, cold coming off you, and you reach out, and your hand passes straight through their plate and their ribs without a mark, and closes on something inside, and they scream as the cold of the grave squeezes their heart.
[Trait: Wraith Stalker]

abilities.name: Phoenix Heart
abilities.info:
What it does: once a day, when you would fall, you burst into flame instead and rise with a third of your health; foes close by are burned.
Your heart stops and for a moment nothing happens, and then it starts again with a roar, and fire comes pouring out of every wound you've got, and you stand up out of the middle of it whole again while the ones who thought they'd finished you dive away from the heat.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Phoenix Heart]

abilities.name: Pick It Up
abilities.info:
What it does: you lift something huge, a wagon, a boulder, a small building's beam, and swing it through a line of foes, hitting all of them.

You get your huge hands under it and stand up straight with it, the whole thing, and the ground groans, and you swing it round in a wide flat sweep and everything standing in its way is swatted aside like flies.
[Trait: Ogre Titan]

abilities.name: Pick the Fight
abilities.info:
What it does: you study a battle before it starts; for the whole fight your side knows where the enemy is weak and strikes there first.

You stand on the ridge a long time and watch them, the way they've set their lines, where the old ones stand and where the young ones bunch up, and then you tell your chiefs exactly where to hit, and when it starts, the enemy falls apart exactly where you said.
[Trait: Orc Warlord]

abilities.name: Pin Down
abilities.info:
What it does: throw at a foe's limb or into their path: they are pinned or tripped in place and can't move next turn.

You let fly low and fast at their feet, or their hand, or the ground just in front of them, and it lands where it pins, tangling, catching, tripping, and they're yanked to a stop mid step and go down hard while you go for the next one.
[Trait: Trained Strike V]

abilities.name: Pincer Grip
abilities.info:
You clamp a limb in a claw.
[Trait: Scorpid]

abilities.name: Pipe Tune
abilities.info:
What it does: a few played or sung notes settle one nervous listener down, or wind them up into a temper, whichever you want.

You put the tune to your lips, or just whistle it through your teeth, a few lazy notes that wander around the room, and the one you're playing for loosens up without noticing, shoulders dropping, a smile coming, or the other way, if you play it sharp and quick, their foot starts tapping and their jaw starts clenching and they're itching to pick a fight with somebody, anybody.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Pipe Tune]

abilities.name: Pit Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you open a pit of fire under one foe; they fall into it and burn unless they climb out.

You stamp one hoof and the ground under them cracks open, glowing, and then it isn't ground at all, it's a pit, a shaft of fire going down forever, and they drop into it with a wail that goes on and on, their hands clawing at the edge as it burns them.
[Trait: Pit Fiend]

abilities.name: Pixie Dazzle
abilities.info:
Burst of glittering light that blinds and confuses.
[Trait: Soul of the Pixie]

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.info:
What it does: a pinch of your dust makes one small thing float for a little while: a key, a stone, a cup, a small creature.

You blow a pinch of glittering dust off your palm and it settles on whatever you blew it at, and the thing just lifts up off the table and bobs there in the air, turning lazily, and you giggle and steer it across the room with one finger while everyone else stares at it.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Pixie Dust]

abilities.name: Pixie Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you flick sparks that catch fire on a foe; they burn for a turn or two.

Your wings catch fire at the edges and you rub your fingers together and flick, and sparks fly off them like from a flint, tiny glowing specks drifting onto their hair, their clothes, their packs, and wherever they land a little fire starts, and they're slapping themselves all over while you hover overhead laughing.
[Trait: Imp-Pixie]

abilities.name: Pixie Hex
abilities.info:
What it does: you lay a petty curse on one foe; their luck sours, they fumble and itch for a few turns.

You flutter in on red-tinged wings and tap them on the nose with one tiny finger and whisper something in a language that scratches at the ears, and from then on everything goes wrong for them, their nose itches, their gear slips, they stub every toe and bite their own tongue, and they can hear you snickering every time.
[Trait: Hob-Pixie]

abilities.name: Plague Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe and sicken them; they're weakened and sick for a few turns.

You bite them with your rat teeth and your mouth is full of everything you've ever eaten off a plague cart, and the bite turns black around the edges before it even bleeds, and the fever hits them by the end of the fight, shaking, sweating, sores bubbling up along their arm.
[Trait: Plague Ghoul]

abilities.name: Plague Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe out a green cloud of sickness; everyone in it is left coughing, weakened and sick for a few turns.

You pull back your filthy hood and smile with gums gone black and bleeding, then lean in and breathe, slow and long and warm, a green fog rolling out between your cracked lips that smells of sweat, sick and old fever, and the ones caught in it start coughing on the first breath, doubled over and spitting green by the third, sores rising on their necks while the cloud still hangs around them.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-Monk]

abilities.name: Plague Look
abilities.info:
What it does: you look at one foe and they fall sick; they weaken and cough for the rest of the fight.

You don't even need to breathe on them any more, you just look at them, a long wet look with your yellow eyes, and they feel it go in, the fever, the ache, the cough rising in their chest, and they back away from you already shivering.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-Lord]

abilities.name: Plague of Undeath
abilities.info:
What it does: you infect one foe; they sicken each turn, and if they die they rise as a ghoul on your side.

You bite them and the sickness goes in, and it's slow, and it's horrible, the fever and the sores and the black veins spreading out from the bite, and they can feel it changing them, the hunger coming on, and they beg the others to kill them before it finishes, and when it does they open their eyes and look at their friends and start to drool.
[Trait: Plague-Lord Ghoul]

abilities.name: Plague Touch
abilities.info:
What it does: touch one foe with a sickness that spreads: they are poisoned, and each turn it may jump to a foe beside them.
You lay your hand on them almost gently, and that's all it takes, the sickness goes in and grows, and when they stumble against their friend it goes into the friend too, and from the friend to the next.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Plague Touch]

abilities.name: Plague Wind
abilities.info:
What it does: you send a wind of sickness through a crowd; everyone it touches falls sick, weakened and coughing, and it spreads to those near them.

You look at them, that's all, and something passes out of your yellow eyes on a warm breeze nobody else can feel, and the crowd coughs, then retches, then claw at their own throats as their breath bubbles wet in their chests, shoving and trampling each other to get away from whoever is coughing beside them, screaming at their own families to keep back, while black blisters bloom on hands and necks and the first ones down lie twitching in the gutter.
[Trait: Ratfolk Plague-Lord]

abilities.name: Plains Stride
abilities.info:
What it does: cover open ground fast; long marches and runs don't tire you, and your party travels faster with you leading.

Your stride opens up and the ground starts going by under you in long easy pulls, hooves drumming the same steady beat hour after hour, your breath never changing, the wind combing back your hair, and the far ridge that was a day away is behind you before the sun has really moved.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Plains Stride]

abilities.name: Plains Sweep
abilities.info:
What it does: on open ground you lead your warband in one wide charge; every foe in its path is hit and scattered.

You throw your head back and howl and the warband breaks out of the long grass behind you in a line a mile wide, spotted backs and snapping jaws and that endless laughing sweeping over the plain, and whatever's standing in the open when it hits just goes under, trampled, torn and scattered.
[Trait: Gnoll Warmaster]

abilities.name: Play Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: drop as if beaten: foes stop attacking you and turn away until you choose to get up and strike.

You take the next hit and crumple, a groan, a twitch, then nothing, eyes half open and tongue out, and they kick you once and lose interest and turn their backs on you, and you lie there counting until you're ready.
[Trait: Trained Trick II]

abilities.name: Plucked String
abilities.info:
What it does: you feel every step on your silk; anywhere your webs reach, you know who's on them and where.

You lay one claw on the main line and close your eyes, and the whole city hums up into you through it, every footstep, every weight, the trader by the gate, the thief on the third bridge, the stranger who's just put a foot on the edge.
[Trait: Arachne Loom-Queen]

abilities.name: Pocket Bomb
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a homemade bomb from one of your pockets; it bursts on a group of foes for heavy damage and knocks them down.

Your claws go into one of the pockets and come out with something round and ticking and stinking of oil, and you light it off your own spark and lob it underhand, giggling, and it rolls to a stop at their feet and they look down at it and then it goes off.
[Trait: Kobold Engineer]

abilities.name: Poison Spit
abilities.info:
What it does: spit poison into one foe's eyes at range: they are blinded for two turns and poisoned.
You work your mouth and spit it, a quick hard stream across the gap straight into their face, and they scream and claw at their eyes as it burns and blinds and soaks in.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Poison Spit]

abilities.name: Poison Waters
abilities.info:
What it does: you poison the water around you; every foe in it or drinking from it is badly poisoned.

You sink down into the pool and let your venom go, and it spreads out from you in an oily rainbow sheen, and the fish come up first, belly up and twitching, then the frogs, then the birds that drink, and the ones wading toward you feel their legs start to burn and itch and go numb, and then their throats tighten and their lips go blue as they try to scramble back to the bank.
[Trait: Plague Hydra]

abilities.name: Poisoned Peak
abilities.info:
What it does: your nest's poison is your armour; for the rest of the fight poison can't touch you, and you heal from it instead.

You've lived so long in the poison that it's in you now, part of you, and when they try to poison you it goes down warm and good, and every drop of venom anyone throws at you only makes you stronger.
[Trait: Wyvern Death-Queen]

abilities.name: Pool of Dark
abilities.info:
You deepen the shadows around you.
[Trait: Shade]

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.info:
What it does: leap on one foe from a distance and land on them: a hard hit that knocks them down.

You gather yourself up low with your back legs bunched and then let it all go in one long leap, hitting them at the top of their chest and riding them down to the ground.
[Trait: Trained Hunt III]

abilities.name: Pounce and Rake
abilities.info:
What it does: spring from hiding onto a foe who hasn't seen you and rake with every claw; a surprised foe takes heavy damage and is left bleeding.

You're down low with your back end wiggling, eyes huge and black, so still you're not even breathing, and then you're just not there anymore, you're on them, all four sets of claws hooked in and raking at once, front and back, and you've kicked off them and landed somewhere else while they're still working out where the screaming is coming from.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Pounce and Rake]

abilities.name: Prank
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a trick that trips, blinds or embarrasses a foe; they lose their next action.

You zip in giggling, quick little hands flying, and it's done in a blink, bootlaces tied together, belt cut, a handful of pollen in the eyes, and they take one step and go face first into the mud with their trousers round their ankles while you shriek with laughter somewhere just out of reach.
[Trait: Pixie Prankster]

abilities.name: Prism Beam
abilities.info:
What it does: you fire a beam of refracted light; one foe is burned and blinded.

The torchlight in the room bends toward you and pours into your crystal body, gathering, brightening, every colour at once spinning inside you, and then it all comes out of your mouth in one beam, white and burning, and it punches through them and leaves them blinded with a smoking hole where the beam went in.
[Trait: Prism Worm]

abilities.name: Procession of Ghosts
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a procession of ghosts against your foes; the dead drain and terrify them for the rest of the fight.

On a dark-moon night you trot down the old road with your tails glowing, and behind you comes the procession, ghosts in their hundreds, pale and silent and swaying, the drowned and the hanged and the forgotten, and they drift into your enemies and through them, and every one they pass through goes white-haired and gibbering.
[Trait: Dead Moon Fox]

abilities.name: Pure Instinct
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight you fight like the oldest beast alive: you can't be surprised, you dodge more, and every hit finds a weak spot.

You let the thinking part of you go quiet and the old part take over, the part older than speech, and it fights the way the first monster fought, without a single wasted move.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VIII]

abilities.name: Put Them Down
abilities.info:
What it does: one heavy blow that knocks a foe off their feet, and they lose their next action getting up. Rolls fight.

You stop dodging and plant your feet, take whatever they've got on the shoulder, then put everything into one swing that lifts them clean off the ground and drops them flat, and they're still looking for their legs when you step over them.
[Trait: Brute]

abilities.name: Pyre
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe you can see burns from the inside, taking heavy fire damage and burning hard for three turns; if it dies burning, the fire leaps to the nearest foe.
You only have to look at it now, a crackle starts deep in its chest like dry kindling catching, its eyes go bright from the inside, smoke rolls out of its mouth before the scream does, and when it drops the fire doesn't go out, it climbs off the body and goes looking for the next one, pure fire, hungry and alive.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Pyre]

abilities.name: Pyre Body
abilities.info:
What it does: you burst into flames; anyone near you or striking you is badly burned for a few turns.

You shake yourself out and your fur goes up all at once with a whump, and you're a dog made of fire, roaring and crackling, and the ones close to you stagger back with their faces blistering, and the fool who swings at you finds their arm on fire.
[Trait: Hellhound Pyre]

abilities.name: Python Crush
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush one foe in your coils until something breaks; they're badly hurt and held.

Your tail is as long as a hall and every foot of it is muscle, and once it's wrapped around them there's nothing in the world that can unwind it, and you tighten, and keep tightening, and they feel their ribs bend inward and their spine creak and their breath squeeze out of them in a thin whistle, until the first bone goes with a crack you can feel through your scales.
[Trait: Lamia Python]

abilities.name: Quake
abilities.info:
What it does: you shake the ground until it splits; foes nearby are thrown down and some fall into the cracks.

You lift your great stone and gold body up off the ground and drop it, and the mountain rocks around you, the ground jolting and heaving and splitting open in long black cracks that race outward from your belly, and they're flung down, and the unlucky ones go sliding and clawing into the gaps as they open and grind shut again.
[Trait: Earth Dragon]

abilities.name: Queen's Voice
abilities.info:
Speak with the queen's voice; every antfolk who hears it stops what it's doing and listens.
[Trait: The Hive: Queen's Voice]

abilities.name: Questions
abilities.info:
What it does: you ask the runes in you a question; they tell you how one magic, device or rune works and what it was made to do.

You look at it and the runes inside you start working on it, reading it, turning it over, and you ask it questions your makers never meant you to ask, and it answers, every rune of it, what it does and who made it and why.
[Trait: Arcane Golem]

abilities.name: Quick Burrow
abilities.info:
You scrape a hollow fast enough to duck into.
[Trait: Kobold]

abilities.name: Quick Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: the lightning in you speeds you up for three turns: you move and act first, and cover twice the ground.
You let a little of it into your legs and it fizzes up through you and suddenly everything's too slow, and you're moving in jerks and bursts, here, there, across the ground before they've turned their heads.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Quick Charge]

abilities.name: Quick Fix
abilities.info:
What it does: patch up one broken thing, a strap, a wall, a door, a pot, well enough to work for a while.

You grab whatever's closest, a strip of hide, a twist of root, a fistful of mud and grit, and you wrap and bind and pack it round the break with quick hard hands, and it's ugly as anything and it holds, for now.
[Trait: Trained Build I]

abilities.name: Quick Jab
abilities.info:
What it does: a fast hit that lands before a foe can react; it can be thrown again on the next turn.

You flick out and back in the blink of an eye, a hit so fast they only know it happened from the sting, and you're already bouncing on your feet looking for where the next one goes.
[Trait: Trained Strike I]

abilities.name: Quick Lie
abilities.info:
What it does: tell a simple lie well: one creature believes it, if it isn't too hard to swallow.

It comes out of you smooth and easy, no pause, no flicker, no look away, and you even add a little bit of boring detail on the end to make it sit right, and they nod along to it like it's the most obvious thing in the world.
[Trait: Trained Talk I]

abilities.name: Quiet Gravediggers
abilities.info:
What it does: you hear any death that happens near you and know how it happened; nothing dies near you without you knowing.

You stand very still in the soil and listen, and every death near you is a little scream you hear down in your roots, a fall, a cut, a poisoning, and you know each one, where and how and who, before anyone else has found the body.
[Trait: Mandrake Banshee-Root]

abilities.name: Rag Doll
abilities.info:
What it does: seize a foe and swing them into their own allies: both the one you hold and the ones you hit are hurt and knocked down.

You catch them by whatever's closest and swing, their body coming up off the ground and round in a wide arc with their arms and legs flopping, and you let them fly into the ones behind them and the whole lot of them go down in a tangle, groaning.
[Trait: Trained Fight VI]

abilities.name: Raid Rush
abilities.info:
Hit hard and fast and get out before anyone forms up; the next fight action in an ambush hits harder.
[Trait: The Red Fins: Fin]

abilities.name: Raiding Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing your flock into a frenzy; for a few turns your flying allies strike faster and harder.

You start the raiding song and the flock picks it up, every voice, louder and louder, wilder and wilder, and it gets into their wings and their claws, and they dive faster and hit harder with every verse.
[Trait: Siren Harpy-Queen]

abilities.name: Rain of Points
abilities.info:
What it does: throw everything you've got in one burst at a group: several foes are hit at once from range.

Your hands go in and out so fast it looks like you've got four of them, throwing, throwing, throwing, whatever you've got flying out in a spread that comes down on them all at once, and they scatter and duck and still don't get out of it.
[Trait: Trained Strike VII]

abilities.name: Rainbow Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: you scatter light across the area; foes see you in a dozen places at once and strike at the wrong one.

You turn your crystal body and the light breaks into rainbows that spill across the walls, and in every one of them there's you, a dozen of you, a hundred, and they swing at the reflections and miss the real one.
[Trait: Prism Worm]

abilities.name: Raise a Room
abilities.info:
What it does: dig or build a whole new room in a home in a fraction of the usual time.

You scratch the outline on the rock with a claw and start, and you don't stop, digging, hauling, stacking, packing, bracing, the others falling in beside you, and by nightfall there's a room where there was solid stone that morning.
[Trait: Trained Build V]

abilities.name: Raise Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a few skeletons from the dead nearby; they fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You slam your bone staff into the earth and the green fire in your eye sockets flares up, and the ground around you heaves, and bony hands push up out of the dirt, then skulls, then whole skeletons dragging themselves free with grave-dirt pouring off them, rattling to their feet and turning toward the living.
[Trait: Bone Necromancer]

abilities.name: Raise the Necropolis
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a whole cemetery to war; every grave nearby opens and its dead fight for you.

You lift your rusted crown off your skull and hold it up to the moon, and the necropolis answers, every tomb cracking open, every grave spitting up its dead, thousands upon thousands of them climbing out of the earth and the crypts and the walls, and the cemetery rises up as an army with you at its head.
[Trait: Bone King]

abilities.name: Raise Tower
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a tower of earth in a day; it gives allies height, shelter and a strong point to hold.

You start at dawn with the whole crew behind you, and by noon the base is laid, and by sunset there's a tower of hard-packed earth spiralling up out of the ground three storeys high with windows and ramps and a lookout on top, and you climb up to the top and look down at what you built.
[Trait: Antfolk Architect]

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.info:
What it does: call your allies together: those who were scattered, scared or down get up and come back to you, with a little health back.

You roar their names out over the noise of it all, each one, and they hear you, and the ones who were running slow down and turn around, and the ones who were down push themselves up off the ground, and they all come back to you bloody and breathing.
[Trait: Trained Command II]

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through the foes around you, striking every one you pass; each is knocked about and hurt.

You stop picking targets and just go, an orc wrecking ball tearing through the middle of them, swinging, shoulder-charging, headbutting, stamping on whatever goes down, bodies spinning away from you in every direction, and you don't stop to see who's still standing because there's always another one in front of you and the rampage only ends when there isn't.
[Trait: Orc Ravager]

abilities.name: Rampage Revel
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a revel so wild that everything around you gets trampled; foes nearby are knocked about and hurt.

You bellow for more wine and the party starts and nobody can stop it, a giant goat-legged reveller stamping and spinning and laughing with a barrel under each arm, tables flying, carts tipping, fences flattening, and anyone standing too close gets swept up in the dance and flung, kicked, trodden on and left groaning in the wreckage while the revel thunders on without them.
[Trait: Satyr Rampager]

abilities.name: Range Goes Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: you and your wyverns blot out the sky; for a few turns everything below is in shadow, frightened and fighting badly.

You take to the air and every nest on every peak takes to the air behind you, and the sky goes dark from end to end, and down below the people look up into the shadow of you all and the fight goes out of their legs.
[Trait: Wyvern King]

abilities.name: Raptor Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive out of the clouds onto prey; your strike lands hard and knocks them down.

You hunt the passes on wings of wind and feather, circling high where they can't see you, and when you dive the wind dives with you, a howling rush that hits them just before your talons do, slamming them flat into the snow.
[Trait: Storm Raptor Sylph]

abilities.name: Raptor Kick
abilities.info:
What it does: you kick one foe with stone-hard talons; they're badly hurt and knocked down.

You come in at a run and leap, both feet up, talons spread, and they're hard as stone and twice as heavy, and you kick, and the talons punch into their chest and hurl them back off their feet into the dirt.
[Trait: Cockatrice Raptor]

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.info:
What it does: you whistle up a swarm of rats that pours over a foe or a small area, biting and blinding for a few turns.

You put two claws in your mouth and whistle, shrill and sharp, and the walls squeak, a scrabbling in the drains, a rustling in the gutters, then they come pouring out of every crack and grate and rotten floorboard in a brown flood of fur and tails, up legs, under shirts, into collars, a thousand tiny teeth all biting at once while the one they're on slaps and screams and stamps and still can't find where they're coming from.
[Trait: Ratfolk Swarm-Chief]

abilities.name: Ratfolk Scurry
abilities.info:
Slip through gaps and away from a fight before anyone can close.
[Trait: Soul of the Ratfolk]

abilities.name: Rattle Back
abilities.info:
You shrug off a blow that should break bone.
[Trait: Skeleton]

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.info:
What it does: you tear into one foe with claws and teeth; they're badly hurt and bleeding.

You hit them starving and get into the meat, claws first, then teeth, no technique to it at all, just hunger, ripping and tearing and gulping, and they're shrieking and beating at your head while you chew.
[Trait: Ghoul Ravager]

abilities.name: Read the Beast
abilities.info:
What it does: read one creature's body: you know what it will do next, attack, flee, submit, and act first.

You watch its ears and the set of its weight and the twitch of its tail and the way its eyes keep flicking to your throat, and you know, the same way you know your own hunger, that it's about to lunge left, and you're already moving to meet it.
[Trait: Trained Instinct IV]

abilities.name: Read the Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: find and follow tracks on the ground: you can tell how many passed, how long ago and how fast.

You crouch down and look at the dirt and it's all there, a scuff, a bent stem, a heel deeper than the toe, a drop of something, and you know how many, how heavy, how hurried and which way they went.
[Trait: Trained Hunt I]

abilities.name: Read the Marks
abilities.info:
What it does: read old marks, carvings, scratches or signs left by other races: you learn what they meant.

You run your finger slow along the scratches in the stone and they stop being scratches and start being words, warning, no water past here, this way, turn back, written by somebody long dead who wanted whoever came next to live.
[Trait: Trained Lore II]

abilities.name: Read the Stars
abilities.info:
What it does: on a clear night you read the stars and learn where the next danger lies and which way to go.

You stand out in the dark grass and tip your head back, and the pale dapples on your coat begin to glow, first a few, then all of them, matching the stars above them, and the sky seems to lean down and turn for you, constellations sliding into new shapes, a broken horn in the east, a burning wheel to the south, and by the time the glow fades you know exactly which way the trouble's coming and how many nights it has left.
[Trait: Centaur Starseer]

abilities.name: Real Shape
abilities.info:
What it does: you shed a wounded shape for a fresh one; you heal a good share of your health and throw off one effect on you.

The shape they've been hurting slumps and splits and you slide out of it into another one, whole, unhurt, leaving the old one in a heap, and they stare at the wreck on the floor and then at you and realise they've barely scratched what you really are.
[Trait: Every-Shape Mimic]

abilities.name: Reap
abilities.info:
What it does: you reap a sliver of one foe's soul; they're badly weakened and you're strengthened.

You drift down over them with your cold hand outstretched and lay it on their chest, gently, almost kindly, and pull, and a pale glowing thread comes out of them through their skin, and they arch and shriek as you wind it round your fingers and feel the life in it soak into you.
[Trait: Wraith Reaper]

abilities.name: Reaping Shadow
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike every foe standing in one shadow at once.

They're bunched together in the shade of the wall, and the shade is you, and every one of them feels it at once, a scythe of cold cutting through all of them from below, out of their own shadows, and they fall together in a heap at the foot of the wall.
[Trait: Shade Reaper]

abilities.name: Reassemble
abilities.info:
What it does: when you are smashed down, pull your body back together and stand up again with some health back; once a fight.

You go down in pieces with bones scattered across the ground and they turn away, and then there's the rattle, the bits twitching and scraping toward each other, a rib, a hand, a jaw clicking back into place, all of it rolling and clacking together, and you stand up behind them with your skull turning round to face them and your teeth grinning.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Reassemble]

abilities.name: Reaver Fleet
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the reaver fleets; sharkfolk raiders come and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You bang your fist on the rail of your flagship three times and the horns start, ship to ship, down the coast, and out of the fog they come, reaver ship after reaver ship, decks crowded with snarling grey sharkfolk, a fleet so big the sea goes grey with sails, and every one of them is coming for whatever you point at.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Reaver-King]

abilities.name: Reaver Raid
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike one foe from the water and are gone before they can strike back.

A fin cuts through the water toward them, and they back away from the edge, and the fin goes under, and the water's flat, and they let out the breath they were holding, and that's when you come up out of the shallows right in front of them, all teeth, and bite, and you're back under the water before the shriek has left their throat.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Reaver]

abilities.name: Reaver's Grin
abilities.info:
What it does: you grin and show every tooth; one foe freezes with fear for a turn, and the rest think twice about coming near you.

You open your jaws slowly and show them all of it, row after row of teeth, yellow and old and stained, and you hold it there without blinking, and the one in front of you forgets how to move, and the ones behind him take a careful step back.
[Trait: Crocodile Lord]

abilities.name: Rebuild Myself
abilities.info:
What it does: you swap out a broken part of your own body for a spare you carry; you heal a good share of your health and shake off a crippling wound.

You sit down right there in the middle of it and unscrew the bent bit with your own claws, tutting, and dig the spare out of your pack and click it in and tighten it, and stand up again whirring, better than before, and the thing that broke you stares at you.
[Trait: Kobold Artificer]

abilities.name: Recruit
abilities.info:
What it does: talk a defeated or wandering monster into joining you for a while: weaker creatures follow you as allies.

You don't kill it, you crouch down where it can see your face and tell it what you can give it, food, a place, a side to be on, and it thinks about it and follows you home.
[Trait: Trained Command V]

abilities.name: Red Fin's Due
abilities.info:
Name a ship or a shore as the Fins' due; anyone who knows the Fins gives it up rather than fight.
[Trait: The Red Fins: Red Fin]

abilities.name: Red Mark
abilities.info:
What it does: you show the red mark on your belly; every foe who sees it is frightened for a few turns and keeps their distance.

You rear up slowly and let them see it, the red mark on the black, and the story that goes with it is in all their heads, and they back away from you without deciding to, wanting to be anywhere that isn't within reach of those fangs.
[Trait: Arachne Widow]

abilities.name: Red Moon Hunt
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the red moon and hunt beneath it; you and your wolves are stronger and faster, and foes are hunted under it for the rest of the fight.

You howl at the moon and it bleeds, red spreading across its face like blood soaking through a bandage, and its red light falls on the field, and every wolf on your side grows bigger and hungrier and faster in it, and the hunt begins, and nobody under that moon is anything but prey.
