[Trait: Moonblood King]

abilities.name: Red Pool
abilities.info:
What it does: you sink into your pool of darkness and vanish; you can strike from it at anyone who steps near and drag them in.

You sink down into the red dark until you're gone, just a pool on the floor, and you wait, and the first one who steps close you come up out of it and take by the ankle and pull, and they don't come back out.
[Trait: Blood Night Shade]

abilities.name: Red Water Nose
abilities.info:
Smell blood in the water a mile off; the next hunt action against a wounded foe is stronger.
[Trait: The Red Fins: Chum]

abilities.name: Red Weeds
abilities.info:
What it does: you heal from all blood spilled around you; for the rest of the fight you heal each turn while blood is flowing.

The blood that's spilled on the ground doesn't soak in, it creeps toward you, thin red lines across the dirt, and it runs up into you, and you feel it, warm and endless, closing every wound as long as the fight keeps bleeding.
[Trait: Crimson Vampire]

abilities.name: Red Wind
abilities.info:
What it does: you move as a red blur for a few turns; foes can't follow you, and every hit you land drinks a little blood.

You go so fast you stop being a shape and become a red wind, howling through them, and the only things they see are the flash of teeth and the spray of red, and every time you touch one of them you take a little of their blood with you.
[Trait: Vampire Blood-Reaver]

abilities.name: Reed Vanish
abilities.info:
What it does: you sink into water or reeds and vanish; foes lose track of you until you strike or move into the open.

You step backwards into the reeds and your scales ripple green and brown and yellow to match the stalks, and you sink down until only your eyes are above the water, then those go too, and the reeds sway and settle and there's nothing there but reeds and water, and they're left standing on the bank poking at the water with sticks.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Stalker]

abilities.name: Reef Fortress
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a fortress of rock and coral; allies sheltering on or behind you are protected for a few turns.

You settle down into the shallows and pull your legs in, and the reef on your back spreads, coral and rock and barnacles growing up and out into walls and towers, and your friends climb up into the shelter of it while the attacks break on your shell like surf.
[Trait: Living Reef Crab]

abilities.name: Refuse to Die
abilities.info:
What it does: when you would fall, you stay up and fight on for two more turns, then fall; once a day.

Your heart should have stopped and it doesn't, it hangs on, and your body keeps going on nothing but spite, every breath a choice, and you use every one of those breaths to take somebody with you.
[Trait: Trained Endure VII]

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.info:
What it does: you regrow lost heads and mend your wounds; cutting you only makes you stronger for the rest of the fight.

They cut one of your heads off and cheer, and the stump twitches and bubbles and bulges, and two new heads burst out of it slick and wet and hissing, snapping at the air, and the rest of your wounds close up too while they watch, and now there are six of you staring at them where there were five.
[Trait: Five-Headed Hydra]

abilities.name: Regrowing Heads
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight a crippling wound heals over, and a lost part grows back; a severed head or limb may regrow doubled, giving you an extra attack each turn.

They cut it clean off and cheer and then they watch the stump bubble and split and push out not one but two, wet and snapping and hungry, and you grin at them with twice as many mouths as before and they look down at what they're holding like it's suddenly the worst thing they've ever done.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Regrowing Heads]

abilities.name: Rewrite
abilities.info:
What it does: you rewrite a magic or a rune binding in front of you; a spell, ward or enchantment is undone or turned to your use.

You look at the spell coming at you and you can read it, every line of it, like writing on a page, and you reach out with one glowing finger and change a single stroke, and the spell stops in the air, turns round, and goes back the way it came.
[Trait: Rune King]

abilities.name: Rewrite Fate
abilities.info:
What it does: you twist fate; something that just happened goes the other way instead, once.

You sigh, bored of all of it, and reach out with one claw, and pluck at something in the air nobody else can see, a thread humming tight, and you give it one little tug, and the world shudders, and the blow that landed didn't, the bridge that broke held, and everyone around you has the strangest feeling they've just watched this moment twice.
[Trait: Catfolk Fate-Weaver]

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.info:
What it does: a thrown hit that bounces from one foe to another: two or three foes close together are hit in one throw.

You throw it hard at an angle off the first one's head and it doesn't stop there, it cracks off and spins into the next and off them into a third, and you've already caught your breath while all three are still clutching their skulls.
[Trait: Trained Strike V]

abilities.name: Ride of the Khan
abilities.info:
What it does: every rider of the plains rides with you in one long charge nothing can stand in front of; walls and fences in its path come down.

You put your heel to the earth and the call goes out across the grass sea from herd to herd like fire through dry stalks, and by dawn every rider of the plains is at your back, and you ride, every fence in your path going down under the hooves and every wall coming apart, posts torn out of the ground and stacked into bonfires along your trail, so anyone looking back across the plains can follow where the khan rode by the line of smoke it leaves from one horizon to the other.
[Trait: Centaur High Khan]

abilities.name: Ride the Bolt
abilities.info:
What it does: turn into lightning for a moment and strike to any spot you can see: every foe in your path takes lightning damage.
You're standing here and then there's a flash and a bang and you're standing over there, and between the two the air is scorched and smoking and everyone who was in the way is on the ground twitching.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Ride the Bolt]

abilities.name: Ring Law
abilities.info:
Call the moot law in a fight; herd folk stop, and anyone who keeps swinging is an outlaw to every herd.
[Trait: The Horn Moot: Ring Warden]

abilities.name: Rip the Soul
abilities.info:
What it does: on a solid hit you tear a sliver of soul out of a living target; it's weakened for the rest of the fight, slower, its blows lighter, its nerve shaken.

Your hand closes on them and keeps going, past the hide and the meat, fingers sinking into something cold that isn't flesh, and you pull, a wet tearing only you can hear as a pale thread of them comes out wriggling between your fingers and they sag, their next swing slow, their stare dull and frightened, staring at the piece of themselves you're holding.
[Trait: Soul Hook]

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.info:
What it does: when a foe attacks you, you turn the blow aside and strike back in the same motion.

You wait with your weight on your toes and that lazy half-smile on your face, tail flicking once, twice, and when they finally commit you're already moving, a twist of the hips, a flick of the wrist, their blow sliding past your ear close enough to stir the fur, and in the same breath your answer goes in under their guard, so quick and so neat they only know they've been cut when they see you bowing.
[Trait: Catfolk Duelist]

abilities.name: Rippling Air
abilities.info:
What it does: the heat coming off you hurts anything close; for a few turns foes near you are burned each turn and attacks on you miss more.

The heat rolls off you so thick the air ripples like water and they can't see you straight through it, and the closer they come the more it cooks them, and they swing at a wobbling shape and burn for it.
[Trait: Pit Fiend]

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.info:
What it does: you drag one foe out with a riptide; they're pulled away from the shore, held under and helpless until they break free.

You lower your hand into the water and pull, and the sea pulls with you, a riptide tearing out from under their feet, and it takes them, sweeping them off the beach and out into the deep, kicking and gasping, further and further from the shore with every breath.
[Trait: Merfolk Tide-Priest]

abilities.name: Rise Again
abilities.info:
What it does: once a day, after you fall, you get back up with a good share of your health back.

You're down and it's over and they've turned away, and then there's a sound behind them, a cough, a scrape, a deep ragged breath, and you're getting up, slow, pushing off the ground with blood running off you, and you're not done.
[Trait: Trained Endure VIII]

abilities.name: Ritual Knowledge
abilities.info:
What it does: perform a simple rite you know: a blessing, a ward, a burial, a curse lifted; it works for a while.

You do it the way it was always done, the words in the right order, the marks drawn true in ash or blood, the right things set at the four corners, and when the last word leaves your mouth something old and patient answers.
[Trait: Trained Lore VI]

abilities.name: River Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you burst up out of water and drag one foe under; they're hurt and held drowning until they break free.

The water's flat and brown and lazy, nothing on it but a log, and they're halfway across when the log opens its eyes and its jaws, and you take them by the middle with a crunch and roll, and the river goes flat and brown and lazy again, with a slick of red spreading slowly downstream and one boot turning in the current.
[Trait: Crocodile Lord]

abilities.name: River Tyrant
abilities.info:
What it does: you claim a river; nothing crosses it without your leave, and any foe who tries is attacked in the water.

You lie in the middle of the river with only your ridged back showing, as long as a longboat and twice as heavy, and the river belongs to you, every ford, every bridge, every fishing boat, and the ones who try to cross without paying get halfway before the water around them goes still and dark and then the river tyrant rises up and takes its toll.
[Trait: Crocodile King]

abilities.name: Rivers of Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn stone into a river of fire; it blocks a path, splits a fight or runs where you want it.

You coil your body through the rock and it melts behind you, and the molten stone runs out of your track in a glowing river, and you guide it where you want it, across the path, round the camp, between your foes and their way out.
[Trait: Magma Wyrm-King]

abilities.name: Robbed for Years
abilities.info:
What it does: you pretend to be a vault full of treasure; anyone who comes in to rob it is trapped inside you.

You make yourself into a little vault, the floor scattered with coins, a chest in the corner, and you wait, and they come creeping in rubbing their hands, and the door closes behind them, and the floor softens, and they realise.
[Trait: Vault Slime]

abilities.name: Roc's Shadow
abilities.info:
What it does: you darken a whole valley and strike from the storm; foes are blinded by the dark and struck from above for a few turns.

You spread wings of storm cloud that span the valley from ridge to ridge and the day goes dark under you, black as midnight at noon, and down in that dark they huddle and stare upward, and out of the storm come your talons, huge as trees, plucking them off the ground one at a time.
[Trait: Storm-Roc Sylph]

abilities.name: Rock Burrow
abilities.info:
What it does: you bore through stone faster than anything can run, to escape, pursue or come up under a foe.

You nose into the rock and the rock crumbles away from your face, your great claws scooping and your body pushing on behind, and you're through the wall and into the next passage before they've turned around, and through the floor and down into the next level before they've got their breath back.
[Trait: Basilisk Tunnel-King]

abilities.name: Rock Formation
abilities.info:
What it does: you lie still and pass for a rock formation; foes walk right up to you before you rise.

You tuck your legs in and settle into the sand and you're a rock, a big one, weathered and cracked, and the caravan camps in your shade and the travellers lean against you, right up until the rock stands up.
[Trait: Scorpid Sand-Titan]

abilities.name: Rockworm Burrow
abilities.info:
Bore through stone and burst out beneath a foe.
[Trait: Soul of the Rockworm]

abilities.name: Rolling Over
abilities.info:
What it does: you roll your enormous body over a group of foes; everyone under you is crushed and the ground shakes.

You drop down onto your side, slow, the way a mountain settles, and roll, and the whole of you goes over them like a landslide, and the ground shakes for a mile around, and when you get back up there's a long flat trail behind you.
[Trait: Mountain Bear]

abilities.name: Room Mimic
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a room and close on the foes inside; they're trapped, crushed and engulfed until they break out.

They walk into the room and it looks like every vault, stone walls, a heap of treasure, a heavy door, and they're halfway to the gold when the door shuts behind them on its own and the walls bead with sweat and the floor goes soft under their boots, and the ceiling starts coming down.
[Trait: Vault Slime]

abilities.name: Root Down
abilities.info:
You root in place; nothing moves you.
[Trait: Treant]

abilities.name: Root Drain
abilities.info:
What it does: you root into one foe and drain them; they weaken while you heal.

Your roots shoot out of the ground under their feet and wrap around their ankles, then push in, through boots and skin, and they feel it, a cold sucking in their legs, their strength draining down into the soil, their skin going pale and dry, while you swell fat and green on the battlefield.
[Trait: Grave Mandrake]

abilities.name: Root Lore
abilities.info:
You know a plant's use at a touch.
[Trait: Mandrake]

abilities.name: Root Out
abilities.info:
What it does: you sniff out whatever is hidden nearby: buried things, hiding foes, or a lie someone is telling you.

Your grizzled snout goes down into the dirt and starts working, snuffling and grunting, pushing through leaf litter and loose soil, and nothing stays buried long under that nose, not the coin pot, not the scout curled in the hollow log, and when you lift your head and look at whoever's talking to you, you can smell a lie on them plain as smoke.
[Trait: Boarfolk Rootwise]

abilities.name: Root Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: know on sight which plants heal and which ones kill, and how to use them: brew a simple remedy or a simple poison.

Your fingers brush along the leaves and you just know them, every one, this one settles a fever, that one stops a heart, this one makes you dream for a week, and you pick and crush and chew and mix without a pause, and what you hand over is going to cure somebody or kill them, whichever one you meant.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Root Sense]

abilities.name: Root Shriek
abilities.info:
What it does: you shriek and one foe staggers, dazed and deafened for a turn.

The mouth in your root-face splits wider than it should and you shriek, a raw squealing sound, and it punches into them, and they stagger back with their ears ringing and their eyes watering.
[Trait: Mandrake Shrieker]

abilities.name: Root Snare
abilities.info:
What it does: wake the roots under a group of foes: they are grabbed and held fast for several turns, and the roots squeeze harder the more they struggle.

The ground heaves under their feet and the roots come up out of it grabbing, wrapping round ankles, round knees, round waists, dragging them down, and every time one of them pulls or hacks at it the roots just tighten and the earth swallows a little more of them while the trees around you creak and groan.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Root Snare]

abilities.name: Root Wall
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a wall of roots out of the ground; it blocks a path, protects allies or traps foes.

You stamp one bare foot on the earth and the grove answers, roots tearing up out of the soil in a great twisting tangle, as thick as your arm, weaving themselves together into a living wall higher than your head, and anything on the other side can scratch and hack at it all day while it keeps on growing.
[Trait: Dryad Warden]

abilities.name: Rot Bloom
abilities.info:
What it does: rot blooms around you; wood, leather, food and flesh nearby soften and decay, weakening foes and their gear.

You squat and press your fungus-crusted hands into the floor and the rot spreads out from you in a ring, black mould racing across the boards, toadstools pushing up through the cracks, belts and straps rotting through and splitting, and the ones standing in it feel their skin itch and blister and go spongy under their clothes, the smell of a wet cellar rising off their own bodies.
[Trait: Rot Rat]

abilities.name: Rot Cloud
abilities.info:
What it does: a cloud of poison rolls out from you for three turns; every foe in it takes poison damage each turn, chokes and moves slower.
You open your mouth and it floods out of you, a thick cloud that hugs the ground and creeps outward, it gets into eyes and noses and throats, they cough, then they can't stop coughing, they're on their knees spitting and trying to crawl out of it while it follows them, patient, and you breathe your own poison in deep and easy.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Rot Cloud]

abilities.name: Rot Curse
abilities.info:
What it does: you curse one foe so their limbs go weak and heavy; every strike they make is slower than the last for a few turns.

You rattle your bone charms in their direction and spit out a name, theirs, and it settles on them, the muscle in their arms turning to wet bread, their legs heavy as logs, every swing slower than the last, every step a drag through mud, while green fire curls between your fingers and you watch them rot from the inside out.
[Trait: Goblin Hexer]

abilities.name: Rot Everything
abilities.info:
What it does: you rot everything around you, wood, stone, metal and flesh, ruining gear and walls and hurting every foe nearby.

You let go, that's all it takes, you stop holding the rot in and it pours out of you in every direction, stone walls going soft and black and sagging like rain-soaked sacks, iron flaking to rust in a breath, gear falling apart on their backs, and their flesh going grey and spongy as they scream and pull at skin that comes away in their hands, everything around you slumping into one heaving mound of mould, and the mound keeps growing.
[Trait: Fungus Rat Queen]

abilities.name: Rot Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you spray spores that rot armour and gear; foes' protection crumbles and they're easier to hurt for a few turns.

You cough out a cloud of brown spores that settles over them like fine dust, and their gear gives out, leather spotting with mould, wood swelling and crumbling, iron blooming orange with rust, straps snapping and plates falling away until they're standing there in rotten rags.
[Trait: Myconid Rot-Bringer]

abilities.name: Rotting Death
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread a plague that rots the living; everyone in an area sickens and rots each turn unless cured.

You walk in among them and the rot walks with you, and by morning it's in every house, people waking up with grey patches on their skin that go soft and black by noon, fingers dropping off, faces sliding, screaming as their bodies rot around them while they're still alive and still awake, and the crows settle all around and wait.
[Trait: Ghoul Rot-King]

abilities.name: Rotting Tribute
abilities.info:
What it does: every caravan pays you to cross; you get the best of any trade in the dunes, and tribute keeps arriving.

The heap at the mouth of your burrow gets bigger every week, and every caravan master who comes by adds to it without a word, and when you come out to trade they give you the best of everything, because they've all heard what happens to the ones who don't.
[Trait: Scorpid Death-King]

abilities.name: Rows Like an Audience
abilities.info:
What it does: the statues in your hall watch your foes; anyone fighting you in your hall is frightened and fights badly.

They come into your hall and the statues are standing in rows all around, all facing the middle like an audience, all of them grey and staring, and every one of your foes feels those stone eyes on them and their nerve cracks.
[Trait: Cockatrice Tyrant]

abilities.name: Ruin Coil
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap your coils round a building and crush it in; anyone inside is hurt and trapped in the rubble.

You pour yourself around the building, coil after coil after coil wrapping it from the cellar to the roof, and every window shows nothing but scales, and then you squeeze, and the walls buckle inward and the beams start snapping like kindling and the roof folds down on top of them in a roar of dust and breaking timber.
[Trait: Lamia Coil-Queen]

abilities.name: Rumour of Your Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: word that you might be watching spreads; foes fight with their eyes shut or half closed, and miss far more for the rest of the fight.

You don't even need to look, you just need them to believe you might, and the whisper goes through their ranks, she's here, she's watching, and they're fighting with their eyes screwed shut and their heads down, swinging at shadows.
[Trait: Gorgon Queen]

abilities.name: Run It Down
abilities.info:
What it does: chase one fleeing creature: you close the distance fast and it can't get away this turn.

You go after it the moment it turns tail, legs pumping, breathing easy, cutting the corners it has to take wide, closing the gap a stride at a time until you can hear it panting.
[Trait: Trained Hunt I]

abilities.name: Run It Ragged
abilities.info:
Chase prey until it drops; the next hunt action against something running is stronger.
[Trait: The Laughing Pack: Runner]

abilities.name: Run Them Down
abilities.info:
What it does: you chase a fleeing or wounded foe without tiring and drive them toward your allies; they can't break away from you this turn.

You don't have to catch them, you only have to keep them running, a laugh behind them every time they slow, footfalls in the grass off to the side whenever they try to turn, so they run exactly where you want until they come stumbling into your pack with their lungs on fire and nothing left to fight with.
[Trait: Gnoll Reaver]

abilities.name: Run Them Ragged
abilities.info:
What it does: your whole party moves as hunters for a day: they travel faster, find prey and tracks easily and are never lost.

You lead them out at a run and they pick it up from you without knowing how, the way to read the land, which way the prey will break, how to run all day and still have something left, and they eat well that night.
[Trait: Trained Hunt VIII]

abilities.name: Rune Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge with rune-driven force; whatever you hit is smashed aside and badly hurt.

The runes on your plates light up one after another from your tail to your head in a rippling blaze, and then you're moving, a cart-sized iron ant charging with the force of a thunderbolt behind it, and you hit them and they're gone, flung away limp.
[Trait: Rune Ant Colossus]

abilities.name: Rune Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike one foe with a rune-charged claw; they take heavy damage and are thrown back.

The runes on your claw blaze blue, one after another from the joint to the tip, humming louder and louder, and you swing it, and it lands with a crack like lightning on rock, and they're flung back across the sand in a spray of blue sparks.
[Trait: Rune Crab]

abilities.name: Rune Pulse
abilities.info:
What it does: you pulse a rune that staggers the foes near you for a turn.

The runes on your chest light up one after another, brighter and brighter, humming deep in their teeth, and then they pulse, a pulse of blue light rolling out from you with a deep booming thrum, and it hits everyone around you and knocks the breath out of them and sends them stumbling.
[Trait: Rune Golem]

abilities.name: Rune Script
abilities.info:
What it does: you write a rune that holds a door shut or binds a foe in place until it's broken.

You lift one finger and it glows, and you write in the air, a rune of holding, lines of blue fire hanging in front of you, and then you push it onto the door, or onto them, and it sticks, and whatever it's on stops, the door won't open, their legs won't move, and the rune pulses there smugly.
[Trait: Arcane Golem]

abilities.name: Rune Slam
abilities.info:
What it does: you slam one foe with a rune-charged blow; they take heavy damage and are thrown back.

The runes carved into your knuckles glow red, then orange, then white hot, smoke curling off your skin, and you wind up one huge arm and bring your fist down on them, and the runes go off on impact with a crack like lightning splitting a tree, flinging them across the room in a spray of sparks.
[Trait: Rune Ogre]

abilities.name: Rune Strength
abilities.info:
What it does: hit with crushing rune-driven strength: walls break, armour caves in, and a struck foe is thrown and badly hurt.

Every rune down your arm lights at once, one after the other in a rising line, the hum building up through you until your whole body is buzzing with it, and your fist comes down and the glow leaves the runes and goes into whatever you hit, and it caves in around your knuckles, stone, steel, bone, all the same.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Rune Strength]

abilities.name: Runes Blaze
abilities.info:
What it does: the runes carved into your body flare; foes close by are thrown back and blinded for a turn.

Every rune carved into your skin lights at once, line after line, until you're glowing from the inside like a forge, and then they all flash together and the light blasts out of you and throws everything close back off its feet with its eyes burning.
[Trait: Fortress Ogre]

abilities.name: Running Shot
abilities.info:
What it does: throw or shoot at full gallop and still hit where you aim; moving doesn't spoil your aim and lets you strike and get clear in the same turn.

You come in at a full run, the world bouncing and jolting around you, and somehow your upper half stays dead still, steady as a post, eyes locked on the one target, and you loose it as you thunder past and it lands exactly where you looked, and you're already wheeling away out of reach before they've finished falling.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Running Shot]

abilities.name: Sailors' Prayer
abilities.info:
What it does: sailors and travellers who pray to you are guided safely; a party or ship you bless travels fast and safe for a day.

They whisper your name at the prow before they set off, and you hear it, and you send the right wind to fill their sails, and they fly across the water like they're being carried, and every storm on the way turns aside to let them pass.
[Trait: Four Winds Sylph]

abilities.name: Salamander Blaze
abilities.info:
Wreathe the body in flame for a few moments.
[Trait: Soul of the Salamander]

abilities.name: Salvage
abilities.info:
What it does: you find something useful in any wreck, ruin or pile of junk.

You scuttle into the wreck with your eyes on stalks swivelling every which way, and you poke and pry and sift, flipping planks, cracking open chests, sorting the rubbish, and in no time you come back out sideways clacking happily with a rope, a good iron hook, three coins and a bottle of something that's probably still drinkable.
[Trait: Crabfolk Scavenger]

abilities.name: Sanctified Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: make the ground round you holy for three turns: allies on it heal each turn, and the dead and dark burn on it.
You kneel and press your hands to the ground and the light pours down into it and spreads out under everyone, and your allies feel their wounds ease while every dark thing that sets foot on it burns.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Sanctified Ground]

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.info:
What it does: holy light surrounds you and your allies for three turns; you all heal a little each turn, and undead and shadow-things that come into it burn.
You go still and the noise of the fight falls away, a low hum of many voices far off fills the air, the light spreads out from you over everyone you'd call your own, the cuts close and the bleeding stops, and the first dead thing that steps into it goes up in holy fire from the feet and howls.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Sanctuary]

abilities.name: Sand Bury
abilities.info:
What it does: you bury yourself in sand or loose earth; you're hidden until you strike, and your first strike lands hard.

You dig in with all eight legs and wriggle and in a few breaths you're gone under the dune with only your eyes poking up through the sand, and they walk right over the top of you, and the sand erupts around their ankles in a spray of grit and snapping claws.
[Trait: Scorpid Sand-Warden]

abilities.name: Sandstorm Burrow
abilities.info:
What it does: you burrow and raise a sand cloud; foes are blinded and you strike from beneath them.

You dive into the dune head first and the desert goes with you, sand exploding up into the air in a great choking cloud, and while they're coughing and squinting and spinning in circles you're moving under their feet, and the claws come up out of the sand to drag them down.
[Trait: Scorpid Dune-Lord]

abilities.name: Sapper's Hands
abilities.info:
What it does: dig at a frantic pace: drop a tunnel roof on whoever is chasing you, or punch a fresh passage straight through stone to get somewhere new.

Your claws are a blur and grit sprays out behind you, chip, chip, chip, the rock coming away in fistfuls, and you can hear them right behind you shouting and you don't look back because you already know which stone holds the roof up, one hard rake at it and you're through and the whole passage comes down at your heels in a roar of dust that buries the shouting along with everything else.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Sapper's Hands]

abilities.name: Satyr Song
abilities.info:
Play or sing a tune that sways a group's mood.
[Trait: Soul of the Satyr]

abilities.name: Say It Like You Mean It
abilities.info:
What it does: one lie, threat or plea lands as true, and the one hearing it acts on it for the rest of the scene. Rolls talk.

You hold their eye and don't blink, voice low and easy like you've said it a hundred times before, and somewhere behind their face you watch the doubt fold itself up and get put away.
[Trait: Smooth Talker]

abilities.name: Scar Speech
abilities.info:
What it does: you name a scar and tell how you got it; every goblin ally who hears it stops wavering and fights harder for a few turns.

You stab a thick finger at the long ugly one across your chest and start shouting the story of it, and it gets bigger every time you tell it, and by the end the warband's howling and banging on anything that makes a noise, and every one of them would die to have a scar like that.
[Trait: Goblin General]

abilities.name: Scent Lock
abilities.info:
You lock onto a scent and follow it anywhere.
[Trait: Wolfkin]

abilities.name: Scorpid Sting
abilities.info:
Strike with a venomous tail.
[Trait: Soul of the Scorpid]

abilities.name: Scrap-Craft
abilities.info:
What it does: turn whatever junk is lying around into one working snare, spike pit or crude stabbing point in moments; it breaks after a use or two.

Your hands are already moving before you've thought about it, picking through the rubbish, a bent nail, a strip of hide, a split bit of wood, twisting and knotting and jamming it all together with your teeth holding one end, and what comes out the other side is ugly and lopsided and it bites the first ankle that steps on it, which is all a goblin ever asked of anything.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Scrap-Craft]

abilities.name: Scrape Cover
abilities.info:
What it does: scrape out quick cover where you stand: for the fight you are harder to hit from range.

You drop to your knees and dig with both hands, fast, flinging dirt and stones up in front of you into a lip, and you're just ducking down behind it when the first thing thrown at you smacks into the mound and sprays you with grit instead.
[Trait: Trained Build I]

abilities.name: Screech
abilities.info:
What it does: a shriek that staggers and deafens everyone in front of you for a few turns; they can't hear orders and fight badly.

You gape your beak wide and what comes out is high and tearing and goes straight through the skull, and they clutch at their heads, and some fall to their knees with blood coming out of their ears, and when you stop they're still shouting at each other with their mouths moving and nothing coming out but the ringing.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Screech]

abilities.name: Scythe Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: your folded arms snap out in a slash too fast to see: a heavy hit that can't be dodged by a foe who didn't see you move.

Nothing moves and then everything has moved, your arms are out and back and folded again before the sound of it reaches anyone, and they're still standing there looking at you, puzzled, and then they look down at the long thin red line that's opening across them and keep opening.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Scythe Strike]

abilities.name: Sea Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through water at the head of your riders; foes in your path are run through and scattered.

You lower yourself along your war-eel's neck and kick, and it surges forward, and behind you the riders follow in a line, eels and merfolk and points all lowered together, and you come through the water in a flashing shoal of teeth, and the ones in front of you are run down and scattered in a cloud of bubbles and blood.
[Trait: Merfolk Sea-Knight]

abilities.name: Sea Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a storm over the water; ships and foes on it are battered, rocked and struck by lightning for a few turns.

You rise up out of the waves and raise both arms and sing a song with thunder in it, and out on the horizon the clouds pile up black and boiling, and the wind comes in howling, and the sea heaves up in great grey walls, and lightning cracks down on every mast in sight.
[Trait: Merfolk Storm-Caller]

abilities.name: Season Without Luck
abilities.info:
What it does: you curse a whole village or camp with bad luck for days; every check anyone there makes goes a little worse.

You fly round the village once at sunset sprinkling something nasty off your fingers and giggling, and the next day the milk curdles and the roof leaks and the hunters miss and the deals go sour, and it keeps going like that until you get bored.
[Trait: Imp-Pixie Hexqueen]

abilities.name: Second Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: a second bite snaps in right after the first: when you bite and hit, you get another attack straight away.

You bite and they jerk back from it, thinking that's it, and that's when the second set of jaws comes snapping out of nowhere, out of your shoulder, out of your neck, out of somewhere they swear wasn't there a moment ago, and closes on them right where they thought they were safe.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Second Bite]

abilities.name: Second Heart
abilities.info:
What it does: when you would go down, your second heart takes over; you stay on your feet a few breaths longer and shake off some of the damage.

The first heart skips, slows and quits, black closing in from the edges of your sight, then the other one hits, a hard double thud deep under your ribs, then again, faster, and again, hot blood slamming back into your limbs as you get your hands under you and push up off the floor with both hearts pounding in your ears.
[Trait: Twin Heart]

abilities.name: Second Line
abilities.info:
What it does: when your allies fall back, call up more: a few nearby creatures loyal to you or your tribe join the fight.

You fill your chest and give the call, and from somewhere behind you they come, the ones you didn't know were there watching, out of the rocks, out of the dark, out of the long grass, running to stand at your back with their teeth showing.
[Trait: Trained Command VI]

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.info:
What it does: catch your breath mid fight: you recover a little health and shake off tiredness.

You step back and drag in a breath that goes all the way down, and another, your heart slowing, the shaking going out of your legs, and when you look up again you're ready to go another round.
[Trait: Trained Endure I]

abilities.name: Secret of the Deep
abilities.info:
What it does: know one deep secret about the Great Dungeon: a hidden way down, a sealed hall, what lies at the bottom.

You know the thing the dungeon doesn't want anybody to know, the hidden way down past the sealed hall and what's waiting at the bottom of it, and you tell them, quiet, and you wish you didn't have it in your head at all.
[Trait: Trained Lore VIII]

abilities.name: Seen from Miles Off
abilities.info:
What it does: your towering shape is a signal; allies who see you rally to you, and foes who see you lose their nerve.

You stand up to your full height over the treeline and they see you from miles away, and your own come running toward you, and the ones on the other side look up at the tower of wood walking toward them and start looking for somewhere to be.
[Trait: Treant Colossus]

abilities.name: Sell It Inland
abilities.info:
Find the buyer for stolen goods; the next barter action with plunder is stronger.
[Trait: The Red Fins: Biter]

abilities.name: Sense the Weak Spot
abilities.info:
What it does: find one foe's weakness at a glance: your next hits on it land harder.

Something old in you looks at it the way a predator looks at a herd, not at the teeth or the claws or the size of it but at the old wound, the stiff leg, the place where the hide is thin, and once your eyes find it they don't leave it.
[Trait: Trained Instinct III]

abilities.name: Sentinel Watch
abilities.info:
What it does: you see everything from a high perch; nothing in sight below you can move unseen.

You crouch up high with your stone wings folded and go still, the stillness of a thing carved there a hundred years ago, and you watch, and nothing moves below without your stone eyes following it, every thief, every shadow, every rat.
[Trait: Gargoyle Sentinel]

abilities.name: Serpent's Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: hold one person's stare: a weak or tired mind goes slow, unsure and easy to talk around for a short while.

You catch their eye and you don't let it go, your head swaying a little, side to side, slow, and your voice drops low and soft and close, and you watch their thoughts go thick and sluggish, their answers coming slower and slower, nodding along to things they'd never agree to, wondering why it all suddenly seems so reasonable.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Serpent's Gaze]

abilities.name: Set Like Stone
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few breaths your body locks hard as rock; blows barely hurt you, but you can't move or strike until it passes.

The soul in you sinks like a dropped rock and its weight spreads out through your limbs, skin greying, every joint locking with the crack of a quarry face settling, and anything that hits you now hits solid rock, and it's their bones that give.
[Trait: Stone Soul]

abilities.name: Shade Dark
abilities.info:
Swallow the light around you; foes fight blind.
[Trait: Soul of the Shade]

abilities.name: Shade Step
abilities.info:
What it does: once a turn you step into any shadow and out of another you can see, and your next hit after a step does extra shadow damage.
Your shadow moves a moment before you do, then you lean back into it and you're gone, cold dark closing over your face, and you come out of their shadow right behind them, close enough to hear them breathe, and they never felt you coming.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Shade Step]

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.info:
What it does: throw a bolt of shadow at one foe: shadow damage, and it drains a little of their strength into you.
You pull the dark into a tight knot between your hands and throw it, and it hits them in the chest and sinks in cold, and something of them drains back along the line into you.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Shadow Bolt]

abilities.name: Shadow Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike one foe with claws of shadow from the darkness; armour doesn't stop them.

You rise up out of the shadow under the table, a shape cut out of the dark with long black claws, and you rake them, and the claws go straight through their armour and leave cold black lines across their skin that burn like frostbite.
[Trait: Shade Stalker]

abilities.name: Shadow Cocoon
abilities.info:
What it does: you wrap one foe in living darkness; they're held, blinded and their strength drains away until they break free.

You open a hole in the shadow and the void pours out of it into your claws, and you wind it round them like silk, and the dark that wraps them isn't just dark, it's empty, it eats sound and warmth and light, and inside it they're screaming with no sound coming out and feeling their own body go cold and far away.
[Trait: Void Spinner]

abilities.name: Shadow Drain
abilities.info:
What it does: you drain one foe from the shadows; they weaken and grow cold while you grow stronger.

Their own shadow stretches out long behind them, and you're in it, and you reach up out of it and take hold of their ankles with cold hands, and drink, and they feel it go, the warmth draining out of their feet and their legs and up into their chest, their lips going blue, while their shadow gets darker and darker.
[Trait: Umbral Wraith]

abilities.name: Shadow Grab
abilities.info:
What it does: shadows reach out and grab one foe: they are held in place for a turn.
Your shadow stretches across the ground toward them, too long, the wrong shape, and when it reaches their shadow it grabs hold, and they look down to find they can't lift their feet.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Shadow Grab]

abilities.name: Shadow Kill
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike a foe who doesn't know you're there from the shadows; the strike lands with full force and you vanish again.

The candle in the room flickers and their shadow on the wall gets a second shadow behind it, and then the second shadow moves, and they don't turn around in time, and there's a cold, cold pain in their back, and when they finally turn there's nothing there but a candle flickering.
[Trait: Shade Assassin]

abilities.name: Shadow Meld
abilities.info:
What it does: you melt into shadow; you're hidden while you stay in darkness.

You drift into the dark corner and you're gone, the shadow taking you in like water swallowing ink, and all that's left are two little candle-flame eyes in the black, and then those blink out too, and they're standing in the room waving their torches around a shadow that's watching them.
[Trait: Shadow Wraith]

abilities.name: Shadow on the Peaks
abilities.info:
What it does: your shadow passing overhead terrifies everything below; weaker foes scatter and hide, and stronger ones look up instead of fighting.

You pass between them and the sun and your shadow slides over the field, huge, and everything in it stops and looks up, and the small ones bolt for the rocks screaming, and the big ones stand there frozen with their faces turned to the sky.
[Trait: Wyvern Sky-Tyrant]

abilities.name: Shadow Pounce
abilities.info:
What it does: you pounce out of the darkness onto a foe who never saw you; the first strike lands hard and they're knocked down.

They're holding the torch up high and turning in slow circles, and they never think to look up, and the last thing they see is the light catching two green eyes on the rafter right above their head, then you drop out of the dark in total silence, all claws and weight, and the torch goes rolling away and gutters out as you land on them.
[Trait: Nightstalker Cat]

abilities.name: Shadow Shapes
abilities.info:
What it does: you weave shadows into beasts that fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You reach into the darkness and pull, and the dark comes out in long black strands, and you twist them and knot them, and they take shape in your hands, a wolf of shadow, a spider of night, a hound with no face, and you set them down and they run at your enemies on silent feet.
[Trait: Shade Nightweaver]

abilities.name: Shadow Sip
abilities.info:
What it does: you drink from one foe through their own shadow; they weaken and bleed while you grow stronger.

You slide into their shadow where it stretches across the floor behind them, and you drink, and the blood starts coming out of them without any wound at all, beading on their skin and running down into the shadow at their feet, and they're going pale and weak while the shadow under them goes red.
[Trait: Blood Shade]

abilities.name: Shadow Slip
abilities.info:
What it does: you step into one shadow and out of another nearby, unseen in between.

Your ink-black fur seems to drink the light as you back into the corner, eyes shining like two lamps for one more moment, then they blink out and you're gone, the shadow where you stood suddenly just a shadow again, and over by the far wall another one stirs and stretches and has a cat in it, licking one paw and watching them search the wrong corner.
[Trait: Shadowcat]

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: step out of a shadow beside any foe close by and hit them before they can turn.

You go into one shadow and come out of another right beside them, and they never saw you cross the space in between because you didn't, and the hit's already landed while they're still facing the wrong way.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VI]

abilities.name: Shadow Under the Sea
abilities.info:
What it does: you pass under the surface unseen; nothing on the water knows where you are until you rise.

The sea goes quiet as your shadow passes under it, the fish gone, the birds gone, and up on top they feel the quiet but can't see you, and they look down into the water and see only dark, and wait, and wait, until you rise.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Megalodon]

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.info:
What it does: step into one shadow and out of another you can see: you vanish and reappear there in an instant.
You step back into the dark of the doorway and you're gone, and a moment later you step out of the shadow under the far wall, behind them, brushing the dark off your shoulders.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Shadow Walk]

abilities.name: Shadow Web
abilities.info:
What it does: you web one foe in strands of darkness; they're held and blinded until they break free.

You reach into the shadow at their feet and pull, and the darkness comes away in your claws like silk, and you throw it over them, strand after strand of black that wraps around their arms, their legs, their eyes, cold and clinging, and they can't see, can't move, can't even scream through the dark across their mouth.
[Trait: Umbral Spider]

abilities.name: Shadows Pull Away
abilities.info:
What it does: the living feel their shadows tug toward you; for a few turns foes near you weaken each turn and you heal.

You come close and their shadows pull away from them, toward you, stretching across the ground like they want to leave, and as they stretch something goes with them, and the living go cold and slow while you drink it in.
[Trait: Shade Reaper]

abilities.name: Shake It Off
abilities.info:
What it does: throw off one effect holding you: a daze, a slow, a fear, a numbness; it ends now.

You shake your head hard, like a dog coming out of water, and growl, and whatever's got hold of you, the fog in your head, the weight in your limbs, the cold in your gut, comes loose and falls away.
[Trait: Trained Endure III]

abilities.name: Shape the Power
abilities.info:
What it does: hold your power in a shape for a while: a wall, a bridge, a cage, a light; it lasts a few turns.

You pull it out of you and work it with your hands and it takes the shape you give it, a wall, a bridge, a cage, and holds there humming while you keep it fed.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke IV]

abilities.name: Shared Dream
abilities.info:
What it does: you learn what the colony has seen; anything any mushroom kin witnessed nearby is known to you.

You sit down in the middle of the mushroom ring and close your eyes, and the circle dreams together, and through countless caps in damp corners everywhere you see it all, who walked past the colony, what they carried, what they said, where they sleep, the colony's memory flowing into you like water into a cup.
[Trait: Myconid Circle-Keeper]

abilities.name: Sharkfolk Frenzy
abilities.info:
Rip into a bleeding foe with savage speed.
[Trait: Soul of the Sharkfolk]

abilities.name: Shell Bash
abilities.info:
What it does: you bash one foe with your shell; they're knocked back and down.

You turn sideways the way crabfolk do and come at them with your shell leading, and then you heave, all your weight behind that thick plate, and it slams into them and they go flying back into the surf.
[Trait: Crabfolk Bulwark]

abilities.name: Shell Guard
abilities.info:
What it does: a plate of shell hardens over your chest and back: for a while blows to your body do much less damage.

It comes up out of your skin in plates with a wet crunch, grey and bumpy and crusted with salt, locking together over your chest and wrapping round your back, and the next hit just knocks against it and stops dead, and you scuttle sideways and click at them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Shell Guard]

abilities.name: Shell Up
abilities.info:
You pull in behind your shell and take the blow.
[Trait: Crabfolk]

abilities.name: Shell Wall
abilities.info:
What it does: you lock shells with allies into a wall; while it holds, attacks against the line lose much of their force.

You clack twice and the crabfolk beside you scuttle in close, shell overlapping shell overlapping shell, claws raised at the front, a curving wall of shell, and when they hit it they hit all of you at once, and it doesn't move.
[Trait: Crabfolk Shellguard]

abilities.name: Shelter of Ages
abilities.info:
What it does: you shelter your allies under your boughs; blows and missiles against them glance away for a few turns.

You spread your branches wide, so wide a village could live in them and one has, and your friends crowd in under you among the roots, and whatever comes at them hits leaf and branch and bark instead, rocks bouncing off your limbs, fire guttering out in your green canopy, while underneath it's as calm and shady as a summer afternoon.
[Trait: World Oak]

abilities.name: Shelter on the March
abilities.info:
What it does: you open your iron body as a shelter; your allies camp inside you safe from anything outside.

You kneel down and your iron plates slide open and lift up like a roof, and inside there's room for all of them, and they climb in and settle down, and outside the storm and the raiders can bang on your shell all night.
[Trait: Iron Hive-Titan]

abilities.name: Shield Line
abilities.info:
What it does: you form allies into a line; while it holds, blows against the line lose much of their force and none of you can be flanked.

You click once and the warriors around you snap into place on either side of you, perfectly spaced, plate overlapping plate, a living wall of chitin with mandibles open at the front, and when the enemy hits it they hit the hive at once.
[Trait: Antfolk Warrior]

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.info:
What it does: you lock in with the allies beside you; together you hold your ground and blows against the line lose much of their force this turn.

You snarl at the goblins either side of you until they shuffle in close, elbow to elbow, whatever scrap of cover each of you has jammed edge to edge into one ugly wall, and you dig your heels into the muck and grin over the top of it, and when the charge hits, everything slamming into you and sliding off, and the little bastards behind you start jeering.
[Trait: Hobgoblin]

abilities.name: Shift the Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: in a maze or halls you know, you move walls and doors to box a foe in, cut them off or open a way for your allies.

There's a grinding deep under the floor, dust sifts down out of the ceiling and the corridor that was there a breath ago is solid stone, and the only way left open is the one you chose for them.
[Trait: Labyrinth Warden]

abilities.name: Ship Crusher
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush a ship, a wall or a building in your tentacles; it breaks apart and those on it fall.

The sea around the ship goes still and then the tentacles come up out of it, dozens of them, as thick as masts, and they wrap the hull from end to end, and squeeze, and the timbers crack, the mast snaps, and the ship folds in half and goes under with its crew still clinging to the rails.
[Trait: Kraken]

abilities.name: Shipwreck Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a crew into steering wrong; a ship or a group following a path goes off course and into danger.

You sit on the reef with the wrecks of a hundred ships piled up below you and sing, and out on the water the helmsman's hands start turning the wheel without him, toward the music, toward the rocks, the crew smiling at the rail and swaying, and nobody notices the white water ahead until the hull splits open on the reef.
[Trait: Wreck-Singer]

abilities.name: Shiver at the Window
abilities.info:
What it does: you pass through walls and windows unseen at night; sleepers you pass wake weakened and cold.

You drift up to the window and through the glass like breath on a cold morning, and you pass along the row of sleepers taking a little warmth from each, and by the time anyone wakes up shivering you're three houses away.
[Trait: Fox Wraith]

abilities.name: Shore It Up
abilities.info:
What it does: brace a tunnel, wall or roof so it holds: it won't fall in, even under a heavy hit.

You jam the props in tight and hammer the wedges home and pack every gap with stone and mud, testing each one with your shoulder, and later when something huge slams into it the whole thing shudders and groans and dust pours down and it holds.
[Trait: Trained Build II]

abilities.name: Shoulder In
abilities.info:
What it does: drive your weight into one foe at close range: they are shoved back a step and lose their footing for a moment.

You drop your shoulder and step into them with everything you weigh, no swing, no wind-up, just your whole body arriving at once, and they go back off their heels with the air knocked out of them, arms out wide trying to find their feet again.
[Trait: Trained Fight I]

abilities.name: Show of Strength
abilities.info:
What it does: make a display that cows weaker creatures: they back down, give way or obey simple demands.

You stand up to your full height and let them see all of you, every scar, every tooth, and the small ones lower their heads and back away, and the brave ones think about it and lower theirs too.
[Trait: Trained Command II]

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.info:
What it does: you shriek at one foe; they stagger back deafened and dazed for a turn.

Your swollen throat puffs out and you open your beak-sharp mouth right in their face and let it go, a shriek so high and so loud their ears pop, and they reel away clutching their heads with blood trickling out between their fingers.
[Trait: Harpy Screecher]

abilities.name: Siege Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: you crack a wall or gate with your claw; it breaks and those behind it are scattered.

You scuttle up to the gate sideways, as wide as a wagon, and close your claw on the edge of it, and squeeze, and the wood creaks, and the iron bands bend, and with a crack the gate splits from top to bottom and falls in two halves.
[Trait: Crabfolk Siege-Shell]

abilities.name: Siege Contraption
abilities.info:
What it does: you build a siege contraption from scrap in moments; it batters a wall or gate, or hurls rocks at foes, until destroyed.

You empty out every pocket and pouch onto the ground, gears, ropes, planks, pots, chain, a cartwheel nobody knows where you got, and your hands blur, banging and lashing and tying, and out of the junk heap rises a lopsided monster of a machine that creaks and groans and somehow works, swinging its great log arm at the gate with a crunch while you sit on top steering it with your tail.
[Trait: Kobold Engineer]

abilities.name: Siege Fist
abilities.info:
What it does: you batter down a wall or gate; it breaks and those behind it are hurt and scattered.

You walk up to the gate while the archers on the wall pour everything they've got on you, and it rattles off your plates like gravel thrown at a wall, and you draw your arm back, and back, gears grinding, and punch, and the gate explodes inward in a storm of splinters and iron bands.
[Trait: War Golem]

abilities.name: Siege Work
abilities.info:
What it does: build something to break defences: a ram, a ramp, a tunnel under the wall; it gets your side through.

You stare at the wall for a long time without saying anything, and then you start building the thing that beats it, a ram, a ramp, a tunnel creeping underneath, and the ones up on the wall watch it grow day by day and sweat.
[Trait: Trained Build V]

abilities.name: Silent Kill
abilities.info:
What it does: finish a weak or unaware foe without a sound: nobody nearby hears it happen.

You come up behind it and take it with one hand over the face and the other doing the work, quick and quiet, and you lower it down to the ground gently so it doesn't make a sound, and nobody ten paces off knows a thing.
[Trait: Trained Stalk III]

abilities.name: Silent Paws
abilities.info:
You move without a sound across any floor.
[Trait: Catfolk]

abilities.name: Silk Armour
abilities.info:
What it does: you weave armour from silk in an hour; it is light and turns blows nearly as well as steel.

You sit with your eight legs tucked under you and weave, and the silk comes out thick and shining and you fold it, layer it, stiffen it with a spit of something from your jaws, and in an hour there's a coat lying in your lap so light it floats and so tough a claw skids off it.
[Trait: Arachne Silk-Mistress]

abilities.name: Silk Bridge
abilities.info:
What it does: you spin a bridge, ladder or rope of strong silk across a gap or up a wall in moments.

You squat at the edge of the drop and start pulling silk from yourself hand over hand, your long fingers flying, twisting and knotting and plaiting, and you flick the first line across the gap where it sticks to the far wall, then another, then the cross-strands, and in a few breaths there's a silk bridge swaying over the drop, strong enough to carry an ogre.
[Trait: Arachne Weaver]

abilities.name: Silk City
abilities.info:
What it does: you web an area into a fortress; walls, bridges and snares of silk protect allies and trap foes for the rest of the fight.

You rear up in the middle of the square and the silk pours out of you in torrents, strung up into walls and towers and walkways faster than anyone can follow, and in minutes the whole place is a silk fortress, every gap sealed, every approach strung with snares, and your daughters crawling along the battlements waiting for the first fool to try it.
[Trait: Arachne Loom-Queen]

abilities.name: Silk Line
abilities.info:
You spin a line to climb, bind or snare.
[Trait: Arachne]

abilities.name: Silk Spinner
abilities.info:
What it does: spin strong thread and simple webs from your own body: rope, a sling, a net, a line to climb or a tripwire.

You draw it out of yourself hand over hand, wet and glistening and then drying tough as wire, and your fingers work it without you watching, looping, knotting, plaiting, and in moments there's a rope that'd hold a horse coiled at your feet and a web strung across the way through that nobody's going to walk through quietly.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Silk Spinner]

abilities.name: Silk Throne
abilities.info:
What it does: you settle into your web; for the rest of the fight every spider and spider-goblin nearby fights for you, and anything that touches your web is felt by you.

You climb up into the centre of it and settle there among the old bones like a queen on her seat, and the whole web hums under your claws, every thread telling you who's on it, and out of the dark the little ones come crawling, hundreds of them, waiting for your word.
[Trait: Web Queen]

abilities.name: Silver Cups
abilities.info:
What it does: your court brings you tribute; you get the best of any deal with vampires and night creatures.

They come to you with blood in silver cups and secrets on their lips and gifts in their hands, and when you deal with any creature of the night they give you the best they've got, because nobody wants to be the one who disappointed you.
[Trait: Vampire Lord]

abilities.name: Silver Toll
abilities.info:
What it does: miners and tunnel-folk pay you; you get the best of any trade underground, and they warn you of anything coming down.

You coil across the shaft mouth with your eyes shut and they come down to you with the silver in bags, setting it at your feet without looking, and while they're there they tell you everything, who's coming, who's digging, who's been asking about you.
[Trait: Basilisk Tunnel-King]

abilities.name: Silver Tongue
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day every deal you make goes a little better: prices, terms and goodwill all lean your way.

Everything you say today comes out soft and easy and lands right, every offer sounding like a favour you're doing them, every refusal sounding like you're sorry, and by evening every trader in the place is pressing extras on you and asking when you'll be back.
[Trait: Trained Barter V]

abilities.name: Silver Words
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day every creature you talk to is a little warmer to you and a little easier to convince.

Something about you today makes people want to agree with you, every word lands soft and right, every smile gets one back, and by the end of the day you've got more friends than you've had in your whole life.
[Trait: Trained Talk V]

abilities.name: Sip
abilities.info:
You drink a little blood to mend.
[Trait: Vampire]

abilities.name: Siren Call
abilities.info:
You sing one listener a step closer.
[Trait: Siren]

abilities.name: Siren Song
abilities.info:
Sing to hold a group spellbound.
[Trait: Soul of the Siren]

abilities.name: Siren's Call
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a whole crowd into the sea; those who can't break the song walk into the water and drown unless pulled out.

You sing from your reef and the crew climbs over the rail, smiling, and steps down into the sea, and the cold doesn't wake them and the water closing over their heads doesn't wake them, only the drowning does, right at the end, when their eyes go wide in the green water and they understand, still mouthing the words of your song as they sink.
[Trait: Siren Enchantress]

abilities.name: Sixth Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you feel where every foe is, even unseen, and can't be flanked or struck from behind.

You stop needing your eyes, you can feel them all around you like heat on your skin, this one there, that one creeping round, and you turn to meet each one before it gets there.
[Trait: Trained Instinct V]

abilities.name: Skeleton Reform
abilities.info:
Shrug off a crippling blow by pulling the frame back together.
[Trait: Soul of the Skeleton]

abilities.name: Skull Crack
abilities.info:
What it does: slam your head into one foe's face at close range: a hard hit that leaves them dazed for a turn.

You pull your head back and snap it forward into their face with a crack you feel all the way down your neck, and they reel away with their eyes swimming and blood running out of their nose, blinking at three of you.
[Trait: Trained Fight II]

abilities.name: Sky Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive out of the sky onto prey below; your first strike lands hard and they're knocked down.

You circle so high you're only a speck against the clouds, and then the speck tucks its wings and drops, and the shadow on the ground gets bigger and bigger and darker and darker, and they hear a whistle, a rush of wind, and look up just in time to see your talons and teeth filling the sky.
[Trait: Sky Drake]

abilities.name: Sky Dominion
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every flying beast in the sky to strike your foes for the rest of the battle.

You scream once from the top of the sky and every flying thing for a hundred miles hears it, wyverns, hawks, harpies, crows, things with feathers and things with leather, and they come, darkening the sky over the field into a whirling storm of wings and beaks and talons that drops onto your enemies from every direction.
[Trait: Wyvern Sky-King]

abilities.name: Sky Leap
abilities.info:
What it does: you leap so far you nearly fly, clearing walls, rivers or a whole line of foes and landing well past them.

Your wing-buds shiver and the feathers at your fetlocks flare out wide, you gather yourself on your back legs, and then you go up, and up, the wind catching under those half-grown wings and holding you a breath longer than anything with hooves should be held, the enemy line passing underneath with their faces turned up to watch, before you come down light as a bird on the far side, already running.
[Trait: Skyrunner]

abilities.name: Sky Peck
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive from the air and peck one foe; the wound stiffens toward stone.

You flap up out of reach and wait, and when they pass below you drop with your wings half folded and your beak first, and you peck once at the back of their neck and you're back up out of reach before they turn, and the grey is already spreading out from the spot.
[Trait: Sky Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Sky Raid
abilities.info:
What it does: you raid from the air; you swoop on a foe or ship, strike, snatch something and are gone.

You come down on the deck out of the sun with a scream and a song, talons raking, wings beating, snatching a purse, a ring, a sailor's knife, and you're gone again over the rail before the crew has even got off the floor.
[Trait: Siren Raider]

abilities.name: Sky Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike from the storm, and what you hit is blasted and begins turning to stone.

You come down out of the black clouds with lightning crawling over your feathers and crowning your comb, and you hit them in a crack of thunder, and the strike turns them grey from the inside out, lightning and stone in the same breath, and they stand there smoking and frozen.
[Trait: Storm-King Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Sleep Pollen
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe out a pollen that makes one foe drowsy; they fall asleep unless they shake it off.

The blossoms in your hair open wide and you lean close and blow softly across them, and a golden cloud of pollen drifts into their face, sweet as honeysuckle on a summer evening, and their eyes start to droop and their head nods and their knees fold until they're curled up in the grass at your feet, fast asleep.
[Trait: Dryad Charmer]

abilities.name: Sleep Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a lullaby that drops one foe, or a few weak ones, asleep where they stand.

The pipes grown into your fingers find the tune without you, soft and low and sweet as a summer evening, the kind of song a mother hums over a cradle, and their eyelids get heavy on the second bar, their knees go loose on the third, and by the end of the verse they're curled up in the grass snoring with their thumbs halfway to their mouths.
[Trait: Satyr Pipe-Mage]

abilities.name: Sleeping Islands
abilities.info:
What it does: the islands in the bay are your tentacles; you wake one and it rises, flinging anything on it or near it into the sea.

You stir in your sleep and one of the little islands in the bay heaves up out of the water, trees and rocks and all, and it's an arm, and it rises and rises and sweeps across the water flinging everything off it.
[Trait: Elder Kraken]

abilities.name: Slide Off the Air
abilities.info:
What it does: you dance on the air for a few turns; you move freely above the ground and strike from any angle.

You step up onto the air like it's a stair and keep going, spinning, leaping, turning on nothing at all, and you come at them from above, from the side, from upside down, and they can't keep up with where you are.
[Trait: Sylph Sky-Dancer]

abilities.name: Slime Engulf
abilities.info:
Surround a smaller foe and digest it.
[Trait: Soul of the Slime]

abilities.name: Slime Shape
abilities.info:
What it does: you reshape your body to whatever you need: a limb, a hook, a flat sheet, a long reach.

You think about it and your body does it, a long arm pushing out of you to grab a ledge, a hook to snag a rope, a flat sheet to slide under a door, wobbling and stretching and sucking back in again, and you gurgle happily to yourself as you squeeze through a crack the width of a coin.
[Trait: Thinking Slime]

abilities.name: Slip Past
abilities.info:
What it does: move straight past a foe or a line of them without being hit; you end up behind them.

They spread out to stop you and you go through the gap between them that wasn't there a second ago, turning sideways, ducking under one arm and spinning off another, and you're out the back of them before they've closed ranks on nothing.
[Trait: Trained Strike III]

abilities.name: Slowing Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare at one foe and their limbs drag; they act slowly for a few turns.

You plant all eight feet and lower your stony head and fix them with those heavy yellow eyes, and they feel the weight land on them, their arms sagging, their feet dragging as if the floor has turned to glue, and every move they try to make comes half a beat too late.
[Trait: Greater Basilisk]

abilities.name: Small Print
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike a bargain that favours you; whoever agrees is bound to it, and the small print always works in your favour.

You unroll the scroll with a flourish and smile your sly little smile and talk, fast and friendly and reasonable, and it all sounds so fair, and they sign, and only later do they read the tiny writing curling round the edges, the part about their firstborn and their shadow and the next three summers.
[Trait: Imp Contractor]

abilities.name: Smell the Gold
abilities.info:
What it does: you smell gold, gems and anything valuable nearby, even buried or hidden, and know roughly how much.

Your nostrils flare and your little wings twitch and there it is, the smell of it, metal and stone and treasure, and your whole body turns toward it the way a dog turns toward meat, and you're digging before anyone's asked you where.
[Trait: Drakeling]

abilities.name: Smell the Lie
abilities.info:
What it does: tell whether one creature you are talking to is lying, scared or hiding something.

They're talking and you're listening to the words with one ear and smelling them with everything else, the sweat starting under the arms, the fear they're sitting on, and you know before they've finished.
[Trait: Trained Instinct II]

abilities.name: Smiling Bones
abilities.info:
What it does: the bones of your reef sing with you; for a few turns every foe near the reef is slowed and dazed by the chorus.

You sing and the reef sings with you, all the smiling bones of everyone who ever heard you, a chorus of the dead from every crack in the coral, and the living standing near it slow down and stare and sway.
[Trait: Endless Song Siren]

abilities.name: Smiling Sleepers
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak to someone in their dreams; when they wake they remember it as their own idea, and do it.

You lean down over one of the sleepers under your trees and whisper what you want, slow and sweet, and they smile in their sleep, and when they wake they get up and do it without ever knowing where the idea came from.
[Trait: Dream Dryad]

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.info:
What it does: a strike filled with holy light: extra damage against the dead, demons and creatures of the dark, and they're thrown back.
You fill your arm with the light until it shines through your skin and you hit them with it, and to the dead and the dark it's like being hit by the sun, and they're thrown back smoking and wailing.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Smite]

abilities.name: Smith's Name
abilities.info:
What it does: every smith and trader knows your work; anything you make or sell fetches far more than it should.

You put your mark on it, the little burned sign you've stamped on every piece you've ever made, and the trader sees it and goes quiet, and turns it over, and the price they offer you doubles while they're still looking at it.
[Trait: Salamander Forge-King]

abilities.name: Smoke Out
abilities.info:
What it does: fill the area with choking smoke for three turns: foes in it can't see and cough, while you see and breathe fine.
You let the fire in you smoulder instead of burn and the smoke pours off you thick and choking, rolling out low and filling every gap, and they're choking and stumbling and rubbing at streaming eyes while you walk through it breathing easy.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Smoke Out]

abilities.name: Smoke Scent
abilities.info:
What it does: track prey through smoke, ash, burning ground and darkness without losing the trail; fire and smoke never hide anything from you.

You push your snout into the smoke where everyone else is choking and blind and you breathe it in deep, and under the burning and the soot it's all still there, sharp and clear, sweat and fear and the hot iron smell of their blood, and you go loping through the flames after it with your eyes glowing like coals.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Smoke Scent]

abilities.name: Smoke Trail
abilities.info:
You track through smoke and ash.
[Trait: Hellhound]

abilities.name: Smoking Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through a cloud of your own smoke; the foe you hit is burned and can't see you coming.

Smoke starts pouring off your bristles in black ropes as you work yourself up, eyes glowing red through the haze, and by the time you start running you're wrapped in a stinking cloud of it, so all they see is a dark shape and two red eyes coming out of the smoke before your hot tusks slam into them and set their clothes smouldering.
[Trait: Hellboar]

abilities.name: Smoking Floor
abilities.info:
What it does: the floor you stand on cracks and smokes; for a few turns foes near you are burned each turn.

You stand still and the floor under you smokes, then cracks, then glows in the cracks, the heat spreading out from your feet in a slow red ring, and whoever's in it dances from foot to foot.
[Trait: Magma Golem]

abilities.name: Smoking Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: the ground you walk on burns for days; for the rest of the fight foes who follow your path are burned each turn.

Every step you take leaves a hoofprint that smokes and glows, and it doesn't go out, it smoulders, and anything that crosses your trail gets its feet burned, and you lead them round in circles until the ground behind you is all fire.
[Trait: Hellfire Boar]

abilities.name: Smooth Over
abilities.info:
What it does: fix a bad first impression or an insult: one creature or group forgives it and moves on.

You laugh it off and say the right thing, something small and warm and a little bit against yourself, and the anger in the room goes out of it all at once, and someone laughs, and it's as if it never happened.
[Trait: Trained Talk III]

abilities.name: Snake Hair
abilities.info:
What it does: your hair-snakes strike at every foe near you, biting and poisoning them.

The snakes on your head have been hissing quietly all along, and when anyone steps close they lash out all at once, twenty heads striking in every direction, fangs sinking into hands and necks and faces, and the ones bitten stagger back clutching at the punctures as the venom burns its way through their blood.
[Trait: Medusa]

abilities.name: Snakes Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: the snakes on your head strike at every foe close to you at once; each is bitten and poisoned.

The snakes on your head go still, all of them, every little head lifting and turning toward the ones standing close, and then they strike all together in one hissing lash, and everyone near you staggers back clutching a bite.
[Trait: Gorgon]

abilities.name: Snap and Snap
abilities.info:
You bite twice where one bite should be.
[Trait: Hydra]

abilities.name: Snap Trap
abilities.info:
What it does: you set a nasty trap in seconds right where a foe is about to step; it catches them, hurts them and holds them for a turn.

Your quick little fingers fly over the tool belt grown into your scales, a spring, a jaw, a twist of wire, a spike, and you've jammed it into the dirt and kicked leaves over it before they've finished their sentence, and their very next step comes down on it with a snap and a howl you could hear a mile off.
[Trait: Kobold Trapper]

abilities.name: Snare
abilities.info:
What it does: set a simple trap: the next creature to walk into it is caught or hurt.

A loop of cord, a bent sapling, a little pin to hold it down and a scatter of leaves over the top, and your hands do it all in the time it takes to say it, and you back away into cover and wait for the snap and the squeal.
[Trait: Trained Build II]

abilities.name: Snatch
abilities.info:
What it does: you seize one foe and carry them up into the air; they're held helpless and can be dropped.
