You come in low and fast with your hawk's eye fixed on one of them and your talons spread, and you hook them under the arms and beat your wings, and their feet leave the ground, and the ground drops away, and they're kicking and begging fifty feet up with nothing below them but your choice of where to let go.
[Trait: Wyvern Raptor]

abilities.name: Snatch and Fly
abilities.info:
What it does: you snatch something from a foe, a pouch, a trinket, the thing in their hand, and are gone into the sky before anyone reacts.

You drop out of nowhere in a whirl of feathers and stink and there's a tug, a flash of talons, and you're gone again, laughing your cackling harpy laugh as you climb, and they look down and the purse that was on their belt is up there glittering in your claws on its way to your nest.
[Trait: Harpy Plunderer]

abilities.name: Sniff the Air
abilities.info:
What it does: smell what's around you: who passed, what's cooking, what's rotten, what's afraid, what's hiding.

You lift your head and breathe in slow and the air tells you all of it, smoke, sweat, old blood, fear, something dead, and something alive behind that wall that doesn't want to be found.
[Trait: Trained Instinct I]

abilities.name: Soft Feet
abilities.info:
What it does: move without a sound for a while; anyone not looking right at you won't notice you pass.

You put your weight down slow on the outside of your feet and roll it in, testing every step, finding the quiet ground, and you go past them close enough to smell without making a single sound.
[Trait: Trained Stalk I]

abilities.name: Song and Talon
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing and the whole flock strikes; every flying ally attacks your foes together for the rest of the battle.

You rise up high and sing, and every siren and harpy within earshot takes up the song and takes to the air, and the sky fills with wings and voices, and the singing flock comes down on your enemies singing.
[Trait: Siren Sky-Queen]

abilities.name: Song of Drowning
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing and every listener walks into the sea; those who can't break the song drown unless pulled out.

You sing one song on a still night and it carries over the open sea, and on every beach and every deck they hear it, and they walk, smiling, into the water, up to the knees, the waist, the chin, and some part of them wakes as the cold closes over their heads and they thrash and claw and scream bubbles, but their legs keep walking them deeper, deeper, out into the black, singing along.
[Trait: Siren Reef-Queen]

abilities.name: Song of Ending
abilities.info:
What it does: you play a song that stops a fight dead; nobody can attack while it plays, and those who hear it may lose the will to start again.

You sit down in the middle of the fighting with your pipes and play something so sad and so quiet it shouldn't carry over all that noise, but it does, and hands start to lower, then weapons, and grown warriors find themselves weeping for people they killed years ago, and when the last note fades nobody can quite remember what they were fighting about.
[Trait: Satyr Songmaster]

abilities.name: Soul Bargain
abilities.info:
What it does: you trade with a soul's worth; you can buy great favours, power or knowledge with a soul you hold, or demand one as payment.

You take a little glass bottle down off the shelf and shake it, and the soul inside it flutters against the glass, and you set it on the table between you and the one you're bargaining with, and they lean in, because a soul is worth more than any gold, and you both know it.
[Trait: Devil Broker]

abilities.name: Soul Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe's soul; they're weakened and shaken, and armour doesn't help them.

You come at them pale and blue-eyed and your teeth go straight through their armour and their skin without leaving a mark, and close on something deeper, and you tear a mouthful of it away, and they crumple howling, clutching their chest, feeling a piece of themselves go missing.
[Trait: Spectral Hound]

abilities.name: Soul Echo
abilities.info:
What it does: draw on a soul you hold: for a few turns you fight, sense or move with the strengths of one race you have absorbed.

You reach down into the crowd of souls in you and pull one up to the top, and its strength floods through you, its eyes, its nose, its way of moving, and for a while it's not just you fighting, it's the both of you.
[Trait: Trained Absorb IV]

abilities.name: Soul Knot
abilities.info:
What it does: you tie your soul to one ally's for a scene; you share their senses, and you can take a wound meant for them or lend them your strength.

You reach out without moving and find theirs, warm and bright and frightened, and pull a knot tight between you, and suddenly their pulse thuds along with yours and every step they take jolts up your own legs, and when something hits them it lands on you instead, and you grin through it.
[Trait: Knotted Soul]

abilities.name: Soul Lash
abilities.info:
What it does: you hit one foe with the souls you carry (your element's if you have one); it hurts and leaves them shaken. Rolls evoke.

The souls you've kept stir all at once and you throw them like a fist, a howl of voices only the target can hear as something that was never yours slams through their chest and leaves them cold and shaking.
[Trait: Soulcaller]

abilities.name: Soul Lore
abilities.info:
What it does: know what absorbing one race's soul will do to you, and what its gifts are, before you take it.

You know the old stories about this one, what its soul leaves behind in you, what it takes from you in return, and what became of the ones who ate too many of them and forgot what they started out as.
[Trait: Trained Lore IV]

abilities.name: Soul Pyre
abilities.info:
What it does: you burn one kept soul for one action of strength or speed far past your own; that soul is gone for good.

You reach inside and pick one, the little knot of something you took, and it catches, heat rolling up your spine and out through your eyes in a white-orange glow as the thing it was screams once behind your ribs and burns, and for one breath you are everything it ever was and more, every muscle running hot as a forge as you hit, and when the glow dies there's ash in your mouth and one less voice in the dark.
[Trait: Ember Soul]

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.info:
What it does: tear at one foe's soul: heavy damage that no armour or hide can stop, and they are shaken for a turn.

You reach for them across the gap and close your fist and pull, and they scream, not from any wound but from somewhere deeper, their soul stretching out of them toward you before it snaps back in.
[Trait: Trained Absorb V]

abilities.name: Soul Scent
abilities.info:
What it does: you track a soul you have touched; you always know which way it is and roughly how far.

You touched them once, weeks ago, a brush of cold fingers across their cheek in the dark, and they've been running ever since, across rivers and mountains, and none of it matters, because you can feel their warmth out there, and you drift after them, patient, always getting closer.
[Trait: Wraith Hunter]

abilities.name: Soul Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: feel the souls nearby: you know how many living things are close, roughly how strong, and which ones are dying.

You close your hand and something inside you opens, and they're there around you, little warm lights in the dark of your head, bright ones and dim ones, and one off to the side that's flickering, going out.
[Trait: Trained Absorb I]

abilities.name: Soul Sight
abilities.info:
What it does: you read a creature's soul: its race, how strong it is, what souls it keeps and whether it's hiding something.

Your eyes empty out until there's nothing in the sockets but dark, then everything else fades and they come on, every soul around you lit from the inside, the big ones blazing, the feeble ones guttering, and when you look at one you see the knots it carries and the lies sitting cold in its chest.
[Trait: Hollow Eyes]

abilities.name: Soul Snare
abilities.info:
What it does: seize a foe's soul from a distance: they can't move away from you for a few turns and grow weaker each turn.

You catch hold of something inside them from across the fight and hold on, and they try to run and their soul won't go with them, and it drags them back toward you weaker every step.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VI]

abilities.name: Soul Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: pull at every foe's soul around you at once: they all take damage no armour stops, and you heal for every one hit.

You throw your arms out and pull with everything you are, and every soul around you comes loose at once, a howling wind of them streaming in toward you, and they all scream together, and you drink it.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VIII]

abilities.name: Soul Taste
abilities.info:
What it does: touch a creature, living or freshly dead, and learn what it was: its race, its strength and what it feared most.

You lay your palm on it and taste it through the skin, bitter, sweet, sour, and the taste tells you everything, what it was, how strong, the thing it was most afraid of at the end.
[Trait: Trained Absorb II]

abilities.name: Soul Theft
abilities.info:
What it does: you steal a sliver of one foe's soul; they're badly weakened, and you take something of their strength.

You drift up behind them pale as smoke and lean down and breathe in, long and slow, and they feel it go, something warm pulled out of them through their mouth in a glowing thread, and they go cold, colder than they've ever been, clutching at their chest and gasping, forgetting their own mother's name as it disappears down your throat.
[Trait: Fox Wraith]

abilities.name: Sounder Rally
abilities.info:
What it does: you grunt the rally; your sounder gathers on you and charges together, each one hitting harder for it.

You plant your feet and let out a deep, rasping grunt that every boar in the sounder knows from their first day out of the den, and they come crashing out of the undergrowth from every side to bunch up around you, shoulder to shoulder, snorting and stamping, and when you go they all go, a wall of bristles and tusks moving as one stubborn animal.
[Trait: Boarfolk Matriarch]

abilities.name: Spark
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes lightning damage and loses its next move to the shock.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning Magic]

abilities.name: Spark Spit
abilities.info:
You spit a gob of flame.
[Trait: Drake]

abilities.name: Speak Softly
abilities.info:
Talk the dead down without a fight; the next command or lore action with the restless dead is stronger.
[Trait: The Quiet Council: Grave-Hand]

abilities.name: Speak with the Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: you question any corpse for what it knew in life; it answers truthfully.

You kneel over the body and press your mouth to its ear and whisper its name, and its dead eyes roll toward you, and its jaw creaks open, and it talks, in a dry rattling whisper, and it tells you everything you ask, who killed it, what it hid, what it saw, because the dead don't lie to you.
[Trait: Ghoul Grave-Elder]

abilities.name: Spear Lunge
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike out of reeds or water with one long thrust before the foe knows you're there; the first strike lands hard.

You've been lying in the shallows so long the frogs have stopped noticing you, reed-striped scales and one cold eye just above the waterline, and when they lean down to fill their waterskin the water explodes and your arm shoots out full length behind your point, one long thrust that takes them under the ribs before the ripples have even reached the bank.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Hunter]

abilities.name: Spear's Length
abilities.info:
What it does: nothing can get close to you without burning; for a few turns foes who come within reach of you take fire damage every turn.

The heat coming off you is so fierce now that the air wobbles around you a long way out, and anything that steps into it smokes, and the ones who try to close in on you to strike have to do it with their fur crisping and their eyes watering.
[Trait: Living Flame]

abilities.name: Spine Back
abilities.info:
What it does: you hunch your back and your iron bristles stab anyone who strikes or grabs you this turn.

You drop your head and hunch, and the bristles along your spine rise up stiff and hard as a row of iron nails with a long hiss, and the fool who grabs you or swings at your back pulls away with their hands and arms full of holes, shrieking, while you stand there grunting like nothing happened.
[Trait: Boarfolk Ironback]

abilities.name: Spirit Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe's soul instead of their flesh; they're weakened and shaken, and armour does nothing against it.

You fade in, fade out, then you're right beside them with your ghostly jaws open, and you bite down, and your teeth go right through their armour and their skin without leaving a mark and close on something deeper, and they shriek and stagger as you tear away a piece of whatever makes them them.
[Trait: Spectral Fox]

abilities.name: Spirit Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a storm of spirits over the field; lightning and howling ghosts strike your foes for a few turns.

You raise both arms and clouds boil up full of faces, and the spirits of every orc who ever died fighting come pouring down in the rain, shrieking and spinning and flashing with lightning, slashing at every enemy on the field, and through it all you hold the centre of the storm with your eyes blazing white, its eye and its master.
[Trait: Storm Shaman]

abilities.name: Spirit Ward
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the ancestor spirits to guard an ally; for a few turns blows and curses against them lose much of their force.

You slap a palm full of ash and blood onto their chest and growl the names of the old dead, and the air around them goes cold and crowded, faint grey shapes of tusked warriors crowding close at their shoulders, and when the next blow comes in the spirits catch it, the hit landing soft and the curse sliding off, the grandfathers of the tribe standing guard over one of their own.
[Trait: Orc Shaman]

abilities.name: Spit Fire
abilities.info:
What it does: spit a short burst of flame: light a fire, scare off a beast, or burn one face close in.

There's a tickle at the back of your throat and a smell of smoke coming up out of your chest and you hack it out, a short hot cough of fire that lights the kindling, or the end of a rope, or the face of whatever's leaning in too close, leaving them howling and swatting at their own eyebrows.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Spit Fire]

abilities.name: Split
abilities.info:
What it does: when you're struck you split into two; each half fights on, and you can rejoin when the fight is done.

Their blow cuts right through you and for a moment they think they've won, and then the two halves of you wobble, and stretch, and pull themselves up into two of you, each one grinning, each one hungry, and now they're fighting twice as much ooze as they were a breath ago, and they look down at their weapon dripping with you and start to understand.
[Trait: Ooze Colossus]

abilities.name: Spore Brood
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe out spores that grow into a brood of fungus-rats from the floor and the fallen, and they fight for you.

A ripple runs under the grey crust of your body and you breathe out a cloud of fat golden spores that settle on the floor, the walls, the bodies of the dead, and for a while nothing happens, then the ground starts to bulge and split and out they crawl, rats made of mushroom and mould, blind and squealing and starving, one from every spore, wriggling out of corpses' mouths and the cracks in the stone to swarm whatever you point at.
[Trait: Fungal Rat-Mother]

abilities.name: Spore Burst
abilities.info:
What it does: you burst a cloud of rotting spores; foes nearby are sickened and weakened for a few turns.

Your dead trunk splits open down the middle with a crack and the fungus inside bursts out, a cloud of spores as black as soot pouring out of you and creeping low along the dirt, and they breathe it and gag, and their skin itches and their lungs burn with the rot of a forest that died standing up.
[Trait: Rot Colossus]

abilities.name: Spore Cloud
abilities.info:
What it does: release a cloud of spores over everyone around you: they are dazed, sickened or calmed (you choose) for several turns; anything that doesn't breathe ignores it.

You swell up and burst, the spores pouring out of you in a slow thick cloud that rolls and settles over everything, and they cough and wave at it and then their gaze turns soft and stupid, or they double over retching, or they just sit down in the middle of the fight and smile at nothing, and the spores keep drifting down on them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Spore Cloud]

abilities.name: Spore Cough
abilities.info:
What it does: you cough a cloud of spores; everyone in it sneezes, chokes and stumbles for a turn or two and keeps a wet cough after.

A tickle starts in the mushroom caps along your back, then your chest heaves and you cough, a big wet bark, and a yellow cloud bursts out of your fur like dust beaten out of an old rug, and it gets everywhere, up noses, into eyes, down throats, and they're sneezing and gagging and staggering blind, rubbing at eyes that only itch worse, while little white threads of fungus are already taking root in their lungs.
[Trait: Plaguecap Rat]

abilities.name: Spore Hive
abilities.info:
What it does: you puppet everything infected around you; every spore-infected creature nearby fights for you for the rest of the battle.

You open your eye and every infected thing in it opens its eyes too, white and blank, rats and bats and goblins and the adventurers who came in last week, and they all stand up together, swaying, mushrooms sprouting from their skin, and turn on the living in a silent shuffling crowd.
[Trait: Spore Mind-Lord]

abilities.name: Spore Puff
abilities.info:
A puff of spores that dazes one foe.
[Trait: Myconid]

abilities.name: Spore Puppet
abilities.info:
What it does: you puppet a spore-infected foe for a short while; they act as you choose.

The spores you breathed into them have been growing quietly for a while, and now you reach out through them, and they jerk, and their arms lift on their own, and fungus threads creep across their eyes, and their mouth opens and your thoughts come out of it as they turn and walk toward their friends.
[Trait: Fungal Gazer]

abilities.name: Spore Speech
abilities.info:
What it does: share a thought, picture or feeling with one creature nearby, without speaking and without sharing a language.

A soft puff of dust drifts off you and across the space between you and they breathe it in without meaning to, and then they just know, a picture blooming in their head, the way you feel, what you want, warm and quiet and sure, and they take it for their own idea.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Spore Speech]

abilities.name: Spore Stare
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare spores into one foe; they're dazed and sickened, and the spores take root in them.

You fix your big wet eye on them and your stalks puff out little clouds of spores that drift straight at them along your gaze like dust in a sunbeam, into their eyes, their nose, their mouth, and they start coughing and blinking, and they can feel something itching behind their eyes.
[Trait: Spore Eye]

abilities.name: Spore Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you release a spore storm across a whole field; everyone in it is dazed, sickened and choking for a few turns.

Your crown of caps bursts open all at once and the spores pour out of you in a column that climbs high and spreads, a storm of grey and yellow dust filling the air as far as anyone can see, too thick to see or breathe through, coughing and gagging and falling to their knees with spores caking their eyes and mouths.
[Trait: Ruin Cap]

abilities.name: Spot the Cheat
abilities.info:
What it does: tell whether a trader is cheating you: a light scale, a bad ingot, a hidden flaw, a lie about where it came from.

You watch their hands instead of their face, the thumb on the scale, the bad side turned down, the story that's a little too smooth, and you smile and turn the thing over.
[Trait: Trained Barter II]

abilities.name: Spring Volley
abilities.info:
What it does: you set off a hidden bank of spring traps; a shower of darts, spikes and stones hits every foe in the area.

You yank one little string hidden behind a loose brick, and all around them the walls go click, click, click, click, a dozen hidden hatches flicking open, and out comes everything you've been stuffing in there for weeks, darts, nails, sharpened bones and fist-sized rocks, flying from every direction at once while you giggle from somewhere safe.
[Trait: Kobold Gadgeteer]

abilities.name: Squeeze Through
abilities.info:
You fit through a gap a head could barely pass.
[Trait: Ratfolk]

abilities.name: Stakes Through Hearts
abilities.info:
What it does: your sickness keeps you up; for the rest of the fight, when you would fall, you keep fighting for one more turn.

They put you down and you don't stay down, the sickness in you won't let you, and you get up again, rotten and grinning, and keep coming for one more round, and they start looking around for something sharp to drive through your heart.
[Trait: Plague-Lord Ghoul]

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead a stampede in a straight line; everything in its path is trampled and walls or gates at the end of it may break.

You stamp once and the whole herd behind you answers, a thousand hooves hitting the ground together, then you drop your bronze-capped horns and run, the earth shaking so hard the stones jump in the road, dust boiling up behind you like smoke off a burning city, and whatever is between you and the wall goes under the hooves, bodies, beasts, carts, the gate itself caving in with the shape of your horns pressed deep into the bronze.
[Trait: Minotaur Warlord]

abilities.name: Stampede Sense
abilities.info:
Feel a charge coming through the ground before it hits; the next instinct or endure action against a rush hits harder.
[Trait: The Horn Moot: Grass-Runner]

abilities.name: Stand Your Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: steady your allies for a turn: none of them break, flee or panic.

You plant yourself in front of them with your back to the fight and look each one of them in the eye in turn and growl low in your throat, and the ones whose feet were edging back stop edging, and nobody runs.
[Trait: Trained Command I]

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.info:
What it does: you call down a shower of falling stars over an area; everything under it is burned.

The starlight caught in your mane drips, silver beads running down your neck and hissing where they hit the grass, and you shake it loose and fling your head up and the sky answers, a slow rain of white sparks drifting down over them pretty as snow until it lands, burning through cloth and hide and skin, every spark a tiny piece of a star come down to find them.
[Trait: Centaur Sky-Sage]

abilities.name: Stars Go Out
abilities.info:
What it does: you stretch and the stars go out overhead; foes under the dark sky are frightened and fight badly for a few turns.

You stretch long and lazy and the stars go out, one, then another, then the whole sky, and the ones down there look up into black and feel very small and very alone, and every one of them knows you're out there somewhere in it.
[Trait: Night Panther]

abilities.name: Static
abilities.info:
What it does: charge your hands with static: your next touch jolts one foe, making them drop what they hold or stagger.
You rub your fingers together and the air round them snaps and ticks, and when you grab them it jumps with a crack, and their hand flies open on its own and they stagger back shaking it.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Static]

abilities.name: Statue Army
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn every foe in sight to stone; those who meet your eyes are petrified and the rest shut their eyes and fight blind.

You rise up off your perch and spread your wings over the field and open your eyes wide, and the army below looks up, every face turning toward the sound of your wings, and the grey rolls over them, rank after rank turning to stone mid-shout, and the ones at the back who saw it happen throw themselves on the ground with their hands over their eyes, screaming at each other not to look.
[Trait: Stone Medusa Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Statue Pose
abilities.info:
You hold stone-still and pass for a carving.
[Trait: Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Statue Stillness
abilities.info:
What it does: turn still and stony: while you don't move you are very hard to hurt and pass for a statue.

You freeze mid crouch and the grey spreads over you in a breath, your skin turning rough and pitted and cold, moss even, and you sit there on the ledge with your chin on your fist, perfectly still, while the rain runs off you and they look right at you and see nothing but old stone.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Statue Stillness]

abilities.name: Stay Away from Wildflowers
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a field of wildflowers; any foe who walks into it is confused, lost and tricked for a few turns.

You sprinkle your dust over the ground and wildflowers burst up out of it in a wave, a whole meadow in a heartbeat, and anyone who steps into it loses their way, turning in circles, laughing at nothing, forgetting why they came.
[Trait: Pixie King]

abilities.name: Steal a Face
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the face of someone you've seen up close; for a while everyone believes you're them.

You look at them a long time, close, learning every line, and then you smile and your face slides and shifts and settles into theirs, every scar and every wrinkle, and you walk off wearing it and nobody who sees you thinks twice.
[Trait: Fox Face-Thief]

abilities.name: Steal the Herd
abilities.info:
Cut animals out of a herd and run them off without the herders seeing; the next stalk action near stock is stronger.
[Trait: The Laughing Pack: Biter]

abilities.name: Steaming Water
abilities.info:
What it does: you slide into water and boil it; foes in the water or the steam are scalded each turn for a few turns.

You slide down into the water and it steams, then hisses, then boils, great bubbles rolling up all around you, and anything swimming in it or standing in the steam is screaming and scrambling out with their skin red and blistering.
[Trait: Inferno Hydra]

abilities.name: Steel Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite through metal; one foe's armour or gear is cut through and they're hurt.

Your steel mandibles open and the runes along them flare blue, and you close them on whatever they're holding up, and the metal screams as it gives, a shriek of tearing iron, and the two halves of it fall to the floor and you keep going.
[Trait: Steel Ant]

abilities.name: Steel Guard
abilities.info:
What it does: you guard an ally with your steel body; blows aimed at them hit you instead this turn.

You step in front of them in one heavy clanking stride and stand square, and whatever was coming for them hits you instead, ringing off your steel chest like a hammer on an anvil, and you never rock back, only turn your blank face toward whoever threw it.
[Trait: Steel Golem]

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.info:
What it does: you reek; foes near you gag, retch and can't fight well for a turn or two.

You come closer and the smell comes first, rot and old meat and grave water and something worse underneath, and it hits them, their eyes watering, their stomachs heaving, doubled over and vomiting on their own boots while you walk right up to them.
[Trait: Ghast]

abilities.name: Step Into Shadow
abilities.info:
What it does: you sink into a shadow and come up out of another one you can see; nobody sees you until you strike or step into the light.

The light slides off you first, your outline blurring into the dark, then you lean back into the nearest shadow and it takes you, cold and silent, no sound, no air, and the next anyone sees of you is a darker patch in the corner behind them, standing up.
[Trait: Shadow Soul]

abilities.name: Stiffening Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you stiffen one foe toward stone; they're slowed more each turn until they break your gaze.

You lock eyes with them and they feel their skin tighten and harden, their fingers going stiff, grey creeping up their arms, and they're crying out and trying to turn their head away, and their neck won't turn, it creaks, and the grey keeps climbing.
[Trait: Gorgon Gargoyle]

abilities.name: Stiffening Peck
abilities.info:
What it does: a numbing peck: the struck limb goes numb and clumsy for a few turns.

You bob your head and cluck and then strike, quick as a hen at a grain, peck, and they glance at the little mark and shrug and then their hand won't close, the fingers fat and tingling and stupid, and the thing they were holding slips out of it and they can't even feel it go.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stiffening Peck]

abilities.name: Stiffening Stare
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare one foe half to stone; the limbs it reaches go dead and useless for a few turns.

Your glowing grey eyes fix on them and their legs go first, stone from the hips down in the time it takes to gasp, and they're stuck there, howling, beating at their own dead grey thighs with their fists, trying to pull free of a body that isn't theirs anymore, while you watch from the dark and decide whether to finish the job.
[Trait: Stone-Eye Basilisk]

abilities.name: Still as Leaves
abilities.info:
You hold so still you vanish among plants.
[Trait: Mantid]

abilities.name: Still Hungry
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight every foe or thing you dissolve heals you; the more you eat the harder you are to kill.

You're never full, never, and every single thing you roll over goes into you and turns to strength, the walls, the carts, the ones who couldn't get out of the way, and the more you eat the bigger and harder to hurt you get.
[Trait: Town-Eater Slime]

abilities.name: Still Mind
abilities.info:
What it does: you read a foe's next move; you know what they'll do before they do it and can act first.

You don't watch their weapon, you watch their breathing, their eyes, the little shift of weight in their feet, and you see it before they've even decided, the swing coming high from the left, and by the time their arm moves you've already moved out of the way and into the gap.
[Trait: Mantid Monk]

abilities.name: Still Think They're Fighting
abilities.info:
What it does: the ghosts of an old battlefield replay their war around you; for a few turns foes in the area are caught in it, attacked by phantoms and confused.

You let the old battle wake up and the ghosts rise around you shouting, charging, dying again, and the living get caught up in the middle of it, swinging at phantoms, struck by things that aren't there, lost in a war that ended long ago.
[Trait: Wraith Lord]

abilities.name: Still Water Speech
abilities.info:
What it does: when you speak the water goes still and everyone listens; even foes hear you out before they act.

You open your mouth and the swamp goes quiet, the frogs stop, the water stops lapping, the wind stops in the reeds, and in that great silence your voice is the only thing, slow and old, and nobody wants to be the one to interrupt it.
[Trait: Swamp Elder]

abilities.name: Stillness
abilities.info:
What it does: go perfectly still among leaves, branches or shadows: eyes slide past you and you can't be spotted while you don't move.

You fold your arms up under your chin and lock every joint and you sway, just a little, the way a stem sways in the breeze, and their eyes go over you and past you and back over you and don't stop, and they walk right by close enough for you to count their breaths.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stillness]

abilities.name: Stillness Field
abilities.info:
What it does: you slow every foe around you for a few turns.

You stand in the middle of them and go still, completely still, deeper still than anything alive should be, and the stillness spreads out from you, and they feel it in their arms and legs, everything getting slower and heavier, their swings drifting slow through the air.
[Trait: Mantid Grand Abbot]

abilities.name: Stilt Village
abilities.info:
What it does: your people raise a stilt camp over any marsh or water in a day; it's hard to attack and easy to defend.

You point at the water and the hunters start driving poles, and by nightfall there's a ring of huts standing on stilts out over the marsh, joined by rope bridges you can cut in a breath, and anything that wades out to attack it has to come through the water first.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Chieftain]

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: one quick touch poisons one foe lightly: a little poison damage each turn for two turns.
It's barely a touch, a brush of your fingers, a scratch, a drop, and they don't think anything of it until the itch starts, and the swelling, and the queasy sweat.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Sting]

abilities.name: Stone Belly
abilities.info:
What it does: eat grit, gravel and stone and draw real strength and health from it; you never go hungry underground.

You scoop up a handful of gravel and pour it into your mouth and grind it down, crunch, crunch, crunch, a mill wheel turning, and down in your belly the stone breaks up and turns warm and heavy and good, and you lick the grit off your lips and go looking for a bigger rock.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stone Belly]

abilities.name: Stone Body
abilities.info:
What it does: harden part of your body to stone just as a blow lands: that hit does little or nothing.

The runes on your skin flare once and the flesh under them sets solid and heavy, and the hit lands on stone with a dull clunk, and the one who hit you shakes out their numb arm while you turn your head slowly to look at them with the glow fading out of the runes.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stone Body]

abilities.name: Stone Brow
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn your brow and horns to stone and take a blow head on; it does you little harm and may break whatever struck you.

Your brow greys over as you lower it, the skin crackling and setting hard in a blink, stone creeping up from the base of your horns, and you meet the blow head on, whatever hits you ringing off your skull, sparks spitting and the thing that struck you jarring back broken, and you just lift your head and look at them under a brow of pure grey stone.
[Trait: Stonehorn]

abilities.name: Stone Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge as a colossal moving boulder; everything in your path is smashed and thrown aside and the ground cracks.

You lower your stone head and start moving and you can't stop, a mountain rolling downhill, every step crushing the ground to gravel, and whatever's in your way is hit like a rockfall, and you come to a stop in a cloud of dust and broken things.
[Trait: Granite Bull]

abilities.name: Stone Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive from a height like a falling stone; your strike lands hard and knocks one foe down.

You tip forward off the spire and fold your stone wings and drop, and you're heavy, so much heavier than anything that flies, and you fall, and the wind screams past you, and you hit them, all that stone at once.
[Trait: Gargoyle Spire-Lord]

abilities.name: Stone Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you lock eyes with one foe and they begin turning to stone, slowing more each turn until the stare breaks or they are stone through.

Your head turns with a grinding of granite on granite, half your face already rock, and your eyes find theirs and hold, and they feel it start in their fingertips and they scream, clawing at their own hands as the grey crawls up the wrists, nails cracking on skin gone hard as slate, sobbing and begging and trying to run on legs that won't bend anymore, the stone climbing over their chest so every breath comes shorter and shorter until it reaches the throat and the scream just stops, and all that's left is their eyes, still wet, still moving, staring out of a face that can't move ever again.
[Trait: Petrifying Bull]

abilities.name: Stone Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: your hide hardens to stone; blows do you little harm for a few turns.

You grunt and flex and your skin goes grey and cracked, hard as granite from your scalp to your feet, and when the blows come in they thud off you, and you look down at them chipping away at your belly and laugh a deep, slow ogre laugh.
[Trait: Stoneflesh Ogre]

abilities.name: Stone Peck
abilities.info:
What it does: you peck one foe and the flesh around the wound stiffens toward stone, slowing them for a few turns.

You cock your feathered head and peck, quick as a hen at grain, and it's barely a scratch, but they look down at it and see the skin around it going grey, a little ring of stone, then a bigger one, crawling outward from the wound like frost across a window, and the arm it's on starts going stiff and heavy and cold.
[Trait: Cockatrice Basilisk]

abilities.name: Stone Shell
abilities.info:
What it does: you harden your shell to stone; blows against you do little harm for a few turns.

You tuck your legs in and your shell dulls and roughens, stone spreading across it, and when they hit you it's like hitting a boulder, their arms jarring, their weapons skidding, and you sit there in your rock shell clacking at them.
[Trait: Stone Crab]

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.info:
What it does: harden the patch of hide where a blow is about to land: that hit is mostly turned aside.

You see it coming and your skin knows it too, a grey ripple running across the spot it's aimed at, the scales going cold and dull and heavy, and the blow lands on rock instead of flesh with a sharp crack that shakes their whole arm, and when they pull back there's nothing there but a grey patch already softening back to scale.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stone Skin]

abilities.name: Stone Stand
abilities.info:
You plant and take a blow like a wall.
[Trait: Golem]

abilities.name: Stone Stare
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn one foe to stone.

Your lair is full of the ones who came before, and the newest one lifts their torch and finds your eyes, and the stone starts in their eyes, so they can't even look away, a dry crackle spreading down through the cheeks into an open mouth, the tongue going to gravel halfway through a word, and their torch keeps burning in a grey fist, lighting up a face that will be begging forever.
[Trait: Petrifier]

abilities.name: Stone Stomach
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day nothing you eat or breathe can poison or sicken you, and disease can't take hold.

The fever comes for you and finds nothing to grab, the poison goes down and stays down, the rot in the air goes in and comes out again, and while everyone else is retching and shaking you're sitting there eating.
[Trait: Trained Endure VI]

abilities.name: Stone Stride
abilities.info:
What it does: you run through the foes near you and every peck stiffens; each foe you pass is hurt and slowed.

You go through them at a sprint, ducking and weaving, pecking left and right, and every time your beak lands the grey blooms in the wound, an arm here, a leg there, a cheek, and by the time you're out the other side they're all stumbling and creaking with patches of stone spreading on them.
[Trait: Cockatrice Stonerunner]

abilities.name: Stone Wings
abilities.info:
What it does: glide and dive on heavy stone wings: drop on a foe from above with all your weight, knocking them flat and badly hurting them.

You drop from your perch and those stone wings crack open, heavy and grinding, and you fall and fall and swoop, picking up speed every heartbeat, a grey shape coming out of the sky with the wind howling over you, and you hit them with the whole weight of yourself in stone and the both of you go down into a crater of broken earth.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Stone Wings]

abilities.name: Stony Gaze
abilities.info:
What it does: you stare into one foe's eyes and their limbs grow heavy and stiff; they're slowed for a few turns.

Your yellow eyes catch theirs and hold, unblinking, and they feel it start in their fingers, a stiffness, a weight, their knuckles going pale and grey at the edges, and the harder they try to look away the harder it is to move at all, every joint grinding like rusted hinges, while you smile and keep looking.
[Trait: Basilisk Lamia]

abilities.name: Stoop
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive on prey from a height; your strike lands hard and knocks them down.

You spot them from so high up they're just a moving dot, and you fold your wide wings tight against your body and drop, faster and faster, the wind howling past your keen eyes, and you open your wings at the last instant and hit them talons first with everything the fall gave you behind it.
[Trait: Wyvern Skyhunter]

abilities.name: Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: call a storm of your power over a wide area: every foe in it is hit, then hit again next turn.

You lift your face and your arms to the sky and it pours up out of you into the sky and comes back down over everything, a storm of your own power hammering the ground for as far as you can see.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VII]

abilities.name: Storm Call
abilities.info:
What it does: for three turns a storm hangs over the fight; each turn lightning strikes a foe of your choice from the sky for heavy damage.
The sky goes dark over you in the middle of the day, the clouds churn and thicken and the air goes heavy, the hair rises on every neck round you, then the first bolt comes down out of nowhere onto the one you chose and they all look up, and every roll of thunder after is another one of them struck and thrown down, the storm itself answering you.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Storm Call]

abilities.name: Storm Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive through a storm's lightning; one foe is struck by your fall and the lightning that rides with you.

You fly up into the heart of the storm and let the lightning find you, crackling over your stone body, and then you dive out of the clouds with it still clinging to you, and you hit them in a flash and a boom, stone and lightning together.
[Trait: Gargoyle Storm-Wing]

abilities.name: Storm Front
abilities.info:
What it does: you drag a storm over the battlefield; wind, rain and lightning batter your foes for a few turns.

You fly a wide circle over the field and the clouds follow you, piling up black and heavy behind your tail, and then you dive and drag the storm down with you, rain lashing sideways, wind ripping cloaks and packs away, lightning cracking down on the field again and again, and you ride the middle of it with your wings spread wide.
[Trait: Tempest Wyvern]

abilities.name: Storm Hunt
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a storm over the area and hunt inside it; foes can't see through the rain and you strike with lightning at any one who breaks for cover.

The clouds roll in black and low on your howl and you vanish into them, and then the hunt is on, thunder growling from every direction like a pack closing in, rain coming down so hard they can't see their own hands, and every time one of them breaks for cover the sky splits and you come down with the lightning, teeth first, right where they thought they'd be safe.
[Trait: Thunder Wolf]

abilities.name: Storm Ride
abilities.info:
What it does: you ride a storm across the sky with your herd, striking the foes below with lightning wherever it passes.

Black clouds boil up behind you as you take off and your herd rises into them on beating wings, the storm moving with you across the sky like one more herd, rain hammering down, lightning forking out of its belly wherever you point, and the ones on the ground run from shadow to shadow trying to keep out from under it, but a storm that goes wherever its khan goes always catches up.
[Trait: Sky Khan]

abilities.name: Storm Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: you scream down a gale with lightning in it; foes are battered by wind and struck by lightning for a few turns.

You stand with your feathers whipping and scream at the sky, and the sky screams back, black clouds tearing in from nowhere, wind howling all around, lightning cracking down on everything below, and you ride the gusts above it all cackling as the storm you called smashes them flat.
[Trait: Harpy Storm-Crone]

abilities.name: Storm Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a storm over the area; foes and ships are battered and struck by lightning for a few turns.

You spread your storm-dark wings and sing, and the song has thunder in it, and the sky goes black and the sea goes white, waves crashing over the decks, wind ripping the sails to rags, lightning splitting the masts, and you sit in the middle of it on your rock, singing louder.
[Trait: Siren Tempest-Witch]

abilities.name: Strider Rush
abilities.info:
What it does: you rush one foe at a sprint and peck; your strike lands hard and the wound stiffens.

You put your head down and run, those long legs eating the ground, crowing as you come, and before they can get a guard up you're on them and your beak stabs down once, and the skin around the peck stiffens into slate as you dart away.
[Trait: Cockatrice Strider]

abilities.name: Strike from Nowhere
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns each hit you land lets you slip back out of sight, and every hit from hiding lands harder.

You hit and vanish and hit and vanish, never in the same place twice, every blow coming from somewhere new, and they're spinning in circles screaming at the dark while you take them apart.
[Trait: Trained Stalk V]

abilities.name: Stronghold
abilities.info:
What it does: turn a camp or home into a stronghold for a while: every defender there fights harder and raids are beaten off more easily.

Walls on walls, killing ground in front of the gate, a way out the back nobody knows, and every defender knows where to stand, and the place becomes a thing nobody wants to attack.
[Trait: Trained Build VII]

abilities.name: Stunning Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and the foes near you are stunned for a turn.

You rear up out of the dirt and howl, and it goes off inside their skulls, birds dropping out of the trees, glass cracking, and everyone around you is knocked flat on their backs with their eyes rolled up and their limbs twitching.
[Trait: Mandrake Howler]

abilities.name: Sudden Growth
abilities.info:
What it does: you force a growth for one fight, a horn, a spur, a plate of hide or a hooked claw, and it lasts until the fight ends.

Your skin prickles, then splits, and something shoves up out of you with a wet crack, bone sliding out through the meat of your arm into a hooked spur, hide thickening over your shoulders in rough plates, and it hurts like hell and you don't care, because it's sharp and it's yours and it's pointed at them.
[Trait: Wildgrowth]

abilities.name: Sun Goes Out
abilities.info:
What it does: your gathered flocks block out the light; for a few turns the area below is dark, and foes in it fight blind.

You call them all up together and they rise off every cliff on the coast and come wheeling in, thousands, until there are so many of them overhead the sun goes out, and down below it's night in the middle of the day and full of screaming.
[Trait: Harpy Queen]

abilities.name: Sunflare
abilities.info:
What it does: you flare with the light of the sun; foes near you are blinded and burned.

You rise up into the air and your tiny body shines, brighter, brighter, too bright to look at, and then you flare, light pouring out of you, and they scream as it sears their eyes white and blisters their skin, and the shadows on the field vanish completely.
[Trait: Pixie Sun-Sprite]

abilities.name: Swallow
abilities.info:
What it does: you rise out of water and swallow one foe whole; they're held inside you, crushed and drowning, until they cut their way out.

The water under them darkens, then the darkness rises, a mouth as wide as a boat, and it closes over them with a crunch, and the crew at the rail watch the sea go flat and then watch one arm, just the arm, bob back up to the surface beside the hull.
[Trait: Sharkfolk Megalodon]

abilities.name: Swallow Light
abilities.info:
What it does: drown everything around you in darkness so thick torches can't push into it; for several turns only you can see inside it.

You breathe out and it pours out of you, black and thick and cold, rolling across the floor and up the walls and over the torches, which gutter and shrink to little orange dots that light nothing at all, and inside it there's only breathing, theirs, fast and panicked, and the soft sound of you moving between them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Swallow Light]

abilities.name: Swallow the Cave
abilities.info:
What it does: you fill a whole cavern with digesting growth; every foe inside is held and dissolved for the rest of the fight.

You let yourself go and you fill the cavern, slime and fungus pouring from wall to wall and floor to ceiling, swallowing stalagmites and bones and the foes who couldn't get to the door in time, and they hang suspended in you, kicking slower and slower as you digest the lot.
[Trait: Ooze-Fungus Mother]

abilities.name: Swallow the Dying
abilities.info:
What it does: absorb from every creature dying around you at once: you heal for each one that falls this turn.

All around you things are dying and you can feel each one go, and you open up wide and pull, and they all come to you at once, a rush of warmth that closes your wounds and sets your eyes burning.
[Trait: Trained Absorb V]

abilities.name: Swallow the Light
abilities.info:
What it does: darkness fills the area for three turns; every foe in it is blinded and takes shadow damage each turn, and you can see through it.
The light round you thins and fades until there's none left, a dark so complete they can't see their own hands, and out of it come whispers from every side at once, they swing at nothing, they call out names, and every time one of them goes quiet it's because you got there first.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Shadow: Swallow the Light]

abilities.name: Swallow Whole
abilities.info:
What it does: you swallow one foe whole; they're held inside you, crushed and digesting, until they cut their way out.

The ground in front of them opens up, and up, and up, a ringed mouth wide enough to swallow a house rising out of the earth with teeth turning in it, and it comes down over them, and the last their friends see is a hand clawing at the rim as the rings grind shut, and the last they hear is a muffled thumping from somewhere under their feet that slows, and slows.
[Trait: Rockworm Leviathan]

abilities.name: Swallowing Hall
abilities.info:
What it does: you close a corridor on intruders; they're crushed and held as the walls close in.

They walk down the corridor and it's a corridor, damp walls, flickering torches, a door at the end, and halfway along the torches go out, and the walls sweat, and breathe, and the floor goes soft and the ceiling comes down to meet it, and they're running, and the door at the end keeps moving further away.
[Trait: Corridor Mimic]

abilities.name: Swamp Awakens
abilities.info:
What it does: you wake the whole swamp; roots, water and spirits rise against your foes for the rest of the fight.

You wade out into the deepest pool and sink until the water covers your head, and the swamp goes quiet, then the water boils, and everything comes alive at once, roots ripping up out of the mud to grab ankles, the marsh surging up in grasping waves, and the ghosts of the marsh rising pale out of the mist to drag the living down into the cold green deep.
[Trait: Swamp Elder]

abilities.name: Swamp Call
abilities.info:
What it does: you call up swamp mist and a cloud of biting insects around one foe; they're blinded and harried for a few turns.

Your feathered crest lifts and rattles and you hum low in your throat, a low drone, and the marsh hums back, mist curling up off the water and thickening around them, and out of it comes the swarm, midges and mosquitoes and fat black biting flies, into their eyes and ears and up their noses until they're swatting at the air and weeping with it.
[Trait: Lizardfolk Shaman]

abilities.name: Swamp Muster
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every marsh tribe to war; lizardfolk warriors rise out of the water and fight for you for the rest of the battle.

You bang the great drum made of a dead crocodile's hide, slow, three times, and the sound rolls out across the swamp for miles, and from every stilt village and reed island the warriors come, sliding into the water and swimming without a sound, and then the marsh in front of the enemy rises up dripping, raised weapons and cold yellow eyes as far as anyone can see.
[Trait: Lizard King]

abilities.name: Swarm Hex
abilities.info:
What it does: you curse a whole group with bad luck for a few turns.

You spin in a circle over their heads, tiny and terrible, scattering red dust from your wings and chanting in a thin whining voice, and the curse settles over all of them at once, gear snapping, feet slipping, blows going wide and hitting each other, every one of them suddenly the unluckiest soul alive.
[Trait: Imp-Pixie Hexqueen]

abilities.name: Swarm of Pranks
abilities.info:
What it does: you send a swarm of pixies to harry your foes; they're tripped, robbed, blinded and distracted for a few turns.

You whistle and the air fills, hundreds of pixies pouring up out of the flowers in a glittering cloud and diving on them, pulling hair, tying laces, stealing purses, flicking sparks, stuffing beetles down collars, until your enemies are flailing and spinning and slapping at the air and can't fight anything.
[Trait: Pixie Mischief-Lord]

abilities.name: Swarm Order
abilities.info:
Give an order antfolk take as the hive's; workers nearby do it without a word.
[Trait: The Hive: Gallery Warden]

abilities.name: Swarm the Tunnels
abilities.info:
What it does: you send every kobold in the warren through the tunnels at once; they burst out on every side of your foes and swarm them.

You ring the stolen-spoon bell three times and every tunnel in the warren rattles with tiny claws, hundreds of kobolds pouring through passages too small for anything else, and then the walls and floors and ceiling all around your enemies burst open at once, little scaled bodies spilling out of every hole, yipping and stabbing and pulling them down by the ankles.
[Trait: Warren King]

abilities.name: Sweeten It
abilities.info:
What it does: throw in something small to close a deal that was going cold: the other side agrees.

You can see it slipping, their eyes drifting off, their hand drawing back, so you dig in your pack and put something small and shiny on top of the pile and slide it all back across without a word, and their hand closes on the deal before their head's caught up.
[Trait: Trained Barter II]

abilities.name: Swollen Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you burst a swelling on your body and spores cover the ground; you heal, and the fallen near you rot faster for the brood.

You squeeze and something on your side bursts with a wet pop and the spores come out of it in a puff and settle everywhere, and the fallen around you start fuzzing over grey, and you feel stronger as the rot starts feeding back into you.
[Trait: Fungal Rat-Mother]

abilities.name: Swoop
abilities.info:
You drop on prey from above.
[Trait: Harpy]

abilities.name: Sylph Gale
abilities.info:
Blast foes back with a sudden wind.
[Trait: Soul of the Sylph]

abilities.name: Table Manners
abilities.info:
Make a room full of monsters back down without a fight: one look that says the Table is behind you.
[Trait: The Big Table: Hanger-On]

abilities.name: Tail and Fang
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting and bite one foe at the same moment; they're poisoned twice over and badly hurt.

They watch your heads, everybody watches the heads, and while they're dodging the snapping jaws the scorpion tail curled up among your necks is already moving, and the bite and the sting land at the same moment, one from the front and one from above, and two different poisons start fighting over their blood.
[Trait: Scorpion Hydra]

abilities.name: Tail Venom
abilities.info:
What it does: lash out with a venomous tail sting: the foe is poisoned and crippled, their limbs going weak and heavy for several turns.

Your tail whips over your shoulder and the barb punches in and out again with a wet tick, and for a moment there's nothing, and then the arm it hit goes heavy and dead and the poison runs up into the shoulder and down into the legs and they stagger and fold up, sweating, trying to lift a hand that won't come up.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Tail Venom]

abilities.name: Talk Them Down
abilities.info:
What it does: calm one angry, frightened or hostile creature: they stop and listen instead of attacking.

You keep talking, low and slow and steady, never moving your hands, never raising your voice, never looking away, and bit by bit the fight goes out of their shoulders and their breathing slows and they start listening.
[Trait: Trained Talk III]

abilities.name: Talon Rake
abilities.info:
What it does: you swoop past one foe and rake them with your talons, then climb out of reach.

You come screeching down out of the sky with your scarred face twisted in a grin, wings tucked, and pass them so close they feel the wind of you, and your hooked feet lash out on the way by, opening four red lines across their back, and you're already beating back up into the sky before they've turned round.
[Trait: Harpy Raider]

abilities.name: Talon Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing and strike with your talons; one foe is dazed by the song and raked as you dive.

You sing one sweet note from the sky and they look up at the sound, and they're still looking up, smiling, when your talons hit them, raking down their face and chest, and you're back in the air singing again before the smile has even left their face.
[Trait: Harpy Siren]

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.info:
What it does: goad one foe until they lose their head: for a few turns they attack only you, recklessly, and are easier to hit.

You call them something nasty and specific and very true about their mother and their face and the way they fight, and you see it land, their eyes going wide and red, and they come at you screaming with everything forgotten except getting their hands on you.
[Trait: Trained Trick IV]

abilities.name: Tear Loose
abilities.info:
What it does: you run and the storm runs with you; for a few turns a howling wind follows you, knocking foes near your path off their feet.

You take off and the storm takes off with you, the trees bending double, the leaves tearing loose and whipping round you, and everyone you run past gets the wind full in the face and goes over, tumbling, while you're already far away.
[Trait: Tempest Wolf]

abilities.name: Teeth of Lightning
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite with lightning in your teeth; the foe takes lightning damage on top of the bite and is stunned for a turn.

Your jaws crackle and spark as you open them and the smell of the storm comes out of your mouth, and you bite down and the lightning goes into them along your teeth, and they lock up rigid with every hair on end and their eyes rolled back.
[Trait: Thunder Wolf]

abilities.name: Tempest
abilities.info:
What it does: you call a storm down over the field; wind, rain and lightning batter your foes for a few turns.

You rise off the ground and the weather changes, the sky going black, the wind coming up howling out of every direction at once, rain hammering down sideways, and you rise up into the middle of it with your hair streaming and lightning running down your arms, a storm that's found a body to wear.
[Trait: Sylph Tempest]

abilities.name: Temple Court
abilities.info:
What it does: you hold court in your temple; guests inside cannot leave without your word, and they must answer you.

You coil up on the great stone seat at the end of the hall with incense smoke curling round you, and you smile at your guests, and the doors swing shut behind them with a boom that echoes down the long room, and they find they can't make their feet walk back toward them, can't make their mouths lie to you, and there they'll stay until the queen of the temple says they may go.
[Trait: Lamia Temple-Queen]

abilities.name: Temple Stance
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the stance the monks carve on their walls; for a few turns you parry or turn aside almost every blow.

You set your feet and raise your arms into the stance, the one carved into every temple wall, and you hold it, and every blow that comes at you is met by an edge and turned aside, again, and again, and again.
[Trait: Mantid Blade-King]

abilities.name: Ten Rays
abilities.info:
What it does: you fire every eye at once; every foe in sight is struck by a ray, and many fall.

Your stalks all spread out at once and every eye opens wide and glows, and then they all fire together, a storm of beams of every colour stabbing out across the battlefield, burning and freezing and unmaking and cursing, and wherever they cross the shrieks begin and end in the same breath.
[Trait: Gazer Overlord]

abilities.name: Tentacle Grab
abilities.info:
What it does: you seize one foe with your tentacles; they're held and dragged toward your jaws.

Grey arms come out of the water first, thick and grey and sucker-lined, curling round their legs, their waist, their arms, and they're pulled off their feet, and dragged, kicking, toward the water where both your sets of jaws are waiting open.
[Trait: Shark-Kraken]

abilities.name: Terrifying Presence
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns weaker foes near you are frightened: they fight badly and may break and flee.

You let something out of you that's been sitting quietly the whole time, and every creature near you feels it at once, and the weak ones go white and look at the way out.
[Trait: Trained Command VI]

abilities.name: The Deal of a Lifetime
abilities.info:
What it does: once a week, make one trade that goes about as well as a trade can go; the other side still leaves happy.

You sit down across from them and everything goes right, every word, every pause, every offer, and when you stand up you've got far more than you came for and they're thanking you.
[Trait: Trained Barter VIII]

abilities.name: The Forest Rises
abilities.info:
What it does: you make the whole forest rise and fight for you; trees walk, roots strike and the wood swallows your foes for the rest of the fight.

You close your eyes and breathe in through your nose and the forest breathes with you, and when you open them every tree is opening its own, bark splitting into knotholes that blink, roots tearing free of the soil, and the wood rises up groaning and creaking and walks, trees stepping over trees, branches reaching, the ground opening to swallow foes whole, the forest rising in a tide of bark and leaf around them.
[Trait: Forest Bear]

abilities.name: The Halls Change
abilities.info:
What it does: you rearrange your maze in moments; you and your allies are moved to where you want to be, and foes are cut off from each other.

You let yourself get angry and the maze gets angry with you, the walls grinding, the halls shifting, doors that were there aren't there any more and new ones open where you want them, and when it stops your foes are each standing alone in a different dead end.
[Trait: Labyrinth King]

abilities.name: The Kill Leap
abilities.info:
What it does: a long leap onto a foe below or ahead of you that lands with your full weight behind every claw and tooth.

You come off the high ground in one long arc with everything out, claws, teeth, all of it, and the whole of your weight and speed lands on them at once and they go down under it and don't get up.
[Trait: Trained Hunt VII]

abilities.name: The Last Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: you scream your full scream; everything around you falls, weak foes die and the rest are crippled.

The story goes that this scream ended a kingdom, and nobody has ever been brave enough to dig you up and find out, until now, and you rip yourself up out of the ground and open your mouth all the way, and the scream that comes out shatters stone and bursts eyes and brings birds down dead from the sky for a mile, and everything that hears it falls.
[Trait: Last Scream Mandrake]

abilities.name: The Long Wait
abilities.info:
What it does: lie in wait for as long as it takes without moving, eating or sleeping; the strike that ends it is deadly.

You lie there through the day and the night and the next day, still as a stone, while the bugs crawl over you and the rain soaks you through, and when it finally comes all of that waiting goes into one strike.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VII]

abilities.name: The Night They Heard
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak outside someone's door at night; they believe your warning or your threat completely, and act on it.

You drift outside their window and speak to them through it, low and cold, and they know the story, they've heard about the night you came for their family, and every word you say goes into them and stays there.
[Trait: Long Night Banshee]

abilities.name: The Old Senses
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day you sense everything around you: every living thing, every hidden thing, every trap within a long way.

You open every sense you've got all the way and the whole world pours in, every heartbeat, every buried thing, every breath held behind a wall, and none of it can hide from you today.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VIII]

abilities.name: The Oldest Are Afraid
abilities.info:
What it does: ancient and deep creatures fear you; weaker monsters won't fight you, and even strong ones hesitate.

You rise up out of the deep and the oldest things in the dungeon draw back from you, the ones that were there before the dungeon was, and if they're afraid of you, everything else is too.
[Trait: Abyss Shade]

abilities.name: The Stories Bring Them
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread word of a treasure you guard; within days adventurers and the greedy come looking, right into your reach.

You let a little coin roll out of you into the hall and a rumour roll out after it, gold, gems, a vault nobody's found, and it travels, and within days they're coming down the stairs with their lamps and their sacks, right into you.
[Trait: Treasure-Vault Mimic]

abilities.name: The Trap Closes
abilities.info:
What it does: lure foes onto ground you have set up: when they get there, a trap you prepared hits all of them at once.

You back away like you're beaten and they come after you grinning, right over the patch you scuffed up earlier, right under the thing you loosened, and you give one little tug and all of it happens at once and they're under it.
[Trait: Trained Trick VII]

abilities.name: The Wood Awakens
abilities.info:
What it does: you wake every tree in the wood to fight; branches strike, roots grab and trees walk against your foes for the rest of the fight.

When they cut you the forest feels it, every leaf shivering, and then the forest wakes, bark splitting into angry faces, roots tearing loose from the soil, branches swinging down, and the trees walk, crowding in on your enemies from every side until there's no sky left above them, only wood, and the wood is furious.
[Trait: Forest Dryad]

abilities.name: Thick Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: for a while cold and light blows barely touch you: small hits, scratches and freezing weather do little or nothing.

You hunch your big shoulders and your fur stands up thick, and the little ones dart in and cut at you and their hits just skid through the fur and the fat and the hide underneath without finding anything, while the snow builds up on your back and you never shiver once, you turn your big head and look down at them.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Thick Hide]

abilities.name: Thicken the Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: strengthen one room or wall of a home or camp: it stands up far better to attack.

You go over the whole thing slow, a second layer of stone behind the first, braces where it sags, the soft spot packed and rammed hard, and when the raid comes they throw themselves at it all night and in the morning it's still standing.
[Trait: Trained Build IV]

abilities.name: Third Eye
abilities.info:
What it does: see through darkness and simple illusions as if they weren't there; hidden doors, disguises and tricks of light don't fool you.

A third eye opens in your forehead, wet and slow, and the world shifts, the dark going see-through, the pretty glamour on the stranger's face peeling back to what's underneath, the wall with the door in it suddenly showing the door, and you blink the other two eyes shut and just watch with the one.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Third Eye]

abilities.name: Thorn Guard
abilities.info:
What it does: you grow thorns that cut whoever strikes you for a few turns.

Bark creeps thicker over your arms and down your sides, and with a creak the thorns push out of it, long and black and wicked, all along your forearms and shoulders, and the first fool who hits you pulls back with their hand full of holes and their knuckles torn open.
[Trait: Dryad Guardian]

abilities.name: Thought Spores
abilities.info:
What it does: you share orders with allies by spore; your group acts together perfectly this turn without a word spoken.

The gills under your broad cap pulse and a faint shimmer of spores drifts out over your friends, and suddenly they know, all of them, what you're thinking, who goes left, who goes right, when to strike, and they move together without a word.
[Trait: Myconid Cap-Elder]

abilities.name: Thoughts That Aren't Theirs
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe who has breathed your spores turns on their own side for a turn, believing it's their own idea.

You think it at them, quietly, and the spores in their head carry it in, and they suddenly know, they just know, that the one beside them is the enemy, and they turn and swing at their friend with total conviction.
[Trait: Mind-Spore Gazer]

abilities.name: Thousand Blows
abilities.info:
What it does: for one turn you move faster than anything can see: one foe takes a storm of hits too fast to count.

You breathe in and you go and there's nothing to see, just the sound, a long rattling drum roll of hits landing faster than the ear can split them up, and when you go still again they stay up for a second, and then they're not.
[Trait: Trained Strike VIII]

abilities.name: Thousand Caps
abilities.info:
What it does: every mushroom near you puffs its spores at your word; foes in the area are dazed and choking for a turn.

You lift your cap and every mushroom in the cave leans toward you, and then they all puff at once, a thousand little clouds, and the air fills thick and gold and choking, and everyone not of the colony is coughing and staggering.
[Trait: Myconid King]

abilities.name: Thousand Cuts
abilities.info:
What it does: you cut a foe a hundred times in a blink; each nick is small but together they bleed them badly and slow them.

You stop dancing and just stand there in front of them, perfectly still, tail curled, and for a moment they think you've given up, then you blur, and the air around them fills with a hissing like rain on a hot roof, and when you're standing still again a step away they look down at a body crossed with a thousand fine red lines, each one barely a scratch, all of them bleeding at once.
[Trait: Catfolk Swordmaster]

abilities.name: Thousand Edges
abilities.info:
What it does: you cut every foe around you at once.

They surround you, a ring of them, all coming in together, and for a moment you're perfectly still in the centre, and then you're not, a flicker, a hiss, a single breath of wind, and you're still again in the same spot, and every one of them in the ring staggers and falls with a cut across them they never saw.
[Trait: Mantid Blade-King]

abilities.name: Thousand Shapes
abilities.info:
What it does: you change into any shape you have ever eaten, mid-fight, taking its body and its abilities.

They swing at a wolf and hit a troll, they run from a troll and it's a harpy above them, they shoot at the harpy and it's a slime on the ground, and you shift and pour and change between every meal you've ever had, never the same twice, and they can't land a hit on something that won't stay one thing.
[Trait: Every-Shape Mimic]

abilities.name: Thrall Order
abilities.info:
What it does: you command your servants; your bound followers obey you without question and fight harder for a few turns.

You snap your fingers once and every servant you have hears it, in their heads, and they come, shuffling up out of the cellars and down from the towers with empty eyes, and they do exactly what you tell them, and they fight like dying for you is the best thing that ever happened to them.
[Trait: Vampire Count]

abilities.name: Threaten
abilities.info:
What it does: frighten one creature with words: a weaker one does as you say or backs down.

You lean in close, too close, and tell them very quietly and very slowly exactly what's going to happen to them if they don't, and you don't blink once the whole time, and when you're done they don't argue.
[Trait: Trained Talk II]

abilities.name: Three Bites
abilities.info:
What it does: you lunge and bite three times at once; one foe takes three wounds, or three foes take one each.

Your three heads argue all the way over, snapping at each other about who gets the first bite, and then they all lunge together, one going high, one going low, one going for the middle, and three sets of jaws close on them at once from three directions, and they don't know which way to fall.
[Trait: Swamp Hydra]

abilities.name: Three Heads, One Gate
abilities.info:
What it does: your three heads watch three ways; for the rest of the fight nothing gets behind you and you see every attack coming.

Your three heads turn three ways, left, right and ahead, and every one of them is watching, and there's no angle they can come at you from that one of those heads isn't already snarling at.
[Trait: Three-Headed Hellhound]

abilities.name: Through Walls
abilities.info:
What it does: you see through stone, walls and doors; you can see what's on the other side as if they weren't there.

You turn your central eye toward the wall and it goes glassy, then clear, and you look right through the stone into the next room, and the one after that, the guards playing dice, the treasure under the floor, the ambush waiting behind the door.
[Trait: Gazer Seer]

abilities.name: Throw Down
abilities.info:
What it does: lift or sweep one foe your size or smaller and slam them to the ground: they are hurt and left lying down.

You get under them and heave, their feet leaving the ground, their arms grabbing at nothing, and you bring them over and down flat on their back so hard the dust jumps, and they lie there gaping like they've forgotten how breathing works.
[Trait: Trained Fight II]

abilities.name: Thrown Point
abilities.info:
What it does: throw something sharp or heavy at one foe out of reach: a quick, accurate hit from range.

Your hand goes back and snaps forward and whatever you were holding is gone, spinning through the air, and it finds them right where you were looking before the sound of the throw reaches them.
[Trait: Trained Strike III]

abilities.name: Thumb on the Scale
abilities.info:
What it does: one trade or deal swings your way: the other side takes the worse price and thinks it was their idea. Rolls barter.

You let them talk first, nodding along like it's a fair offer, then pick at the one thing they're worried about until it's all they can think of, and by the time you finally name your number they're grabbing at it before you can change your mind.
[Trait: Haggler]

abilities.name: Thunder Crow
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow thunder that staggers the foes near you; they're knocked down and deafened for a turn.

You flap up into the storm and crow, and the crow comes out as thunder, a boom so loud it shakes the stones, and it knocks them flat and leaves them deaf and bleeding from the ears.
[Trait: Storm Cockatrice]

abilities.name: Thunder Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive as a bolt of lightning; one foe is blasted and those near them shocked.

You circle once in the black clouds, a hawk made of storm, and then you fold your wings and fall, and as you fall you become the lightning, a jagged white bolt with a hawk's shape inside it, and the thunder and the strike come at the same instant, blowing them apart.
[Trait: Thunderhawk Sylph]

abilities.name: Thunder Howl
abilities.info:
What it does: you howl and thunder cracks down over a group in front of you; they're knocked flat and deafened for a turn.

You plant your feet and throw your head back and the fur along your spine stands up crackling, the air goes heavy and sharp like the breath before a storm, and when the howl finally tears out of you the sky answers it, thunder cracking down so close the ground jumps and everyone in front of you is flat on their back with their noses streaming red.
[Trait: Gale Wolf]

abilities.name: Thunder Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike as a falling thunderbolt; one foe is blasted and everything near them shaken.

You climb into the black storm until you're lost in it, and then you fall, not diving but falling, a thunderbolt with stone wings, and you hit with a flash so bright it turns night to day and a boom that cracks stone for a mile.
[Trait: Gargoyle Thunderhead]

abilities.name: Thunder Voice
abilities.info:
What it does: you shout and thunder follows your voice; every foe close by is deafened and knocked off balance.

You open your mouth to shout and the thunder that's always following you comes rolling out of it instead, a crack and a boom so loud the ground shakes, and everyone in front of you staggers with their ears ringing and their legs gone.
[Trait: Storm Shaman]

abilities.name: Thunderbird
abilities.info:
What it does: you become the storm itself and strike as lightning; one foe is blasted and those near them shocked.
