Your body goes bright and thin and crackling and any harpy who sees it drops to its face, because this is what they built their shrines for, and you're not a wyvern anymore but a bird of white lightning spreading wings that cross the sky, and you fold them and dive, and the strike lands with a sound like the world splitting.
[Trait: Thunderbird Wyvern]

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.info:
What it does: a crack of thunder from your hands: every foe close by is deafened and stunned for a turn.
You bring your hands together and the sound of it isn't a clap, it's thunder, right there in the middle of them, so loud it's a blow, and they all go reeling with their hands over their ears and their eyes rolling.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Thunderclap]

abilities.name: Thundering Herd
abilities.info:
What it does: you lead every rider at your back in one charge across open ground; foes in its path are run down and the rest scatter.

You raise your arm and a thousand riders behind you fall silent, and in that silence they can already hear it, a low drumming under the earth, then you drop your arm and the herd breaks into a gallop, the noise so huge it stops being a sound and becomes something they feel in their ribs, and the grass sea turns into a sea of hooves and dust and there's nothing left for them but to be under it.
[Trait: Centaur Warchief]

abilities.name: Thunderstorm
abilities.info:
What it does: call a full storm over the fight for three turns: each turn several foes are struck by lightning from the sky and stunned.
The sky above you boils dark in the space of a breath and the wind comes up howling and the first bolt hits before anybody's even looked up, and then they don't stop, bolt after bolt after bolt, the storm itself answering you, the whole sky gone mad with lightning.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Lightning: Thunderstorm]

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a tidal wave; everything in its path is battered, swept away and drowned.

You drive both hands down into the sea and pull upward, and the water runs out first, far out, the seabed lying bare and glistening and quiet, and the ones on the shore have just long enough to look up and see the grey wall standing over them, taller than the cliffs and leaning in, before it comes down and folds everything under, timber and stone and bodies tumbling together in the churn and dragged back out to sea.
[Trait: Merfolk Tide-Lord]

abilities.name: Tide Boss Roar
abilities.info:
Roar the crew into a frenzy; Fins nearby fight harder until the fight ends.
[Trait: The Red Fins: Tide Boss]

abilities.name: Tide Call
abilities.info:
What it does: command the currents: drag a foe under and hold them there, pull them away, or lift yourself and your allies along; needs a body of water nearby.

You lay your hands on the water and feel it, every pull and swirl of it, and then you take hold of it and it does what you say, rising up into a hand that grabs them round the waist and drags them down kicking into the dark, or a wave that lifts you all up and sets you down on the shore laughing.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Tide Call]

abilities.name: Tide Comes and Goes
abilities.info:
What it does: you move the tide; you draw the sea out to bare the floor, or bring it in to flood the shore, for a few turns.

You lift your hands and the sea goes out, far out, the floor of the bay laid bare and gasping, fish flapping, wrecks showing, and then you bring your hands down and it comes back in, all at once, over everything standing on the shore.
[Trait: Merfolk Tide-Lord]

abilities.name: Tide Goes Out
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk into the sea and the water rushes back; foes in the water are dragged off their feet and left stranded.

You walk into the sea and the water pulls away from you, sucking out, further and further, and everything standing in it is dragged off its feet and left sprawled on the wet sand gasping while you stand over them.
[Trait: Crabfolk Titan]

abilities.name: Titan Claw
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush one foe in a giant claw; they're badly hurt and held until they break free.

Your claw comes down out of the sky and closes round them, the whole of them, and lifts them off the ground kicking, and you squeeze, and the claw doesn't care what they're wearing or how strong they are, it just keeps closing with a creak of chitin until something inside them gives.
[Trait: Scorpid Sand-Titan]

abilities.name: Titan Pincer
abilities.info:
What it does: you crush anything in one claw; one foe or object is badly hurt or destroyed.

Your claw comes down out of the sky and closes on them, and nothing in the world could stop it closing, and it doesn't stop, it just keeps closing until it meets itself in the middle.
[Trait: Crabfolk Titan]

abilities.name: Titan's Forge
abilities.info:
What it does: you forge a legendary weapon in your chest; it carries great power for whoever wields it.

You open the great doors in your chest and the heat that rolls out makes the air shimmer for a hundred paces, and you put the metal in and close the doors and stand there for a day and a night with the hammering going on inside you, and when the doors open again the thing on the anvil inside is singing.
[Trait: Forge-Titan]

abilities.name: Titan's Strength
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns your strength doubles: you can lift, throw or break things far past your size, and every hit lands like a falling rock.

It comes up from your gut, a heat that swells every muscle you've got until your skin's stretched tight over them and the veins stand up like ropes, and you take hold of something nobody your size should be able to move and lift it over your head and look around for somewhere to put it.
[Trait: Trained Fight VIII]

abilities.name: Toll of Teeth
abilities.info:
What it does: you demand a toll from anyone crossing your river; they pay in goods, or you take it out of them.

You float there in the middle of the ford with just your eyes and your snout above the water and wait, and when they come to cross you rise up so they can see how long you are, and they stop, and start counting out what they've got.
[Trait: Crocodile King]

abilities.name: Tomb Ward
abilities.info:
What it does: you seal a tomb or door against intruders; it can't be opened while the seal holds.

You press your grey hands flat to the tomb door and whisper the names of the dead inside it, and the stone goes cold, colder, frost spreading over it, and the door seals itself into its frame, stone into stone, and no crowbar, no ram and no key will move it until you say so.
[Trait: Ghoul Tomb-Warden]

abilities.name: Took Their Anchor
abilities.info:
What it does: you pull at something from beneath the water; a boat stops, an anchor is lost, or a foe on the water is pulled off balance.

Something tugs from far below and the boat stops dead in the water, or tips, or the anchor chain runs out and keeps running and snaps, and up above they're staring down into the black water and nobody sees what did it.
[Trait: Trench Lord]

abilities.name: Tool Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: understand human tools, locks, mechanisms and writing at a glance: what a thing is for and how to work it.

You pick it up and turn it over and something old stirs in your head, a dead person's habits waking up in your hands, and suddenly you know what this lever does and where the key goes and what those scratched little marks on the page mean, and the others watch you work it like you've done it every day of your life.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Tool Sense]

abilities.name: Total Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: you put out every light around you; torches, fires and magic lights die, and the dark belongs to you for the rest of the fight.

You breathe in, and every light in the place goes with your breath, torches dying, lanterns going black, the campfire shrinking to embers and then to nothing, even the magic glow on their weapons flickering out, and the dark comes down on them total and absolute, and in it, everywhere at once, is you.
[Trait: Shade Dark-Lord]

abilities.name: Tough Bristles
abilities.info:
What it does: small cuts, thorns and light hits bounce off your bristles; minor wounds don't get through for a while.

Your bristles stand up stiff as wire along your back and down your arms and the brambles snap against them, the little cuts skid off them, and you push through the thorn bushes the rest of the party has to go around, grunting, not a scratch on you.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Tough Bristles]

abilities.name: Tough Hide
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns light hits barely hurt you; scratches and small bites do almost nothing.

You hunch your shoulders and draw everything tight, and the skin across your back and arms thickens and toughens while you breathe, and the little hits start thumping off it, scratches that don't open, bites that don't take, until you stop bothering to block them at all.
[Trait: Trained Endure II]

abilities.name: Tower Lights
abilities.info:
What it does: the drowned cities rise to your call; for a day you and your allies are welcome and safe in any sea-folk place.

You come home and the lights in the towers under the bay burn brighter, and the word goes out to every drowned city, the king is here, and wherever you go under the water for the rest of the day the doors open and the guards salute.
[Trait: Merfolk Sea-King]

abilities.name: Toxic Sweat
abilities.info:
What it does: for three turns your skin sweats poison: anything that grabs, bites or touches you is poisoned.
You break out in a sweat that smells sharp and wrong, and it beads on your skin and runs, and the one who grabs you snatches their hand back with the palm already blistering and their fingers going numb.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Toxic Sweat]

abilities.name: Track by Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: follow a wounded creature anywhere, through water, rock or crowds, until you find it.

There's a drop on a leaf and a smear on a stone and a smell on the wind and you follow them one to the next, steady, patient, through the water, across the rocks, wherever it goes, because something that bleeds can't stop leaving a trail.
[Trait: Trained Hunt IV]

abilities.name: Trade Route
abilities.info:
What it does: set up a regular deal with one trader or camp: they keep goods and terms for you whenever you come back.

You spit in your palm and shake on it, every new moon, this much of this for that much of that, and after that the haggling's done, they keep your share aside and you keep theirs, and the goods come and go between you as steady as the seasons.
[Trait: Trained Barter VII]

abilities.name: Trade Talk
abilities.info:
What it does: talk your way into a deal with a creature who wouldn't normally trade with your kind: they hear you out.

They don't trade with your sort, everybody knows that, and you talk to them anyway about the one thing they need that you've got, and they put down whatever they were holding to listen.
[Trait: Trained Barter IV]

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.info:
What it does: you gallop over every foe in your path; they're knocked down and trampled, and the ones still standing scatter.

You don't swerve, you never swerve, you just pick up speed with the bronze plates on your chest rattling, and the first one goes under your front hooves with a crunch you feel in your teeth, the second gets your back ones, and the rest scramble and dive and throw themselves into the mud trying to be anywhere but the strip of torn-up ground you leave behind you.
[Trait: Centaur Charger]

abilities.name: Trap Line
abilities.info:
What it does: lay a run of traps along a path: several foes who come along it are hurt or caught.

You lay them one after another all down the narrow way, a pit, a snare, a dropping log, a spike in the long grass, each one hidden and each one different, and anything that comes down that path is going to have a very bad walk.
[Trait: Trained Build IV]

abilities.name: Treant Crush
abilities.info:
Bring limb-branches down to crush and pin.
[Trait: Soul of the Treant]

abilities.name: Treasure Nose
abilities.info:
What it does: you sniff out hidden treasure, secret doors, loose stones and anything valuable hidden nearby.

Your nose starts twitching the moment you walk in, whiskers forward, and you drift around the room with your head tilted, past the obvious chests without a glance, until you stop at a perfectly ordinary bit of wall and grin, because behind it, faint as perfume, is the smell of old gold and a lock nobody has opened in years.
[Trait: Catfolk Fortune-Seeker]

abilities.name: Tree Step
abilities.info:
What it does: you step into one tree and out of another nearby, unseen between them.

You press your back to an old oak and sink into it like stepping into a warm bath, and the bark closes over your face, and for a moment you're everywhere in the wood at once, and then you step out of a different tree twenty paces behind them, brushing a leaf out of your hair and smiling at the backs of their heads.
[Trait: Fae Grove-Sprite]

abilities.name: Tree Whisper
abilities.info:
What it does: you hear what the trees have heard; you learn what passed nearby and what was said in the forest.

You lean your crown down close to an old birch and listen, and it whispers to you in a rustle of leaves, and the oak next to it joins in, then the beech, then the rest of the wood, every tree passing along what it saw and heard, until you know who walked through the forest last night, what they carried and what they said around their fire.
[Trait: Treant Sage]

abilities.name: Trembling March
abilities.info:
What it does: you march and the ground trembles; foes near you are knocked off their feet every turn for a few turns.

You march and every step is a thump that goes down into the ground and comes back up everywhere, and the ones near you can't keep their feet, stumbling and falling over and over while the runes on your plates glow brighter.
[Trait: Rune Ant Colossus]

abilities.name: Tremor Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: you feel footsteps through stone; you know where every creature on the ground nearby is, even in total darkness.

You press your wide pale claws flat to the tunnel floor and go still, and the rock starts talking to you, the soft pat of a bare foot two passages over, the scrape of a boot heel behind a pillar, the heavy shuffle of something big in the dark ahead, every step a ripple you can feel in your belly.
[Trait: Cave Basilisk]

abilities.name: Trench Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike from the dark water below; your first strike lands hard and you drag one foe down.

They're swimming on the surface, legs kicking in the green water, and they never look down, nobody ever looks down, and far below in the black something is rising, quicker than they can kick, and you come up out of the deep with your jaws open and take them by the legs and they're gone.
[Trait: Abyss Hunter]

abilities.name: Tribe's Fury
abilities.info:
What it does: unleash your whole tribe at once: for a few turns every ally fights with savage strength and doesn't feel pain.

You scream it at the sky and they all scream it back, every one of them at once, and the sound of it shakes something loose in them, and they go into the fight together like one great animal that's stopped feeling pain.
[Trait: Trained Command VII]

abilities.name: Tribute
abilities.info:
What it does: you demand tribute from a town, tribe or holding; they pay, in gold or goods, rather than face you.

You land on the hill above their walls and fold your wings and just sit there, looking, and by evening they've sent someone up to you carrying everything they've got, shaking so hard it rattles, asking what it would take.
[Trait: Elder Dragon]

abilities.name: Trickster's Offering
abilities.info:
What it does: you visit a grove or shrine of the hill tribes; they treat you as a god and give you offerings, food, goods or knowledge.

You walk into the grove wearing a face they've been praying to and they fall on their knees, and they bring you everything, their best food, their best goods, their secrets, and you take it all with a little nod and a very straight face.
[Trait: Masked Satyr]

abilities.name: Trident Thrust
abilities.info:
What it does: you drive your point through one foe; they're badly hurt and pinned for a moment.

You come up out of the green water with a flick of your tail that sends you shooting forward, arm drawn back, and you drive your point into them with the speed of the sea behind it, and they're pinned there against the reef, thrashing in a cloud of their own blood.
[Trait: Merfolk Trident-Guard]

abilities.name: Trip
abilities.info:
What it does: hook a foe's legs out from under them: they go down and lose their next action getting up.

You hook a foot or a tail behind their ankle and pull just as they lean in, and their own weight does the rest, down they go flat on their face, and you're standing over them shaking your head.
[Trait: Trained Trick II]

abilities.name: Troll Regeneration
abilities.info:
Close a serious wound in a breath; recover health between blows.
[Trait: Soul of the Troll]

abilities.name: Troll Regrowth
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight you heal heavily every turn and keep standing through wounds that should drop you; only fire and acid stop the healing where they land.

They take a chunk out of you and it doesn't matter, the hole fills while they're still pulling back, muscle twisting and sprouting and binding itself over raw bone with a wet creaking sound, and you shrug off a blow that should've opened you to the spine and keep walking toward them with your new flesh still steaming, and the smart ones start looking around for anything that burns.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Troll Regrowth]

abilities.name: True Lie
abilities.info:
What it does: you tell a lie and the world believes it; for a while it becomes true for everyone who hears it.

You say it with a straight face, the bridge is out, the king is dead, I was never here, and the world blinks, and then the world agrees with you, and the bridge they're standing on is suddenly a ruin and the people who heard you would swear on their children's lives that you were telling the truth, because right now, you are.
[Trait: Fox Liar-King]

abilities.name: Truth of Things
abilities.info:
What it does: learn the hidden truth about one creature, place or thing: its real nature, its secret, its true name.

You look at it long enough, turning it over, listening to it, smelling it, and the pieces fall into place one after another, what it really is under the skin, what it's hiding, and what it was before it was this.
[Trait: Trained Lore VII]

abilities.name: Tug the Thread
abilities.info:
What it does: you tug on one foe's fate; for the rest of the fight their luck turns bad and things keep going wrong for them.

You reach out and pinch something in the air that only you can see and pull it, gently, and they stumble, and their footing goes, and the next thing they reach for isn't where it should be, and from then on nothing goes right for them.
[Trait: Catfolk Fate-Weaver]

abilities.name: Tunnel Ambush
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike from a tunnel you dug beforehand, popping up behind or beneath a foe; your first strike lands hard.

They think the ground under them is solid, why wouldn't it be, but you've been digging under it for days, a warren of tunnels just under the surface, and they stand right on top of one, and the floor erupts beneath them in a shower of dirt and rust-red scales and snapping jaws, and you're on them before the stones have finished falling.
[Trait: Deep Boss]

abilities.name: Tunnel Brace
abilities.info:
Brace a tunnel so it holds when it shouldn't; a cave-in on you comes down slow enough to get clear.
[Trait: The Hive: Tunnel Hand]

abilities.name: Tunnel Network
abilities.info:
What it does: you open tunnels between places you know; you and your allies can travel between them underground.

You drop into the earth and go, and you don't stop, grinding a tunnel wide enough for a wagon straight through the hills, under the rivers, all the way to the place you're thinking of, and when you burst up out of the ground at the other end your friends follow you out blinking in the sunlight a hundred miles from where they started.
[Trait: Great Borer]

abilities.name: Tunnel Sense
abilities.info:
What it does: underground you always know the way back to where you came in, and you can feel which stone is weak, cracked or about to give before anyone touches it.

You press a palm flat to the rock and hold your breath and there it is, a hum coming up through your fingers, faint drips and the groan of weight sitting where it shouldn't, and the whole tunnel draws itself in your head like you'd walked it a hundred times, every turn behind you, every crack in front of you, the soft spot in the ceiling that's waiting for an excuse.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Tunnel Sense]

abilities.name: Turn It Back
abilities.info:
What it does: catch one blast of power aimed at you and throw it back at the one who sent it.

It comes at you and you catch it, actually catch it, the force of it shoving your hands back, and you wrestle it round and send it straight back the way it came.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke VI]

abilities.name: Turn of Fortune
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn a bad moment around; for one key action luck lands on your side instead of the foe's.

You flip a coin up off your thumb and catch it without looking, and the moment it slaps into your palm the world tips your way, their foot comes down on a rolling stone, the rope you're hanging from catches on a nail, the dice in the back room all come up yours, and you grin as fortune turns her head and smiles at you like she always has.
[Trait: Catfolk Lucky Star]

abilities.name: Turn the Boats
abilities.info:
What it does: your shriek from a high place frightens off anything that sees you; weaker foes and travellers turn back rather than come near.

You climb up onto the highest rock where they can all see you and spread your ragged wings and scream, and the sky darkens behind you on cue, and down there they look up and see you and turn round and go back the way they came.
[Trait: Harpy Storm-Crone]

abilities.name: Turn the Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: call the light down on the dead and the dark close by: weaker undead flee or crumble, stronger ones are badly hurt.
You raise your hand and the light comes out of you in a blaze, and every dead thing near you shrieks, and the weak ones fall apart into dust right where they stand while the strong ones stagger back with their bodies smoking.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Holy: Turn the Dead]

abilities.name: Turn the Ground
abilities.info:
What it does: use the ground itself: knock something down on foes, kick a loose rock under their feet, cut a rope; several foes are hurt or knocked down.

You've been looking at it the whole fight, the loose pile, the leaning post, the edge, the rope holding something up, and when they're all standing in the right place you kick it, cut it, shove it, and the whole lot comes down on them at once.
[Trait: Trained Trick VI]

abilities.name: Turn the Tide
abilities.info:
What it does: talk to a whole fighting force on the other side: some of them stop fighting, some switch sides, and the rest waver.

In the middle of the fight you stand up and shout it, why are you dying for them, and it spreads through their ranks, and the fighting slows, and some of them lower their claws.
[Trait: Trained Talk VIII]

abilities.name: Turn Their Weight
abilities.info:
What it does: use a charging or swinging foe's own weight against them: they are thrown off past you and hurt by their own momentum.

They come at you with everything and you don't meet it, you step aside at the last moment and give them a little help on the way past, a hand on the back, a foot in the path, and they keep going right into whatever's behind you, hard.
[Trait: Trained Trick III]

abilities.name: Turn Them
abilities.info:
What it does: talk a foe or an enemy's follower round to your side: a weaker one switches sides for a while.

You talk to them about the one they follow, what they're owed and never been given, who gets the good share and who does the dying, and you watch the doubt set in behind their eyes, and then they're standing beside you.
[Trait: Trained Talk V]

abilities.name: Tusk Gore
abilities.info:
What it does: you drive your tusks into one foe and rip upward, leaving a deep, bleeding wound.

You snort twice and scrape a hoof through the dirt, little eyes going red and small, then you put your head down and hit them low, tusks punching in just above the hip, and with a grunt that comes up from your gut you wrench your neck upward and rip, lifting them off their feet on a spray of blood before you shake them loose into the mud.
[Trait: Boarfolk Tusker]

abilities.name: Tusk Rush
abilities.info:
You put the head down and charge one foe.
[Trait: Boarfolk]

abilities.name: Twin Foxfire
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw two balls of foxfire; they burn the soul of one foe or two, leaving them shaken.

Your two tails flick and a ball of blue fire blooms at the tip of each, flickering and cold and pretty, and you toss them one after the other, and where they hit nothing burns, not a hair, but whoever they touch gasps as something warm is scooped out of them.
[Trait: Two-Tailed Fox]

abilities.name: Twin Scythes
abilities.info:
What it does: you slash twice in one motion; one foe takes two deep cuts.

You stand perfectly still with your scythe-arms folded, and then you unfold, both arms snapping out in a single blurring motion, an X of cuts across their chest so quick they hear it after they feel it, a soft double hiss like silk tearing.
[Trait: Mantid Blademaster]

abilities.name: Two Against One
abilities.info:
What it does: set two foes on each other: with a lie, a shove or a hit at the right moment, they fight each other for a few turns.

You duck out from between them just as one swings and it lands on the other, and you shout something about who did it, and they look at each other with blood up and that's it, they're at each other's throats and you're sitting back watching.
[Trait: Trained Trick VI]

abilities.name: Two Hungers
abilities.info:
What it does: your two heads never sleep at once; you can't be surprised, and you keep watch through any night.

One head sleeps while the other watches, and then they swap, snarling at each other about it, and there's never a moment when both of them are shut, and anything that comes creeping up on you in the night finds one of them already awake.
[Trait: Two-Headed Hellhound]

abilities.name: Tyrant Rush
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge through a group, pecking as you go; every foe you hit begins turning to stone.

You put your huge head down and charge with your comb flaring, a horse-sized rooster with a lizard's tail crashing through them, and your beak goes in and out, in and out, and behind you they're freezing grey one after another, mid-scream, mid-run, a trail of fresh statues marking where you went.
[Trait: Cockatrice Tyrant]

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight you can't be knocked out, stunned or frightened; only death stops you.

Whatever they do to your head it doesn't take, the hits, the screams, the spells, the horrors, all of it slides off something that's set like stone in the middle of you, and you just keep coming.
[Trait: Trained Endure VII]

abilities.name: Uncanny Dodge
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you move before blows land: most attacks on you miss as your body reacts on its own.

You don't decide to move, your body decides for you, a twitch, a lean, a flinch half a heartbeat before the blow is even thrown, and the hits keep sliding past you by a hair while you stand there almost as surprised as they are.
[Trait: Trained Instinct VI]

abilities.name: Under Your Banner
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a wreck and crew it with the drowned; the old crew of a sunk ship fights for you for the rest of the fight.

You clack your claws and the wreck on the bottom shudders and rises, water pouring out of it, and up on the deck the old crew stand up, drowned and grey, and they look to you, and they've got a new captain now.
[Trait: Crabfolk Wreck-King]

abilities.name: Under-Roads
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every hidden way under the town; you and your companions travel anywhere beneath it unseen and come up where you choose.

You lift a grate nobody else ever noticed and drop into the dark, and the under-roads open for you, drains and old cellars and forgotten crypts all running together in a maze only you can read by the smell of the water and the scratches on the bricks, and an hour later you come up through a floorboard in the one room in town they thought was safe.
[Trait: Ratfolk Under-King]

abilities.name: Underfoot
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every tunnel under the ground here; you and your party move through them unseen and come up anywhere in the area.

You stamp twice and a hatch nobody else saw opens up in the floor, and down you all go into the dark, and you lead them through the maze without a torch, left, right, up, down, and you pop up again behind the enemy's camp brushing the dirt off your scales.
[Trait: Deep Boss]

abilities.name: Undermine
abilities.info:
What it does: you dig out the ground under a wall or a foe and let it collapse; walls fall and foes drop into the hole.

You drop to your belly and start digging, picks for claws throwing dirt back between your legs in a spray, faster than any shovel crew, and you tunnel in under their feet quiet as a mole, scooping out the earth that holds them up, and then you scuttle back out and wait, grinning, for the groan and the crack and the crash as the ground gives way and takes them down with it.
[Trait: Kobold Sapper]

abilities.name: Undo the Magic
abilities.info:
What it does: work out how one spell, curse or magic works, and how to break or turn it.

You trace it with your eyes, every thread of it, where it starts and where it's tied off and what's holding it together, and you find the knot at the middle of it and pull, and the whole thing comes apart in your hands.
[Trait: Trained Lore VII]

abilities.name: Undying
abilities.info:
What it does: you will not die; when you fall you get back up with a good share of your strength, once per fight.

They kill you, and they're sure of it, the troll king lying in the mud with a hole through you you could walk a dog through, and they're cheering and slapping each other's backs when the cheering stops, because the mud is moving, and the hole is closing, and you're getting up again, slower, uglier and angrier than before.
[Trait: Troll King]

abilities.name: Unkillable
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns you can't be put down; a blow that should kill you leaves you standing and your wounds start closing at once.

They cut you open from collarbone to hip and you look down at it and grunt, and the edges of the wound are already crawling back together, and they take your arm off and you pick it up and hold it to the stump until it sticks, and they run you through the chest and you just pull it back out and keep coming, slow and steady and wearing them down, because trolls don't die, they just get angrier.
[Trait: Troll Brute]

abilities.name: Unseen Hunter
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight foes can't see you unless you're within reach of them, and you choose who to hit.

You fade back out of the light and stay faded, a shape at the edge of their eye, a breath behind them, never there when they turn, and they fight the dark with nobody to fight while you pick which one to take.
[Trait: Trained Stalk VII]

abilities.name: Unstoppable
abilities.info:
What it does: you go forward and nothing stops you; you can't be knocked down, held or slowed this turn, and whatever is in your way is shoved aside.

You lower your head and just walk, not fast, not slow, one huge step after another, and they throw everything at you, ropes, nets, hands grabbing, bodies throwing themselves in your way, and none of it matters, you plough through it all, dragging half of them along behind you.
[Trait: Ogre Juggernaut]

abilities.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: you charge in a straight line and nothing stops you: walls, barricades and lines of foes are smashed through.

You're the size of a wagon and armoured in your own bone, and once you roll there's no turning you, the first step shakes the ground, the tenth shakes the trees, and by the time you hit their barricade you're a mountain of gristle and hate moving at a gallop, logs exploding into splinters, foes flung left and right, and you keep going through the next line and the one after that.
[Trait: Boarfolk Juggernaut]

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.info:
What it does: you dodge everything for a few breaths; no blow lands on you until the move ends.

You let the wind take you and suddenly you're not where they swing, not where they stab, not where they throw, sliding aside on the air a hair's width from every edge, laughing as their blows cut the wind and nothing else, until they're gasping and red-faced and haven't laid a finger on you.
[Trait: Sylph Sky-Dancer]

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.info:
You ride a gust a little higher and farther.
[Trait: Sylph]

abilities.name: Uproot
abilities.info:
What it does: tear up stone, earth or anything rooted with immense slow strength: rip walls apart, upend the ground under foes, or hurl what you pull up.

You sink your fingers into the earth and they go down like roots, deep, deeper, and you pull, and you keep pulling, slow and patient and unstoppable, and the whole thing comes up out of the earth with a groan you feel in your teeth, stones and soil and whatever was standing on it tipping over and sliding off and crashing down.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Uproot]

abilities.name: Uproot Foe
abilities.info:
What it does: you pick up one foe and hurl them across the field; they're badly hurt where they land.

You reach down with an arm as long as a ship's mast and close your branches around them, and lift them, kicking, up past your crown, and then you swing and let go, and they sail out over the battlefield turning end over end before they come down a long, long way off.
[Trait: Treant Colossus]

abilities.name: Valley of Stone
abilities.info:
What it does: you crow a whole valley's worth of foes toward stone; everyone who hears it begins to petrify.

You spread your vast feathered wings over the valley and crow, and the army in the middle of it runs, and that's the mistake, because the legs set solid mid-stride and the bodies keep going, and the valley fills with the crack and crash of stone as hundreds of grey soldiers snap off at the knee and shatter on the rocks.
[Trait: Cockatrice King]

abilities.name: Vampire Drain
abilities.info:
Bite and drink, healing as the foe weakens.
[Trait: Soul of the Vampire]

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn invisible for a few turns, slipping away or setting up a strike from nowhere.

You mutter a little rhyme nobody would expect out of a mouth that big and fold your hands over your belly, and your edges start to go thin, then see-through, then gone, and a creature the size of a cart just isn't there anymore, and somewhere in the room, close, they can hear heavy breathing and smell old meat.
[Trait: Ogre Mage]

abilities.name: Vanishing Act
abilities.info:
What it does: you vanish and reappear behind a foe; your next strike lands hard.

You blow them a kiss and pop out of sight with a little pop, and they turn around and around looking for you, and the next thing they know there's a tiny weight on their shoulder and a giggle in their ear and something sharp going into the back of their neck.
[Trait: Pixie Trickster]

abilities.name: Vault Trap
abilities.info:
What it does: you become a treasure room and close on everyone inside; they're crushed and held until they break out.

They find the vault at last, the one in all the stories, gold heaped to the ceiling, and they whoop and pile in and start filling their sacks, and the door grinds shut behind them, and the gold slides toward them, and the walls swell in and out, slow and hungry, and the room chews.
[Trait: Treasure-Vault Mimic]

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.info:
What it does: one foe takes poison damage each turn for three turns.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison Magic]

abilities.name: Venom Bite
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe with venomous fangs; they're poisoned and weakened for a few turns.

The chitin plates on your necks clatter as you strike, and your fangs sink in deep and pump, a scorpion's venom pouring into their blood, and the bite throbs and swells purple and black, and the poison crawls through them making their sweat run cold and their vision swim.
[Trait: Venom Hydra]

abilities.name: Venom Blood
abilities.info:
What it does: for the rest of the fight every hit you land poisons, and poison you're already carrying in foes works twice as fast.
Your blood runs thick and hot and wrong now and every hit you land carries some of it in with it, and everything you've already poisoned speeds up, the sickness racing through them, until they're all shaking and grey.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Venom Blood]

abilities.name: Venom Dive
abilities.info:
What it does: you dive out of a storm and sting one foe; the venom cripples them for a few turns.

The thunderheads are where you live now, and you come out of them, wings folded, lightning flashing on your scales, and you swoop low over them and your barbed tail lashes down and buries itself in their shoulder, and by the time you're climbing back into the clouds the venom is already in their blood, their legs folding under them.
[Trait: Storm Wyvern Lord]

abilities.name: Venom Fang
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite one foe with paralysing venom; they're stiff and slow for a few turns.

You drop down on them from above, legs wrapping round them from behind, and your fangs slide into the meat of their shoulder, and they feel it pump in, cold, then numb, their arms going heavy and their legs going stiff, until they're stood there swaying and can't even turn their head to see what's got them.
[Trait: Arachne Huntress]

abilities.name: Venom Rain
abilities.info:
What it does: you spray venom over a group; all of them are poisoned and weakened for a few turns.

You flap over them on wings that drip poison and shake yourself hard, and a rain of venom comes down over every one of them, spattering their faces and hands, burning where it lands, and the air goes sour and thick and they start retching and coughing and staggering with their skin blistering.
[Trait: Wyvern Plaguewing]

abilities.name: Venom Spray
abilities.info:
What it does: you spray venom over a group; all of them are badly poisoned for a few turns.

You raise your tail high over the group and it swells, and then it bursts open in a spray, a fine green mist of your venom drifting down over all of them like rain, and every drop that lands burns, and the ones who breathe it in start choking and retching, their faces swelling and their eyes bulging as it soaks in.
[Trait: Scorpid Venom-King]

abilities.name: Venom Sting
abilities.info:
What it does: you sting one foe with a venomous barb; they're poisoned and weakened for a few turns.

Your heavy tail curls up over your back, the big barb at the end dripping a drop of clear venom that smokes where it hits the ground, and then it whips down faster than they can follow and drives into them, and they feel it burn, then throb, then spread, a cold sick weakness creeping out from the wound.
[Trait: Wyvern Stinger]

abilities.name: Vent Breath
abilities.info:
What it does: you breathe out the dungeon's furnace heat; foes in front of you are scorched and choke on smoke for a turn.

You snort and the heat comes out of your nostrils in two jets of smoke and flame, the same breath as the deep vents, and the ones in front of you are blasted with it, coughing, eyes streaming, their fur and hair crisping.
[Trait: Infernal Boar]

abilities.name: Vents Breathe
abilities.info:
What it does: the dungeon's vents breathe fire at your word; jets of flame burst up from the ground under foes for a few turns.

You breathe in and every vent in the depths breathes in with you, and you breathe out and they breathe out fire, jets of it bursting up out of every crack in the floor under their feet, over and over, in time with you.
[Trait: Vent Archdevil]

abilities.name: Village in the Branches
abilities.info:
What it does: you raise a shelter or home in your branches in a day; anyone living in it is safe and rests fully.

You lower your great arms and let them climb up, and you bend your branches into floors and walls and roofs, and in a day there are houses up there, and the ones who sleep in them sleep like they haven't slept in years.
[Trait: World Oak]

abilities.name: Voice That Talks
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak and creatures listen with dread; weaker ones obey you and even strong ones bargain instead of fighting.

You open your mouth and the words that come out of it are deep and old and burn a little in the air, and the drakes lower their heads, and the people stop running and stand there trembling, waiting to hear what the dragon wants.
[Trait: Young Dragon]

abilities.name: Voices Inside
abilities.info:
What it does: you ask the memories inside you; one of the things you ate tells you what it knew about a place, person or thing.

You go still and listen, and they're all talking at once in there, everything you ever ate, and you find the one who knows and ask it, and it answers in its own old voice from somewhere deep in your core.
[Trait: Soul Slime]

abilities.name: Void Step
abilities.info:
What it does: you step into nothing and out somewhere else nearby.

You step sideways out of the world, and for a moment there's a hole where you were, a ghost-shaped gap of absolute nothing that hurts to look at, and then it closes, and you step back into the world behind them with the cold of the void still steaming off you.
[Trait: Void Wraith]

abilities.name: Volcanic Burrow
abilities.info:
What it does: you burst from the ground in an eruption; everything around where you surface is burned and thrown into the air.

The ground under them starts to shake and then to glow, cracks of orange spreading across it, and then you come up through the middle in an eruption, fire and molten rock blasting into the sky, the earth thrown apart in every direction, and you rise up out of the crater roaring with lava running off you like water off a whale.
[Trait: Magma Wyrm-King]

abilities.name: Wail
abilities.info:
What it does: you wail and one foe's courage breaks; they're shaken and may flee.

You float toward them with your hollow face streaked with tears that aren't there and open your mouth wide, wider than any mouth should go, and the wail comes out, every grief that ever was, and it goes right through them, and they're sobbing and backing away and then turning and running without knowing why.
[Trait: Banshee Wraith]

abilities.name: Wail of Ending
abilities.info:
What it does: you wail and everything near you weakens toward death; foes grow weaker each turn the wail goes on.

You wail and it doesn't stop, it goes on and on through the night, and with every breath of it they feel themselves dying a little more, their hair going white, their skin going thin and grey, their teeth loosening in their gums, aging years with every minute, begging, crawling, until they're withered elders clawing at the dirt.
[Trait: Long Night Banshee]

abilities.name: Wait for Dawn
abilities.info:
What it does: your howl stops travellers on the road; for a night no one dares move through your lands.

You howl from the hills and the whole road stops, every cart, every walker, every rider, and they huddle round their fires with their backs to each other and wait for dawn, and nobody moves through your land until you let them.
[Trait: Blood Wolf Lord]

abilities.name: Waiting Lightning
abilities.info:
What it does: the lightning waits for you; you call one bolt down on any foe you can see, once per turn for a few turns.

You hang there in the black of the thunderhead and the lightning waits, crackling, patient, until you choose, and every time you look down at one of them it comes straight down out of the cloud and finds them.
[Trait: Storm Wyvern Lord]

abilities.name: Wake the Mountain
abilities.info:
What it does: you wake the mountain itself; rocks roll, the earth heaves and slides crash down on your foes.

You rear up and roar a roar you've been holding in since you lay down a hundred winters ago, and deep under your feet something answers, a groan of stone so low they feel it in their teeth, then the slopes start to move, boulders breaking loose, the earth splitting in long jagged lines, whole hillsides coming down on them in a roaring grey wall while they run uphill, downhill, anywhere, and the mountain buries the lot.
[Trait: Mountain Bear]

abilities.name: Wake Up Hungry
abilities.info:
What it does: you eat during a fight; each mouthful of a fallen foe heals you a lot and makes your next hit harder.

You stop fighting just long enough to grab the nearest fallen one and tear a mouthful out of it, and another, chewing with your eyes on the rest of them, and with every bite you feel bigger and warmer and angrier.
[Trait: Great Bear]

abilities.name: Walk Away
abilities.info:
What it does: make a show of leaving a deal: a trader who wanted it calls you back with a better offer.

You stand up, nod once, tell them it was good talking, and walk off without looking back, easy and unhurried, counting your steps in your head, one, two, three, and on the fourth they call your name and you stop and turn around like you're surprised.
[Trait: Trained Barter III]

abilities.name: Walking Inside You
abilities.info:
What it does: you feel everything that moves in your halls; you know where every intruder is and what they're doing.

They think they're walking down a hall, but they're walking on you, and you feel every footstep, every hand on the wall, every whisper, and you know exactly where every one of them is in the maze of you.
[Trait: Labyrinth Slime]

abilities.name: Walking Wood
abilities.info:
What it does: you move trees around to block a path, crush a foe or trap them in a ring of trunks.

You hum low and the trees answer, pulling their roots up out of the earth with a wet sucking sound and shuffling, slow and heavy, wherever you point, closing a path behind them, crowding in around them, two great trunks leaning together until whoever is caught between them is squeezed until the bones go.
[Trait: Treant Shepherd]

abilities.name: Wall of Flesh
abilities.info:
What it does: plant yourself in front of allies: for a few turns blows aimed at them land on you instead, and you take less from each.

You step in front of them and spread yourself wide and plant your feet, and everything that comes at them has to come through you first, and it does, again and again, and you take it, and you don't move.
[Trait: Trained Endure IV]

abilities.name: Wall Ward
abilities.info:
What it does: you guard a wall; nothing climbs or crosses it unseen while you watch, and you strike any who try.

You crouch on the wall above the gate through the night and every rope that's thrown, every ladder that's raised, every claw that hooks the stone, you see it, and you drop on it before the climber gets halfway, and the wall stays clean.
[Trait: Gargoyle Warden]

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.info:
What it does: a roar that steadies your allies for the next few turns and makes weaker foes in front of you hesitate.

It comes up out of your chest from somewhere deep and old, a roar that rattles your own teeth, and the ones fighting beside you straighten up and plant their feet while the small ones in front of you lose a step, then another, eyes going wide, because something in them knows what kind of thing makes that sound and what it usually does next.
[Trait: Soul Gift: War Cry]

abilities.name: War Leader
abilities.info:
What it does: for a few turns your allies fight better: they hit harder and are harder to frighten.

You lead from the front, the first one into it every time, and they see you do it and something lifts in them, and they follow you in fighting like they've never fought before.
[Trait: Trained Command IV]

abilities.name: War-Eel
abilities.info:
What it does: your great war-eel fights at your side; it bites, coils and drags foes under for the rest of the fight.

You whistle down into the water and it comes up out of the dark, long and slick and enormous, the war-eel you ride, and it coils round you once and then goes for whatever you're looking at, all teeth and grip and drag.
[Trait: Merfolk Sea-Knight]

abilities.name: Warcry of Ruin
abilities.info:
What it does: you let out a warcry; your allies strike harder and shake off fear, while weak foes break and run.

You suck in so much air your chest creaks, and then you let it out, a warcry so loud it shakes dust off the rocks and sets every horse in the valley bolting, and your warriors go mad with it, howling back, beating their chests, foaming, while on the far hill the cowards drop what they're holding and run before the warband has even started moving.
[Trait: Orc Warchief]

abilities.name: Ward
abilities.info:
What it does: wrap yourself or an ally in your power for a few turns: blows and blasts against them are weakened.

You draw it round them like a coat, a layer of your power humming over their skin, and the next hit that lands on it loses most of itself on the way in.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their power shows, and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Trained Evoke II]

abilities.name: Ward Flare
abilities.info:
What it does: you flare a ward that turns a blow aside; one attack against you or an ally next to you is stopped.

The blow comes in and a shimmer of runes snaps into the air in front of it, crackling, and the blow hits it and skids off with a shower of sparks and a sharp twang, and the ward fades away and you haven't even had to move.
[Trait: Rune-Warded Golem]

abilities.name: Warden's Stand
abilities.info:
What it does: you plant yourself in a gap or doorway and hold it; nothing gets past you to those behind while you stand, and blows against you lose much of their force.

You set your feet wide in the gap and sink your weight into it, claws dug in, shoulders hunched, head low, a rumble starting deep in your chest that the ones behind you feel through the ground, and when they come at you they hit a wall of fur and muscle that simply doesn't move, the warden of this ground saying no in the only way that has ever mattered.
[Trait: Bearkin Warden]

abilities.name: Warm Hands
abilities.info:
You heat metal, dry wood or light a fire by touch.
[Trait: Salamander]

abilities.name: Warren Cunning
abilities.info:
What it does: pick the ground and rig it: for the rest of the fight foes who come at you and your allies run into traps you set, losing footing, taking hits and getting split up.

You go quiet and your eyes flick over the ground the way a goblin boss reads a tunnel, which loose rock, which dark corner, which way they'll run when it goes bad, and by the time they come for you there's a tripline behind the tripline and a pit under the place they jump to and every way out funnels them into the one spot where you're standing, grinning, waiting.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Warren Cunning]

abilities.name: Watch the Sky
abilities.info:
What it does: you read the sea and the sky; you know what weather is coming for days and where the safe water is.

You sit on the rocks and watch the clouds and taste the wind and listen to the swell, and you know, the way the fishing towns wish they knew, what's coming tomorrow and the next day, and where the safe water will be when it does.
[Trait: Merfolk Storm-Caller]

abilities.name: Water Breath
abilities.info:
You breathe and swim freely under water.
[Trait: Merfolk]

abilities.name: Wave Song
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a wave that knocks the foes in front of you down.

You rise out of the shallows and sing one long rising note, and the sea behind you lifts with it, a wave climbing up out of the bay, higher, higher, curling over your head, and on the last note it breaks over them and slams them flat on the sand and drags them tumbling back toward the deep.
[Trait: Merfolk Tide-Singer]

abilities.name: Wax in Their Pockets
abilities.info:
What it does: you know every trick for resisting a song; you and your allies can't be charmed, lured or sung into anything for a day.

You know every trick they've ever used against you, the wax, the rope, the humming of their own tune, and you teach them to your friends, and for the rest of the day no song, no voice, no charm can get a hook into any of them.
[Trait: Siren-Harpy Queen]

abilities.name: Weak to What
abilities.info:
What it does: know what one kind of creature is weak to and what it shrugs off.

You look it up and down and the old knowledge comes, fire, they hate fire, don't waste the cold on them, they don't even feel it, and you yell it out before they throw their best at the one thing it shrugs off.
[Trait: Trained Lore II]

abilities.name: Weakening Venom
abilities.info:
What it does: poison one foe so their strength drains away: they hit much weaker for the rest of the fight.
It goes in and goes to work on the muscles first, and they feel it, their arms going heavy and soft, their grip loosening, every swing they throw slower and sloppier than the last, until they can barely lift their own hands.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Poison: Weakening Venom]

abilities.name: Wear It Down
abilities.info:
What it does: chase a foe until it's spent: a foe you pursue for a few turns tires, fights worse and can't run.

You stay on it without ever closing in, always there, always a little too close, never letting it rest or eat or sleep, and by the time you finally move in it's staggering and has nothing left.
[Trait: Trained Hunt VI]

abilities.name: Wear the Dark
abilities.info:
What it does: for a while darkness and shadow hide you completely, even from creatures that see in the dark.

You pull the shadows round you and they stick, you can feel them clinging to you as you walk, and even the creatures that see in the black look straight at you and see more black.
[Trait: Trained Stalk IV]

abilities.name: Wear the Dead
abilities.info:
What it does: you take the look, voice and smell of the last creature you killed for a scene; it fools anyone who didn't know it well, and slips if you're hurt badly or questioned close.

Your face goes slack first, then the skin crawls as something moves underneath it, bones clicking and sliding as your jaw stretches and your nose flattens and the colour drains out of your eyes and comes back theirs, and when you speak it's their voice in your throat, rough at first, their smell rolling off you strong enough that anything that knew them by scent lowers its hackles.
[Trait: Stolen Face]

abilities.name: Wear the Soul
abilities.info:
What it does: draw a held soul up so hard you take on its body for a few turns: its hide, its senses, its natural weapons.

You call one of them up out of you and let it take hold, and your body answers it, your skin roughening, your teeth changing, your hands going to claws or hooves or whatever it had, until for a while you're half you and half it.
[Trait: Trained Absorb VI]

abilities.name: Weather Changes
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk into a place and change its weather; for a day it's calm, wind, rain or storm, whichever you want.

You walk down into the valley and the sky changes with you, the clouds rolling in or rolling back, the wind rising or dying, and the valley gets the weather you're in the mood for, and keeps it until you leave.
[Trait: Sylph Tempest]

abilities.name: Weather It
abilities.info:
What it does: for a day cold, heat, hunger and hard travel don't wear you down; you march on when others must stop.

The wind cuts through everyone else and the snow piles up on your shoulders and you just keep walking, head down, one foot after the other, hour after hour, while the rest of them huddle up and beg to stop.
[Trait: Trained Endure III]

abilities.name: Weather Like a Dog
abilities.info:
What it does: you call the weather to follow you; for a day it's whatever you want around you, calm, storm, fog or rain.

You whistle like you're calling a dog and the weather comes trotting after you along the coast, and you tell it what to do, rain here, calm there, fog over that camp, and it does it, wagging its storm clouds behind you.
[Trait: Harpy Tempest-Witch]

abilities.name: Weave the Night
abilities.info:
What it does: you weave night over a place; it falls dark as midnight there for the rest of the scene, and you and your kin see while foes are blind.

You climb up into the sky over them and spin, and the silk you spin is night itself, black strands stretched across the sun one after another until the day thins, then greys, then vanishes, and the town below wakes up in darkness at noon, and they can feel it, something huge moving overhead in the black.
[Trait: Night-Weaver]

abilities.name: Web Fortress
abilities.info:
What it does: you fill a whole space with webs; every foe inside is trapped, slowed and easy prey for the rest of the fight.

You rear up in the middle of them and silk comes out of you in a torrent, sheets and ropes and curtains of it filling the space from floor to roof in moments, every passage sealed, every exit gone, and they find themselves stuck in a white maze that clings and tugs at every step, and somewhere in the middle of it the web queen sits waiting, feeling every twitch on every strand.
[Trait: Web Queen]

abilities.name: Web Net
abilities.info:
What it does: you throw a net of silk over a group; they're tangled and slowed for a few turns and struggle to fight.

All four of your arms go to work at once, plucking thick sticky ropes from your wrists and weaving them faster than an eye can follow, and you fling the net out spinning over their heads, and it comes down on them, clinging to faces and hands and boots, and the harder they thrash the tighter it pulls.
[Trait: Silk Goblin]

abilities.name: Web of Empire
abilities.info:
What it does: you web a whole valley; every path is blocked and every foe in it is slowed and snared for the rest of the battle.

You climb to the top of the valley and spin, and the silk goes out from you on the wind in long white streamers, settling across the valley from one side to the other, strand on strand, until it's all draped in white like snow, every path, every tree, every enemy caught knee-deep in it and getting tangled deeper with every step.
[Trait: Arachne High Weaver]

abilities.name: Web Snare
abilities.info:
What it does: throw webs that pin foes in place for several turns, and string silk bridges, walls and snares across any gap you need.

You spin and fling it all in one motion, the silk opening up in the air into a wide sticky sheet that slaps over them and drags them down, and the more they thrash the more it wraps them, arms glued to their sides, legs glued together, and you walk out across your own threads to them without hurrying at all, picking your feet up delicately, one at a time.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Web Snare]

abilities.name: Wet Beds and Loose Tents
abilities.info:
What it does: your swarm hits a camp at night; by morning everyone in it is tired, soaked, robbed and fighting badly for the day.

You send them in at midnight and they get busy, every tent rope untied, every bed soaked, every boot filled with something nasty, every pot stolen, every horse let loose, and in the morning the whole camp staggers around exhausted and furious.
[Trait: Pixie Mischief-Lord]

abilities.name: Where the Floor Begins
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread flat and still across the ground; nobody can tell you from the floor until they walk onto you.

You let yourself spread out thin and flat and still across the cave floor, slime and fungus and grit, and you're the floor now, and they walk in looking for you, and they keep looking right up until they realise they're standing on you.
[Trait: Living Ooze-Garden]

abilities.name: Whirlwind Cut
abilities.info:
What it does: spin through every foe close around you, hitting each one once in a single turn.

You turn on one foot and keep turning, faster and faster, arms out, a spinning blur that goes through them like a wind through grass, and when you stop dead in the middle every one of them is staggering back holding somewhere new.
[Trait: Trained Strike VII]

abilities.name: Whisper in Ten Towns
abilities.info:
What it does: you spread a rumour through your rats; within a day it's whispered in every town in the region.

You lean down to the nearest rat and whisper it, and it scurries off, and you can feel it going, from rat to rat, under doors, through walls, into every town in the region, until by nightfall there isn't a tavern anywhere where somebody isn't saying it.
[Trait: Rat King]

abilities.name: White Caverns
abilities.info:
What it does: everything in a cave you pass through is covered in spore; for the rest of the fight foes there weaken each turn as you feed on them.

You drift through the cavern and it goes white behind you, the walls, the floor, the ones standing in it, all furred over with your spores, and the spores feed, and what they feed on comes back into you, and they get weaker while you get stronger.
[Trait: Ruin Cap]

abilities.name: White Out
abilities.info:
What it does: a freezing storm fills the area round you for three turns; every foe in it takes cold damage each turn and can barely see, and you see through it fine.
The air drops so cold so fast it sings, a thin high whine, then snow comes out of nowhere and the world disappears, and out in it they're stumbling, calling to each other, eyelashes frozen together, while you walk through the storm untouched and every time the whine rises you're standing right beside one of them.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Cold: White Out]

abilities.name: Whose Side
abilities.info:
What it does: you play to two sides at once; each believes you're with them, and you get what you want from both.

You play a tune that sounds like victory to one side and peace to the other, and both of them think you're theirs, and they both come to you afterward with gifts and secrets and promises, and you take all of it.
[Trait: Satyr Songmaster]

abilities.name: Wide Eye
abilities.info:
You see through darkness and simple illusions.
[Trait: Gazer]

abilities.name: Widow's Kiss
abilities.info:
What it does: you bite with killing venom; one foe is badly poisoned and may die if not treated quickly.

You wait, and when they come close you lean in, almost tender, and bite, and they laugh at the little sting, and then the laugh locks in their throat as their jaw clamps shut, and their back arches until the bones creak, and they're begging you with their eyes because their mouth won't open anymore, while you watch with all eight of yours and do nothing at all.
[Trait: Arachne Widow]

abilities.name: Wild Brawl
abilities.info:
What it does: you brawl wild and dirty with horns, hooves and fists all at once; one foe takes a battering and can't hit back cleanly this turn.

You tear off your shirt and throw yourself in howling, no style, no rules, horns, elbows, knees, a hoof to the shin, a bite on the ear, a fistful of hair yanked, rolling in the dirt with them and up again before they can find their footing, the hill-country way of fighting where the only thing that counts is who's still laughing at the end.
[Trait: Satyr Wildman]

abilities.name: Wild Hunt Revel
abilities.info:
What it does: you blow your horn and lead a wild hunt of revellers through anything in your way; foes in its path are run down and scattered.

You put the great ram's horn to your lips and blow, and out of the hills they come, satyrs and drunks and wild things and anything else that heard the call, a howling, laughing, torch-waving stampede with you at the head of it, and the wild hunt goes through them in front of you, leaving feathers and wreckage and terrified foes hiding in the ditches.
[Trait: Satyr King]

abilities.name: Wild Song
abilities.info:
What it does: play music that takes over a whole crowd for a few turns: they dance, fall asleep or flee in panic (you choose which when you play); strong wills can shake it off.

The first notes are pretty and the next ones wild and then the tune gets into everybody at once, into their feet and their blood, and you can see it take them, a whole crowd lurching into a dance they can't stop, or slumping down where they stand yawning, or bolting in every direction screaming at nothing, all of them moving to your music now whether they like it or not, and you just play louder.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Wild Song]

abilities.name: Wildfire
abilities.info:
What it does: a fire you start spreads fast for three turns, jumping from foe to foe and thing to thing; each foe it reaches burns.
You flick one ember into it and it takes, and then it runs, faster than they can, leaping from the grass to the cart to the one standing by the cart and on to the next, a fire with a mind of its own and an appetite to match.
How it looks is theirs: narrate it the way they have said their element shows (their backstory, or what they said in play), and only fall back on this when they haven't.
[Trait: Fire: Wildfire]

abilities.name: Wind Run
abilities.info:
What it does: for a short burst you run on the wind, faster than anything on four legs, and close any distance before a foe can react.

You hear it, you feel it, the wind itself as it flows through your fur, then you are gone, dashing across the ground, moving to all fours as you leap from tree to tree, the sound of your claws hitting the ground like cracks of thunder, your speed like lightning.
[Trait: Storm Wolf]

abilities.name: Wind Slash
abilities.info:
What it does: you slash a cut of wind at range; one foe some distance away is cut.

You snap your scythe through the air and the air comes apart, a thin howling crescent of wind leaping off your edge and racing across the clearing, and it hits them from twenty paces off and opens them up all the same.
[Trait: Wind Mantid]

abilities.name: Wind Step
abilities.info:
What it does: a gust carries your leap twice as far and high, and softens any landing.

You crouch and the air around you crouches with you, coiling, and when you jump a gust comes up under you and throws you, your hair whipping, the ground falling away twice as fast as it should, and you come down on the far side light as a feather with the wind still giggling in your ears.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Wind Step]

abilities.name: Wind Walk
abilities.info:
What it does: you walk on the air for a while, crossing gaps, climbing out of reach or crossing over foes.

You step off the edge of the gorge and don't fall, the wind gathering under your feet, and you stroll out over the drop with nothing under you, as easy as walking down a road, while they stand at the edge gaping.
[Trait: Sylph Windwalker]

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.info:
What it does: you batter a foe with your wings; they're knocked back and down.

Your leathery wings snap open with a crack and you rear up and beat them once, twice, three times, battering blows like being hit by a door in a storm, and the wind and the leather slam into them, hurling them backwards off their feet with grit in their eyes.
[Trait: Wyvern Drake]

abilities.name: Wing Stretch
abilities.info:
What it does: glide down from any drop or jump on spread membranes instead of falling: no fall damage, and you can steer a short distance.

You step off into the drop and throw your arms wide and the skin between your arm and your side snaps tight, catching the wind with a crack, and the fall turns into a long slanting swoop, the ground coming up slow and soft while the ones who were chasing you are left standing at the top staring down.
[Trait: Soul Gift: Wing Stretch]

abilities.name: Wing Strike
abilities.info:
What it does: you strike a foe from the air on beating wings, then land back at a gallop out of their reach.

Your wings crack open wide as a barn door and one hard beat throws you into the air, dust and grass blasting out in a ring beneath you, and you drop on them from above forehooves first, hit, and are gone again on the next beat, hooves touching down at a gallop twenty paces off while they're still looking the wrong way.
[Trait: Winged Centaur]

abilities.name: Wings Over Valleys
abilities.info:
What it does: you fly over a whole valley at once and see everything in it; nothing hiding there escapes your notice.

You spread your wings and they cover the whole valley, end to end, and from up there you see every last thing in it, every den, every camp, every creature crouching under a bush thinking it's hidden, and you choose.
[Trait: Storm-Roc Sylph]

abilities.name: Witch's Laughter
abilities.info:
Laugh the witch's laugh; the pack comes, and anyone hearing it alone in the grass runs.
[Trait: The Laughing Pack: Witch's Hand]

abilities.name: Witchfire Scream
abilities.info:
What it does: you scream green fire across everything in front of you; foes in its path are burned and many flee in fear.

Your finger bones start to rattle, then clatter, then shake so hard they sound like teeth chattering, and your eyes blaze green in your ash-grey face, and your jaw drops and you scream, and the scream comes out burning, a howling torrent of witchfire tearing away from you, and everything in front of you goes up green, and those who live through it run and never come back.
[Trait: Witch-Hag]

abilities.name: Wolf Form
abilities.info:
What it does: you take a wolf's shape for a hunt; you move faster, track by scent and bite harder until you change back.

You drop to all fours and your bones crack and stretch, your face pushing out into a snout, grey fur rippling over you, and in a few gasping breaths a great grey wolf with red eyes stands where you were, nose already lifting to catch the smell of blood on the wind.
[Trait: Blood Wolf]

abilities.name: Wolf Lunge
abilities.info:
What it does: you close the distance in one wolf's bound and drag one foe to the ground.

You drop to a crouch with your nostrils flaring, the wolf in your blood smelling their fear before you've even seen their face, and then you go, one long bound off all fours across ground no orc should be able to clear, and you hit them in the chest with all your weight and your teeth bared, and you both go down in the dirt with you on top.
[Trait: Wolfblood Orc]

abilities.name: Wolfkin Pounce
abilities.info:
Close the distance in one bound and drag a foe down.
[Trait: Soul of the Wolfkin]

abilities.name: Wonder Work
abilities.info:
What it does: build something the like of which nobody's seen: a great hall, a hidden fortress, a machine; it changes what your home can do.

You see it whole in your head before you start, something nobody's built before, and you spend days on it with your people around you, and when it's done they stand in front of it and nobody says anything for a long while.
[Trait: Trained Build VIII]

abilities.name: Word of Death
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak a word and the weak die; weak foes in hearing die outright, and the rest are badly hurt and shaken.

You open your fleshless jaws and say one word in a language older than the dungeon, and the word doesn't sound so much as land, a weight of death crushing down on everyone who hears it, and the weak ones just stop, hearts quitting mid-beat, falling where they stand with their eyes open, and the strong ones fall to their knees vomiting blood.
[Trait: Archlich]

abilities.name: Word of Legend
abilities.info:
What it does: speak, and creatures listen: weaker ones do what you ask, and even strong ones hear you out before they act.

When you talk, things stop to listen, the weak ones and the strong ones alike, and every word you say lands like it's going to be repeated around a hundred fires for a hundred years, and maybe it will be.
[Trait: Trained Talk VIII]

abilities.name: World Forgets
abilities.info:
What it does: you sit still and the world forgets you're there; you can walk away from any fight or crowd unnoticed.

You sit down and go still and the world just forgets you, its eyes slide off you, its memory lets you go, and you stand up and walk out of the middle of the fight and nobody remembers you were in it.
[Trait: Mantid Elder]

abilities.name: World of Masks
abilities.info:
What it does: you turn the area into a masquerade; nobody's face, voice or shape is their own, foes lose track of you and each other, and you can be anyone for the rest of the scene.

You pull a mask from your belt and put it on and the world puts one on with you, every face sliding into a painted mask, every voice going muffled and strange, the walls and trees draped in ribbons that weren't there, and somewhere in that swirling crowd you're dancing, a different mask every time anyone looks, laughing a laugh they keep hearing from the wrong side.
[Trait: Masked Satyr]

abilities.name: Wraith Drain
abilities.info:
Drain a foe's life with a touch.
[Trait: Soul of the Wraith]

abilities.name: Wrap the Room
abilities.info:
What it does: your coils fill a room; everyone inside is caught in them and held, and you choose who you squeeze.

You pour in through the door and keep coming, and coming, coil after coil filling the room, sliding over the floor, up the walls, round the legs of everyone standing there, until they're all caught in you and the only thing they can move is their eyes.
[Trait: Lamia Coil-Queen]

abilities.name: Wreck Market
abilities.info:
What it does: you trade salvage at a lord's prices; you buy cheap and sell dear, and others can't haggle you down.

You sit on a throne of ship's timbers surrounded by everything the sea ever threw up, and they come to trade, and you clack and click and wave your claws and somehow every deal ends with you holding more coin than they wanted to give and them holding less than they came with, and still thanking you for it.
[Trait: Crabfolk Salvage-Lord]

abilities.name: Wreck Storm
abilities.info:
What it does: you sing a storm that wrecks ships; vessels and foes on the water are battered and driven onto the rocks.

You sing the storm up and then you steer it, and the waves pick up the ships and carry them, sails torn, rudders snapped, straight at your reef, and they hit the rocks one after another, splitting and sinking, and you watch the crews spill into the sea with a smile on your face.
[Trait: Siren Storm-Queen]

abilities.name: Wreck-Craft
abilities.info:
What it does: you build from salvage; you make a raft, a barricade, a tool or a crude machine from whatever wreckage is to hand.

You drag the wreckage together and get to work, your claws snipping rope and prying nails and fitting planks, and you don't need plans, you can see it in the junk already, and by the time the tide turns there's a raft, or a wall, or a catapult made from a broken mast, standing on the sand.
[Trait: Crabfolk Wrecker]

abilities.name: Wrecker's Share
abilities.info:
What it does: the wreckers of your coast bring you a share of what they find; you receive goods or news from every wreck nearby.

They come up the beach to you in the evening dragging what they found, the barrels, the crates, the coins, the papers, and they set your cut down in front of you without being asked, and tell you everything they saw while they did it.
[Trait: Crabfolk Salvage-Lord]

abilities.name: Wrecking Charge
abilities.info:
What it does: charge a whole line of foes: everyone in your path is battered aside and the line is broken.

You come in at a dead run with your head down and they've got time to brace and it doesn't matter, you hit the line and the line comes apart, bodies flying off you either side, and you plough out the far side of them still running while behind you they're picking each other up off the ground.
[Trait: Trained Fight VII]

abilities.name: Wrong Foot
abilities.info:
What it does: a feint; your next hit on that foe lands while they're off balance. Rolls trick.

You show them the hit coming from the left, let them see it, let them believe it, and while they're bracing for it the real one comes in low from the side they forgot they had.
[Trait: Trickster]

abilities.name: Wyrm Voice
abilities.info:
What it does: you speak with a dragon's voice; kobolds and lesser reptiles obey you, and weak foes are cowed and hesitate.

You draw yourself up as tall as a kobold can get and speak, and the voice that comes out isn't yours, it's huge and old and rumbling, a dragon's voice booming out of a body no bigger than a dog, and every kobold in hearing drops flat on its face in worship while the foes in front of you stop dead, suddenly not sure what they've walked into.
[Trait: Wyrmspeaker]

abilities.name: Wyvern Host
abilities.info:
What it does: you call every wyvern there is; they darken the sky and strike your foes for the rest of the battle.

You scream from the highest peak, a raw shriek that echoes off every mountain in the range, and from nests on every crag they come pouring into the sky, hundreds of wyverns, wings and tails and venom, until the daylight drowns behind them and the land below falls into their shadow, and then they dive.
[Trait: Wyvern King]

abilities.name: Wyvern Sting
abilities.info:
Strike with a venomous tail barb.
[Trait: Soul of the Wyvern]

abilities.name: Zephyr Dash
abilities.info:
What it does: you dash along on a breeze, moving much further and faster than normal for a turn.

Your hair lifts and your feet leave the ground and a breeze picks you up from behind, and you're off, skimming over the ground so fast the grass barely bends under you, there and gone before they can blink.
