[Trait: Sylph Zephyr]

traits.name: A Battlefield
traits.info:
You crawled out from under a heap of the dead after a fight nobody won, the first thing you ever smelled was blood and smoke, and you still settle best with a fight going on somewhere close by.

💪 Fight +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: A Caravan Cage
traits.info:
You were born in a cage on the back of a beetle caravan and sold twice before you could walk, so you know what everything is worth, yourself included, and exactly what you'd take for it.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: A Dungeon Pool
traits.info:
The Great Dungeon made you, you came up out of a warm pool under glowing moss with no mother and no nest, and you still feel the place breathing, the shift in the air before the walls move and the hush before something big walks by.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: A Grave
traits.info:
You woke in the dirt with no memory of dying, clawing up through roots and old bones into the cold, and whatever put you there didn't finish the job, so now there isn't much left that can hurt you worse than that did.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: A Hive Nest
traits.info:
You hatched in a nest of hundreds, every one of them moving to the same hum, and you still hear it, how a crowd turns before it turns and which voice it will listen to, even when the hive is long gone.

🔮 Command +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: A Home
traits.info:
You want walls that are yours, a fire nobody can kick you away from and a door you decide who comes through, and you'll build it out of whatever the world leaves lying around.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: A Lone Egg
traits.info:
You hatched alone with nobody to feed you and nobody to teach you, so you ate whatever crawled close enough and learned to sit very still until it did.

💨 Hunt +1

💨 Swiftness build.

traits.name: A Pack
traits.info:
You want your own around you, kin that watch your back and come when you call, and you'll bleed for every one of them and expect the same back.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: A Ruined Fort
traits.info:
You hatched in the rubble of an old human fort, among rusted gear and walls covered in marks you couldn't read, and you spent your first years working out what all of it was for.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: A Witch's Pot
traits.info:
A witch-hag brewed you on purpose out of bones, blood and something she wouldn't name, and you came out of the pot smelling of herbs and ash with her magic still fizzing under your skin.

🔮 Evoke +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: Abyss Hunter
traits.info:
You hunt the trenches now, where light never reaches, and your eyes have grown so big you can see a heartbeat in the dark. Grown from Abyssal Merfolk at level 30. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Abyss Hunter.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Trench Ambush · ⚔️ Heartbeat in the Dark · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Abyss Shade
traits.info:
You're the darkness at the bottom of the Great Dungeon, and the oldest things down there are afraid of you. Grown from Shade Reaper at level 40.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Stalk +3 · ⚔️ Abyssal Step · ⚔️ The Oldest Are Afraid · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Abyssal Megalodon
traits.info:
You're the oldest shark in the sea now, scarred and huge, and the other sharks scatter when you rise. Grown from Sharkfolk Megalodon at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +3 · ⚔️ Leviathan Bite · ⚔️ Others Scatter · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Abyssal Merfolk
traits.info:
Your body glows faintly with deep-sea light now, little blue lights pulsing along your sides, and things in the dark swim toward you. Grown from Deep Merfolk at level 20. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Abyssal Merfolk.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Lure Light

traits.name: Acid Magic
traits.info:
You burn like acid: acid can't eat you, and your magic eats through what it hits.

⚔️ Eat Away · 🚫 immune to acid

Any build.

traits.name: Acid Slime
traits.info:
You go bright green and your body smokes wherever it touches, and the floor you crawl over is left etched and pitted. Grown from Slime at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Acid Splash

traits.name: Acid: Acid Flood
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Acid Flood. A wave of acid pours out over a wide area: every foe in it takes heavy acid damage and their armour and hide are ruined.

traits.name: Acid: Acid Pool
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Acid Pool. Spill a pool of acid on the ground for three turns: foes who stand in it or cross it take acid damage each turn.

traits.name: Acid: Acid Rain
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Acid Rain. Acid falls on the area round you for two turns; every foe in it takes acid damage each turn and loses armour.

traits.name: Acid: Acid Spit
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Acid Spit. Spit acid at one foe at range: acid damage, and it keeps burning for a turn.

traits.name: Acid: Burn Through
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Burn Through. Your hits eat through armour; each hit adds acid damage and weakens the foe's armour for the rest of the fight.

traits.name: Acid: Caustic Hide
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Caustic Hide. For the rest of the fight your skin is acid: anything that touches you is burned, and grabs on you fail.

traits.name: Acid: Dissolve
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Dissolve. One foe's flesh dissolves where you touch them: heavy acid damage, and the wound won't heal for the rest of the fight.

traits.name: Acid: Eat Through
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Eat Through. Touch one object and the acid eats into it: a lock, a chain, a hinge, a strap weakens and breaks.

traits.name: Acid: Melt
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Melt. One foe you hit or grab takes heavy acid damage and keeps dissolving for three turns; its armour is gone for the fight.

traits.name: Acid: Melt Armour
traits.info: Your acid has grown: Melt Armour. Your acid eats one foe's armour, hide or shell: it protects them far less for the rest of the fight.

traits.name: All-Seeing Gazer
traits.info:
You see every corner of the dungeon now, every room you've ever been in, all at once, and you never sleep because you can't close your eyes on it. Grown from Gazer Oracle at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Instinct +3 · ⚔️ Eye of the Dungeon · ⚔️ Can't Close Your Eyes · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Antfolk
traits.info:
That hill on the horizon isn't a hill, it's an antfolk mound, and if you get close enough you'll see the lines, thousands of them in perfect single file, carrying logs and stones ten times their size up the slope without ever once bumping into each other. They're many-legged hive people, soldiers and workers serving a queen nobody outside the mound ever sees, and they act like one body, so a lone antfolk is harmless and a hundred of them move, turn and strike together without a word passing between them. They talk by scent and trade worked earth and hard labour, and a town that hires a crew can have a wall up in a day, but a town that angers one finds the whole mound on its doorstep by morning.

🦊 Build +2 · 🔮 Command +1 · 💪 Endure +1 · ⚔️ Carry Ten · 🧱 resists acid · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Antfolk Architect
traits.info:
Your mounds are towers now, spiralling up out of the earth higher than any tree, and other races come just to stare at them. Grown from Antfolk Builder at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Raise Tower

traits.name: Antfolk Builder
traits.info:
Your limbs broaden into diggers and you've got a builder's feel for earth now, and the mound grows wherever you've been working. Grown from Antfolk at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Earthwork

traits.name: Antfolk City-Mother
traits.info:
Your body and your city are one design now, every road in it running back to you, and the city breathes when you breathe. Grown from Antfolk Mound-Lord at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ City Overnight · ⚔️ City Breathes · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Antfolk Mound-Lord
traits.info:
Your mound is a city now, with roads and markets and towers, and every ant in it knows your scent. Grown from Antfolk Architect at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Fortify · ⚔️ Every Ant Knows · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Antfolk Queen
traits.info:
You're the mother of a hive of a million, and every ant in it would die for you without stopping to think. Grown from Antfolk War-Marshal at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Hive Swarm · ⚔️ A Million Would Die · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Antfolk Soldier
traits.info:
Your head swells huge with crushing mandibles and soldier's plates cover your back, and the workers scatter out of your way when you march through the mound. Grown from Antfolk at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Mandible Crush

traits.name: Antfolk War-Marshal
traits.info:
Your legions move as one now, and from a distance the enemy can't tell where one soldier ends and the next begins. Grown from Antfolk Warrior at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Legion March · ⚔️ One Soldier · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Antfolk Warrior
traits.info:
You're a veteran of a hundred mound wars, scarred and dented, and the young soldiers line up behind you without being told. Grown from Antfolk Soldier at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Shield Line

traits.name: Arachne
traits.info:
At dawn an arachne canyon looks like it's iced over, silk bridges and walkways strung wall to wall in their hundreds and every strand catching the light, and in the middle of it is a market selling the finest cloth anywhere in monster country. They're spider from the waist down and women from the waist up, and they run their silk cities like merchant houses, weaving, haggling and taking metal for cloth at prices that'd make a goblin weep. Along the edge of every market hangs a row of fat white cocoons, and if you ask, an arachne will tell you plainly that's the larder, and that most of what's in it was a customer who tried to leave without paying.

🦊 Build +4 · ⚔️ Silk Line · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Arachne High Weaver
traits.info:
Every arachne city answers to your loom, and silk from every canyon passes through your hands before it goes to market. Grown from Arachne Loom-Queen at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Web of Empire · ⚔️ Market Silk · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Arachne Huntress
traits.info:
Your fangs grow long and curved and the venom sacs at your jaw swell up fat, and other arachne leave the room when you get hungry. Grown from Arachne at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Venom Fang

traits.name: Arachne Loom-Queen
traits.info:
You rule a silk city strung across a canyon, and the place hums when you walk across it like a plucked harp string. Grown from Arachne Silk-Mistress at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Silk City · ⚔️ Plucked String · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Arachne Silk-Mistress
traits.info:
Your cloth sells for gold in every monster town, and merchants wait in a queue at the bottom of your canyon for a chance to buy it. Grown from Arachne Weaver at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Silk Armour

traits.name: Arachne Stalker
traits.info:
Eight legs, eight eyes, and the patience of something that has learned the dark is its best friend, and travellers in the canyon walk faster when they pass under your ledge. Grown from Arachne Huntress at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Ambush Web

traits.name: Arachne Weaver
traits.info:
Your fingers stretch long and nimble and your silk comes out finer than it ever has, and the other spiders start bringing you their tangled thread to fix. Grown from Arachne at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Silk Bridge

traits.name: Arachne Widow
traits.info:
Your body turns glossy black with a red mark on the belly, and your venom kills in moments, and nobody in the canyons ever trades with you twice. Grown from Arachne Stalker at level 30.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Widow's Kiss · ⚔️ Red Mark · 🧱 resists poison

A basilisk is a long eight-legged lizard with a hide like rough granite and dull yellow eyes, and one good look into those eyes greys you over from the skin inward. Everyone who's lived through meeting one says the same thing, watch its feet, never its face, because a basilisk doesn't talk, doesn't trade and doesn't need to chase you, it just needs you to look up.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Heavy Stare · 🧱 resists bludgeoning, piercing

traits.name: Bearkin
traits.info:
In summer the northern rivers are full of bearkin, huge shaggy shapes standing knee-deep in the rapids scooping out salmon, and if you're polite they'll share a fire, a fish and a horn of honey-mead and rumble stories at you half the night. In winter they seal their caves and sleep, and the claw marks on the trees around a den, higher than any man could reach, are a warning to anyone thinking of waking one early. They're slow to anger and it takes a lot to get there, but a roused bearkin mauls whatever's in front of it until it stops moving, and the northern villages pay them in furs and honey to stand between them and everything else that comes down from the snow.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Hibernal Hide · 🧱 resists cold, bludgeoning

Any build.

Your muzzle goes grey, you smell of honey all the time and your eyes fill up with a slow, patient wisdom. Grown from Bearkin at level 10.

traits.name: Boarfolk
traits.info:
Under the oaks where boarfolk live the forest floor is ploughed up like a field, dug over for acorns and roots, and every big trunk has its bark rubbed away at hip height where some bristle-backed brute has scraped its tusks sharp. They live in sounders led by the oldest sow, and that matriarch's word decides where the sounder roots and who it charges, which is usually anything that crosses its ground. Boarfolk speak bluntly and trade acorn-flour and hides, and they never back down, not from a bear, not from an orc warband and not from a fight they're obviously losing, so the smart move is not to start one with them at all.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Tusk Rush · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.info:
The first catfolk most people see is sprawled across the warmest roof in a trade town, tail hanging over the edge, watching the street with half-shut eyes, and the second time they look up it's gone and so is somebody's coin. They're lithe and tufted and proud of it, hunters in the jungles and thieves and duellists in the towns, and they drop off rooftops and land on their feet without a sound. A catfolk will work for you, travel with you and even fight beside you, until something more interesting comes along and they're gone without a goodbye, and they collect curios the way other races collect grudges, odd trinkets they'll trade with you for a story worth hearing.

Horse below and person above, they live on the move in proud herds of archers and lancers who can put an arrow through a running hare at full gallop. Guests get fed, protected and sent off with a gift, but fences get torn down and burned wherever a herd finds them, because to a centaur a fence is someone claiming land that belongs to the wind, and the one who built it had better hope they aren't home.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Gallop · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.info:
The ruined galleries where cockatrices nest are full of little statues, stone rats, stone birds, a stone goblin with one arm still flesh and a look on its face nobody likes to think about. A cockatrice has the head of a rooster, the body of a lizard and the temper of both, and its peck spreads stone through flesh like frost spreading over a puddle, slow enough that you get to watch it happen. They don't talk, they crow, at all hours and for no reason anyone can work out, and that crowing echoing down a gallery is the only warning you'll get to turn around and go back the way you came.

🔮 Instinct +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Numbing Peck · 🧱 resists poison

Any build.

traits.name: Cockatrice Basilisk
traits.info:
A crest of hard feathers grows on your head and your snout turns beak-like, and you start crowing at odd hours. Grown from Basilisk at level 10. Only a body with the Cockatrice soul rooted in it can become Cockatrice Basilisk.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Stone Peck

traits.name: Cockatrice Crower

Your comb swells up big and red and your crow numbs everything that hears it, and the other cockatrices keep their distance at dawn. Grown from Cockatrice at level 10.

traits.name: Cockatrice Doom-Crier

traits.name: Cockatrice Herald

Your dawn crow stiffens a camp now, and armies that camp near the galleries wake up unable to get out of their bedrolls. Grown from Cockatrice Crower at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Dawn Crow

traits.name: Cockatrice King

You're a vast crowing horror, and when you call out at dawn the valley turns grey. Grown from Stone Rooster at level 40. Only a body with the Cockatrice soul rooted in it can become Cockatrice King.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Valley of Stone · ⚔️ Grey Valley · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Cockatrice Raptor

You run down horses now, and the ranchers near the galleries keep their herds behind stone walls. Grown from Cockatrice Strider at level 20.

Your legs grow long and your body turns into a runner's, and you can outpace a horse across the galleries. Grown from Cockatrice at level 10.

traits.name: Cockatrice Tyrant
traits.info:
You're a cockatrice the size of a horse now, king of the galleries, and the statues in your hall stand in rows like an audience. Grown from Cockatrice Stonerunner at level 40.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💪 Fight +3 · ⚔️ Tyrant Rush · ⚔️ Rows Like an Audience · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Cold Magic
traits.info:
The cold lives in you: no cold can hurt you, and your magic freezes what it hits.

⚔️ Frostbite · 🚫 immune to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Cold: Chill Breath
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Chill Breath. Breathe out a short cold blast: one foe is chilled and slowed for a turn, or water in front of you freezes.

traits.name: Cold: Cold Snap
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Cold Snap. The cold drops suddenly over a wide area: every foe in it is slowed for three turns and takes cold damage each turn.

traits.name: Cold: Deep Freeze
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Deep Freeze. One foe freezes solid for two turns and can't act; a hit while it's frozen does heavy cold damage and breaks the ice.

traits.name: Cold: Eternal Ice
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Eternal Ice. Freeze everything in a wide area solid for two turns: every foe in it is trapped in ice and takes heavy cold damage when it breaks.

traits.name: Cold: Frost Grip
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Frost Grip. One foe you hit or grab freezes where you struck; that part of it stays stiff and slow for three turns, and a second hit there shatters the frost for extra cold damage.

traits.name: Cold: Frozen Ground
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Frozen Ground. Freeze the ground round you for three turns: foes on it slip, fall and move at half speed; you don't.

traits.name: Cold: Heart of Winter
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Heart of Winter. For the rest of the fight foes who touch you or stand close are frozen a little every turn; a foe frozen three times can't move.

traits.name: Cold: Ice Skin
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Ice Skin. For three turns a layer of ice armours your skin: blows do less, and anything that hits you is chilled.

traits.name: Cold: Ice Spike
traits.info: Your cold has grown: Ice Spike. Drive a spike of ice up from the ground or out of your hand into one foe: heavy cold damage and the foe is pinned for a turn.

traits.name: Cold: White Out
traits.info: Your cold has grown: White Out. A freezing storm fills the area round you for three turns; every foe in it takes cold damage each turn and can barely see, and you see through it fine.

traits.name: Colossus
traits.info:
You're a walking statue as tall as a tower, made for wars older than anyone remembers, and birds nest in the cracks in your shoulders. Grown from War Golem at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +3 · ⚔️ Colossal Step · ⚔️ Nest in the Cracks · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Contract Devil
traits.info:
Every monster lord in the Wildreach owes you something, and you carry all their names written in a book of skin. Grown from Devil Broker at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Barter +3 · ⚔️ Collect the Debt · ⚔️ Book of Skin · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Corridor Mimic
traits.info:
You can become a hallway now, flagstones and torches and all, and the adventurers who walk down you never reach the end. Grown from Door Mimic at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Swallowing Hall

traits.name: Corrosive Slime
traits.info:
You dissolve armour and stone now, and the dungeon halls you roll through are left with smooth grooves eaten into the floor. Grown from Acid Slime at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Corrode

traits.name: Crabfolk
traits.info:
Crabfolk villages are walled with shells, thousands of them stacked and cemented together along the tide-flats, and the houses inside are built sideways and low because that's how a crabfolk thinks about everything. They're broad and hard-shelled with one great crushing claw and one small clever one, and any ship that wrecks along their coast is picked clean by morning, timber, rope, cargo and all, because salvage is what the crabfolk live on. They're stubborn as the rock pools they guard, they clack when they talk and they trade salvage, and if you want to haggle with one you'd best be patient, a crabfolk will come at any deal from the side and never straight on.

💪 Endure +3 · 🦊 Build +1 · ⚔️ Shell Up · 🧱 resists slashing, piercing · ⚠️ weak to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Crabfolk Bulwark
traits.info:
Your shell grows thick and your big claw grows broader, and you can stand in the surf all day without moving an inch. Grown from Crabfolk at level 10.

traits.name: Crabfolk Scavenger

traits.name: Crabfolk Shellguard

traits.name: Crabfolk Wrecker

You strip ships for parts now, and a wreck on your beach is gone down to the keel in a single night. Grown from Crabfolk Scavenger at level 20.

Somebody's old helmet, dented, still good.

traits.name: Drake
traits.info:

They're horse-sized dragons with no wings and a lot of pride, they preen their scales, they sulk when they're ignored and they'll fight to the death over a shiny buckle. Most drakes never learn to talk, but the old ones do, and an elder drake will hear you out from on top of its hoard and let you pass if the tribute you brought is bright enough, and burn you where you stand if it isn't.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Spark Spit · 🧱 resists fire, piercing · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Drakeling
traits.info:
You've got wings now, small but real, a long tail and a gold hunger that won't shut up. Grown from Wyrmspeaker at level 30. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Drakeling.

traits.name: Dream Dryad

traits.name: Drowned Once
traits.info:
You went under and something held you there until your ribs cracked and you stopped breathing, and you came back with a chest that healed thick and hard enough to take a beating, but your heart jumps and stutters every time a storm cracks overhead.

🧱 resists bludgeoning · ⚠️ weak to lightning

traits.name: Dryad
traits.info:
In every old grove there's one tree greener and older than the rest, and if you look at its roots you'll see the axes, rusted and half-swallowed by the bark, from every logger who ever tried to cut it. That tree has a dryad in it, a woman of bark and leaf who can step out of the trunk as easily as through a doorway, and she'll sing intruders to sleep where they stand and wake the roots to wrap them up while they dream. They speak with the whole forest's voice, birds and branches and wind all at once, and the only thing a dryad will ever trade for is the grove's safety, everything else is just something walking on her floor.

🦊 Lore +2 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Coax Green · 🧱 resists bludgeoning · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Dryad Charmer
traits.info:
Blossoms open in your hair and you smell so sweet it makes people's heads swim, and they forget what they came into the grove to do. Grown from Dryad at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Sleep Pollen

traits.name: Dryad Dreamweaver
traits.info:
Intruders in your grove fall asleep and wake up a year later, and their families have long since stopped looking. Grown from Dryad Enchantress at level 30.

traits.name: Dryad Enchantress

traits.name: Dryad Guardian

traits.name: Dryad Warden

traits.name: Dungeon Mimic
traits.info:

💪 Might +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Living Floor · ⚔️ Days Inside You · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Dyed Robes

Robes dyed in your family's colours.

traits.name: Earth Dragon

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Soul Pyre

traits.name: Endless Song Siren
traits.info:
Your song never ends now, and the ones who hear it never wake up, and the reef around you is full of smiling bones. Grown from Siren Enchantress at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Endless Song · ⚔️ Smiling Bones · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Every-Shape Mimic
traits.info:
You've been everything you ever ate, and you can be any of them again, and nobody alive has ever seen your real shape. Grown from Polymorph Mimic at level 40. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Every-Shape Mimic.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Absorb +3 · ⚔️ Thousand Shapes · ⚔️ Real Shape · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Fae Dryad
traits.info:
Gossamer wings veined like leaves open on your back and your eyes start to glitter, and the pixies stop playing tricks on you. Grown from Dryad at level 10. Only a body with the Pixie soul rooted in it can become Fae Dryad.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fae Light

traits.name: Fae Grove-Queen
traits.info:
The pixies and the trees both answer to you now, and your grove hums with little lights at night. Grown from Fae Grove-Sprite at level 30. Only a body with the Pixie soul rooted in it can become Fae Grove-Queen.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Fae Court · ⚔️ Little Lights · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Fae Grove-Sprite
traits.info:
You're half dryad and half pixie, flitting tree to tree so fast people swear there are three of you. Grown from Fae Dryad at level 20. Only a body with the Pixie soul rooted in it can become Fae Grove-Sprite.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Tree Step

traits.name: Fae King
traits.info:
You rule the hidden fae courts under the hills, and every bargain struck in the wild ends up owing you something. Grown from Fae Grove-Queen at level 40. Only a body with the Pixie soul rooted in it can become Fae King.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Fae Bargain · ⚔️ Everything Owes You · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Fang Necklace
traits.info:
A string of fangs from your best kills.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Feathers and Beads
traits.info:
Feathers and beads tied in wherever they'll stay.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Fen Hag
traits.info:
You're weed-crowned and old as the marsh, and you know every safe path through it and every one that drowns people. Grown from Bog Troll at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Swiftness +1 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Marsh Curse · ⚔️ Drowning Path · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Fen Witch
traits.info:
The marsh does what you say, mist rolls in on your word and the drowned things come up when you call them. Grown from Fen Hag at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Drowned Host · ⚔️ Mist Roll · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Fire Devil
traits.info:
Wings of fire open on your back and your tail ends in a forked tip, and people in the vent towns cross the street when they see you coming. Grown from Imp Firebrand at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Hellfire Lash

traits.name: Fire Drake
traits.info:
Your scales go red, your throat glows like a forge and smoke curls out of your nostrils every time you get annoyed. Grown from Drake at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Flame Gout

traits.name: Fire Hydra
traits.info:
Your scales go red and every one of your throats glows like a coal. Grown from Hydra at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fire Spit

traits.name: Fire Magic
traits.info:
Your body runs hot and fire answers you: fire can't burn you, and your magic burns what it hits.

⚔️ Flare · 🚫 immune to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Fire: Burning Ground
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Burning Ground. The ground round you catches fire for three turns; every foe in it burns each turn, and the fire spreads a step further out every turn.

traits.name: Fire: Fire Fist
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Fire Fist. One heavy hit that lands as a burst of fire: fire damage on top of the blow, and the foe is thrown back burning.

traits.name: Fire: Firestorm
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Firestorm. A huge eruption of fire around you: every foe in a wide area takes heavy fire damage and burns for three turns.

traits.name: Fire: Heat Haze
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Heat Haze. For three turns the air round you shimmers with heat; foes trying to hit you from range miss far more often.

traits.name: Fire: Hot Hands
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Hot Hands. For the rest of the fight every hit you land sets the foe burning, and a burning foe takes fire damage each turn until it's put out.

traits.name: Fire: Kindle
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Kindle. Set one thing alight with a touch: kindling, a rope, a door, a foe's fur or clothes; it burns for two turns.

traits.name: Fire: Phoenix Heart
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Phoenix Heart. Once a day, when you would fall, you burst into flame instead and rise with a third of your health; foes close by are burned.

traits.name: Fire: Pyre
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Pyre. One foe you can see burns from the inside, taking heavy fire damage and burning hard for three turns; if it dies burning, the fire leaps to the nearest foe.

traits.name: Fire: Smoke Out
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Smoke Out. Fill the area with choking smoke for three turns: foes in it can't see and cough, while you see and breathe fine.

traits.name: Fire: Wildfire
traits.info: Your fire has grown: Wildfire. A fire you start spreads fast for three turns, jumping from foe to foe and thing to thing; each foe it reaches burns.

traits.name: First Kill: Antfolk
traits.info:
You killed an antfolk soldier at the edge of its colony and the whole nest went still at once, and you still hear the faint hum of a thousand others in the back of your head.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Arachne
traits.info:
An arachne caught you in its web and made the mistake of coming close to bite, and you came out of it patient, counting the threads of every trap before you step.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Basilisk
traits.info:
You killed a basilisk without ever looking it in the eye, and now the weak ones flinch and look away when you stare at them too long.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Bearkin
traits.info:
A bearkin mauled you half to death before you won, and ever since the cold barely reaches you and a blow that should drop you just makes you angry.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Boarfolk
traits.info:
The boarfolk charged and you met it head on, and you came out of it wanting to put your head down and run straight at the next thing that looked at you wrong.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Catfolk
traits.info:
You never heard the catfolk coming and it never heard you leave, and afterwards you noticed your own feet going quiet on every floor.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Centaur
traits.info:
The centaur tried to outrun you across open ground and nearly did, and when its soul came in your legs remembered what it is to have the whole plain under your feet.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Cockatrice
traits.info:
A cockatrice pecked you and your fingers went grey and stiff before you wrung its neck, and stone doesn't creep into you the way it should anymore.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Crabfolk
traits.info:
You cracked a crabfolk out of its shell one plate at a time, and your skin grew thicker over the next month like it was making a shell of its own.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Drake
traits.info:
A young drake spat fire at you and missed by a hand, and when you took its soul you tasted smoke on your breath for a week and felt a spark sitting in your throat.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Dryad
traits.info:
You cut down a dryad's tree with it still inside, and the plants lean your way a little now when you walk past, like they're not sure if they should be afraid.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Fox Spirit
traits.info:
A fox spirit led you round in circles for a whole night before you caught it, and you woke the next morning knowing three tricks and a lie you'd never learned.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Gargoyle
traits.info:
You thought the gargoyle was a statue until it moved, and you only beat it because it was slow to start, and you can stand stone-still for hours now, watching.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Gazer
traits.info:
You stabbed out a gazer's eye while it was looking into your mind, and now and then you see what other creatures are really thinking about you.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Ghoul
traits.info:
You caught a ghoul feeding in a barrow and it fought you with its mouth still full, and food has never tasted quite right since, not unless it's been dead a while.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Gnoll
traits.info:
A gnoll laughed at you right up until the end, and you swear you heard the laugh again inside your own head after it went quiet, along with the itch to run something down.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Goblin
traits.info:
A goblin scout jumped you with a rusty shiv and a mouthful of insults, and when it stopped twitching you felt its nasty little cleverness settle in behind your eyes instead of fading out with the rest of it.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Golem
traits.info:
You broke a golem apart rune by rune until the light went out of it, and you came away steady and certain and very hard to move off a decision.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Harpy
traits.info:
A harpy screamed itself hoarse trying to drive you off, and when it fell your eyes went sharp, catching every flick of movement in the sky.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Hellhound
traits.info:
You put down a hellhound that was hunting you, and the fire in its belly sits in yours now, smouldering, waiting for a reason.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Hydra
traits.info:
You cut one head off a hydra and two grew back, so you took them all, and some nights you hear them, a room full of arguing voices inside you that all want to live.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Imp
traits.info:
An imp spent the whole fight insulting you and setting little fires, and when you finally caught it you got its spite as well, giggling at things that aren't funny to anyone else.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Kobold
traits.info:
You pulled a kobold out of a crack in the rock by its tail and it bit you the whole way down, and afterwards you could hear the tunnels the way it used to, every drip and scrape telling you where the gaps went.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Lamia
traits.info:
The lamia almost talked you into its coils, and when you killed it you kept the voice, low and smooth and very good at making people want to listen.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Lizardfolk
traits.info:
You fought a lizardfolk in waist-deep marsh water and held it under until it stopped moving, and its soul taught your lungs to wait.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Mandrake
traits.info:
You pulled a mandrake out of the ground and its scream nearly killed you first, and that scream is yours now, sitting at the back of your throat waiting to be let out.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Mantid
traits.info:
The mantid held so still you walked right past it, and you only won because it struck a heartbeat too early, and now you're the one that waits for the perfect moment.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Merfolk
traits.info:
You fought a merfolk in the shallows and it nearly pulled you under, and the sea has felt like home ever since, the tide pulling at you when you're far from it.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Mimic
traits.info:
You opened a chest and it opened you back, and you killed it with your hand still stuck in its teeth, and seeming like something else comes easier to you now than being yourself.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Minotaur
traits.info:
You got lost in a minotaur's maze and it found you, and when you finally got it down you knew every turn of that place like you had built it yourself.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Myconid
traits.info:
You stamped a myconid into the mud and breathed in its last cloud of spores, and afterwards you could hear the rot working quietly under every forest floor.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Ogre
traits.info:
The ogre was so big you had to kill it in pieces, and for a week after you were hungry all the time, slow to anger and slower to stop once you started.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Orc
traits.info:
An orc picked a fight it thought it would win and you put it in the mud instead, and its soul came into you roaring, so that for a moment you wanted nothing in the world but the next fight.

🔮 Command +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Pixie
traits.info:
You swatted a pixie out of the air without thinking and almost missed what happened next, a speck of bright mischief settling in you that has never once sat still.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Ratfolk
traits.info:
You cornered a ratfolk in a sewer and it bargained with you right up to the end, and you've caught yourself counting coins in your head and looking for the angle in every deal since.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Rockworm
traits.info:
A rockworm came up under your feet and you fought it in the dark of its own tunnel, and now you feel the ground hum through your feet for miles.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Salamander
traits.info:
You put out a salamander in a river and the steam boiled up round you both, and you came out of the water with a little ember in your chest that never quite goes out.

🦊 Build +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Satyr
traits.info:
A satyr played you a tune to make you dance into a ravine and you killed it before the last note, and the song stayed, humming in your chest whenever you open your mouth.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Scorpid
traits.info:
A scorpid stung you and you killed it while the venom was still burning through you, and you've never been that sick from a sting since.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Shade
traits.info:
A shade followed you for three nights before you caught it in the open, and your own shadow sometimes moves a moment before you do.

🦊 Lore +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Sharkfolk
traits.info:
A sharkfolk smelled your blood in the water from a mile out and came for you, and you killed it with your teeth in its gills, and now you can smell blood in the water too.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Siren
traits.info:
A siren sang you onto the rocks and you killed it with the song still in your ears, and folk go quiet now when you speak, without quite knowing why.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: First Kill: Skeleton
traits.info:
You knocked a skeleton apart and it kept trying to put itself back together until you ground the skull to dust, and you got up the next morning with an old soldier's habits, standing your watch whether anyone asked or not.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Slime
traits.info:
A slime swallowed your arm and you tore it apart from the inside, and for days after your skin felt loose and wet, like it was waiting to be told what shape to hold.

🔮 Absorb +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Sylph
traits.info:
You caught a sylph in a cave where the wind couldn't save it, and you feel the breeze shift before anyone else in the room does.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Treant
traits.info:
It took you all day to bring down the treant, hacking and burning, and you've been a little slower and a lot harder to hurry from that day on.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Troll
traits.info:
You killed a troll three times before it stayed dead, the third time with fire, and the stubbornness that kept getting it back up crawled into you and never left.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: First Kill: Vampire
traits.info:
You killed a vampire just before dawn and watched the light finish what you started, and you've been thirsty in a way water doesn't fix, and very, very polite about it.

🔮 Absorb +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Wolfkin
traits.info:
You ran down a wolfkin in the long grass by moonlight, and when its soul came into you the night opened up, every smell on the wind telling you a story.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Wraith
traits.info:
You killed a wraith that was already dead, and since then you can feel the dead watching from wherever they wait.

🔮 Absorb +1

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: First Kill: Wyvern
traits.info:
You dragged a wyvern out of the sky by its tail and broke it on the rocks, and now you catch yourself climbing things just to look down from them.

💪 Endure +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: Five-Headed Hydra
traits.info:
You've got five heads now, and every one that gets cut off comes back as two. Grown from Swamp Hydra at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Regrow

traits.name: Flame Drake
traits.info:
You grow bigger and your scales are too hot to touch, and fire bends toward you when you call it like a dog coming to heel. Grown from Fire Drake at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fire Sweep

traits.name: Flame Hydra
traits.info:
Your heads take turns breathing fire, so there's never a gap anyone can get through. Grown from Fire Hydra at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fire Volley

traits.name: Forest Bear
traits.info:
You're a whole forest in a bear's body, older than any tree in it and terrible when you're angry. Grown from Treebear at level 40. Only a body with the Treant soul rooted in it can become Forest Bear.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ The Forest Rises · ⚔️ Older Than Trees · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Forest Dryad
traits.info:
The forest's soul lives in you now, and when you're hurt the leaves wilt for a mile. Grown from Grove Mother at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ The Wood Awakens · ⚔️ Leaves Wilt · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Forge Golem
traits.info:
A furnace glows in your chest behind iron bars and your joints run red-hot, and the smiths in town want you in their workshop more than they want gold. Grown from Golem at level 10. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Forge Golem.

💪 Might +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Furnace Heart

traits.name: Forge-Titan
traits.info:
You're a titan whose chest is a forge for legends, and smiths make pilgrimages to stand in front of you and feel the heat. Grown from Magma Golem at level 40. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Forge-Titan.

💪 Might +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Titan's Forge · ⚔️ Feel the Heat · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Fortress Ogre
traits.info:
You're more stone than flesh now, with runework carved right into your own body like the walls of a keep. Grown from Rune Ogre at level 30. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Fortress Ogre.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Bulwark · ⚔️ Runes Blaze · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Four Winds Sylph
traits.info:
Every wind that blows answers to you, and sailors pray to you before they put to sea. Grown from Sylph Sky-Dancer at level 40.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Four Winds · ⚔️ Sailors' Prayer · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Four-Tailed Fox
traits.info:
Four tails fan out behind you, each one burning, and nobody at the crossroads wants to haggle with you anymore. Grown from Two-Tailed Fox at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Foxfire Ring

traits.name: Fox Deceiver
traits.info:
You can wear any face you've ever seen, and you've sat at a family's table wearing their uncle's. Grown from Fox Trickster at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Borrowed Face

traits.name: Fox Face-Thief
traits.info:
Nobody knows your real face anymore, maybe not even you. Grown from Fox Deceiver at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Masquerade · ⚔️ Steal a Face · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Fox Liar-King
traits.info:
Your lies come true now, and the countryside is a little bit wrong because of things you've said. Grown from Fox Face-Thief at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ True Lie · ⚔️ A Bit Wrong · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Fox Spirit
traits.info:
There's a simple way to tell how much trouble a fox spirit is, count the tails, one is a clever animal, three is a trickster who can wear a face, and anything past five has been around long enough to own half the road and most of the people on it. They live on the edges of every town and crossroads, sometimes as a fox in the hedge and sometimes as the stranger at the inn whose shadow doesn't quite match, and they love a deal more than they love anything. A fox spirit speaks beautifully and trades in favours, and every word it says is true in a way, just never the way you took it, so by the time you work out what you actually agreed to it's already collecting.

🦊 Barter +4 · ⚔️ Fox Trick · 🧱 resists fire · ⚠️ weak to holy

Any build.

traits.name: Fox Trickster
traits.info:
You've got a sly grin that never leaves your face and you can copy anyone's voice, and half the town's arguments start with something you said in someone else's. Grown from Fox Spirit at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Mimic Voice

traits.name: Fox Wraith
traits.info:
You're a ghost fox now that steals the warmth out of the living, and people wake up shivering after you've passed their window. Grown from Spectral Fox at level 30. Only a body with the Wraith soul rooted in it can become Fox Wraith.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Soul Theft · ⚔️ Shiver at the Window · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Foxhorn Satyr
traits.info:
You've got fox ears and goat horns both now, and blue foxfire dances in the holes of your pipes while you play. Grown from Trickster Satyr at level 20. Only a body with the Fox Spirit soul rooted in it can become Foxhorn Satyr.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Foxfire Tune

traits.name: Frost Ogre
traits.info:
You're blue-skinned and crowned in ice and winter follows you around wherever you go. Grown from Ogre Mage at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Blizzard · ⚔️ Ice Crown · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Fungal Gazer
traits.info:
You're half eye and half mushroom now, caps growing all over you, and the spores you breathe out let you get inside people's heads. Grown from Spore Eye at level 20. Only a body with the Myconid soul rooted in it can become Fungal Gazer.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Spore Puppet

traits.name: Fungal Rat-Mother
traits.info:
You're a huge, swollen fungus-rat, and the spores that come off you grow into new rats in the dark corners of the sewers. Grown from Rot Rat at level 30. Only a body with the Myconid soul rooted in it can become Fungal Rat-Mother.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Spore Brood · ⚔️ Swollen Spores · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Fungus Rat Queen
traits.info:
You're a rat-shaped mountain of fungus filling a sewer cavern, and the ratfolk worship you with offerings of rot. Grown from Fungal Rat-Mother at level 40. Only a body with the Myconid soul rooted in it can become Fungus Rat Queen.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Absorb +3 · ⚔️ Rot Everything · ⚔️ Offerings of Rot · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Fur Mantle
traits.info:
A thick fur mantle off something that lost a fight with you.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Furnace Golem
traits.info:
Your furnace roars all the time now and sparks rain from your joints with every step, so you leave a trail of little fires behind you through the halls. Grown from Forge Golem at level 20. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Furnace Golem.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Furnace Blast

traits.name: Gale Mantid
traits.info:
You fly on cuts of wind now, wings humming, and the jungle canopy bends under you when you pass over it. Grown from Wind Mantid at level 20. Only a body with the Sylph soul rooted in it can become Gale Mantid.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Gale Blades

traits.name: Gale Wolf
traits.info:
Lightning runs along your pelt when you're angry, and when you howl thunder rolls in behind it. Grown from Storm Wolf at level 20. Only a body with the Sylph soul rooted in it can become Gale Wolf.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Thunder Howl

traits.name: Gargoyle
traits.info:
In the towns that pay gargoyles there's a stone figure perched on every rooftop, and if you pay attention you'll notice each one is crouched in a slightly different pose every morning than it was the night before. They're winged statues that wake when the sun goes down, guarding ruined spires and any town willing to show them the respect they ask for, and turning back into stone by day. A gargoyle talks in a grinding voice like millstones turning, and what it wants in trade is respect, a proper greeting, a share of the harvest set out on the roof, and a town that forgets its manners finds its guardians gone one morning and a lot of things it was being protected from coming in through the dark.

They talk, and they'll trade what they know, which is a lot, for anything new to look at, a painting, a strange coin, a face they haven't seen before.

A caravan they've hit is easy to recognise, every bone cracked open for the marrow and every crate gone, and what they don't eat turns up later in their camps as trade, bones, teeth and other people's belongings, haggled over in barks and giggles that never quite stop.

traits.name: Goblin
traits.info:
Goblins are small creatures but no less deadly. They live in groups and hunt in packs, and they use tricks and terrain to their advantage. While goblins have short lifespans they breed fast and in huge numbers, so there are always more of them. They live in hovels or caves in huge groups, keeping the weaker ones at the back with the children, usually a gaggle of morons or low intellects. Every once in a while a higher tier or station of goblin, a general, a king or a witch-hag shaman, will organise this gaggle of chaotic little biters into a dangerous and co-ordinated mass of teeth, claws and tools.

Golems don't talk, but some of them will stop for a password, and treasure hunters spend years digging through ruins for the right words, because every vault guarded by a golem is a vault that's never been robbed.
