🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Storm Scream · ⚔️ Turn the Boats · 🧱 resists lightning

traits.name: Harpy Tempest-Witch
traits.info:
You're a storm with wings and a face, and the weather follows you along the coast like a dog. Grown from Harpy Storm-Crone at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Hurricane · ⚔️ Weather Like a Dog · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Hawk's Generosity
traits.info: Hawk passed through and left you better than he found you: every attribute +2 for a few days, then it fades.

traits.name: Hellboar
traits.info:
Your bristles start smoking, your eyes glow like coals and your tusks are too hot to touch. Grown from Boarfolk at level 10. Only a body with the Hellhound soul rooted in it can become Hellboar.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Smoking Charge

traits.name: Hellfire Boar
traits.info:
You're a boar of living hellfire, the dungeon's furnace given tusks, and the ground smokes for days where you've walked. Grown from Infernal Boar at level 40. Only a body with the Hellhound soul rooted in it can become Hellfire Boar.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Hellfire Rampage · ⚔️ Smoking Ground · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Hellhound
traits.info:
Down near the lower vents the tunnels smell of smoke and the floor is marked with scorched paw prints as wide as a dinner plate, and the baying that comes out of the dark sounds more like a forge's bellows than any dog. Hellhounds are black hounds the size of ponies with eyes like coals and jaws that smoke when they pant, and they run in packs that can follow a scent through ash and fire for days. They don't talk and they can't be tamed, only beaten, which is why a warlord with a hellhound at heel has already proved something to everyone watching, nothing breaks one to the leash but someone stronger than the whole pack.

💪 Endure +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Smoke Trail · 🧱 resists fire · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Hellhound Alpha
traits.info:
You get bigger and darker and your eyes burn like coals in a forge, and the rest of the pack drops its ears when you walk past. Grown from Hellhound at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Pack Snarl

traits.name: Hellhound Firebreather
traits.info:
Your throat glows orange through your black fur and smoke pours from your jaws every time you pant. Grown from Hellhound at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fire Breath

traits.name: Hellhound Huntmaster
traits.info:
You're a hound of hellfire who leads the burning hunt, and the night sky glows orange when your pack runs across the land. Grown from Hellhound Inferno at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Burning Hunt · ⚔️ Orange Sky · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Hellhound Inferno
traits.info:
You're a hound of pure fire now, and the stone floors crack and glow where you walk. Grown from Hellhound Pyre at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Inferno Howl · ⚔️ Glowing Floor · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Hellhound Packmaster
traits.info:
You lead a pack of burning hounds now, and when the pack runs it leaves a trail of smoking paw prints across the land. Grown from Hellhound Alpha at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Burning Pack

traits.name: Hellhound Pyre
traits.info:
Your fur is flame now, crackling and roaring, and you leave the smell of burning wherever you lie down. Grown from Hellhound Firebreather at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Pyre Body

traits.name: Hexed
traits.info:
A shaman cursed you and the curse never quite let go, so shadow magic slides off you like it already knows you, but anything holy burns where the hex sits.

🧱 resists shadow · ⚠️ weak to holy

Any build.

traits.name: Hide Wraps
traits.info:
Strips of tanned hide wrapped and tied where you need them.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Hoard Drake
traits.info:
Gold coins and gems grow right into your scales, so you rattle when you walk, and every thief in the badlands has a plan to get them. Grown from Earth Drake at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Hoard Sense

traits.name: Hoard Mimic
traits.info:
Your body is a pile of coins with a mouth in it now, and you clink softly when you breathe. Grown from Chest Mimic at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Gold Bait

traits.name: Hob-Pixie
traits.info:
Tiny horns grow on your head, your wings go red at the edges and your jokes get a lot meaner. Grown from Pixie at level 10. Only a body with the Imp soul rooted in it can become Hob-Pixie.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Pixie Hex

traits.name: Hobgoblin
traits.info:
You shoot up a head taller and straighten out, your skin goes slate green and hard, and for the first time in your life the other goblins step aside when you walk through the warren instead of trying to trip you. Grown from Goblin at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Shield Wall

traits.name: Hollow Eyes
traits.info:
You see souls, every living thing glows from the inside, the strong ones burn so bright it hurts to look and the dead flicker out slow, and the souls you keep show up in your own reflection as knots of light, which takes some getting used to.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Soul Sight

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: Hollow Hill Hexqueen
traits.info:
You rule the cursed fae under the hills, and every bad luck charm sold in every market is meant to keep you away. Grown from Imp-Pixie Hexqueen at level 40. Only a body with the Imp soul rooted in it can become Hollow Hill Hexqueen.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Grand Curse · ⚔️ Bad Luck Charms · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Holy Magic
traits.info:
Light found you: holy fire can't hurt you, and your magic sears the dead and the dark.

⚔️ Brand · 🚫 immune to holy

Any build.

traits.name: Holy: Blessing
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Blessing. Bless your allies for three turns: they hit a little harder and the dark can't frighten them.

traits.name: Holy: Bright Eye
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Bright Eye. For the rest of the fight your eyes shine with holy light; you see anything hidden or invisible, and the undead and shadow-things that meet your stare take holy damage.

traits.name: Holy: Glow
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Glow. Give off a steady holy light for a while: it lights the dark, and the dead and the dark shy away from it.

traits.name: Holy: Healing Light
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Healing Light. Touch one ally and the light heals a little of their wounds.

traits.name: Holy: Judgement
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Judgement. A column of holy light falls on one foe: very heavy damage, and against the dead and the dark it's usually the end of them.

traits.name: Holy: Last Light
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Last Light. A pillar of holy light comes down on one foe for heavy holy damage; undead and shadow-things it hits are destroyed outright, unless they're bosses.

traits.name: Holy: Sanctified Ground
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Sanctified Ground. Make the ground round you holy for three turns: allies on it heal each turn, and the dead and dark burn on it.

traits.name: Holy: Sanctuary
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Sanctuary. Holy light surrounds you and your allies for three turns; you all heal a little each turn, and undead and shadow-things that come into it burn.

traits.name: Holy: Smite
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Smite. A strike filled with holy light: extra damage against the dead, demons and creatures of the dark, and they're thrown back.

traits.name: Holy: Turn the Dead
traits.info: Your holy has grown: Turn the Dead. Call the light down on the dead and the dark close by: weaker undead flee or crumble, stronger ones are badly hurt.

traits.name: Hooded Mantle
traits.info:
A short hooded mantle for keeping your head down.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Hundred-Headed Hydra
traits.info:
You've got more heads than anyone can count, and you rule the dungeon's sumps from a nest of bones. Grown from Nine-Headed Hydra at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +3 · ⚔️ Endless Heads · ⚔️ Nest of Bones · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Hungering Maw
traits.info:
Your soul is a mouth and it's always hungry, other monsters take a sliver when they kill but you take it best with your teeth, eating from the dead while they're still warm, and the longer you go without the louder the hunger gets until it's all you can hear.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Devour the Fallen

💪 Might build.

traits.name: Hunted for Sport
traits.info:
Something hunted you for fun for a whole season and you lived through it, so you can feel where a strike is coming from before it lands, but the dark still gets under your skin and makes your hands shake.

🧱 resists piercing · ⚠️ weak to shadow

Any build.

traits.name: Hydra
traits.info:
Down where the dungeon floods, the hissing never comes from one place, it comes from five or six at once and it sounds like arguing, because it is, every head on a hydra has its own opinion and they bicker over every meal. It's a great swamp serpent with a body like a sunken boat and a tangle of necks, and cutting one off is the worst thing you can do, two more push out of the stump while you're still celebrating. The only adventurers who've ever killed one went in with torches and burned every neck shut the moment it was cut, and the ones who didn't know that are still down there in the black water, what's left of them.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Snap and Snap · 🧱 resists slashing, poison · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Imp
traits.info:
Half the warlords in the Wildreach keep an imp around, a little horned, bat-winged thing perched on the back of a chair with a message scrawled on its arm in somebody else's handwriting, because nothing runs an errand faster through the dungeon than an imp. They're bred in the hot vents of the lower levels and they come up speaking every language there is, all of them badly, and they'll serve anyone who pays and sell that person out to the next one who pays more. You can always spot someone who stiffed an imp on the bill, they're the one with the itching rash, the bad luck and the boots that keep coming untied.

🦊 Barter +4 · ⚔️ Fingertip Spark · 🧱 resists fire · ⚠️ weak to holy

Any build.

traits.name: Imp Contractor
traits.info:
You carry a scroll everywhere now and talk like a market trader, and everybody who signs one of your papers regrets it eventually. Grown from Imp at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Small Print

traits.name: Imp Dealmaker
traits.info:
Your contracts bind now, truly bind, and the ink burns into the skin of anyone who breaks one. Grown from Imp Contractor at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Binding Contract

traits.name: Imp Firebrand
traits.info:
You go brighter red with a tail of flame and horns that smoke, and everything you sit on ends up scorched. Grown from Imp at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Imp Flame

traits.name: Imp-Pixie
traits.info:
Your wings catch fire at the edges and your cruel streak gets wider, and what you call a joke leaves burns. Grown from Hob-Pixie at level 20. Only a body with the Imp soul rooted in it can become Imp-Pixie.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Pixie Fire

traits.name: Imp-Pixie Hexqueen
traits.info:
You're queen of curses, tiny and terrible, and whole villages have gone a season without a single bit of good luck because of you. Grown from Imp-Pixie at level 30. Only a body with the Imp soul rooted in it can become Imp-Pixie Hexqueen.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Swarm Hex · ⚔️ Season Without Luck · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Infernal Boar
traits.info:
You're a boar made of smoke and flame now, and the dungeon's vents seem to breathe easier when you go back down into them. Grown from Cinder Boar at level 30. Only a body with the Hellhound soul rooted in it can become Infernal Boar.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Inferno Charge · ⚔️ Vent Breath · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Infernal Scorpid
traits.info:
You're a scorpion of hellfire from the dungeon's furnace depths, and the air around you ripples like the inside of an oven. Grown from Volcanic Scorpid at level 40. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Infernal Scorpid.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Hellfire Sting · ⚔️ Oven Air · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Inferno Hydra
traits.info:
Every head you've got is a furnace, and the swamp water steams when you slide into it. Grown from Flame Hydra at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Firestorm Heads · ⚔️ Steaming Water · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Iron Ant
traits.info:
Plates of grey metal spread across your chitin and a rune glows on your head, and you clank when you march. Grown from Antfolk at level 10. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Iron Ant.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Iron Plates

traits.name: Iron Golem
traits.info:
Plates of iron bolt themselves over your old clay and your fists grow heavy as anvils, and you clank when you walk like a smithy falling down stairs. Grown from Golem at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Iron Fist

traits.name: Iron Hive-Titan
traits.info:
You're a walking iron fortress shaped like an ant, and armies use you as shelter on the march. Grown from Rune Ant Colossus at level 40. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Iron Hive-Titan.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +3 · ⚔️ Iron Fortress · ⚔️ Shelter on the March · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Ironwood Treant
traits.info:
Your bark goes hard as iron and axes bounce off it, and the loggers have taken to carrying their broken blades home as proof. Grown from Oak Treant at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Ironbark

traits.name: Island Crab
traits.info:
You're a crab so vast your back is an island now, with trees and birds and a little beach, and some sailors have camped on you without knowing. Grown from Living Reef Crab at level 40. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Island Crab.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +3 · ⚔️ Island Shell · ⚔️ Camped on You · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Jelly Troll
traits.info:
You're a troll-shaped mass of living jelly that just reforms around whatever you cut it with. Grown from Ooze Troll at level 20. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Jelly Troll.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Engulfing Grasp

traits.name: Jelly-Cap
traits.info:
You're a fungus of living slime now and you eat the dead whole, bones and all. Grown from Ooze-Cap at level 20. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Jelly-Cap.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Engulf Corpse

traits.name: Keening Wraith
traits.info:
Your keening chills the blood now, a high, endless note that makes dogs howl and children wake screaming for miles. Grown from Banshee Wraith at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Chilling Keen

traits.name: Knotted Soul
traits.info:
Your soul ties knots, it hooks into whoever you spend enough time with and holds on, so you know when your pack is hurt before they shout and they feel it when you're angry, and losing one of them tears something loose in you for good.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Lore +1 · 🔮 Command +1 · ⚔️ Soul Knot

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: Kobold
traits.info:
Kobolds are knee-high to a man and they live like it, you'll find them in the old mines and the cracks between the stone, squeezing through gaps a cat would turn back from and nesting in shafts too narrow for anything bigger to follow. Most folk only know they're there from the sounds, claws ticking behind the rock, a yip in the dark, a pebble dropping where nobody's standing, and by the time you see the rust-red scales and the little dog snout it's usually because one of them wants you to. They never stop digging, every crack they move into gets wider, deeper and full of traps, so within a season an abandoned mine with kobolds in it is a maze of tripwires, pit drops and tunnels that loop back on themselves. They hoard anything that catches the light, chips of quartz, copper nails, a lost ring, and they pile the best of it in front of crude dragon shrines scratched into the walls, because every kobold believes the great wyrms are their kin and one day one will come down into the dark and claim them.

🦊 Build +3 · 🔮 Instinct +1 · ⚔️ Quick Burrow · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Kobold Artificer
traits.info:
There's more machine in you than flesh in places now, a genius with a body built by your own hands and a workshop nobody else is allowed in. Grown from Kobold Engineer at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Clockwork Guardian · ⚔️ Rebuild Myself · 🧱 resists lightning

traits.name: Kobold Dragon
traits.info:
You're a real dragon now, a small one, born out of a kobold, scaled in gold and crowned in horn, and every kobold who ever grovelled to a drake grovels to you. Grown from Drakeling at level 40. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Kobold Dragon.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Dragon's Fury · ⚔️ Gold Scales · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Kobold Engineer
traits.info:
You've got brass studs in your scales and clockwork claws you built yourself, and every pocket you own is a weapon. Grown from Kobold Gadgeteer at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Siege Contraption · ⚔️ Pocket Bomb · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Kobold Gadgeteer
traits.info:
Your little body's covered in contraptions, springs, wires, hooks, and half of them are bolted straight into your scales. Grown from Kobold Trapper at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Spring Volley

traits.name: Kobold Sapper
traits.info:
Your claws thicken into proper digging picks, your snout hardens and your rust-red scales go tough as boot leather, and rock starts feeling soft under your hands. Grown from Kobold at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Undermine

traits.name: Kobold Trapper
traits.info:
You go quick-fingered and sharp-eyed, and the tool belt you've worn forever starts growing into your scales like it's part of you. Grown from Kobold at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Snap Trap

traits.name: Kraken
traits.info:
You're a true kraken now, and ships sink in your grip, and the sailors pray to their gods when they feel the hull shudder. Grown from Kraken-Spawn at level 30. Only a body with the Hydra soul rooted in it can become Kraken.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Ship Crusher · ⚔️ Hull Shudder · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Kraken-Spawn
traits.info:
You're more tentacle than shark now, a writhing mass of grey arms with a mouth in the middle, and the fishermen burn their nets when they catch a glimpse of you. Grown from Shark-Kraken at level 20. Only a body with the Hydra soul rooted in it can become Kraken-Spawn.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Crushing Coils

traits.name: Labyrinth Keeper
traits.info:
You go calm and patient, a ring of keys grows right into your hide, and you can find any door in the maze with your eyes shut. Grown from Minotaur at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Maze Trap

traits.name: Labyrinth King
traits.info:
You've lived in your maze so long the walls breathe when you breathe, and the halls change their shape whenever you're angry. Grown from Labyrinth Lord at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Living Maze · ⚔️ The Halls Change · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Labyrinth Lord
traits.info:
You rule a maze that's alive, and anything that gets lost in the Wildreach seems to end up wandering into your halls sooner or later. Grown from Labyrinth Warden at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Endless Halls · ⚔️ Lost Ones · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Labyrinth Slime
traits.info:
You've grown into a dungeon floor, every hall and room and trap of it, and adventurers who walk your halls are walking around inside you. Grown from Vault Slime at level 40. Only a body with the Mimic soul rooted in it can become Labyrinth Slime.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Living Dungeon · ⚔️ Walking Inside You · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Labyrinth Warden
traits.info:
The halls shift as you walk through them, walls sliding aside to let you pass and closing again behind you. Grown from Labyrinth Keeper at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Shift the Walls

traits.name: Lamia
traits.info:
Every oasis temple in the desert has a pool of clear water and a soft voice calling travellers to rest by it, and the sand around those temples is full of old bones that nobody ever talks about. A lamia is a woman from the waist up and a great scaled serpent from there down, and most people don't see the tail until she rises up out of the water and keeps rising. They speak sweetly and they trade in secrets and gold, and they're easy company for as long as you owe them nothing, but a lamia never forgets a debt, not a coin, not a favour and not an insult, and sooner or later every one of them gets collected in coils.

🦊 Barter +4 · ⚔️ Coil · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Lamia Charmer
traits.info:
Every word out of your mouth is a hook, and the merchants who deal with you walk away happy until they count what they agreed to. Grown from Lamia Enchantress at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Binding Stare

traits.name: Lamia Coil-Queen
traits.info:
You've grown into a colossal serpent-woman who can wrap a building in her coils, and the ruins around your temple are the ones that annoyed you. Grown from Lamia Python at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Ruin Coil · ⚔️ Wrap the Room · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Lamia Constrictor
traits.info:
Your tail grows long and thick with muscle, and you can crack a barrel by wrapping it once. Grown from Lamia at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Crushing Coil

traits.name: Lamia Enchantress
traits.info:
Your voice gets softer and sticks in people's heads for days after they've heard it, and travellers find themselves walking back to your temple without knowing why. Grown from Lamia at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Charming Word

traits.name: Lamia Python
traits.info:
Your tail runs as long as a hall now and your scales are as big as shields, and the temple steps are worn smooth where you drag yourself up them. Grown from Lamia Constrictor at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Python Crush

traits.name: Lamia Queen
traits.info:
Every oasis in the desert answers to you, and caravan masters pay you a toll just to drink from water you'll never visit. Grown from Lamia Temple-Queen at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Desert Court · ⚔️ Oasis Toll · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Lamia Temple-Queen
traits.info:
You rule an oasis temple and every traveller who stops for a drink, and the ones who try to leave without your blessing find the doors don't open. Grown from Lamia Charmer at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Temple Court · ⚔️ Doors That Won't Open · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Last Dawn Cockatrice
traits.info:
Your crow at dawn has ended towns, and the ones that are left set their bells ringing all night to drown out the morning. Grown from Cockatrice Doom-Crier at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Last Dawn · ⚔️ Bells All Night · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Last Scream Mandrake
traits.info:
The story goes your full scream ended a kingdom, and nobody's ever been brave enough to dig you up and find out. Grown from Mandrake Banshee-Root at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ The Last Scream · ⚔️ Don't Dig Me Up · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Lava Worm
traits.info:
You go hot and red and rock melts at your mouth like butter on a stove, and the tunnels you leave glow for days. Grown from Rockworm at level 10. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Lava Worm.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Melt Rock

traits.name: Lich
traits.info:
You've hidden your life away somewhere nobody will ever find it, and your bones crackle with green magic, and you can't be killed for good while it's hidden. Grown from Bone Necromancer at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Death Bolt · ⚔️ Hidden Life · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Lightning Magic
traits.info:
There's a storm under your skin: lightning can't touch you, and your magic shocks what it hits.

⚔️ Spark · 🚫 immune to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Lightning: Ball Lightning
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Ball Lightning. Throw a crackling ball of lightning that drifts toward foes for three turns, shocking each one it touches.

traits.name: Lightning: Chain Strike
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Chain Strike. A bolt hits one foe and then jumps to up to three more close by; each takes lightning damage and is stunned for a moment.

traits.name: Lightning: Live Wire
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Live Wire. For the rest of the fight lightning jumps from you to anything that hits or grabs you; each time, it takes lightning damage and loses its hold.

traits.name: Lightning: Overload
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Overload. Pour lightning into one foe until it overloads: heavy damage, and the foe is stunned for two turns.

traits.name: Lightning: Quick Charge
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Quick Charge. The lightning in you speeds you up for three turns: you move and act first, and cover twice the ground.

traits.name: Lightning: Ride the Bolt
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Ride the Bolt. Turn into lightning for a moment and strike to any spot you can see: every foe in your path takes lightning damage.

traits.name: Lightning: Static
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Static. Charge your hands with static: your next touch jolts one foe, making them drop what they hold or stagger.

traits.name: Lightning: Storm Call
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Storm Call. For three turns a storm hangs over the fight; each turn lightning strikes a foe of your choice from the sky for heavy damage.

traits.name: Lightning: Thunderclap
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Thunderclap. A crack of thunder from your hands: every foe close by is deafened and stunned for a turn.

traits.name: Lightning: Thunderstorm
traits.info: Your lightning has grown: Thunderstorm. Call a full storm over the fight for three turns: each turn several foes are struck by lightning from the sky and stunned.

traits.name: Living Flame
traits.info:
You're more fire than flesh now, a walking inferno, and nobody stands closer than a spear's length to talk to you. Grown from Salamander Flamelord at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Inferno · ⚔️ Spear's Length · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Living Ooze-Garden
traits.info:
You're a heaving mass of slime and fungus that fills a cave floor, and nobody can tell where you end and the floor begins. Grown from Jelly-Cap at level 30. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Living Ooze-Garden.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Garden Sprawl · ⚔️ Where the Floor Begins · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Living Reef Crab
traits.info:
A whole reef grows on your stone shell now, fish darting among the coral on your back, and you can sit in the shallows for a year. Grown from Rune Crab at level 30. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Living Reef Crab.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Reef Fortress · ⚔️ A Year in the Shallows · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Lizard King
traits.info:
Every marsh tribe answers to you, a cold and patient king who's never once been in a hurry, and never once lost. Grown from Lizardfolk Chieftain at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Swamp Muster · ⚔️ Never Lost · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Lizardfolk
traits.info:
The log in the reeds blinks, that's usually the first and last thing anyone notices about a lizardfolk hunter, because they can lie in the marsh water so still and for so long that birds land on them. Their villages stand on stilts over the swamp, reed huts joined by rope bridges, nets drying on every rail, and nothing in them goes to waste, not fish bones, not shells, and not their own dead, who get eaten at the funeral by the family so the strength stays in the tribe. They're cold-eyed and patient and they don't care much about anything that isn't food, shelter or the next hatching, and they'll trade fish and shells with you in flat hisses without ever once looking like they wouldn't eat you too if the season was bad enough.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Hold Breath · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Lizardfolk Chieftain
traits.info:
You're tall and scarred from a hundred hunts and your village has grown to cover a marsh, stilt huts as far as the eye can see. Grown from Lizardfolk Stalker at level 30.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Ambush Order · ⚔️ Stilt Village · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Lizardfolk Hunter
traits.info:
Your limbs stretch long, your scales pattern up like dry reeds and your spear-arm thickens, and the village starts sending you out first when there's meat to bring home. Grown from Lizardfolk at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Spear Lunge

traits.name: Lizardfolk Mist-Priest
traits.info:
The marsh mist follows you around like a cloak, and when you walk into a village the fog rolls in behind you. Grown from Lizardfolk Spirit-Talker at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Choking Mist · ⚔️ Fog Cloak · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Lizardfolk Shaman
traits.info:
A frill of feathers and scales rises round your head, and your eyes start following things over the water that nobody else can see. Grown from Lizardfolk at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Swamp Call

traits.name: Lizardfolk Spirit-Talker
traits.info:
Little ghost-lights drift around you over still water at night, and the village brings its questions to you because the drowned answer when you ask. Grown from Lizardfolk Shaman at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Ask the Drowned

traits.name: Lizardfolk Stalker
traits.info:
Your scales shift colour to match whatever's behind you, water, reed or mud, and hunters who've worked beside you for years still lose track of you. Grown from Lizardfolk Hunter at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Reed Vanish

traits.name: Long Night Banshee
traits.info:
Your wail has ended whole royal families, and in every noble house there's a story about the night they heard you outside. Grown from Banshee Queen at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Wail of Ending · ⚔️ The Night They Heard · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Lorekeeper
traits.info:
You remember things, which beast spits, which ruin eats the ones who sleep in it, which old soul-story is true, and the elders have started asking you instead of each other.

🦊 Lore +3 · 🔮 Instinct +1 · ⚔️ I've Heard of This

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: Lunar Wolfkin
traits.info:
The silver glow never fades from your fur now, and under the moon your wounds close up while the others watch. Grown from Moonfang at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Moon Mending

traits.name: Magma Golem
traits.info:
You're a golem of molten iron that never cools now, glowing and dripping, and the floors you stand on smoke and crack. Grown from Furnace Golem at level 30. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Magma Golem.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Molten Slam · ⚔️ Smoking Floor · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Magma Salamander
traits.info:
Your scales run with magma and your breath comes out as molten rock, and the floors you walk on cool into new stone behind you. Grown from Cinder Salamander at level 30. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Magma Salamander.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Magma Breath · ⚔️ New Stone · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Magma Scorpid
traits.info:
Your plates crack with lava now, glowing orange seams running all over you, and the sand smokes under your feet. Grown from Ember Scorpid at level 20. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Magma Scorpid.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Magma Claw

traits.name: Magma Worm
traits.info:
Lava spills behind you as you burrow, and the dungeon's lower halls are veined with the glowing trails you've left. Grown from Lava Worm at level 20. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Magma Worm.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Lava Trail

traits.name: Magma Wyrm-King
traits.info:
You're a burrowing dragon that turns stone into rivers of fire, and the volcano towns pray to you not to come up under them. Grown from Deep Fire Wyrm at level 40. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Magma Wyrm-King.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Volcanic Burrow · ⚔️ Rivers of Fire · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Mandrake
traits.info:
In old graveyards and the dungeon's gardens there's a plant with leaves that look a lot like a frown, and every gravedigger knows not to pull it, because under the dirt is a fat root with a face in it and the scream it lets out when it's yanked into the air drops everyone in earshot. Mandrakes are root-people, they pull themselves up and walk when they choose to, and they know every plant that grows, which ones heal and which ones kill. They don't talk much and they hate being dug up more than anything, but they'll trade herbs and poisons with anyone polite enough to knock on the soil first.

🦊 Lore +3 · 💪 Endure +1 · ⚔️ Root Lore · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Mandrake Apothecary
traits.info:
Your brews can heal or kill and you make both from your own leaves, and people are very polite to you. Grown from Mandrake Herbalist at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Brew

traits.name: Mandrake Banshee-Root
traits.info:
Your scream can kill the weak now, and the gravediggers in your graveyard work very, very quietly. Grown from Mandrake Howler at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Death Shriek · ⚔️ Quiet Gravediggers · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Mandrake Cure-Root

Your leaves cure any sickness there is, and people walk across the Wildreach just to ask you for one. Grown from Mandrake Elder-Healer at level 40.

traits.name: Mandrake Elder-Healer
traits.info:
Monster towns send their sick to you, and there's always a line at your patch of earth. Grown from Mandrake Apothecary at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Mend · ⚔️ Always a Line · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Mandrake Herbalist
traits.info:
Leaves of every herb you know grow from your crown, and the sick start leaving offerings at your patch of dirt. Grown from Mandrake at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Lore +2 · ⚔️ Healing Leaf

traits.name: Mandrake Howler
traits.info:
Your scream knocks people flat now, and birds drop out of the sky when you let it go. Grown from Mandrake Shrieker at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Stunning Howl

traits.name: Mandrake Shrieker
traits.info:
The mouth in your root-face splits wider and your voice cracks stone, and gardeners go out with wax in their ears now. Grown from Mandrake at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Root Shriek

traits.name: Mantid
traits.info:
You can walk straight past a mantid in the jungle, it's tall and green-plated and standing perfectly still among the leaves, and the first you know about it is the branch beside your head falling to the ground in two clean pieces. They live in hive monasteries in the deep jungle where every day is training, and a mantid can hold a single pose from dawn to dusk and then move faster than your eye can follow, those scythe forearms are folded one moment and through you the next. They click and chirr when they talk and they only trade with fighters they think are worth the time, which means that before you can buy anything off a mantid you'll have to show it what you can do.

🔮 Instinct +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Still as Leaves · 🧱 resists slashing · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Mantid Abbot
traits.info:
You lead a hive-monastery now, and when you walk its halls the young mantids stop clicking and stand perfectly still out of respect. Grown from Mantid Monk at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Hive Calm

traits.name: Mantid Blade-King
traits.info:
You're the greatest fighter the jungle has ever known, a living legend, and the hive monks carve your stance into their temple walls. Grown from Mantid Executioner at level 40.

traits.name: Mantid Blademaster
traits.info:
Your scythe-arms grow long and their edges go sharp as broken glass, and the other mantids stop sparring with you because you never pull a cut. Grown from Mantid at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Twin Scythes

traits.name: Mantid Elder
traits.info:
You've gone beyond the hive and beyond yourself, and when you sit still the world sometimes forgets to keep moving. Grown from Mantid Grand Abbot at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Instinct +3 · ⚔️ Perfect Stillness · ⚔️ World Forgets · 🧱 resists soul

traits.name: Mantid Executioner

Every race fears you, because you've never once needed a second cut, and the jungle goes silent when you walk out to fight. Grown from Mantid Swordmaster at level 30.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Execution · ⚔️ Jungle Silence · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Mantid Grand Abbot
traits.info:
Your stillness bends others to stillness now, and birds land on you as if you were a tree. Grown from Mantid Abbot at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Stillness Field · ⚔️ Bird on a Branch · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Mantid Monk
traits.info:
You go perfectly still, eyes calm, and you can hold a pose from dawn till dusk, and fighters who meet your gaze feel like you've already read them like a book. Grown from Mantid at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Still Mind

traits.name: Mantid Swordmaster
traits.info:
Your scythes move faster than sight now, and duellists from every race come to the jungle hoping to see you fight once before they die. Grown from Mantid Blademaster at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Flash Cut

traits.name: Masked Satyr
traits.info:
You wear a different face every time anyone looks, and the hill groves leave offerings for you like you're some kind of trickster god. Grown from Glamour Satyr at level 40. Only a body with the Fox Spirit soul rooted in it can become Masked Satyr.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ World of Masks · ⚔️ Trickster's Offering · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Medusa
traits.info:
Your hair turns into a nest of hissing snakes and your eyes grey the skin of anyone who meets them, so people learn to talk to you looking at the floor. Grown from Basilisk Lamia at level 20. Only a body with the Basilisk soul rooted in it can become Medusa.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Snake Hair

traits.name: Merfolk
traits.info:
On a still day you can look down through the water of the bay and see the drowned city, towers and streets far below with lights moving between them, and that's where the merfolk live, farming kelp in long green rows and fighting off whatever comes out of the deep with tridents. They're fish-tailed people with voices like music, and they trade pearls and coral with the coastal monster towns, but always from the water, they won't set foot on a dock or let anyone from the land into their city. Ask why and you'll get an old story about the land taking something from them a long time ago, told like it happened last week, because to the merfolk it might as well have.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Water Breath · 🧱 resists cold · ⚠️ weak to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Merfolk Reef-Warden
traits.info:
You're the guardian of a reef city now, and every merfolk child in it knows your face and swims behind you on patrol. Grown from Merfolk Trident-Guard at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Coral Guard

traits.name: Merfolk Sea-King
traits.info:
You're king of the drowned cities now, and the lights in the towers under the bay burn brighter when you come home. Grown from Merfolk Sea-Knight at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Call the Deep · ⚔️ Tower Lights · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Merfolk Sea-Knight
traits.info:

traits.name: Merfolk Storm-Caller
traits.info:
You call storms off the open sea now, and the fishing towns watch the sky when they hear you singing. Grown from Merfolk Tide-Priest at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Sea Storm · ⚔️ Watch the Sky · 🧱 resists lightning

traits.name: Merfolk Tide-Lord

The sea itself obeys you now, and the tide comes when you call it and goes when you tell it to. Grown from Merfolk Storm-Caller at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Tidal Wave · ⚔️ Tide Comes and Goes · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Merfolk Tide-Priest
traits.info:
The tides answer your prayers now, coming in early and going out late when you ask, and the fishermen bring you offerings. Grown from Merfolk Tide-Singer at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Riptide

traits.name: Merfolk Tide-Singer
traits.info:
Your scales go pearl-white and your voice moves the water, and the fish in the bay swim in circles when you sing. Grown from Merfolk at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Wave Song

traits.name: Merfolk Trident-Guard
traits.info:
Your tail grows strong, coral plates grow over your shoulders and your fighting arm thickens, and the reef city sends you to the gates when something comes out of the deep. Grown from Merfolk at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Trident Thrust

traits.name: Mimic
traits.info:
Every adventurer who lasted in the Great Dungeon learned the same lesson, the chest sitting alone in an empty room is too clean, too new and far too convenient, and the ones who didn't learn it fed a mimic. They're shapeshifters that wear the shape of chests, doors, treasure piles and loose flagstones, holding still for weeks until something reaches for the lid, and then the lid has teeth. The old ones are full of what they've eaten, rusted swords and coin purses rattling around in their guts, and a very old mimic can even talk, though they never trade, they've had everything they want handed to them for as long as anyone can remember.

🦊 Barter +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Lie in Wait · 🧱 resists acid · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Mimic King
traits.info:
You're a legend of the dungeon, and some say whole floors of it are really you, and nobody who has gone looking for the truth of that has ever come back. Grown from Treasure-Vault Mimic at level 40.

traits.name: Mimic Slime

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Object Mimic

traits.name: Mind-Spore Gazer
traits.info:
Your spores carry your thoughts into others now, and the people who've breathed them start thinking things that aren't theirs. Grown from Fungal Gazer at level 30. Only a body with the Myconid soul rooted in it can become Mind-Spore Gazer.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Mind Spores · ⚔️ Thoughts That Aren't Theirs · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Minotaur
traits.info:
Minotaur halls are built to lose people, corridors that fold back on themselves, doors that open onto walls, stairs to nowhere, and the stone floors are worn into deep grooves by hooves that have walked the same paths for generations. The minotaurs themselves never get lost, a bull-headed giant will walk you through its maze without a glance at the turns while you're still trying to remember which way was out. They're patient as herders until something sets them off, and the gouges in the walls at horn height show what happens then, a minotaur in a charge goes through doors, through shields and through whatever is holding them. They speak slow and plain and they trade bronze and hard labour, and a deal with one is good for exactly as long as you keep your end.

🦊 Lore +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Horn Toss · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

Any build.

traits.name: Minotaur Champion
traits.info:
You get taller and your horns grow longer, ringed with brass you hammered on yourself, and you walk like you've never lost a fight. Grown from Minotaur at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Gore and Toss

traits.name: Minotaur Gladiator
traits.info:
You're scarred all over and you roar when you fight, and crowds come from three towns away to watch you win, because you never lose. Grown from Minotaur Champion at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Crowd Roar

traits.name: Minotaur King
traits.info:
You're the bull-king of the high pastures, and when you roar every herd and every herder in the hills goes quiet and listens. Grown from Minotaur Warlord at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +3 · ⚔️ Horns of the King · ⚔️ Bull-King's Roar · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Minotaur Warlord

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Stampede · ⚔️ Horn-Shaped Dents · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Mirror Soul
traits.info:
Your soul copies whatever it touches, the souls you keep settle in fast and feel like they were always yours, but now and then you catch yourself scratching like a goblin or growling at shadows, and you're not sure anymore which thoughts started out as yours.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🦊 Lore +1 · 🔮 Evoke +1 · ⚔️ Borrowed Instinct

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: Monster Monarch
traits.info: Your home is a city and you're the one who runs it, king or queen of monsters, and every faction in the Wildreach deals with you as a power.

traits.name: Moon Wolf

Moss, leaves and vines grown or woven over you.

traits.name: Myconid
traits.info:
Deep in the dungeon's damp caves the walls start glowing a faint blue and the floor goes soft underfoot, and then you notice the rows, neat little farms of mushrooms tended by grey, cap-headed people who all turn to look at you at exactly the same moment. Myconids share their thoughts through spores, so what one of them sees the whole colony knows, and they're gentle folk who farm, heal and turn their dead into the compost that grows the next crop. Leave them be and they'll trade you mushrooms and medicine that'll cure nearly anything, but threaten the colony and the air fills with a cloud that leaves you dazed, sick or calm enough to sit there while they decide what to do with you.

🦊 Lore +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Spore Puff · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Myconid Cap-Elder
traits.info:
Your cap spreads broad and the gills underneath pulse with thought-spores, and the colony starts doing what you're thinking before you say it. Grown from Myconid at level 10.

traits.name: Myconid Circle-Keeper

traits.name: Myconid King

traits.name: Myconid Plague-Cap
traits.info:
Your spores turn foes into mushroom gardens, and the dead you leave behind sprout caps by the next morning. Grown from Myconid Rot-Bringer at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Host Spores · ⚔️ Morning Caps · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Myconid Rot-Bringer
traits.info:
Your spores rot wood and flesh, and the doors of anyone who angers you go soft and black overnight. Grown from Myconid Sporer at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Rot Spores

traits.name: Myconid Sporer
traits.info:
Your cap swells with spores and a dusty cloud hangs around you, and people cough a lot in your company. Grown from Myconid at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Daze Cloud

traits.name: Night Panther
traits.info:
You're a great black cat as big as the night is long, and the stars go out one by one when you stretch. Grown from Void Panther at level 40. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Night Panther.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Stalk +3 · ⚔️ Endless Night · ⚔️ Stars Go Out · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Night-Weaver
traits.info:
You're a spider of night now, so big you blot out stars when you climb, and the darkness follows you down from the canyons like a cloak. Grown from Void Spinner at level 40. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Night-Weaver.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Weave the Night · ⚔️ Blot Out the Stars · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Nightstalker Cat
traits.info:
You walk through pitch dark like it's broad daylight, and the first thing your prey ever sees of you is your eyes. Grown from Shadowcat at level 20. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Nightstalker Cat.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Shadow Pounce

traits.name: Nine-Headed Hydra
traits.info:
You've got nine heads now, and your body fills a swamp channel when you stretch out. Grown from Five-Headed Hydra at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Hydra Flurry · ⚔️ Nine Ways at Once · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Nine-Tailed Fox
traits.info:
Nine tails spread behind you like a sunrise made of fire, and every fox spirit on every road bows its head when you pass. Grown from Six-Tailed Fox at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Nine Flames · ⚔️ Every Road Bows · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: No Element
traits.info:
No magic at all, just more body: you take more punishment than anyone, and spells slide off you a little.

❤️ Health +30

Any build.

traits.name: Nothing Worn
traits.info:
Nothing at all: your own hide, scales or slime is enough.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Oak Treant
traits.info:
Your trunk thickens, your limbs get heavy and acorns grow in your crown, and squirrels start moving in. Grown from Treant at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Branch Slam

traits.name: Ogre
traits.info:
You can tell where an ogre's been by what's missing, the sheep from the paddock, the barrel from the cellar, the door off the cellar, and you can smell where it is long before you see it, a great slab of a thing twice a man's height with a gut like a rain barrel and hands that hang down past its knees. They have to stoop under every roof and turn sideways through every gate, so most of them don't bother and sleep out in the open on a pile of bones from everything they've eaten, which is anything, raw or rotten or still kicking. They aren't clever and they don't need to be, so every race in the Wildreach hires them as muscle and pays them in meat, and an ogre remembers every feast it was ever given and every meal anyone ever stole from it, feed one well and it'll walk through a wall for you, let its belly empty mid-job and it'll start eyeing the nearest thing that looks soft.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Big Swing · 🧱 resists bludgeoning · ⚠️ weak to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Ogre Brute
traits.info:
You get even bigger, a gut like a barrel sitting on top of muscle like iron and fists the size of hams. Grown from Ogre at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Ground Pound

traits.name: Ogre Colossus
traits.info:
You're a walking stone colossus with an ogre's grin and runes blazing all over you, and gates are just doors you haven't kicked yet. Grown from Fortress Ogre at level 40. Only a body with the Golem soul rooted in it can become Ogre Colossus.

💪 Might +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Colossus Stride · ⚔️ Kick the Gate · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Ogre Juggernaut
traits.info:
You've had iron plates hammered straight into your hide and you walk through things now instead of around them. Grown from Ogre Brute at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Unstoppable

traits.name: Ogre King
traits.info:
You're the biggest ogre alive, you eat armies and you keep a court of giants who are scared of you. Grown from Ogre Titan at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +3 · ⚔️ Giant's Wrath · ⚔️ Eat an Army · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Ogre Mage
traits.info:
You're taller and horned, cold mist rolls off your skin and you've got a scholar's patience that has no business in an ogre's head. Grown from Ogre Magus at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Vanish

traits.name: Ogre Magus
traits.info:
Your skin goes blue-tinged, a third-eye scar opens on your brow and you get sharp in a way ogres usually aren't, which scares the other ogres more than anything. Grown from Ogre at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Frost Breath

traits.name: Ogre Titan
traits.info:
You're a mountain of meat and iron and the ground shakes with every step you take. Grown from Ogre Juggernaut at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Earthquake Stomp · ⚔️ Pick It Up · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Ooze Colossus
traits.info:
You're a heaving troll of jelly that splits apart and comes back together whenever you feel like it. Grown from Jelly Troll at level 30. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze Colossus.

🔮 Soul +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Split · ⚔️ Jelly Wall · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Ooze Mimic
traits.info:
You go soft and jelly-like and flow into any shape you like, and you can pour yourself through a keyhole if you take it slow. Grown from Mimic at level 10. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze Mimic.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Gel Shape

traits.name: Ooze Mountain
traits.info:
You're a troll-shaped mountain of hungry jelly that rolls over whole camps and leaves nothing but clean bones. Grown from Ooze Colossus at level 40. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze Mountain.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Absorb +3 · ⚔️ Devour the Field · ⚔️ Clean Bones · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Ooze Troll
traits.info:
Your flesh starts half-melting and wounds close up in oozing jelly, and you stink of acid. Grown from Troll at level 10. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze Troll.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Acid Hide

traits.name: Ooze-Cap
traits.info:
Your cap turns into see-through jelly and your flesh goes soft and acid, and things that touch you come away smoking. Grown from Myconid at level 10. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze-Cap.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Digesting Touch

traits.name: Ooze-Fungus Mother
traits.info:
You're a cavern-filling mother of slime and spore, and everything that falls into your cave becomes part of you. Grown from Living Ooze-Garden at level 40. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Ooze-Fungus Mother.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Absorb +3 · ⚔️ Swallow the Cave · ⚔️ Part of Me · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Orc
traits.info:
Big and warhungry brutes with muscle like iron and heads like steel, they live for war and fighting and think anyone who wants to waste time talking is weak and not worth their blood on an axe. Taller than most men, shorter than trolls but no less deadly, they raise warriors from birth to wield bigger and bigger weapons. The men and women fight equally, and some women are even deadlier than the men. They sport hulking frames and huge proportions, the females built like amazons, the men built like a steel wall with teeth. Their tribe means everything and their leader's words are absolute, until that leader starts to become weak or act in their own interests, then it's a challenge just waiting to happen.

🔮 Command +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Orc Roar · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

Any build.

traits.name: Orc Berserker
traits.info:
You get heavier, meaner and red-eyed the second a fight starts, veins standing out on your arms like rope. Grown from Orc at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Blood Rage

traits.name: Orc Ravager
traits.info:
You're scarred and huge and the rage isn't a mood anymore, it's a living thing sitting right behind your eyes. Grown from Orc Berserker at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Rampage

traits.name: Orc Shaman
traits.info:
You're painted in ash and old blood with bones knotted in your hair, and you can see the war-spirits standing behind everyone in the room. Grown from Orc at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Spirit Ward

traits.name: Orc Warchief
traits.info:
You're a wall of muscle and iron with gold-capped tusks, and the warband would follow you off a cliff if you told them there was a fight at the bottom. Grown from Orc Ravager at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Warcry of Ruin · ⚔️ Off the Cliff · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Orc Warlord
traits.info:
Through blood and bone and battle he emerges, the true leader of all orcs, the master of the strong, the unbeaten in battle and the one who has the wisdom to win and fell foes much greater than themselves. A leader is not just strong, he is wise enough to use that strength to benefit himself and his clan in the best way possible. War teaches toughness and grit. Time teaches wisdom and patience. Grown from Orc Warchief at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Horde · ⚔️ Pick the Fight · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Pack Leader
traits.info:
Monsters follow you, maybe because you're loud and maybe because you're right more often than not, and when you bark an order half the camp is moving before they've thought about it.

🔮 Command +3 · 🦊 Talk +1 · ⚔️ On Me

🔮 Soul build.

traits.name: Patchwork Coat
traits.info:
A coat stitched together from a dozen other coats.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Petrifier
traits.info:
Your lair is a garden of statues and every one of them is someone who came looking for you. Grown from Stone-Eye Basilisk at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Stone Stare · ⚔️ Garden Keeper · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Petrifying Bull
traits.info:
Half your body has gone to granite and the other half isn't far behind, and the statues in your halls were people who looked you in the eye. Grown from Basilisk Bull at level 30. Only a body with the Basilisk soul rooted in it can become Petrifying Bull.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Stone Gaze · ⚔️ Granite Hide · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Petrifying Gargoyle
traits.info:
Your perch overlooks a garden of statues now, all of them looking up, and all of them with the same frozen scream on their faces. Grown from Gorgon Gargoyle at level 30. Only a body with the Basilisk soul rooted in it can become Petrifying Gargoyle.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Perch Gaze · ⚔️ Frozen Scream · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Pit Fiend
traits.info:
You're a towering devil of the dungeon's vents now, and the heat coming off you makes the air ripple like water. Grown from Fire Devil at level 30.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Pit Fire · ⚔️ Rippling Air · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Pixie
traits.info:
When the milk sours overnight, the horse's mane is knotted into a hundred tiny braids and your boots are full of beetles in the morning, there's a pixie meadow somewhere close. They're hand-sized, gossamer-winged little things that swarm the wildflowers in their hundreds, and everything they do is a joke, it's just that most of their jokes are cruel and some of them are deadly. The giggling always comes from somewhere just out of reach, and they trade in mischief and dreams, so a deal with one gets you a dream worth having and costs you something you won't notice is gone until much later.

🦊 Lore +2 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Flit · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Pixie Aurora
traits.info:
Your wings throw off the colours of the northern lights, and people miles away look up at night wondering what's glowing. Grown from Pixie Glimmer at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Aurora Veil · ⚔️ Northern Lights · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Pixie Glimmer
traits.info:
You cast illusions out of light, and travellers walk for hours toward a town that isn't there. Grown from Pixie Lightweaver at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Mirage

traits.name: Pixie King
traits.info:
You're a legend of the meadows that real kings are scared of, and armies camp a long way from any wildflowers because of you. Grown from Pixie Mischief-Lord at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 💨 Stalk +3 · ⚔️ Mischief Night · ⚔️ Stay Away from Wildflowers · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Pixie Lightweaver
traits.info:
Your wings start glowing in shifting colours, and people stop to stare at the lights dancing over the meadow at night. Grown from Pixie at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Lightburst

traits.name: Pixie Mischief-Lord
traits.info:
You lead a swarm of pranksters, and when your swarm comes through a camp there isn't a dry bed or a tied tent left in it. Grown from Pixie Trickster at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Swarm of Pranks · ⚔️ Wet Beds and Loose Tents · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Pixie Prankster
traits.info:
You've got a wicked grin and quick little hands and you can't stop giggling, and soldiers wake up with their bootlaces tied together. Grown from Pixie at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Prank

traits.name: Pixie Sun-Sprite
traits.info:
You're a pixie made of pure light now, painful to look at straight on. Grown from Pixie Aurora at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Sunflare · ⚔️ Painful to Look At · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Pixie Trickster
traits.info:
You steal boots off sleeping soldiers, and the camps near your meadow keep a guard on the boots now instead of the gate. Grown from Pixie Prankster at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Vanishing Act

traits.name: Plague Ghoul
traits.info:
You go rat-toothed and covered in sores that spread sickness to everything you touch, and even other ghouls won't eat with you. Grown from Ghoul at level 10. Only a body with the Ratfolk soul rooted in it can become Plague Ghoul.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Plague Bite

traits.name: Plague Hydra
traits.info:
Your venom poisons the water for a mile around, and the fish float belly up wherever you've been swimming. Grown from Scorpion Hydra at level 30. Only a body with the Scorpid soul rooted in it can become Plague Hydra.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Poison Waters · ⚔️ Belly Up · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Plague-Lord Ghoul
traits.info:
Your sickness raises the dead now, and towns you pass through bury their plague victims with stakes through their hearts. Grown from Rat-Ghoul at level 30. Only a body with the Ratfolk soul rooted in it can become Plague-Lord Ghoul.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Plague of Undeath · ⚔️ Stakes Through Hearts · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Plaguecap Rat
traits.info:
Little mushroom caps start sprouting in your fur and spores drift off you every time you breathe out. Grown from Ratfolk at level 10. Only a body with the Myconid soul rooted in it can become Plaguecap Rat.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Spore Cough

traits.name: Poison Magic
traits.info:
Your blood is poison: no poison works on you, and your magic sickens what it hits.

⚔️ Venom · 🚫 immune to poison

Any build.

traits.name: Poison: Bad Blood
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Bad Blood. Your hits poison; a poisoned foe takes poison damage each turn and gets weaker for the rest of the fight.

traits.name: Poison: Black Fever
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Black Fever. One foe is poisoned so deep it takes heavy poison damage each turn for four turns, and if it dies of it the fever passes to the nearest foe.

traits.name: Poison: Miasma
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Miasma. A vast poison fog rolls out over the whole area for three turns: every foe in it takes heavy poison damage each turn and is weakened.

traits.name: Poison: Plague Touch
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Plague Touch. Touch one foe with a sickness that spreads: they are poisoned, and each turn it may jump to a foe beside them.

traits.name: Poison: Poison Spit
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Poison Spit. Spit poison into one foe's eyes at range: they are blinded for two turns and poisoned.

traits.name: Poison: Rot Cloud
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Rot Cloud. A cloud of poison rolls out from you for three turns; every foe in it takes poison damage each turn, chokes and moves slower.

traits.name: Poison: Sting
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Sting. One quick touch poisons one foe lightly: a little poison damage each turn for two turns.

traits.name: Poison: Toxic Sweat
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Toxic Sweat. For three turns your skin sweats poison: anything that grabs, bites or touches you is poisoned.

traits.name: Poison: Venom Blood
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Venom Blood. For the rest of the fight every hit you land poisons, and poison you're already carrying in foes works twice as fast.

traits.name: Poison: Weakening Venom
traits.info: Your poison has grown: Weakening Venom. Poison one foe so their strength drains away: they hit much weaker for the rest of the fight.

traits.name: Poisoned
traits.info:
You ate something that should have killed you and spent days shaking it out, and now most poisons barely make you sick, but your nerves never settled after, and a shock of lightning goes through you like nothing else.

🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Polymorph Mimic
traits.info:
You can be any creature you've ever eaten now, perfectly, and you've sat at a family's table wearing the shape of the one who didn't come home. Grown from Gel Mimic at level 30. Only a body with the Slime soul rooted in it can become Polymorph Mimic.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Full Copy · ⚔️ At the Family Table · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Power
traits.info:
You want to be the biggest thing in any room, the one the others step around, and every soul you take is one more step up a ladder you mean to stand on top of.

💪 Fight +1

💪 Might build.

traits.name: Prism Worm
traits.info:
You're a worm of living crystal that bends light, and rainbows spill across the cave walls wherever you go. Grown from Crystal Worm at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Prism Beam · ⚔️ Rainbow Walls · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Ragged Cloak
traits.info:
A torn cloak that's seen a lot of weather.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Rat King
traits.info:
Every rat in the region is your spy now, and there isn't a secret in ten towns that doesn't end up whispered in your ear. Grown from Ratfolk Under-King at level 40.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Every Rat · ⚔️ Whisper in Ten Towns · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Rat-Ghoul
traits.info:
A pack of rats follows you everywhere now, and they bring you whatever they find in the graves. Grown from Plague Ghoul at level 20. Only a body with the Ratfolk soul rooted in it can become Rat-Ghoul.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Grave Rats

traits.name: Ratfolk
traits.info:
Every monster town has ratfolk under it, and you'll find out the day your knife goes missing and turns up on a ratfolk stall two streets over before noon, with a hunched, whiskered little seller swearing it's been in the family for years. They live in the sewers and the refuse pits in numbers nobody has ever counted, grain sacks gnawed open in the night, rope chewed through, a purse cut and gone before you felt the tug, and they sell rumours as quickly as they sell stolen goods. A ratfolk will sell out their closest friend for a full belly and expect you to understand, and their bite carries every filthy thing they've ever crawled through, so the ones who fight them usually die of the fever a week later rather than the wound.

🦊 Barter +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Squeeze Through · 🧱 resists poison · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Ratfolk Plague-King
traits.info:
You're a plague walking around in a rat's shape, and every race in the Wildreach burns its dead when they hear you've been through. Grown from Ratfolk Plague-Lord at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Black Death · ⚔️ Burn the Dead · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Ratfolk Plague-Lord
traits.info:
Your sickness spreads with a look now as well as a breath, and whole streets empty out when word gets around you're in town. Grown from Ratfolk Plague-Priest at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Plague Wind · ⚔️ Plague Look · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Ratfolk Plague-Monk
traits.info:
You wrap yourself in filthy rags and cough green, and the sores on your skin don't hurt you anymore, they just spread to everyone else. Grown from Ratfolk at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Plague Breath

traits.name: Ratfolk Plague-Priest
traits.info:
A censer full of green smoke swings from your claw everywhere you go, and people cross the street when they smell it coming. Grown from Ratfolk Plague-Monk at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Pestilence Censer

traits.name: Ratfolk Swarm-Chief
traits.info:
You get bigger and nastier and covered in scars, and real rats start following you around the sewers, hundreds of them, squeaking at your heels. Grown from Ratfolk at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Rat Swarm

traits.name: Ratfolk Under-King
traits.info:
Every sewer and tunnel under three towns belongs to you, and nothing moves under those streets without you hearing about it. Grown from Ratfolk Warlord at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Under-Roads · ⚔️ Nothing Moves · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Ratfolk Warlord
traits.info:
You wear a crown made of rat tails and a horde of ratfolk scrabbles behind you, and every one of them would sell you out the second you look weak. Grown from Ratfolk Swarm-Chief at level 20.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Horde Tactics

traits.name: Revenge
traits.info:
Someone took something from you, kin, a nest, a name, and you remember their smell, and every hunt you go on is practice for the one that counts.

💨 Hunt +1

💨 Swiftness build.

traits.name: Riches
traits.info:
You want a hoard, ingots, gems, good gear, the kind of pile you can sleep on, and you can smell a good deal or a bad one from across the market.

🦊 Barter +1

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: Rings and Studs
traits.info:
Gold rings and studs through ears, horns or hide.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: River Troll
traits.info:
You go long and lean and green, with webbed hands and a grin full of fishhook teeth. Grown from Troll at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Drag Under

traits.name: Rivet Collar
traits.info:
A thick iron collar studded with rivets.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Rockworm
traits.info:
Maps of the dungeon go wrong every season and rockworms are why, one day there's a tunnel that wasn't there last time, perfectly round, smooth as glass and big enough to drive a cart through, and somewhere at the end of it something eyeless and as thick as a tree trunk is still chewing. You feel them before anything else, a low rumble under your boots that gets louder, and the smart thing is to get off the floor before the stone underneath you opens up and swallows you along with everything else in the way. They don't talk and they don't trade, but miners follow behind them anyway, because a rockworm's new tunnel is full of ore it didn't bother eating.

🦊 Build +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Bore · 🧱 resists bludgeoning, piercing · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Rockworm Borer
traits.info:
You grow thicker and your grinding teeth spread into more rings, and the miners can hear you chewing through the rock from three tunnels away. Grown from Rockworm at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 🦊 Build +2 · ⚔️ Fast Bore

traits.name: Rockworm Gem-Eater
traits.info:
Glittering bands run along your body from all the gems you've eaten, and in the dark you sparkle like a road made of stars. Grown from Rockworm at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Gem Sense

traits.name: Rockworm Leviathan
traits.info:
You're a worm the size of a river now, and when you move the whole mountain shudders like it's caught a chill. Grown from Great Borer at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Swallow Whole · ⚔️ Mountain Shudder · 🧱 resists bludgeoning

traits.name: Room Mimic
traits.info:

traits.name: Salamander
traits.info:
The air shimmers in the dungeon's furnace halls and the stone floor glows where something has walked across it barefoot, and that's salamander country, red-scaled fire-lizards who lie in lava vents to rest and burn everything they touch. They're the best smiths anywhere near the Wildreach, a salamander doesn't need a forge, it picks up the iron in its own hands and works it hot, and the blades they trade come out sharper and harder than anything a hammer and coals can make. They talk in crackles and pops like a log on the fire, and they're friendly enough to anyone who brings them ore and doesn't mind singed eyebrows, but nobody shakes hands with one twice.

🦊 Build +4 · ⚔️ Warm Hands · 🧱 resists fire · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Salamander Anvil-Lord

You're lord of the forge-city in the lava vents, and the ringing of hammers never stops while you're awake. Grown from Salamander Forgemaster at level 30.

traits.name: Sash and Wraps

traits.name: Satyr
traits.info:
You hear the pipes first, a tune drifting down out of the hill groves that gets into your feet before you've decided to listen, and the ones who follow it are found days later in some clearing, sore and wine-stained and danced half to death with no memory of how they got there. Satyrs are goat-legged, horned revellers who'll share their wine with anyone, and the same music that has a whole camp laughing can drop it asleep or send it running in a panic with a change of the tune. They speak sweetly, trade wine and songs and keep every promise they make until the sun comes up, and if you're angry about it they'll be sorry, honestly sorry, and play you something to help you forget.

🦊 Barter +4 · ⚔️ Lilting Tune · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Satyr Bard
traits.info:
Your songs travel faster than you do, and people in towns you've never been to are already singing them. Grown from Satyr Pipe-Mage at level 20.

traits.name: Scorpid
traits.info:
The dunes rattle at dusk, a dry clicking that carries for miles across the sand, and caravan drivers who hear it double the watch and stop the camels, because it means scorpids are moving. They're armoured crawlers the size of a cart, claws that'll crush a man's leg, plates that turn a blade and a curled tail with a sting whose venom can stop a heart in a dozen beats. They raid the caravans, guard the ruins buried under the dunes and trade the salt and stolen goods they take, and you always know a camp has done business with them by the empty plates of chitin stacked by the tents, the old skins they shed and sold off as armour.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Pincer Grip · 🧱 resists poison, slashing · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Shade
traits.info:
Your torch starts shrinking to an ember even though there's no wind, and the light ends a pace in front of you like it's hit a wall, and somewhere in that black is a shade. They're living darkness that pools in the dungeon's deepest places, and anything that walks into one goes cold and blind and finds the way out isn't where it was a second ago. Shades don't speak, but they can be bargained with if you sit in the dark long enough and ask quietly, and what they want in return is usually light, a lantern, a candle, a memory of the sun, which they swallow and keep forever.

🦊 Lore +2 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Pool of Dark · 🧱 resists slashing, piercing, bludgeoning · ⚠️ weak to holy · 🚫 immune to poison

traits.name: Shadow: Blot Out the Sun
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Blot Out the Sun. Swallow all the light in a wide area for three turns: foes in it are blinded, frightened and drained a little each turn.

traits.name: Shadow: Dim
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Dim. Draw the light out of a small area: it goes dark around you, and you're hard to see in it.

traits.name: Shadow: Fear Shade
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Fear Shade. Fill one foe's mind with shadow: they are frightened for two turns and fight badly or flee.

traits.name: Shadow: Hollow
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Hollow. You pull the shadow out of one foe; it takes heavy shadow damage, you heal by part of it, and for three turns it has no shadow and takes extra damage from everything.

traits.name: Shadow: Night Cloak
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Night Cloak. For three turns darkness covers the area: you and your allies are hidden in it and strike from it, and foes can't see.

traits.name: Shadow: Shade Step
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Shade Step. Once a turn you step into any shadow and out of another you can see, and your next hit after a step does extra shadow damage.

traits.name: Shadow: Shadow Bolt
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Shadow Bolt. Throw a bolt of shadow at one foe: shadow damage, and it drains a little of their strength into you.

traits.name: Shadow: Shadow Grab
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Shadow Grab. Shadows reach out and grab one foe: they are held in place for a turn.

traits.name: Shadow: Shadow Walk
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Shadow Walk. Step into one shadow and out of another you can see: you vanish and reappear there in an instant.

traits.name: Shadow: Swallow the Light
traits.info: Your shadow has grown: Swallow the Light. Darkness fills the area for three turns; every foe in it is blinded and takes shadow damage each turn, and you can see through it.

traits.name: Shadowcat

traits.name: Sharkfolk
traits.info:
Shore villages near sharkfolk waters build their watchtowers facing the sea instead of the land, because when a grey fin cuts across the bay at dusk a raid is coming before morning. Sharkfolk are grey-skinned reavers with rows of teeth behind rows of teeth, and they can smell one cut finger in the water from across the bay. Once blood starts flowing they frenzy, faster, harder and deaf to anything but the next bite, and even their own chiefs keep their distance until it passes. They snarl more than they speak and trade whatever they've plundered, and every coastal market has a stall of their loot, half of it still damp.

💪 Endure +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Blood Scent · 🧱 resists cold, piercing · ⚠️ weak to lightning

Any build.

traits.name: Sharkfolk Bull

traits.name: Siren
traits.info:
The reefs off the coast are piled with wrecks, ship on top of ship rotting on the rocks, and on calm nights the singing comes off them across the water, so sweet that sailors plug their ears with wax and tie themselves to the mast just to sail past. Sirens are feathered sea-singers who perch on the wreck-rocks and sing sailors right onto them, and then they drown the crew and pick through what's left of the cargo. They speak in song and trade pearls and drowned treasure, and every word out of a siren's mouth is the most beautiful lie you'll ever hear.

🦊 Barter +4 · ⚔️ Siren Call · 🧱 resists cold · ⚠️ weak to lightning

traits.name: Siren Charmer
