traits.name: Siren Sky-Queen
traits.info:
You rule the singing cliffs now, and the coastline sings when you open your mouth. Grown from Siren Harpy-Queen at level 40. Only a body with the Harpy soul rooted in it can become Siren Sky-Queen.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Hunt +3 · ⚔️ Song and Talon · ⚔️ Coastline Sings · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Siren Storm-Queen
traits.info:
You're queen of the storm-reefs now, and every wreck on the coast happened while you were singing. Grown from Siren Tempest-Witch at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Wreck Storm · ⚔️ Every Wreck · 🧱 resists lightning

traits.name: Siren Tempest-Witch
traits.info:
You sing storms onto ships now, and the captains who know the coast steer wide of your reef. Grown from Siren Wreck-Witch at level 20.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Storm Song

traits.name: Siren Wreck-Witch
traits.info:
Your feathers go storm-dark and your voice gets a gale in it, and the wrecks on your rock are piled three deep. Grown from Siren at level 10.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Gale Song

traits.name: Siren-Harpy Queen
traits.info:
You're a reef-queen whose song pulls whole fleets in, and every captain on the coast keeps wax in their pocket. Grown from Wreck-Singer at level 30. Only a body with the Siren soul rooted in it can become Siren-Harpy Queen.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Fleet Lure · ⚔️ Wax in Their Pockets · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Six-Tailed Fox
traits.info:
You've got six burning tails and a court of lesser foxes that follow you around doing your errands. Grown from Four-Tailed Fox at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Foxfire Storm · ⚔️ Court of Foxes · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Skeleton
traits.info:
Walk through an old tomb and the bones are scattered all over the floor, walk back an hour later and every one of them is standing up again holding a rusted spear, and that's when you learn the bones down here don't stay down. Skeletons are held together by old magic and older orders, they guard tombs, they march in dead legions and they can be smashed apart a dozen times and still pull themselves back together, piece by rattling piece. They don't talk, they don't trade and they don't think for themselves, but now and then a necromancer speaks through one, and when a skeleton turns its head and says your name in somebody else's voice, whoever's on the other end already knows exactly where you are.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Rattle Back · 🧱 resists piercing, cold · ⚠️ weak to bludgeoning, holy · 🚫 immune to poison

Any build.

traits.name: Skeleton Knight
traits.info:
Rusted plate grows into your bones, and your fighting arm never tires, and you've been standing guard at the same tomb door for longer than the kingdom outside has existed. Grown from Skeleton at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Dead Blade

traits.name: Skirmisher
traits.info:
You fight up close and moving: hit, push, hit again, and never let them settle.

💪 Might +2 · 💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · 💨 Strike +2 · ⚔️ Hit and Hold

💪 Might build.

traits.name: Skull Helm
traits.info:
The skull of something big, worn as a helm.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Sky Cockatrice
traits.info:
Broad wings sprout from your sides and they actually fly, and now nowhere in the galleries is safe from you. Grown from Cockatrice at level 10. Only a body with the Harpy soul rooted in it can become Sky Cockatrice.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Sky Peck

traits.name: Sky Drake
traits.info:
You fly properly now, and the first warning anyone gets is your shadow sliding across the ground. Grown from Wyvern Drake at level 20. Only a body with the Wyvern soul rooted in it can become Sky Drake.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Sky Dive

traits.name: Sky Khan
traits.info:
You're a great winged centaur who rules the high winds, and your herd flies behind you through the clouds. Grown from Storm Pegataur at level 40. Only a body with the Harpy soul rooted in it can become Sky Khan.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Hunt +3 · ⚔️ Storm Ride · ⚔️ Cloud Herd · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Skyrunner
traits.info:
Feathers grow at your fetlocks and little wing-buds push up at your shoulders, and every leap you take carries you farther than it should. Grown from Centaur at level 10. Only a body with the Harpy soul rooted in it can become Skyrunner.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Sky Leap

traits.name: Slime
traits.info:
A dungeon corridor that's perfectly clean, no dust, no bones, not a dropped coin anywhere, means there's a slime living in it, because a slime eats everything it rolls over and leaves the stone behind spotless. It's a wobbling mass of acid jelly you can see straight through, and floating inside it you can usually spot whatever it ate last, a sword, a skull, half a goblin still dissolving. Young slimes don't think at all, they just eat, but the old ones have eaten enough minds to start one of their own, and they'll gurgle a deal at you and spit out polished treasure, cleaner than it's been in a hundred years, for something they haven't tasted yet.

🔮 Absorb +2 · 💪 Endure +2 · ⚔️ Ooze · 🧱 resists slashing, piercing · ⚠️ weak to fire, cold · 🚫 immune to acid

Any build.

traits.name: Smooth Talker
traits.info:
You get by on your mouth, a lie for the guard, a threat for the coward, a kind word for the one who needs it, and most monsters never notice they've been talked round.

🦊 Talk +3 · 🔮 Instinct +1 · ⚔️ Say It Like You Mean It

🦊 Cunning build.

traits.name: Sylph
traits.info:
Up in the high passes the wind sometimes says your name, just once and quiet, and if you turn toward it you might catch the shape of someone in the blowing snow before it's gone. Sylphs are spirits of the wind with bodies you can only half see, and they ride the storms over the mountains for fun, stealing the breath out of travellers who aren't paying attention until they drop gasping in the drifts. They talk in whispers and trade in secrets, because the wind goes everywhere and hears everything, and a sylph who likes you can tell you what's being said about you three valleys over.

traits.name: Treant
traits.info:
People who camp in the deep forest sometimes wake up and the path they walked in on isn't there any more, and the big oak that stood beside the fire last night is twenty paces to the left. That's treants, walking trees as old as the forest itself, so slow you'll swear they never move and so patient they can take a week to finish a sentence. They speak maybe once a season and only trade with someone willing to sit and wait for the answer, but anyone who brings an axe or a torch into their woods learns how fast a treant can be when it wants to, and what's left gets grown over by spring.

💪 Endure +3 · 🦊 Build +1 · ⚔️ Root Down · 🧱 resists bludgeoning, piercing · ⚠️ weak to fire

Any build.

traits.name: Troll
traits.info:
Trolls look like part of the riverbank until they move, long-armed and hunched with moss growing in the cracks of their hide and weed hanging off them from years spent sitting in the black water of the fens and under old bridges, waiting. You learn what they are the first time you cut one, the wound closes while you watch, and a lopped arm pushes a new one out of the stump by morning, so a troll fights without fear and without hurry and simply wears its prey down. The only scars they ever carry are burns, which is how everyone knows fire and acid are what they fear and why they stay in the wet and the dark. They love riddles more than gold, a troll will let a traveller pass for a good one and drown them for a bad one, and they trade only for things strange enough to be worth remembering, because when you live as long as a troll the only thing worth having is something new.

💪 Endure +4 · ⚔️ Knit Flesh · 🧱 resists slashing · ⚠️ weak to fire, acid

traits.name: Vampire
traits.info:
Every village in the shadow of a vampire's castle looks the same, everyone pale and tired, shutters locked at sundown, and nobody will tell you why they keep wearing scarves in the heat. Vampires are pale, beautiful and very old, and they rule their courts from ruined castles like lords of the old kind, feeding on blood and charming the living into servants who'd happily die for them. They speak like nobles and trade in favours and blood-debts, and they're charming company for as long as you're useful, but they fear the sun more than anything, so whatever deal you make with a vampire, make it at noon.

traits.name: Vampire Lord
traits.info:
You rule a vampire court and the lands around it now, and the other vampires bring you blood in silver cups. Grown from Vampire Count at level 30.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Court of Night · ⚔️ Silver Cups · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Vampire Noble
traits.info:
You go paler and finer, your voice learns to command, and a cape of shadow hangs off your shoulders even on a bright day. Grown from Vampire at level 10.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Noble Charm

traits.name: Vampire Slayer-Fiend
traits.info:
You hunt the strong for the richest blood now, and warlords hire guards specifically because of you. Grown from Vampire Hunter-Fiend at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Blood Frenzy

traits.name: Vault Slime
traits.info:
You can take the shape of a room now, floor, walls and ceiling, and some of the vaults people have been robbing for years were you all along. Grown from Treasure Slime at level 30. Only a body with the Mimic soul rooted in it can become Vault Slime.

🦊 Cunning +2 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Room Mimic · ⚔️ Robbed for Years · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Venom Hydra
traits.info:
Chitin plates grow on your necks and every bite carries a scorpion's venom. Grown from Hydra at level 10. Only a body with the Scorpid soul rooted in it can become Venom Hydra.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Venom Bite

traits.name: Vent Archdevil
traits.info:
You're lord of the dungeon's fire depths now, and the vents breathe in time with you. Grown from Pit Fiend at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Infernal Gate · ⚔️ Vents Breathe · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Void Panther
traits.info:
You're a panther made of living darkness now, and lamps dim and candles shrink when you pad into the room. Grown from Nightstalker Cat at level 30. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Void Panther.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Darkness Falls · ⚔️ Candle Shrink · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Void Spinner
traits.info:
You weave between worlds of shadow, stepping out of one dark corner and into another a mile away, and your webs hold things that aren't there. Grown from Umbral Spider at level 30. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Void Spinner.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Shadow Cocoon · ⚔️ Corner to Corner · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Void Wraith
traits.info:
You're a hole in the world shaped like a ghost now, and looking at you too long makes people feel like they're falling. Grown from Umbral Wraith at level 30. Only a body with the Shade soul rooted in it can become Void Wraith.

🔮 Soul +2 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Void Step · ⚔️ Feel Like Falling · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Volcanic Hydra
traits.info:
You're a hydra of lava and smoke from the deepest vents, and your heads glow orange in the dark. Grown from Inferno Hydra at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Lava Heads · ⚔️ Orange in the Dark · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Volcanic Scorpid
traits.info:
You nest in the lava vents now and the heat that comes off you could cook an egg on your back, and steam hisses up wherever you walk. Grown from Magma Scorpid at level 30. Only a body with the Salamander soul rooted in it can become Volcanic Scorpid.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Lava Spray · ⚔️ Cook an Egg · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Volcano Salamander
traits.info:
You're a salamander-dragon as big as a volcano's heart, and the mountain rumbles when you wake up. Grown from Magma Salamander at level 40. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Volcano Salamander.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Eruption · ⚔️ Mountain Rumbles · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: War Golem
traits.info:
You're a siege engine that walks now, and armies drag you to the walls of cities because nothing else will open them so fast. Grown from Steel Golem at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Siege Fist · ⚔️ Dragged to the Walls · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: War Paint
traits.info:
Bold paint in your own marks, fresh before every fight.

📖 no numbers: it plays out in the story.

Any build.

traits.name: Warlord
traits.info: Your home is big enough that people think twice. Chiefs send word before they cross your ground, and your people fight for you.

traits.name: Warren King
traits.info:
You're a kobold the size of a bear and your warrens are a city, and down there under the ground your word is the only law there is. Grown from Deep Boss at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Swarm the Tunnels · ⚔️ Law Under Ground · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Web Queen
traits.info:
You're a towering spider-goblin whose webs fill whole caverns, crowned in silk and old bones, and anything that walks into your hall stays there. Grown from Spider Goblin at level 40. Only a body with the Arachne soul rooted in it can become Web Queen.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Web Fortress · ⚔️ Silk Throne · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Webcrawler
traits.info:
Your arms and legs stretch spindly and stick to walls, a second pair of beady eyes opens above your brow and silk starts oozing from your wrists whether you want it to or not. Grown from Goblin at level 10. Only a body with the Arachne soul rooted in it can become Webcrawler.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Ceiling Drop

traits.name: Werewolf Vampire
traits.info:
You're half wolf and half vampire, moon and blood both, and you change whether you want to or not when the moon is full. Grown from Blood Wolf at level 20. Only a body with the Wolfkin soul rooted in it can become Werewolf Vampire.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Moon Hunger

traits.name: Wildgrowth
traits.info:
Every soul you take tries to grow something on you, a horn, a scale, a spur of bone, and your body never quite settles, things sprout overnight and drop off a week later, and you've stopped being surprised by what's there when you wake.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Fight +1 · 💨 Hunt +1 · ⚔️ Sudden Growth

💨 Swiftness build.

traits.name: Wind Mantid
traits.info:
Translucent wings unfold on your back and hum like wind through tall grass, and you can lift yourself off the ground with a buzz. Grown from Mantid at level 10. Only a body with the Sylph soul rooted in it can become Wind Mantid.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Wind Slash

traits.name: Winged Centaur
traits.info:
Real wings open from your shoulders now, wide and feathered, and you can lift off and fly short hops over the herd. Grown from Skyrunner at level 20. Only a body with the Harpy soul rooted in it can become Winged Centaur.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Wing Strike

traits.name: Winter Ogre
traits.info:
Your breath freezes rivers solid and the tribes in the north tell their kids you'll come for them if they don't behave. Grown from Frost Ogre at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +3 · ⚔️ Endless Winter · ⚔️ Frozen River Breath · 🧱 resists lightning

traits.name: Witch-Hag
traits.info:
You're what happens when a goblin shaman lives long enough to get truly nasty, ash-grey skin, a necklace of finger bones that rattles every time the spirits stir and eyes that glow green in the dark, and the warren is terrified of you and they should be. Grown from Goblin Hexer at level 30.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Witchfire Scream · ⚔️ Finger Bone Curse · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Wolf King
traits.info:
You're a huge grey-furred orc-wolf and every pack in the north calls you king. Grown from Moonhowler at level 40. Only a body with the Wolfkin soul rooted in it can become Wolf King.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 💨 Hunt +3 · ⚔️ Hunt of Kings · ⚔️ King's Howl · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Wolf Rider
traits.info:
You're lean and furred and there's always a pack of wolves loping along behind you, because they know you're one of them. Grown from Wolfblood Orc at level 20. Only a body with the Wolfkin soul rooted in it can become Wolf Rider.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Pack Call

traits.name: Wolfblood Orc
traits.info:
Grey fur grows across your shoulders and back, your eyes go yellow and your jaw stretches out just enough to make people nervous. Grown from Orc at level 10. Only a body with the Wolfkin soul rooted in it can become Wolfblood Orc.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Wolf Lunge

traits.name: Wolfkin
traits.info:
Wolfkin forests are marked, gouges dragged through the bark at the height of a tall man's head every few hundred paces, and if you keep walking past them the howls start, one ridge answering another until the whole valley knows where you are. They stand upright in grey and black pelts and live in packs bound by blood, and you can read a pack's whole order at a kill, the alpha eats first, the strong eat next and the young wait and watch and learn exactly where they stand. They'll trade furs and amber with you fair and square, but they never forget an insult, and a wolfkin who's been shamed will track the one who did it across half the Wildreach just to settle it.

🔮 Instinct +4 · ⚔️ Scent Lock · 🧱 resists cold · ⚠️ weak to holy

Any build.

traits.name: Wolfkin Alpha
traits.info:
Your chest broadens and your pelt darkens, and other wolfkin drop their eyes when you look at them, even the ones who used to bully you. Grown from Wolfkin at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Alpha Stare

traits.name: Wolfkin King
traits.info:
Every pack in every forest sings about you, a huge grey wolf with a crown of old scars, and they come running when you howl. Grown from Dire Wolfkin at level 40.

💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Call of the Wild · ⚔️ Crown of Scars · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Wolfkin Packlord
traits.info:
You're huge and scarred and you lead a pack of packs, and when you howl it gets answered from every ridge in the forest. Grown from Wolfkin Alpha at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Pack Tactics

traits.name: World Oak
traits.info:
You're so big a whole village could live in your branches, and one has, and you don't mind. Grown from Treant Colossus at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Endure +3 · ⚔️ Shelter of Ages · ⚔️ Village in the Branches · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: World Worm
traits.info:
You're a worm whose tunnels are the dungeon's arteries, and some scholars think the dungeon itself grew around your track. Grown from Rockworm Leviathan at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 🦊 Build +3 · ⚔️ Earth-Eater · ⚔️ Dungeon's Arteries · 🧱 resists slashing

traits.name: Wraith
traits.info:
The candles gutter all at once, your breath fogs in the middle of summer and frost creeps across the walls in thin white fingers, and that's the only warning you get before a wraith comes through the stone. They're the cold shadows of souls that wouldn't move on, haunting battlefields and ruins and the dungeon's dark, and they drain the warmth out of anything living they touch until it's as cold as they are. Some still remember who they were and can be talked to, and they'll bargain hard for whatever it was that kept them here, a name, a grave, a debt nobody paid, but they never quite understand that the living can't wait forever for an answer.

🔮 Absorb +4 · ⚔️ Cold Touch · 🧱 resists slashing, piercing, bludgeoning · ⚠️ weak to holy · 🚫 immune to poison, cold

Any build.

traits.name: Wraith Hunter
traits.info:
You hunt the living across any distance now, and once you've touched a soul you never lose it, no matter how far it runs. Grown from Wraith Stalker at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Soul Scent

traits.name: Wraith Lord
traits.info:
You're lord of the restless dead now, and your court is a battlefield full of ghosts who still think they're fighting. Grown from Wraith Reaper at level 40.

🔮 Soul +2 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Host of the Dead · ⚔️ Still Think They're Fighting · 🧱 resists holy

traits.name: Wraith Reaper
traits.info:
Your touch takes souls now, and the living who see you start making their peace with whatever gods they've got. Grown from Wraith Hunter at level 30.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Absorb +2 · ⚔️ Reap · ⚔️ Make Their Peace · 🧱 resists shadow

traits.name: Wraith Stalker
traits.info:
You go colder and darker, and your hands reach straight through armour like it's smoke, and the living feel you coming as a chill on the back of the neck. Grown from Wraith at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Stalk +2 · ⚔️ Phase Strike

traits.name: Wreck-Singer
traits.info:
You perch on the reefs and sing, and the wrecks piling up beneath you are all ships that turned toward the music. Grown from Sea Harpy at level 20. Only a body with the Siren soul rooted in it can become Wreck-Singer.

🦊 Cunning +1 · 🦊 Barter +2 · ⚔️ Shipwreck Song

traits.name: Wyrmspeaker
traits.info:
You've grown a frilled crest and smoke curls out of your nostrils, and your voice has picked up some of a dragon's weight so lesser monsters flinch when you talk. Grown from Dragonscale Kobold at level 20. Only a body with the Drake soul rooted in it can become Wyrmspeaker.

🔮 Soul +1 · 🔮 Command +2 · ⚔️ Wyrm Voice

traits.name: Wyvern
traits.info:
Shepherds in the high country count their flock every evening, because a shadow passes over the hills now and then and afterwards there's one less sheep and nobody saw it go. Wyverns are two-legged, bat-winged lesser dragons that nest on the highest peaks in nests built from the bones of everything they've carried up, and they hunt by folding their wings and dropping out of the clouds onto whatever looks slow. The barbed sting on the end of their tail carries a venom that locks up the limbs, so whatever they don't kill in the dive just lies there waiting, and nobody bargains with a wyvern, it looks at you and sees dinner.

💪 Endure +2 · 🔮 Instinct +2 · ⚔️ Glide · 🧱 resists piercing · ⚠️ weak to cold

Any build.

traits.name: Wyvern Death-Queen
traits.info:
Your sting is death, and you nest in peaks so poisoned nothing else can live there. Grown from Wyvern Plaguewing at level 40.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +3 · ⚔️ Death Sting · ⚔️ Poisoned Peak · 🧱 resists acid

traits.name: Wyvern Drake
traits.info:
Leathery wings start unfolding from your shoulders and a barbed tail grows out behind you, and you start looking up at the sky a lot. Grown from Drake at level 10. Only a body with the Wyvern soul rooted in it can become Wyvern Drake.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Wing Buffet

traits.name: Wyvern King
traits.info:
Every wyvern nest from peak to peak answers to you, and when you take to the sky the mountain range goes dark. Grown from Storm Wyvern Lord at level 40. Only a body with the Wyvern soul rooted in it can become Wyvern King.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Wyvern Host · ⚔️ Range Goes Dark · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Wyvern Plaguewing
traits.info:
Venom drips off your wings and claws and the air around you turns sour, and the grass under your nest has died for a mile around. Grown from Wyvern Venomlord at level 30.

💪 Might +2 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Venom Rain · ⚔️ Dead Grass Nest · 🧱 resists poison

traits.name: Wyvern Raptor
traits.info:
You've got a hawk's precision in a dragon's body now, and you can pluck a rider off a horse without slowing down. Grown from Wyvern Skyhunter at level 20.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Snatch

traits.name: Wyvern Sky-King
traits.info:
Every sky from the coast to the mountains is yours, and every flying thing in it gets out of your way. Grown from Wyvern Sky-Tyrant at level 40.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 🔮 Command +3 · ⚔️ Sky Dominion · ⚔️ Out of the Way · 🧱 resists piercing

traits.name: Wyvern Sky-Tyrant
traits.info:
You rule the peaks and even the eagles flee your shadow, and nothing in the high country flies in daylight while you're hunting. Grown from Wyvern Raptor at level 30.

💨 Swiftness +2 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Peak Tyrant · ⚔️ Shadow on the Peaks · 🧱 resists cold

traits.name: Wyvern Skyhunter
traits.info:
Your wings get wider and your eyes get sharper, and you can spot a rabbit from a mile up. Grown from Wyvern at level 10.

💨 Swiftness +1 · 💨 Hunt +2 · ⚔️ Stoop

traits.name: Wyvern Stinger
traits.info:
Your tail gets heavier and the barb on the end gets bigger, always dripping a little venom. Grown from Wyvern at level 10.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Venom Sting

traits.name: Wyvern Venomlord
traits.info:
Your venom can drop an ox, and shepherds have started burning the bodies of anything you sting. Grown from Wyvern Stinger at level 20.

💪 Might +1 · 💪 Fight +2 · ⚔️ Crippling Venom

traits.name: Young Dragon
traits.info:
You're a dragon now, a real one, winged and terrible with a voice that talks, and every drake in the badlands bows its head to you. Grown from Flame Drake at level 30.

🔮 Soul +1 · 💪 Might +1 · 🔮 Evoke +2 · ⚔️ Dragon Fire · ⚔️ Voice That Talks · 🧱 resists fire

traits.name: Your Maker
traits.info:
Something made you what you are, the soul that won't let go, and you want to find it and ask why, and you can feel it out there like a pull in your chest.

🔮 Instinct +1

🔮 Soul build.

categories.name: Lineage
categories.info:
The body you were born in. Pick one race; every one can evolve, and the souls you take decide how.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Fighting Style
categories.info:
How you fight, whatever body you were born in. Your race gives your senses, your skin and what hurts you; this gives your strength in a fight. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Way of Life
categories.info:
What you're good at when nobody's bleeding. Your fighting style is how you live through a fight; this is how you get by the rest of the time. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Aberration
categories.info:
How your soul is wrong. Every monster keeps a sliver of what it kills; you keep far more, and this is the shape of it. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: First Kill
categories.info:
The first soul that stayed. Every monster kills; the first time you did, the soul didn't fade, and that's how you found out what you are. Pick the race it was: you start with its soul counted, and its gift comes to you.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Born Of
categories.info:
Where you came into the world. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Hunger
categories.info:
What drives you. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Scar
categories.info:
What nearly killed you, and what it left behind. Pick one.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Element
categories.info:
The magic in you, if there is any. Pick one, then say how it shows in your backstory: the colour, where it comes out of you, what it feels like. Your element grows on its own at levels 12, 25 and 40.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

categories.name: Outfit
categories.info:
What you wear, if anything. It's looks only and goes into your portrait. Pick up to two; whatever your body is, you wear it your own way: strapped, draped, hung or painted on.

Build marks: 💪 Might: hit hard, lift, shove · 💨 Swiftness: run, dodge, strike first · 🦊 Cunning: tricks, ambush, read a fight · 🔮 Soul: take souls, magic, hold your mind. Match the marks.

skills.name: absorb
skills.info:
Drawing a dead foe's soul in and holding it: the Aberrant's craft.

Covers: drawing a defeated foe's soul in and holding it. Not: killing the foe, which is fight, strike or trick. Easy: take a rat's soul. Medium: hold a goblin's soul through pain. Hard: absorb a soul mid-battle. Very hard: keep a stronger monster's soul from tearing loose. Extremely hard: absorb an elder's soul whole.

Primary Attribute: Soul

skills.name: barter
skills.info:
Trading goods and ingots, reading a deal, haggling.

Covers: trading goods and ingots, haggling, reading a deal. Not: leading monsters, which is command. Easy: swap meat for salt. Medium: haggle an ingot down. Hard: strike a caravan contract. Very hard: win a monopoly from a town. Extremely hard: trade with a dragon and keep your hoard.

Primary Attribute: Cunning

skills.name: build
skills.info:
Digging, raising and fortifying dens, halls and walls; working materials.

Covers: digging, raising, fortifying and working materials into rooms, walls and gear. Not: trading the results, which is barter. Easy: dig a sleeping hollow. Medium: raise a palisade. Hard: wall a cave mouth with a gate. Very hard: raise a stone hall. Extremely hard: found a city's walls.

Primary Attribute: Cunning

skills.name: command
skills.info:
Leading a tribe: rallying, ordering, keeping monsters loyal.

Covers: leading a tribe: rallying, ordering, keeping loyalty. Not: trading, which is barter. Easy: get a kobold to fetch. Medium: hold a warband together. Hard: rally a routed tribe. Very hard: rule a town's chiefs. Extremely hard: bend an elder monster to your banner.

Primary Attribute: Soul

skills.name: endure
skills.info:
Shrugging off poison, cold, hunger and hard travel.

Covers: toughing out poison, cold, hunger, heat and the road. Not: healing others, which is lore. Easy: walk a day unfed. Medium: shake off a snakebite. Hard: cross the ice wastes. Very hard: survive a cave-in. Extremely hard: outlast a curse.

Primary Attribute: Might

skills.name: evoke
skills.info:
Racial magic and breath: fire, frost, venom, spores, the powers a body or a kept soul carries.

Covers: racial magic, breaths, spores, venoms and aura powers. Not: pulling a soul in, which is absorb. Easy: light a fire with a spark. Medium: scorch a wolf. Hard: freeze a stream to cross it. Very hard: breathe through a war party. Extremely hard: turn a storm on an army.

Primary Attribute: Soul

skills.name: fight
skills.info:
Fighting by force with tooth, claw, horn, tail or a scavenged weapon: heavy hits, grapples and shoves.

Covers: close combat by force: heavy hits, grappling, shoving, throwing a foe, slugging it out. Not: quick hits and darting in and out, which is strike; feints and dirty tricks, which is trick; racial magic or breath, which is evoke. Easy: drive off a scavenger. Medium: kill a goblin raider. Hard: beat an orc in a ring. Very hard: bring down an ogre. Extremely hard: kill a dungeon floor's keeper.

Primary Attribute: Might

skills.name: hunt
skills.info:
Tracking, chasing and running prey down.

Covers: tracking, chasing and running prey down. Not: hiding, which is stalk. Easy: follow fresh tracks. Medium: run down a deer. Hard: track a pack across rock. Very hard: find a hidden lair by trail. Extremely hard: hunt a beast that hunts you back.

Primary Attribute: Swiftness

skills.name: instinct
skills.info:
Monster senses: scent, tremor, danger before it shows.

Covers: monster senses: scent, tremor, danger-sense, reading another monster. Not: knowledge of a race, which is lore. Easy: smell a rival's mark. Medium: feel footsteps through stone. Hard: sense an ambush. Very hard: read a beast's intent. Extremely hard: feel the dungeon itself turn its eye on you.

Primary Attribute: Soul

skills.name: lore
skills.info:
Knowing races, ruins, the dungeon's depths and the old soul-stories.

Covers: knowledge of races, ruins, the dungeon and soul-stories; tending wounds. Not: monster senses, which is instinct. Easy: name a common beast. Medium: know a race's weakness. Hard: read a ruin's runes. Very hard: recall a lost depth's dangers. Extremely hard: know what the Great Dungeon is.

Primary Attribute: Cunning

skills.name: stalk
skills.info:
Moving unseen and unheard; ambush.

Covers: moving unseen, ambush and escape. Not: tracking, which is hunt. Easy: creep past a sleeper. Medium: ambush a lone scout. Hard: slip through a camp. Very hard: pass a watchtower by day. Extremely hard: walk unseen through a dragon's hall.

Primary Attribute: Swiftness

skills.name: strike
skills.info:
Fighting fast: quick hits, darting in and out, slashing past, and thrown weapons.

Covers: fast close combat and thrown weapons: quick hits, darting in and out, slashing past a guard. Not: slugging it out or grappling, which is fight. Easy: nip a scavenger and get clear. Medium: cut a goblin raider down before he swings. Hard: slash past an orc's guard. Very hard: run rings round an ogre and bleed it. Extremely hard: outpace a dungeon floor's keeper hit for hit.

Primary Attribute: Swiftness

skills.name: talk
skills.info:
Talking your way in or out: persuading, lying, threatening, getting someone to spill.

Covers: persuading, lying, threatening and getting someone to talk. Not: haggling a price, which is barter; giving your own tribe orders, which is command. Easy: talk a guard into looking away. Medium: lie to a goblin boss and walk out. Hard: scare a caravan into paying up. Very hard: talk a warband out of a fight. Extremely hard: lie to a dragon's face and live.

Primary Attribute: Cunning

skills.name: trick
skills.info:
Fighting dirty: feints, bluffs, dirt in the eyes, and turning the ground and the foe's own weight against them.

Covers: fighting dirty: feints, bluffs mid-fight, blinding, tripping, turning the ground and the foe's weight against them. Not: hitting from hiding, which is stalk. Easy: kick dirt in a scavenger's eyes. Medium: feint a goblin raider into a miss. Hard: trip an orc into the fire. Very hard: lure an ogre off a ledge. Extremely hard: turn a dungeon floor's own traps on its keeper.

Primary Attribute: Cunning

lowText.might: A runt's body: easily thrown, quickly winded.
lowText.swiftness: Slow to move and slower to react.
lowText.cunning: A blunt mind that walks into traps and bad bargains.
lowText.soul: A thin soul: what it takes from the dead leaks away.

lore.name: Bounties
lore.info: Every town has a wall where the bosses pin up bounties, a drawing of the face, the race and what it's worth in ingots, and nobody asks how you bring it in as long as you bring it in. The old adventurers' notice boards in the guildhouse were the first bounty wall, and some of the old human bounties are still pinned up under the new ones.

lore.name: District: Greenhill
lore.info: Greenhill is a district of Monster Kingdom. Low green hills north-west of the Basin, riddled with goblin and kobold warrens. Every hill has a hole in it and every hole has something looking out. Orc warbands cross it and ogres sit at the fords charging a toll. Its town is Rattle Warren; its other places: Ogre Ford, Copper Seam, Bonecairn, Rope Bridge Gully, Scrap Heap Hill, Kobold Kilns. By land Greenhill joins The Basin, The Iron March, The Spine.

lore.name: District: The Astral Crown
lore.info: The Astral Crown is a district of Monster Kingdom. A blue and gold star dome out past the eastern sea where the gazers read what's coming for everyone. Who lives here: Gazer, Siren, Merfolk, Pixie. Its town is Star Landing; its other places: The Star Bridge, The Star Gate, The Armillary, The Star Falls, The Moon Orrery, The Crystal Cliffs, The Round Seats, The Black Well. By land The Astral Crown joins The Scattered Isles.

lore.name: District: The Barrow Hills
lore.info: The Barrow Hills is a district of Monster Kingdom. Grey hills in the south covered in old grave mounds from wars nobody remembers. The dead walk here and mostly keep to themselves; ghouls dig, wraiths drift, golems guard tombs for masters long gone, and something old lives in the keep. Its town is Stillbarrow; its other places: Gargoyle Chapel, Red Keep, Grave Road Shrine, Open Barrow, Ghoul Warrens, Hanging Stones. By land The Barrow Hills joins The Basin, The Black Fen, The Deepgreen, The Red Waste.

lore.name: District: The Basin
lore.info: The Basin is a district of Monster Kingdom. A wide bowl of old farmland gone to scrub round the mouth of the Great Dungeon. Fallen walls, empty farmhouses, and roads that all run downhill to Delvers' Rest. Weak things live here and strong things pass through on the way down. Its town is Delvers' Rest; its other places: Sinkhole Den, Leaning Post, Dry Well Farm, Gallows Oak, Beetle Wallow. By land The Basin joins Greenhill, The Barrow Hills, The Black Fen, The Deep Wood, The Long Grass, The Red Waste, The Upper Halls.

lore.name: District: The Black Fen
lore.info: The Black Fen is a district of Monster Kingdom. Marsh south-west of the Basin: black water, reed beds, peat islands and fog that sits all day. Lizardfolk build on stilts out here, crocodiles the size of boats lie in the channels, and the hydras keep the deep pools. Its town is Stiltscale; its other places: Hydra Pools, Peat Island, Reed Platform, Sunk Road, Bog Bell, Leech Ditch, Fen Ruin, Peat Reeds, Landing Reeds. By land The Black Fen joins The Barrow Hills, The Basin, The Iron March.

lore.name: District: The Blossom Hills
lore.info: The Blossom Hills is a district of Monster Kingdom. Foothills north-west of the Wildreach between the Lost Human Kingdom and the Rimelands: pines, white orchards and an empty farm under the snow. Its town is Orchard Farm; its other places: Frost Giant Siegehold, Lich War Chapel, Hill Stone, Snow Bear Den, Red Tent Camp, White Orchard, Snowline Road. By land The Blossom Hills joins The Lost Human Kingdom.

lore.name: District: The Broken Coast
lore.info: The Broken Coast is a district of Monster Kingdom. Cliffs, reefs and wreck-strewn bays on the eastern sea. Crabfolk and merfolk trade in the shallows, sirens sing off the rocks, and sharkfolk raid anything that floats. Its town is Saltreef; its other places: Wreck Bay, Drowned Caves, Gull Rock, Tidepool Steps, Lighthouse Stump, Crab Flats. By land The Broken Coast joins The Long Grass; by sea The Scattered Isles (across the sea).

lore.name: District: The Celestial Seal
lore.info: The Celestial Seal is a district of Monster Kingdom. A sealed white and gold dome above the north where every soul in the world is weighed when it dies. Who lives here: Golem, Sylph, Gargoyle, Wraith. Its town is Obelisk Landing; its other places: The Two Gaps, The Sun Gate, The Falling Pools, The Swirl, The Scales, The Gold Grove, The Chained Rocks, The Crystal Ridge, The Sun Stair. By land The Celestial Seal joins The Rimelands.

lore.name: District: The Deep Wood
lore.info: The Deep Wood is a district of Monster Kingdom. Old forest north-east of the Basin, so thick the light comes down green. Treants and dryads tend it, fox spirits play in it, myconids rot the dead parts down, and the trees themselves notice who's walking under them. Its town is Ringgrove; its other places: Old Oak, Rot Hollow, Glowcap Dell, Axe Stumps, Spider Hollow, Moss Circle. By land The Deep Wood joins The Basin, The Long Grass, The Spine.

lore.name: District: The Deepgreen
lore.info: The Deepgreen is a district of Monster Kingdom. Hot jungle south of the Barrow Hills: rivers, ruins older than anyone, and beasts big enough to step on a troll. Its town is Sunken Temple; its other places: Titan Bones, Riverfork Clearing, Vine Bridge, Frog Pools, Strangler Tree, Root Cave, Ruin Terraces, Reed Shallows, Temple Stone, Arena Camp, Jade Dig, High Spring, Grey Cave, Big Bones. By land The Deepgreen joins The Barrow Hills, The Primordial Covenant, The Root Delta.

lore.name: District: The Elder Prison
lore.info: The Elder Prison is a district of Monster Kingdom. A spiked violet prison past the humans' land where the things nobody could kill are kept. Who lives here: Imp, Hellhound, Troll, Shade. Its town is The Spike Landing; its other places: The Lightning Road, The Violet Door, The Pit, The Vaults, The Hanging Cells, The Lit Door, The Dead Trees, The Sluices. By land The Elder Prison joins The Lost Human Kingdom.

lore.name: District: The Heart
lore.info: The Heart is a district of Monster Kingdom. The bottom of the Great Dungeon, if it has one. The walls are warm here and they move like something breathing. Its town is The Heart; its other places: The Meeting Pool, The Soft Halls, The Shade Halls, The Womb, The Gullet, The Ribcage, The Whispering Deep, The Last Keepers, The Pulse. By land The Heart joins The Lower Depths.

lore.name: District: The Ice Coast
lore.info: The Ice Coast is a district of Monster Kingdom. Where the Rimelands' glaciers break into the sea north-east of the Wildreach: ice cliffs, floes and caves through the ice. Its town is Glacier Face; its other places: Frost Giant Shorehold, Merfolk Tidehold, Groaning Crags, Cliff Stone, Floe Landing, Ice Wreck, Floe Field, Ice Arch. By land The Ice Coast joins The Rimelands.

lore.name: District: The Iron March
lore.info: The Iron March is a district of Monster Kingdom. The far west edge of the Wildreach: a line of empty human forts on a ridge, burnt villages and the old roads west. Everyone says the humans are gone. Out here there are fresh tracks that say otherwise. Its town is Last Fort; its other places: Burnt Village, Watch Hill, Burnt Bridge, Old Road Camp, Iron Stakes, Scorched Orchard. By land The Iron March joins Greenhill, The Black Fen, The Lost Human Kingdom.

lore.name: District: The Long Grass
lore.info: The Long Grass is a district of Monster Kingdom. Open grassland east of the Basin, grass up to a centaur's chest, where the herds and packs run. Centaurs, minotaurs, boarfolk and gnolls all claim some of it and none of them agree where the lines are. Its town is Hornmoot; its other places: Bonefield, Salt Lick, Split Stone, Hunter's Hang, Stampede Scar, The Waterhole. By land The Long Grass joins The Basin, The Broken Coast, The Deep Wood, The Red Waste.

lore.name: District: The Lost Human Kingdom
lore.info: The Lost Human Kingdom is a district of Monster Kingdom. The humans' own land west of the Iron March: empty towns and farms, and a capital standing open and silent. Its town is The Empty Capital; its other places: Road of Boots, The Millhouse, The Coaching Inn, Toll Gate, Burnt Crag, Plague Pits, Elder Dragon Roosts, North Gate Ruin, Capital Watch, Aqueduct Ruin, Bone Yard, Walled Farm, Mill Bridge, Chapel Stone. By land The Lost Human Kingdom joins The Blossom Hills, The Elder Prison, The Iron March, The Stair Falls.

lore.name: District: The Lower Depths
lore.info: The Lower Depths is a district of Monster Kingdom. Deep floors where the dungeon splits in two: halls of fire where hellhounds and imps run, and halls flooded black where the drowned things live. Few come back up from here, and the ones that do come back changed. Its town is Burning Halls; its other places: Flooded Halls, Kennels of Ash, The Drowned Market, The Slag Sea, Shark Run, Salamander Deeps, The Lightless Lake, The Brass Halls, Song Grotto, Cinder Choir, The Undertow, The Furnace, The Weeping Wall, The Gate of Fire. By land The Lower Depths joins The Heart, The Middle Depths.

lore.name: District: The Middle Depths
lore.info: The Middle Depths is a district of Monster Kingdom. Below the Upper Halls the dungeon gets bigger and stranger: webbed galleries, ant roads, gazers watching from the ceiling and floors that move when nobody's looking. Its town is Crawling Halls; its other places: The Spinning Dark, Antfront, The Labyrinth, Stonegaze Hollow, The Watching Vault, Wormholes, Golem Graveyard, The Mantis Grove, Imp Market, The Turning Floor, The Hungry Chests, The Middle Keeper's Hold. By land The Middle Depths joins The Lower Depths, The Upper Halls.

lore.name: District: The Primordial Covenant
lore.info: The Primordial Covenant is a district of Monster Kingdom. A dome of living roots under the south where everything that grows made its first promise. Who lives here: Treant, Dryad, Mandrake, Myconid. Its town is The Root Gate; its other places: The Root Road, The Green Door, The Amber Marsh, The Great Trees, The Leaf Circle, The Dead Wood, The Lotus Falls, The Heart Seed. By land The Primordial Covenant joins The Deepgreen.

lore.name: District: The Red Waste
lore.info: The Red Waste is a district of Monster Kingdom. Red desert south-east of the Basin, hot enough to crack stone by day and cold enough to frost it at night. Salamanders work their forges in the heat, lamias keep a court at the wells, and scorpids hunt the dunes. Its town is Cinderforge; its other places: Glass Flats, Scorpion Wells, Sun Bones, Dry Wash Spring, Sandworm Field, Black Chimney. By land The Red Waste joins The Barrow Hills, The Basin, The Long Grass.

lore.name: District: The Rimelands
lore.info: The Rimelands is a district of Monster Kingdom. The frozen land north of the Spine: white plains, ice caves, frost ogres and things that sleep under the snow. Its town is Giant's Stair; its other places: Wyrm Ice, Hot Spring Hollow, Clear Ice, Mammoth Trail, Frozen Camp, Wyrm Gate, Crystal Cut, Ogre Bridge, Ice Ruin, Frost Pool, Stair Bridge, Old Watch, Terrace Dig, Black Crags. By land The Rimelands joins The Celestial Seal, The Ice Coast, The Spine.

lore.name: District: The Root Delta
lore.info: The Root Delta is a district of Monster Kingdom. Mangrove delta south-east of the Wildreach where the Deepgreen's rivers run out into the sea toward the isles. Its town is Root Town; its other places: Serpentfolk Root Keep, Abyssal Tidehold, Delta Spring, Mangrove Reeds, Islet Maze, Channel Mouth. By land The Root Delta joins The Deepgreen.

lore.name: District: The Scattered Isles
lore.info: The Scattered Isles is a district of Monster Kingdom. Islands strung out across the sea east of the Broken Coast: reefs, wrecks, smugglers and something big under the water. Its town is Smugglers' Atoll; its other places: Kraken Deep, Turtle Back, Long Sandbar, Wreckers' Light, Egg Island, Anglers Arch, Bone Arch Ruin, North Cliffs, Reef Wreck, Spray Rock, Gull Crags, Atoll Cliffs, Fresh Spring, Low Tide Cave, Light Wreck. By land The Scattered Isles joins The Astral Crown; by sea The Broken Coast (across the sea).

lore.name: District: The Spine
lore.info: The Spine is a district of Monster Kingdom. The mountains along the north, cold, high and full of ore. The antfolk have hollowed a whole peak into a city, wyverns and drakes nest on the ledges, and rockworms chew roads through the roots of it. Its town is Hivehold; its other places: Wyvern Roost, Iron Seam, Windcut Pass, Ledge Shelter, Harpy Crags, Frozen Falls. By land The Spine joins Greenhill, The Deep Wood, The Rimelands.

lore.name: District: The Stair Falls
lore.info: The Stair Falls is a district of Monster Kingdom. A run of waterfalls south-west of the Wildreach where the Lost Human Kingdom's river drops into the jungle. Its town is Falls Ledge; its other places: Lich Terrace Keep, Serpentfolk Waterhold, Falls Bridge, Keep Stone, Falls Camp, Wall Fields, Plunge Pools. By land The Stair Falls joins The Lost Human Kingdom.

lore.name: District: The Upper Halls
lore.info: The Upper Halls is a district of Monster Kingdom. The first floors of the Great Dungeon under Delvers' Rest: wide stone halls, slime pits, mimics, goblin squatters and the dungeon's weakest children. Most monsters who go down come back from here. Its town is First Hall; its other places: The Drip, Ratrun, The Mossway, Coffer Hall, The Ossuary, Cockatrice Garden, The Gnawed Bridge, Ghoul Pantry, The Echo Halls, The Lantern Run, The First Keeper's Hold. By land The Upper Halls joins The Basin, The Middle Depths.

lore.name: Souls and Aberrants
lore.info: Every creature that kills takes a sliver of its prey's soul; that sliver is how monsters grow, and why old monsters are dangerous. An Aberrant is a monster born wrong: its soul is a sieve that keeps what it takes. Kills feed it a little. Taking a fresh soul whole, in the moments after a foe falls, feeds it far more. The first soul of a race leaves a minor gift, the fifth (with one taken whole) a major one, and the tenth lets the race's soul take root and change the body. An Aberrant can only hold so many rooted souls: three, and one more every fifteen levels. Most monsters have never met one, and the ones who have don't say Aberrant, they say soul eater, and they keep their distance.

lore.name: The Beetle Caravans
lore.info: Big pack-beetles haul goods between the monster towns of the Wildreach, days apart across open country, a guard riding up top on every load and the ingots locked in a strongbox under the driver's seat. Ask the caravan master, pay the fare in goods or an ingot, and ride on top of the load, and keep an eye on the hills, because the Laughing Pack holds up a caravan most months and the Red Fins work the coast road the same way.

lore.name: The Big Table
lore.info: The bosses of Delvers' Rest, the ones strong enough to eat at the long table in the Big Hall. They keep the caravans running and the dungeon mouth open, settle fights before they wreck the town, and take a cut of everything.

lore.name: The Blossom Hills
lore.info: The land north of the Lost Human Kingdom climbs into foothills under the Rimelands' snow, pine woods and meadows and a human farm sitting empty with its gate shut and its field ploughed in rows like somebody's coming back for the harvest. Above it there's an orchard where the trees flower white all year round, snow or no snow, and the petals never run out however hard the wind blows. A dirt road winds up through the pines from the farm to the snowline and the cart ruts in it go up into the snow and stop. It's quiet up here, too quiet for most monsters, and the ones that stay say the farm isn't as empty as it looks.

lore.name: The Deepgreen
lore.info: The grey hills south of the Barrow Hills drop into jungle so thick the light comes down green, hot and wet and loud with things you never see. Brown rivers fork through it, ruins older than the humans or the monsters stick up out of the trees, and there's a valley where the bones are so big you walk under the ribs like a roof. The lizardfolk live round a sunken temple of green stone and go up its steps to the third one and no further, mantids hunt the canopy, mandrakes root in the wet ground and hydras keep the deep pools. Whatever you build in the Deepgreen, build it high.

lore.name: The Hive
lore.info: The antfolk of Hivehold, millions of them under one queen. They mine, build and trade iron and stone, and they deal with outsiders only on the guest ledge. They don't lie and they don't forget.

lore.name: The Horn Moot
lore.info: The herds of the long grass, centaurs, minotaurs and boarfolk, bound by the moot law: no blood spilled inside the ring of stones. They trade stock and hides, and they keep the grass road safe for anyone who keeps the law.

lore.name: The Ice Coast
lore.info: The ice east of the Rimelands keeps going until it runs out of land and breaks off into the sea, a wall of blue glacier taller than Hivehold, groaning and cracking all night, with a sea black with cold below it and ice floes drifting round in slow circles. There are caves right through the glacier where the sea comes in under the ice and the light turns blue as a gem, and old frost drakes too heavy to fly drag their kills in on the tide. Nothing lives out here that isn't big, hungry or both.

lore.name: The Laughing Pack
lore.info: A gnoll pack out of the Bonefield, laughing all night, raiding herds and caravans, and getting bigger every season. They answer to a witch and they take anyone who'll run with them.

lore.name: The Lost Human Kingdom
lore.info: The land west past the Iron March is where the humans lived, farms and stone villages and roads, and a capital with walls and towers and a palace on the hill. It's all still standing. Doors open, shops stocked, washing on the lines, and not a human anywhere, they left one season and none of them came back. Gargoyles sit on the rooftops, the golems the humans built still walk their rounds, and wraiths and ghouls move through the houses at night, and the monsters who go into the capital come out quiet. Everything there was built for human hands, so anything a monster takes, it has to make its own.

lore.name: The One Law
lore.info: Delvers' Rest has one law: the strong survive and the weak shut up. The Big Table enforces it, mostly by being the strongest.

lore.name: The Plague of Men
lore.info: Delvers' Rest was the Town of Adventurers once. Humans came from the west to go down the Great Dungeon, and then one season they stopped coming. Some monsters call it the plague of men. The town fell empty, the monsters below noticed nobody came down any more, and the curious ones climbed up, waited, and took it.

lore.name: The Quiet Council
lore.info: The council of the dead that runs Stillbarrow: skeletons, ghouls and wraiths who have kept the same laws for three hundred years. They trade in bones, bodies and news, and they never forget a debt.

lore.name: The Red Fins
lore.info: Sharkfolk raiders on the Broken Coast who hit anything that floats and anything on the shore. They paint a red fin on everything they take, and they sell what they steal inland through anyone who'll buy.

lore.name: The Rimelands
lore.info: The land north of the Spine goes white and stays that way, plains of snow, blue ice cliffs and lakes frozen so deep you can walk across them in summer. The frost ogres up there call themselves giants and nobody argues with them about it, they built a stair of cut ice out of the mountains to come south and raid, then sat down at the top and never came, and they still keep a fire burning up there the size of a house. Frost drakes sleep in the ice caves so still you'd swear they're part of the wall, trolls and bearkin hunt the edges, and the only warm ground for days is a hollow where hot springs keep the grass green. Up here the cold kills more than anything with teeth.

lore.name: The Root Delta
lore.info: Where the Deepgreen's rivers run out into the sea the jungle stands in the water on mangrove roots, warm brown channels winding between hundreds of little green islets that all look the same, and the tide moves the channels round so a boat that knew the way last week gets lost this week. Somebody built a camp up in the roots once, plank walks and huts in the branches, and nobody knows where they went. The crabfolk will show you through the islets, for a price.

lore.name: The Scattered Isles
lore.info: The sea east of the Broken Coast is full of islands, dozens of them, most with no name, some no bigger than a rock and a tree. Smugglers tie up at an atoll a day's sail out where nobody owns anything and the only rule is you don't rob the boat next to you, the Red Fins run their raids from there, merfolk and crabfolk trade in the shallows and sirens sing off the reefs. Boats go the long way round one black reef where the water goes dark straight down, and the ones that don't come back as wreckage. Out here an island is yours if you can hold it.

lore.name: The Stair Falls
lore.info: The humans' river south of the Lost Human Kingdom runs past a mill, through fields gone wild inside a broken stone wall, and then drops straight off the edge of the land into the jungle in a run of waterfalls, one pool to the next, spray hanging over everything and the noise so loud you shout to be heard. There's a wide dry ledge halfway down that anyone can hold, a dry cave behind the falls, and at the bottom deep green pools where the river goes into the Deepgreen, so deep nobody has ever touched the bottom.

starts.name: (OP Start) God of the Covenant
starts.info:
SOLO · OP
📍 The Heart Seed, The Primordial Covenant. At the bottom of the Covenant, wrapped in a cradle of roots as tall as a tower, a great seed burns gold and orange like a fire in a fist, with a stair running down to it and green halls round the base.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 45-50)

You are the god of the Primordial Covenant, the seed burns for you, and through the roots under every tree in the world you hear what happens everywhere. You start at level 30.

starts.name: (OP Start) God of the Crown
starts.info:
SOLO · OP
📍 The Armillary, The Astral Crown. A great round platform standing in the star-sea with a gold armillary sphere in the middle of it, rings inside rings turning slowly round a white pearl that glows like the moon.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 45-50)

You are the god of the Astral Crown, the gazers read the sky for you and nothing coming for anyone gets past your pearl. You start at level 30.

starts.name: (OP Start) God of the Prison
starts.info:
SOLO · OP
📍 The Pit, The Elder Prison. A great round paved yard in the middle of the prison with a ring wall round it and a deep round pit in its centre, four stairs going down into it from the four sides and a slow violet swirl at the bottom you can't see past.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 45-50)

You are the god of the Elder Prison, the warden over everything nobody could kill, and the imps, hellhounds, trolls and shades all keep your keys. You start at level 30.

starts.name: (OP Start) God of the Seal
starts.info:
SOLO · OP
📍 The Scales, The Celestial Seal. The heart of the Seal, a great round paved plaza with a gold sun cut into the floor and a pair of scales inside it, and a ring of arched stone walls around the edge like the seats of a court.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 45-50)

You are the god of the Celestial Seal, the golems answer to you and every soul in the world comes past your scales when it dies. You start at level 30.

starts.name: (Party) Up the Mouth
starts.info:
TABLE · Low
📍 Delvers' Rest, The Basin. The old adventurers' town at the mouth of the Great Dungeon, taken over by monsters when the humans stopped coming, and a dusty boomtown ever since, because everything that comes up out of the Mouth sells here.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 1-12)

The party climbs up out of the Great Dungeon into Delvers' Rest for the first time.

starts.name: Born in the Den
starts.info:
SOLO · Low
📍 Sinkhole Den, The Basin. A sinkhole in an old field a short walk from Delvers' Rest, opening into a dry cave big enough for a family of anything.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-6)

A fresh monster wakes alone in a sinkhole cave a short walk from Delvers' Rest.

starts.name: Grave Waking
starts.info:
SOLO · Medium
📍 Stillbarrow, The Barrow Hills. A town of the dead in the grey hills, dug into the old barrows: skeletons keeping shop, ghouls running the bone trade, golems at the gates.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-34)

A dead thing wakes up in its crypt in Stillbarrow and finds the town already expects it.

starts.name: Out of the Egg
starts.info:
SOLO · Low
📍 Stiltscale, The Black Fen. A lizardfolk town built on stilts over the black water, huts joined by rope walks, boats tied under every floor.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 10-24)

A monster hatches in the warm hut over the black water at Stiltscale.

starts.name: Stranger at the Moot
starts.info:
SOLO · Low
📍 Hornmoot, The Long Grass. A trading camp in the long grass round a standing stone with horns carved in it, where the herds meet.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 5-16)

A monster walks into Hornmoot on moot day with no herd behind it.
