quests.name: A Burial in the Sun
quests.info: The skeleton will tell the rest if its bones get buried where the sun can reach them.
quests.goal: Bury them by the Old Shrine
steps: Carry the skeleton's bones up the Mouth.
Bury them by the Old Shrine.

quests.name: A Run to the Atoll
quests.info: Grell wants a crate taken out to Smugglers' Atoll and nobody asking what's in it.
quests.goal: Hand it over at the Lagoon Market
steps: Sail the crate out to the Atoll Dock.
Hand it over at the Lagoon Market.

quests.name: A Seat at the Table
quests.info: The bosses meet in the Big Hall to decide who gets the empty seat.
quests.goal: Win the empty seat
steps: Stand before the Big Table in the Big Hall.
Win the empty seat.

quests.name: Ask the Whispers
quests.info: Yarra wants the oldest voices in the Whispering Deep asked one question: what is the dungeon waiting for.
quests.goal: Ask them what the dungeon is waiting for
steps: Find the Old Voices in the Whispering Deep.
Ask them what the dungeon is waiting for.

quests.name: Biter's Dive
quests.info: Grell wants something brought up from where the caves meet the dungeon.
quests.goal: Bring up what Grell asked for
steps: Go down the Drowned Caves past the tide line.
Bring up what Grell asked for.

quests.name: Biter's Raid
quests.info: The pack wants the Salt Lick for a night.
quests.goal: Drive the herders off it
steps: Raid the Salt Lick with the pack.
Drive the herders off it.

quests.name: Blood in the Run
quests.info: Something is killing Grell's hunters in the Shark Run, and it isn't another shark.
quests.goal: Kill it
steps: Hunt the Fin Channels for whatever is killing the Red Fins.
Kill it.

quests.name: Bone Clerk's Count
quests.info: The council wants the chapel's crypt counted, every bone.
quests.goal: Count the crypt's dead and bring Ashwick the number
steps: Go down into the Gargoyle Chapel's crypt.
Count the crypt's dead and bring Ashwick the number.

quests.name: Bone-Calling
quests.info: Yarra throws the bones and they point at Hornmoot.
quests.goal: Bring back what he knows
steps: Find the witch's friend inside Hornmoot.
Bring back what he knows.

quests.name: Bones That Remember
quests.info: Pip has heard that some of the skeletons in the Ossuary still know who they were.
quests.goal: Hear what it remembers of the last day
steps: Find a skeleton in the Ossuary that remembers its name.
Hear what it remembers of the last day.

quests.name: Boss's Trial
quests.info: Grisk wants the First Keeper's Door opened and whatever waits behind it dead.
quests.goal: Kill the keeper of the Upper Halls
steps: Reach the First Keeper's Door.
Kill the keeper of the Upper Halls.

quests.name: Burn It Out
quests.info: Mother Bark says the crack has to be closed and the rot burned, all of it.
quests.goal: Close the crack into the dungeon
steps: Burn the rot out of Rot Hollow.
Close the crack into the dungeon.

quests.name: Chum's Swim
quests.info: Grell wants to see if the party will go in the water after him.
quests.goal: Bring back what's in its hold
steps: Swim out to the farthest wreck with the Fins.
Bring back what's in its hold.

quests.name: Crypt Warden's Errand
quests.info: The council's payment to the Red Keep is due, and the last one to carry it didn't come out.
quests.goal: Come back out
steps: Carry the council's payment into the Red Keep.
Come back out.

quests.name: Down the Cold Pit
quests.info: Kessa wants company going down the coldest pit at night.
quests.goal: Find where the heat is going
steps: Go down the coldest of the Forge Pits with Kessa.
Find where the heat is going.

quests.name: Down the Mouth
quests.info: Grisk wants proof the party can go down the Mouth and come back.
quests.goal: Bring back something from the Upper Halls worth a boss's time
steps: Go down the Mouth into the First Hall.
Bring back something from the Upper Halls worth a boss's time.

quests.name: Down the Old Road
quests.info: Mother Bark wants someone to follow the old road south to the temple the roots come from.
quests.goal: Ask the lizardfolk why nobody climbs past the third step
steps: Reach the Temple Steps of the Sunken Temple.
Ask the lizardfolk why nobody climbs past the third step.

quests.name: Enforcer's Test
quests.info: Someone is stealing from the Swap Ground and the Table wants it stopped.
quests.goal: Make an example of them in front of the Big Hall
steps: Find the thief on the Swap Ground.
Make an example of them in front of the Big Hall.

quests.name: Fin's Raid
quests.info: There's a ship on the rocks and the Fins want it before Saltreef does.
quests.goal: Paint the red fin on it
steps: Reach the ship before Saltreef's salvagers.
Paint the red fin on it.

quests.name: Fire on Watch Hill
quests.info: The signal fire on Watch Hill was laid with new wood. Ashwick wants it watched.
quests.goal: See what is coming from the west
steps: Hold Watch Hill for a night.
See what is coming from the west.

quests.name: Fire With No Fuel
quests.info: Kessa wants to know what keeps the brass forges hot with no fire in them.
quests.goal: Find out what works the forges
steps: Get through the Brass Doors.
Find out what works the forges.

quests.name: Fresh Prints
quests.info: Ashwick wants the boot prints on the old road read by someone who knows tracks.
quests.goal: Work out how old the prints are and which way they go
steps: Follow the Boot Tracks.
Work out how old the prints are and which way they go.

quests.name: Gallery Warden
quests.info: The hive needs iron and Tik wants a deal struck for it outside the mountain.
quests.goal: Bring the deal back to Tik of the Ledge
steps: Strike a deal for iron with a town outside the Spine.
Bring the deal back to Tik of the Ledge.

quests.name: Grass-Run
quests.info: Brannoc wants a message carried to every herd's tent before dark.
quests.goal: Be back at the Moot Ring by dark
steps: Carry the chief's word to every herd in the Tent Rows.
Be back at the Moot Ring by dark.

quests.name: Grave-Hand's Round
quests.info: Ashwick wants the lamps in the Crypt Rows lit and a debt collected.
quests.goal: Collect a debt from a ghoul in the Bone Market
steps: Light the lamps along the Crypt Rows.
Collect a debt from a ghoul in the Bone Market.

quests.name: Hand's Work
quests.info: The Table wants the den held for a night against whatever comes up out of it.
quests.goal: Report to Grisk Ironjaw what came up
steps: Hold the Sinkhole Den through the night.
Report to Grisk Ironjaw what came up.

quests.name: Hauler's Load
quests.info: Tik wants to see the party carry the hive's weight without dropping it.
quests.goal: Bring it to the Guest Ledge whole
steps: Carry a load through the Ore Galleries in the line.
Bring it to the Guest Ledge whole.

quests.name: Herd Watch
quests.info: Someone has been running stock off the Salt Lick at night.
quests.goal: Find out who is running the stock off
steps: Watch the Salt Lick through the night.
Find out who is running the stock off.

quests.name: Horn Oath
quests.info: Brannoc wants the party to swear on the horn stone in front of the herds.
quests.goal: Settle a dispute in the Moot Ring by the moot law
steps: Swear on the Horn Stone in front of the herds.
Settle a dispute in the Moot Ring by the moot law.

quests.name: Lamplighter's Walk
quests.info: A dead thing has been walking out of the Crypt Rows at night and not coming back.
quests.goal: Bring it back or put it down
steps: Follow the walker out of the Crypt Rows.
Bring it back or put it down.

quests.name: Orders for Antfront
quests.info: Tik wants a sealed order carried down past the Crawling Halls to the camp at Antfront.
quests.goal: Bring the soldiers' answer back to Tik
steps: Carry the hive's order to the Mandible Gate.
Bring the soldiers' answer back to Tik.

quests.name: Past the Second Door
quests.info: The hive wants the way under the Middle Depths open, and the keeper is in the way.
quests.goal: Kill the keeper of the Middle Depths
steps: Reach the Middle Keeper's Door.
Kill the keeper of the Middle Depths.

quests.name: Run With the Pack
quests.info: Yarra wants to see if the party can keep up on a night run.
quests.goal: Bring down the first kill
steps: Run with the pack through the long grass at night.
Bring down the first kill.

quests.name: Runner's Errand
quests.info: Grisk wants to see if the party can run the Table's word round town without getting it wrong.
quests.goal: Bring back what Pell owes the Table
steps: Carry the Table's word to Hollin at the Caravan Yard.
Bring back what Pell owes the Table.

quests.name: The Fire at the Top
quests.info: Tik wants to know why the frost ogres built a stair to come south and never came.
quests.goal: Ask the frost ogres why they never came south
steps: Climb Giant's Stair to the Giants' Fire.
Ask the frost ogres why they never came south.

quests.name: The Gate of Fire
quests.info: Kessa wants someone to see the gate the imps keep watching, and tell her it will hold.
quests.goal: Find out what is pushing on it
steps: Reach the Fire Gate.
Find out what is pushing on it.

quests.name: The Guild's Last Page
quests.info: Pip wants someone to look at the last page and believe him.
quests.goal: Show it to Councillor Ashwick in Stillbarrow
steps: Read the last page in the Old Guildhouse cellar with Pip.
Show it to Councillor Ashwick in Stillbarrow.

quests.name: The Island That Moves
quests.info: Grell's charts put Turtle Back somewhere else every year. He wants to know why.
quests.goal: Find out why the island moves
steps: Land on Shell Shore.
Find out why the island moves.

quests.name: The Lantern Names
quests.info: Pip wants every name off the lanterns copied down without putting a single one out.
quests.goal: Bring the names back to Pip
steps: Copy the names off the lanterns in Lantern Row.
Bring the names back to Pip.

quests.name: The Letter on the Table
quests.info: There's a letter on a table at the Millhouse addressed to whoever comes next. Ashwick wants it read.
quests.goal: Read it
steps: Find the letter in the Millhouse.
Read it.

quests.name: The Lit Window
quests.info: Grell wants to know who keeps a light burning on the Black Island.
quests.goal: Find out who keeps the window lit
steps: Cross the Lightless Lake to the Black Island.
Find out who keeps the window lit.

quests.name: The Middle of the Maze
quests.info: The diggers came up into the Labyrinth from below, and the minotaurs won't say what is in the middle.
quests.goal: Come back out with what is kept there
steps: Find the centre of the Labyrinth.
Come back out with what is kept there.

quests.name: The Missing Young
quests.info: Kessa's niece went down to the Salamander Deeps to be blessed and never came back.
quests.goal: Bring her up alive
steps: Find Kessa's niece in the Salamander Deeps.
Bring her up alive.

quests.name: The Night at Riverfork
quests.info: Every tribe that built at Riverfork Clearing died in one night. Mother Bark wants to know what they heard.
quests.goal: Find out what the old tribes heard before the end
steps: Camp a night on the Riverbank at Riverfork Clearing.
Find out what the old tribes heard before the end.

quests.name: The Oldest Drake
quests.info: The ogres say the oldest frost drake in Wyrm Ice has never once woken. Tik wants to know what it's guarding.
quests.goal: See what it is curled round
steps: Find the oldest drake in the Ice Caves without waking it.
See what it is curled round.

quests.name: The Open Gate
quests.info: Ashwick wants to know if the humans' capital is as empty as everyone says.
quests.goal: Reach the Throne Hall
steps: Go in through the West Gate.
Reach the Throne Hall.

quests.name: The Queen's Voice
quests.info: Tik wants the party to stand before the queen.
quests.goal: Hear what the queen asks
steps: Go down to the Queen's Gallery with Tik.
Hear what the queen asks.

quests.name: The Soul Well
quests.info: Yarra wants to know what happens to a soul at the bottom of the Great Dungeon.
quests.goal: Look into it
steps: Reach the Soul Well.
Look into it.

quests.name: The Sunk Ledgers
quests.info: Grell wants the ledgers out of the drowned market before the merfolk sell them to someone else.
quests.goal: Bring them to Tide Boss Grell
steps: Find the ledgers in the Sunk Stalls.
Bring them to Tide Boss Grell.

quests.name: The Thing in the Halls
quests.info: Monsters coming up the Mouth say something in the Upper Halls is eating the dungeon's children.
quests.goal: Kill it or drive it down
steps: Find what is eating the dungeon's children.
Kill it or drive it down.

quests.name: The Witch's Hand
quests.info: Yarra wants blood spilled inside the moot ring and no one to see who did it.
quests.goal: Break the moot law
steps: Get into the Moot Ring unseen.
Break the moot law.

quests.name: Tide Boss's Due
quests.info: Grell wants the Flooded Halls' way kept open, whatever it costs.
quests.goal: Hold it until the Fins come through
steps: Clear the way from the Drowned Caves into the Flooded Halls.
Hold it until the Fins come through.

quests.name: Tracks in the March
quests.info: Ashwick wants the party to go to the empty forts and see if they are empty.
quests.goal: Find out who has been sleeping in the barracks
steps: Reach the Last Fort.
Find out who has been sleeping in the barracks.

quests.name: Tunnel Hand
quests.info: Something has been taking diggers at the Iron Seam.
quests.goal: Find what has been taking them
steps: Guard the diggers at the Iron Seam for a day.
Find what has been taking them.

quests.name: Under the Ribs
quests.info: Mother Bark wants to know what could kill a beast that big.
quests.goal: Find what killed the biggest one
steps: Walk the Rib Road through Titan Bones.
Find what killed the biggest one.

quests.name: Warden of the Ring
quests.info: The gnolls have been seen too close to the moot. Brannoc wants them pushed back.
quests.goal: Push the gnolls back from the grass road
steps: Go to the Bonefield.
Push the gnolls back from the grass road.

quests.name: Warm Ground
quests.info: Tik wants to know why there's warm ground in the middle of all that ice.
quests.goal: Listen to what comes up with the steam
steps: Spend a night by the Steam Pools.
Listen to what comes up with the steam.

quests.name: What Drinks the Fire
quests.info: Something in the Burning Halls is drinking Cinderforge's heat.
quests.goal: Kill it or stop it
steps: Find what is drinking the heat in the Burning Halls.
Kill it or stop it.

quests.name: What the Kraken Keeps
quests.info: Grell lost a boat on the Black Reef, and he wants to know what the kraken is sitting on.
quests.goal: Find what the kraken took off the human ship
steps: Row out to the Black Reef.
Find what the kraken took off the human ship.

quests.name: Where the Roads Meet
quests.info: Yarra wants a handful of the boiling water from where the fire road and the water road meet.
quests.goal: Bring it back to Witch Yarra
steps: Fill a flask at the Meeting Pool.
Bring it back to Witch Yarra.

quests.name: White Floor
quests.info: The rot in Rot Hollow is spreading, and Mother Bark wants to know what's at the middle of it.
quests.goal: Find what is spreading the rot
steps: Go to the middle of Rot Hollow.
Find what is spreading the rot.

say.label: Take a fallen foe's soul
say.how: Right after a kill, within two turns: name the soul and take it, or eat the body. Each race's souls stack toward its gifts and, at ten, its Soul.

examples: I absorb the goblin's soul
I devour its soul
I eat the fallen orc
I tear into the corpse

say.label: Make a place your home
say.how: Where you stand, saying you live here now. One home; everything you claim later answers to it.

examples: This cave is our home now
We settle here and make it our den

say.label: Claim a place as yours
say.how: Where you stand, once you have a home: plant your mark and it pays into your kingdom.

examples: I plant our banner and claim this place
I mark this ground as ours

say.label: Ask someone to live at your home
say.how: Once you have a home, with them in the scene.

examples: Come live with us at the den
Join us, you're one of us now

say.label: Give a resident a post
say.how: Once someone lives at your home: name the post they keep.

needs: with someone living at your home
examples: Brannoc, you guard the gate
I put her in charge of the stores

say.label: Start a build project
say.how: At home, once the kingdom is ready to grow.

needs: when the kingdom is ready to build
examples: We start building a wall around the den
I want to upgrade the hall

say.label: Stash goods at home
say.how: Once you have a home: store or take back what you carry.

examples: I store the ore in the larder
I withdraw the hides from the vault
Fetch me the hides from the stores
How much ore do we have?

say.label: Hit back at raiders
say.how: After your home or a holding was raided: go after the ones who did it.

examples: We raid their camp and pay them back
I attack the raiders' hideout

say.label: Swear to a faction
say.how: In a scene, naming the faction, before someone with the standing to accept it.

examples: I swear an oath to the Horn Moot
I pledge myself to the Hive

say.label: Ask a faction for a job
say.how: At the faction's seat, sworn to it, asking an officer.

needs: someone carrying Sworn: The Big Table
examples: Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work
Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work

needs: someone carrying Sworn: The Horn Moot
examples: Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work

needs: someone carrying Sworn: The Laughing Pack
examples: Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work

needs: someone carrying Sworn: The Quiet Council
examples: Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work

needs: someone carrying Sworn: The Red Fins
examples: Do you have a job for me?
I ask for work

say.label: Sell one faction out to another
say.how: Sworn to two at once: betray one to the other.

examples: I betray the Hive to the Horn Moot
I sell them out

say.label: Take a caravan
say.how: At a town's caravan yard. Name where you are going; the fare is taken in the scene.

examples: I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Delvers' Rest
We board the wagon to Delvers' Rest
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Cinderforge
We board the wagon to Cinderforge
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Rattle Warren
We board the wagon to Rattle Warren
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Cinderforge
We board the wagon to Cinderforge
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Delvers' Rest
We board the wagon to Delvers' Rest
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Delvers' Rest
We board the wagon to Delvers' Rest
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Hornmoot
We board the wagon to Hornmoot
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Cinderforge
We board the wagon to Cinderforge
I pay the fare and ride the caravan to Delvers' Rest
We board the wagon to Delvers' Rest

say.label: Walk to a place you know
say.how: Name it: the walk lands you there instead of on the road.

examples: I walk to Hornmoot
We head to Greenhill

say.label: Say how your element looks
say.how: Once you hold an element: describe it and the narrator keeps it that way.

examples: My fire burns blue
My lightning comes out green
My shadow looks like smoke

text.homeSay: The exact words that take a soul, make a home, grow your kingdom and swear to a faction.
text.homeMap: Every district on one map: find a place, show one district.
text.ledePeople: Everyone the Wildreach introduces you to, with where to find them.
text.ledePlaces: Towns, dens, wilds and the dungeon under the Wildreach.
text.ledeCreatures: Every race you can meet, fight and take souls from.
text.ledeLore: History, souls and places of the Wildreach.
text.ledeMechanics: How the world works, as the guide books every new character carries explain it.
text.ledeMusic: The soundtrack of the Wildreach, by the mood of the scene.
text.ledeDistricts: The districts of the Wildreach, all on the one map.
text.ledeSay: The lines that set off the world's systems.
text.ledeFactions: The moots, packs, hives and tables you can swear to, work for or sell out.
text.ledeItems: Weapons, armour, gear and goods: what each gives, the slot it takes and how you get it.
text.guideSay: Most of the world's systems listen for plain lines.
text.plannerLede: Every pick the creator offers, in its order, with the same unlocks and exclusions. The totals add up what your picks give.
text.benchLede: Build the exact line to type, then run it through the world's own crafting triggers, the same code the game runs, to see what the narrator will be told.

patter: Ladies, gentlemen, and that goblin eating the programme:
patter.people: Everyone in the building, and a few who came in through the roof!
patter.places: Every stage in the house, front of house to the trapdoors!
patter.factions: Pick a side! Pick two! Dreamer once picked them all.
patter.creatures: Mind the beasts, folks. Most of them bite. Some of them clap.
patter.lore: Gather round for the long version, with all the voices!
patter.abilities: The tricks of the trade, and what each one costs!
patter.traits: Pick your costume! It changes everything!
patter.items: Props, every one! Handle with care, return by morning.
patter.starts: Curtain up! Where would you like the story to begin?
patter.quests: Odd jobs for brave volunteers! Dreamer has volunteered you.
patter.map: The whole tour on one page! Dreamer has been everywhere twice.
patter.skills: Practice makes the act! Here is what to practise.
patter.say: Say the magic words. No, really, these exact ones.
patter.planner: Build your act before the curtain goes up!
patter.districts: Every neighbourhood on the tour, each with its own crowd!
patter.guide: First time at the show? Dreamer will walk you in.
patter.search: Lost something? Dreamer finds things. Sometimes the right things.
